name: PshLines.ae_restrict_of_open_neighborhood_ae
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose V hVo hxV hVa using fun x : U => h x x.property
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hEq⟩ := TopologicalSpace.isOpen_iUnion_countable V hVo
  have hcover : U ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ T, V i := by
    rw [hEq]
    intro x hx
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hxV ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  exact ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset hcover
    ((ae_restrict_biUnion_iff (μ := μ) V hT P).2 (fun i _ => hVa i))

name: PshLines.ae_finite_of_subset_pshIntegrabilityLocus
statement:
theorem ae_finite_of_subset_pshIntegrabilityLocus [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {u : E → EReal} {μ : Measure E} {U : Set E}
    (hU : U ⊆ pshIntegrabilityLocus u μ) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict U, u x ≠ ⊤ ∧ u x ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply ae_restrict_of_open_neighborhood_ae
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hfin, _⟩ := hU hx
  exact ⟨V, hV, hxV, hfin⟩

name: PshLines.regularDistribution_congr_ae_on
statement:
theorem regularDistribution_congr_ae_on {μ : Measure E} {u w : E → ℝ}
    (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ) (hw : LocallyIntegrableOn w Ω μ)
    (heq : u =ᵐ[μ.restrict Ω] w) :
    regularDistribution μ u hu = regularDistribution μ w hw
proof:
:= by
  ext φ
  rw [regularDistribution_apply, regularDistribution_apply]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  have heq' : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Ω → u x = w x :=
    (ae_restrict_iff' Ω.isOpen.measurableSet).mp heq
  filter_upwards [heq'] with x hx
  by_cases hxΩ : x ∈ Ω
  · rw [hx hxΩ]
  · have hφx : φ x = 0 :=
      image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hxΩ (φ.tsupport_subset h))
    simp [hφx]

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.ae_finite
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.ae_finite
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u U) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hU : IsPreconnected U) (hne : ∃ a ∈ U, u a ≠ ⊥) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict U, u x ≠ ⊤ ∧ u x ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  ae_finite_of_subset_pshIntegrabilityLocus (hu.subset_pshIntegrabilityLocus μ hU hne)

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.ae_coe_toReal
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.ae_coe_toReal
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u U) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hU : IsPreconnected U) (hne : ∃ a ∈ U, u a ≠ ⊥) :
    (fun x => ((u x).toReal : EReal)) =ᵐ[μ.restrict U] u
proof:
:=
  (hu.ae_finite μ hU hne).mono (fun _ hx => EReal.coe_toReal hx.1 hx.2)

name: PshLines.pshRegularDistribution_apply
statement:
theorem pshRegularDistribution_apply {Ω : Opens E}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hΩ : IsPreconnected (Ω : Set E)) (hne : ∃ a ∈ Ω, u a ≠ ⊥) (φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) :
    pshRegularDistribution hu μ hΩ hne φ = ∫ x, φ x * (u x).toReal ∂μ
proof:
:=
  regularDistribution_apply μ _ (hu.locallyIntegrableOn_toReal μ hΩ hne) φ

name: PshLines.pshRegularDistribution_congr_ae_on
statement:
theorem pshRegularDistribution_congr_ae_on {Ω : Opens E} {w : E → EReal}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω) (hw : PlurisubharmonicOn w Ω)
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] (hΩ : IsPreconnected (Ω : Set E))
    (hnu : ∃ a ∈ Ω, u a ≠ ⊥) (hnw : ∃ a ∈ Ω, w a ≠ ⊥)
    (heq : u =ᵐ[μ.restrict Ω] w) :
    pshRegularDistribution hu μ hΩ hnu = pshRegularDistribution hw μ hΩ hnw
proof:
:= by
  apply regularDistribution_congr_ae_on
  exact heq.mono (fun _ hx => congrArg EReal.toReal hx)

name: PshLines.weighted_circle_lintegral_le_of_pointwise
statement:
theorem weighted_circle_lintegral_le_of_pointwise
    (μ : Measure E) [SFinite μ] {D w : E → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hD : Measurable D) (hw : Measurable w) (v : E) (r : ℝ) {κ : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hpoint : ∀ x ∈ Function.support w,
      (∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi), D (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)) ≤ κ * D x) :
    (∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi),
        ∫⁻ x, w x * D (x + circleMap 0 r t • v) ∂μ) ≤
      κ * ∫⁻ x, w x * D x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : E × ℝ => p.1 + circleMap 0 r p.2 • v) := by
    fun_prop
  have hm : Measurable (fun p : E × ℝ => w p.1 * D (p.1 + circleMap 0 r p.2 • v)) :=
    (hw.comp measurable_fst).mul (hD.comp hc.measurable)
  have hswap := lintegral_lintegral_swap (μ := μ)
    (ν := volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi)))
    (f := fun x t => w x * D (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)) hm.aemeasurable
  have hweighted (x : E) :
      (∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi), w x * D (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)) ≤
        κ * (w x * D x) := by
    by_cases hx : w x = 0
    · simp [hx]
    have hmangle : Measurable (fun t : ℝ => D (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)) :=
      hD.comp (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => x + circleMap 0 r t • v)).measurable
    rw [lintegral_const_mul (w x) hmangle]
    have hs := mul_le_mul_left (hpoint x hx) (w x)
    simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hs
  rw [← hswap]
  exact (lintegral_mono hweighted).trans_eq (lintegral_const_mul κ (hw.mul hD))

name: PshLines.hasDerivAt_polarPoint_radius
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_polarPoint_radius (c : ℂ) (r θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ polarPoint c s θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ) r
proof:
:= by
  simpa [polarPoint] using
    ((hasDerivAt_id r).smul_const (circleMap (0 : ℂ) 1 θ)).const_add c

name: PshLines.hasDerivAt_polarPoint_angle
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_polarPoint_angle (c : ℂ) (r θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (polarPoint c r) (r • (circleMap 0 1 θ * I)) θ
proof:
:= by
  change HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ c + r • circleMap 0 1 t) _ θ
  exact ((hasDerivAt_circleMap 0 1 θ).const_smul r).const_add c

name: PshLines.hasDerivAt_polar_unitTangent
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_polar_unitTangent (θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ circleMap 0 1 t * I) (-circleMap 0 1 θ) θ
proof:
:= by
  simpa [mul_assoc] using (hasDerivAt_circleMap 0 1 θ).mul_const I

name: PshLines.complex_bilinear_rotated_trace
statement:
theorem complex_bilinear_rotated_trace (B : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    B z z + B (z * I) (z * I) = ‖z‖ ^ 2 * (B 1 1 + B I I)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit (w : ℂ) : w = w.re • (1 : ℂ) + w.im • I := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  have hexpand (w t : ℂ) :
      B w t = w.re * (t.re * B 1 1 + t.im * B 1 I) +
        w.im * (t.re * B I 1 + t.im * B I I) := by
    calc
      B w t = B (w.re • (1 : ℂ) + w.im • I) (t.re • (1 : ℂ) + t.im • I) := by
        rw [← hsplit w, ← hsplit t]
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [map_add, map_smul, add_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
  rw [hexpand z z, hexpand (z * I) (z * I), ← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, I_re, I_im, mul_zero, mul_one,
    zero_sub, Complex.normSq_apply]
  ring

name: PshLines.polar_hessian_trace
statement:
theorem polar_hessian_trace (u : ℂ → ℝ) (c : ℂ) (r θ : ℝ) :
    realHessian u (polarPoint c r θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ) +
      realHessian u (polarPoint c r θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ * I) (circleMap 0 1 θ * I) =
        Δ u (polarPoint c r θ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := complex_bilinear_rotated_trace
    (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) (polarPoint c r θ)) (circleMap 0 1 θ)
  simpa [realHessian_eq_fderiv, InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_complexPlane,
    iteratedFDeriv_two_apply] using h

name: PshLines.hasDerivAt_polarRadialDerivative
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_polarRadialDerivative {u : ℂ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (c : ℂ) (r θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ polarRadialDerivative u c s θ)
      (realHessian u (polarPoint c r θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ)) r
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) :=
    (hu.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hc : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ fderiv ℝ u (polarPoint c s θ))
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) (polarPoint c r θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ)) r :=
    (hd (polarPoint c r θ)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt r
      (hasDerivAt_polarPoint_radius c r θ)
  rw [realHessian_eq_fderiv]
  change HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ fderiv ℝ u (polarPoint c s θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ)) _ r
  simpa only [map_zero, add_zero] using!
    hc.clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const r (circleMap (0 : ℂ) 1 θ))

name: PshLines.hasDerivAt_polarRadialFlux
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_polarRadialFlux {u : ℂ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (c : ℂ) (r θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ polarRadialFlux u c s θ)
      (polarRadialDerivative u c r θ + r *
        realHessian u (polarPoint c r θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ)) r
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [polarRadialFlux, Pi.mul_apply, id_eq, one_mul] using!
    (hasDerivAt_id r).mul (hasDerivAt_polarRadialDerivative hu c r θ)

name: PshLines.hasDerivAt_polarAngularDerivative
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_polarAngularDerivative {u : ℂ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (c : ℂ) (r θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (polarAngularDerivative u c r)
      (r * realHessian u (polarPoint c r θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ * I) (circleMap 0 1 θ * I) -
        polarRadialDerivative u c r θ) θ
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) :=
    (hu.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiable (by norm_num)
  have h := ((hd (polarPoint c r θ)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt θ
    (hasDerivAt_polarPoint_angle c r θ)).clm_apply (hasDerivAt_polar_unitTangent θ)
  rw [realHessian_eq_fderiv]
  change HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ fderiv ℝ u (polarPoint c r t) (circleMap 0 1 t * I))
    (r * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) (polarPoint c r θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ * I)
      (circleMap 0 1 θ * I) - fderiv ℝ u (polarPoint c r θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ)) θ
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, map_smul, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_neg,
    sub_eq_add_neg] using! h

name: PshLines.polar_divergence_identity
statement:
theorem polar_divergence_identity {u : ℂ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (c : ℂ) (r θ : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun s ↦ polarRadialFlux u c s θ) r +
      deriv (polarAngularDerivative u c r) θ = r * Δ u (polarPoint c r θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasDerivAt_polarRadialFlux hu c r θ).deriv,
    (hasDerivAt_polarAngularDerivative hu c r θ).deriv,
    ← polar_hessian_trace u c r θ]
  ring

name: PshLines.polarPoint_eq_circleMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem polarPoint_eq_circleMap (c : ℂ) (r θ : ℝ) :
    polarPoint c r θ = circleMap c r θ
proof:
:= by
  simp [polarPoint, circleMap, Complex.real_smul]

name: PshLines.continuous_polarPoint
statement:
theorem continuous_polarPoint (c : ℂ) :
    Continuous (Function.uncurry (polarPoint c))
proof:
:= by
  change Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ c + p.1 • circleMap 0 1 p.2)
  exact continuous_const.add (continuous_fst.smul ((continuous_circleMap 0 1).comp continuous_snd))

name: PshLines.continuous_polarRadialDerivative
statement:
theorem continuous_polarRadialDerivative {u : ℂ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (c : ℂ) : Continuous (Function.uncurry (polarRadialDerivative u c))
proof:
:= by
  exact ((hu.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).comp (continuous_polarPoint c)).clm_apply
    ((continuous_circleMap 0 1).comp continuous_snd)

name: PshLines.continuous_polarRadialFlux
statement:
theorem continuous_polarRadialFlux {u : ℂ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (c : ℂ) : Continuous (Function.uncurry (polarRadialFlux u c))
proof:
:= by
  exact continuous_fst.mul (continuous_polarRadialDerivative hu c)

name: PshLines.continuous_polarHessian
statement:
theorem continuous_polarHessian {u : ℂ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (c : ℂ) (a b : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (ha : Continuous a) (hb : Continuous b) :
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ realHessian u (polarPoint c p.1 p.2) (a p) (b p))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [realHessian_eq_fderiv]
  exact ((((hu.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).comp
    (continuous_polarPoint c)).clm_apply ha).clm_apply hb

name: PshLines.hasDerivAt_intervalIntegral_of_jointly_continuous
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_intervalIntegral_of_jointly_continuous
    {F F' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} (hF : Continuous F.uncurry)
    (hF' : Continuous F'.uncurry) (hderiv : ∀ r θ, HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ F s θ) (F' r θ) r)
    (a b r : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ ∫ θ in a..b, F s θ) (∫ θ in a..b, F' r θ) r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_closedBall r 1).prod (isCompact_uIcc : IsCompact (uIcc a b))).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hF'.continuousOn
  have hFc (s : ℝ) : Continuous (F s) :=
    hF.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  have hF'c (s : ℝ) : Continuous (F' s) :=
    hF'.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  refine (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (F' := F') (bound := fun _ ↦ C) (s := ball r 1) (ball_mem_nhds r (by norm_num))
    ?_ ((hFc r).intervalIntegrable _ _) (hF'c r).aestronglyMeasurable
    ?_ (intervalIntegrable_const) ?_).2
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s ↦ (hFc s).aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards with θ hθ s hs
    exact hC (s, θ) ⟨ball_subset_closedBall hs, uIoc_subset_uIcc hθ⟩
  · filter_upwards with θ _ s _
    exact hderiv s θ

name: PshLines.integral_polarAngularDerivative_deriv_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_polarAngularDerivative_deriv_eq_zero {u : ℂ → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    (∫ θ in 0..2 * π,
      r * realHessian u (polarPoint c r θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ * I) (circleMap 0 1 θ * I) -
        polarRadialDerivative u c r θ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have he : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ circleMap 0 1 p.2 * I) :=
    ((continuous_circleMap 0 1).comp continuous_snd).mul_const I
  have hp : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ ↦ (r, θ)) := continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id
  have hH := (continuous_polarHessian hu c _ _ he he).comp hp
  have hD := (continuous_polarRadialDerivative hu c).comp hp
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (fun θ _ ↦ hasDerivAt_polarAngularDerivative hu c r θ)
    (((hH.const_mul r).sub hD).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
  have heq : circleMap 0 1 (2 * π) = circleMap 0 1 0 := by
    simpa using periodic_circleMap 0 1 0
  simp only [polarAngularDerivative, polarPoint, heq, sub_self]

name: PshLines.hasDerivAt_circleFluxIntegral
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_circleFluxIntegral {u : ℂ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (circleFluxIntegral u c)
      (∫ θ in 0..2 * π, r * Δ u (polarPoint c r θ)) r
proof:
:= by
  let F' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun s θ ↦ polarRadialDerivative u c s θ +
    s * realHessian u (polarPoint c s θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ)
  let G' : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ ↦ r *
    realHessian u (polarPoint c r θ) (circleMap 0 1 θ * I) (circleMap 0 1 θ * I) -
      polarRadialDerivative u c r θ
  have he : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ circleMap 0 1 p.2) :=
    (continuous_circleMap 0 1).comp continuous_snd
  have heI := he.mul_const I
  have hp : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ ↦ (r, θ)) := continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id
  have hF' : Continuous F'.uncurry := (continuous_polarRadialDerivative hu c).add
    (continuous_fst.mul (continuous_polarHessian hu c _ _ he he))
  have hG' : Continuous G' :=
    (((continuous_polarHessian hu c _ _ heI heI).comp hp).const_mul r).sub
      ((continuous_polarRadialDerivative hu c).comp hp)
  have hd := hasDerivAt_intervalIntegral_of_jointly_continuous
    (continuous_polarRadialFlux hu c) hF'
      (fun s θ ↦ hasDerivAt_polarRadialFlux hu c s θ) 0 (2 * π) r
  have hzero : (∫ θ in 0..2 * π, G' θ) = 0 :=
    integral_polarAngularDerivative_deriv_eq_zero hu c r
  have hsum : (∫ θ in 0..2 * π, F' r θ) =
      ∫ θ in 0..2 * π, r * Δ u (polarPoint c r θ) := by
    calc
      (∫ θ in 0..2 * π, F' r θ) =
          (∫ θ in 0..2 * π, F' r θ) + ∫ θ in 0..2 * π, G' θ := by rw [hzero, add_zero]
      _ = ∫ θ in 0..2 * π, F' r θ + G' θ :=
        (intervalIntegral.integral_add ((hF'.comp hp).intervalIntegrable _ _)
          (hG'.intervalIntegrable _ _)).symm
      _ = ∫ θ in 0..2 * π, r * Δ u (polarPoint c r θ) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro θ _
        dsimp [F', G']
        rw [← polar_hessian_trace u c r θ]
        ring
  change HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ ∫ θ in 0..2 * π, polarRadialFlux u c s θ) _ r
  rw [← hsum]
  exact hd

name: PshLines.hasDerivAt_circleAverage_radius
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_circleAverage_radius {u : ℂ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (Real.circleAverage u c)
      ((2 * π)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in 0..2 * π, polarRadialDerivative u c r θ) r
proof:
:= by
  have hderiv (s θ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ u (polarPoint c t θ))
      (polarRadialDerivative u c s θ) s := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, polarRadialDerivative] using
      ((hu.differentiable (by norm_num)) (polarPoint c s θ)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s
        (hasDerivAt_polarPoint_radius c s θ)
  have h := hasDerivAt_intervalIntegral_of_jointly_continuous
    (F := fun s θ ↦ u (polarPoint c s θ))
    (hu.continuous.comp (continuous_polarPoint c)) (continuous_polarRadialDerivative hu c)
    hderiv 0 (2 * π) r
  change HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ Real.circleAverage u c s) _ r
  simpa only [Real.circleAverage_def, polarPoint_eq_circleMap, smul_eq_mul] using!
    h.const_mul ((2 * π)⁻¹)

name: PshLines.polarPoint_mem_closedBall
statement:
theorem polarPoint_mem_closedBall (c : ℂ) {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r ≤ R)
    (θ : ℝ) : polarPoint c r θ ∈ closedBall c R
proof:
:= by
  rw [polarPoint_eq_circleMap]
  exact closedBall_subset_closedBall hrR (circleMap_mem_closedBall c hr θ)

name: PshLines.circleFluxIntegral_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem circleFluxIntegral_zero (u : ℂ → ℝ) (c : ℂ) :
    circleFluxIntegral u c 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [circleFluxIntegral, polarRadialFlux]

name: PshLines.circleFluxIntegral_monotoneOn
statement:
theorem circleFluxIntegral_monotoneOn {u : ℂ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (c : ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hΔ : ∀ z ∈ closedBall c R, 0 ≤ Δ u z) :
    MonotoneOn (circleFluxIntegral u c) (Icc 0 R)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Differentiable ℝ (circleFluxIntegral u c) :=
    fun r ↦ (hasDerivAt_circleFluxIntegral hu c r).differentiableAt
  apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _)
    hd.continuous.continuousOn hd.differentiableOn
  intro r hr
  have hr' : r ∈ Icc 0 R := interior_subset hr
  rw [(hasDerivAt_circleFluxIntegral hu c r).deriv]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall (by positivity)
  intro θ
  exact mul_nonneg hr'.1 (hΔ _ (polarPoint_mem_closedBall c hr'.1 hr'.2 θ))

name: PshLines.circleFluxIntegral_nonneg
statement:
theorem circleFluxIntegral_nonneg {u : ℂ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (c : ℂ) {R r : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hΔ : ∀ z ∈ closedBall c R, 0 ≤ Δ u z)
    (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 R) : 0 ≤ circleFluxIntegral u c r
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [circleFluxIntegral_zero] using
    (circleFluxIntegral_monotoneOn hu c hΔ) ⟨le_rfl, hR⟩ hr hr.1

name: PshLines.circleAverage_monotoneOn_of_laplacian_nonneg
statement:
theorem circleAverage_monotoneOn_of_laplacian_nonneg {u : ℂ → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (c : ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hΔ : ∀ z ∈ closedBall c R, 0 ≤ Δ u z) :
    MonotoneOn (Real.circleAverage u c) (Icc 0 R)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Differentiable ℝ (Real.circleAverage u c) :=
    fun r ↦ (hasDerivAt_circleAverage_radius hu c r).differentiableAt
  apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _)
    hd.continuous.continuousOn hd.differentiableOn
  intro r hr
  have hr' : 0 < r ∧ r < R := by simpa only [interior_Icc, mem_Ioo] using hr
  have hflux := circleFluxIntegral_nonneg hu c hR hΔ ⟨hr'.1.le, hr'.2.le⟩
  have hrad : 0 ≤ ∫ θ in 0..2 * π, polarRadialDerivative u c r θ := by
    apply (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hr'.1).mp
    simpa only [circleFluxIntegral, polarRadialFlux, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      using hflux
  rw [(hasDerivAt_circleAverage_radius hu c r).deriv]
  exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) hrad

name: PshLines.submean_of_laplacian_nonneg
statement:
theorem submean_of_laplacian_nonneg {u : ℂ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (c : ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hΔ : ∀ z ∈ closedBall c R, 0 ≤ Δ u z) :
    u c ≤ Real.circleAverage u c R
proof:
:= by
  have h := (circleAverage_monotoneOn_of_laplacian_nonneg hu c hR hΔ)
    ⟨le_rfl, hR⟩ ⟨hR, le_rfl⟩ hR
  simpa only [Real.circleAverage_zero] using h

name: PshLines.ae_ne_bot_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top
statement:
theorem ae_ne_bot_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top
    (hd : AEMeasurable (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) μ)
    (hI : ∫⁻ x, ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal ∂μ < ⊤) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, u x ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [ae_lt_top' hd hI.ne] with x hx
  intro hbot
  simp only [hbot, EReal.coe_sub_bot, EReal.toENNReal_top, lt_self_iff_false] at hx

name: PshLines.ae_coe_toReal_eq_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top
statement:
theorem ae_coe_toReal_eq_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top
    (hC : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, u x ≤ (C : EReal))
    (hd : AEMeasurable (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) μ)
    (hI : ∫⁻ x, ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal ∂μ < ⊤) :
    (fun x => ((u x).toReal : EReal)) =ᶠ[ae μ] u
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hC, ae_ne_bot_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top hd hI] with x hx hbot
  exact EReal.coe_toReal (hx.trans_lt (EReal.coe_lt_top C)).ne hbot

name: PshLines.ae_toReal_eq_const_sub_deficit_of_lintegral_lt_top
statement:
theorem ae_toReal_eq_const_sub_deficit_of_lintegral_lt_top
    (hC : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, u x ≤ (C : EReal))
    (hd : AEMeasurable (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) μ)
    (hI : ∫⁻ x, ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal ∂μ < ⊤) :
    (fun x => (u x).toReal) =ᶠ[ae μ]
      (fun x => C - ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal.toReal)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hC, ae_ne_bot_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top hd hI] with x hx hbot
  have htop : u x ≠ ⊤ := (hx.trans_lt (EReal.coe_lt_top C)).ne
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (C : EReal) - u x :=
    (EReal.sub_nonneg (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_top C))
      (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_bot C))).mpr hx
  rw [EReal.toReal_toENNReal hnonneg,
    EReal.toReal_sub (EReal.coe_ne_top C) (EReal.coe_ne_bot C) htop hbot,
    EReal.toReal_coe]
  exact (sub_sub_cancel C (u x).toReal).symm

name: PshLines.integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top
statement:
theorem integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hC : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, u x ≤ (C : EReal))
    (hd : AEMeasurable (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) μ)
    (hI : ∫⁻ x, ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal ∂μ < ⊤) :
    Integrable (fun x => (u x).toReal) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hdef := integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_ne_top hd hI.ne
  exact ((integrable_const C).sub hdef).congr
    (ae_toReal_eq_const_sub_deficit_of_lintegral_lt_top hC hd hI).symm

name: PshLines.ae_finite_and_integrable_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top
statement:
theorem ae_finite_and_integrable_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hC : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, u x ≤ (C : EReal))
    (hd : AEMeasurable (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) μ)
    (hI : ∫⁻ x, ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal ∂μ < ⊤) :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, u x ≠ ⊤ ∧ u x ≠ ⊥) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => (u x).toReal) μ ∧
      ((fun x => ((u x).toReal : EReal)) =ᶠ[ae μ] u)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top hC hd hI,
    ae_coe_toReal_eq_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top hC hd hI⟩
  filter_upwards [hC, ae_ne_bot_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top hd hI] with x hx hbot
  exact ⟨(hx.trans_lt (EReal.coe_lt_top C)).ne, hbot⟩

name: PshLines.ae_finite_and_integrableOn_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top
statement:
theorem ae_finite_and_integrableOn_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top {s : Set X}
    (hμs : μ s < ⊤)
    (hC : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, u x ≤ (C : EReal))
    (hd : AEMeasurable (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) (μ.restrict s))
    (hI : ∫⁻ x in s, ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal ∂μ < ⊤) :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, u x ≠ ⊤ ∧ u x ≠ ⊥) ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun x => (u x).toReal) s μ ∧
      ((fun x => ((u x).toReal : EReal)) =ᶠ[ae (μ.restrict s)] u)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure (μ.restrict s) := ⟨by simpa using hμs⟩
  exact ae_finite_and_integrable_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top hC hd hI

name: PshLines.realHessian_eq_fderiv
statement:
theorem realHessian_eq_fderiv (u : E → ℝ) (x v w : E) :
    realHessian u x v w = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x v w
proof:
:= by
  simp [realHessian, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]

name: PshLines.realHessian_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem realHessian_const (c : ℝ) (x v w : E) :
    realHessian (fun _ : E ↦ c) x v w = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [realHessian, iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne two_ne_zero]

name: PshLines.realHessian_add
proof:
:= by
  simp [realHessian, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply hu hv]

name: PshLines.realHessian_smul
statement:
theorem realHessian_smul {u : E → ℝ} {x : E} (hu : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 u x)
    (c : ℝ) (a b : E) :
    realHessian (c • u) x a b = c * realHessian u x a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [realHessian, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hu]

name: PshLines.realHessian_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem realHessian_neg (u : E → ℝ) (x a b : E) :
    realHessian (-u) x a b = -realHessian u x a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [realHessian, iteratedFDeriv_neg_apply]

name: PshLines.realHessian_zero_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem realHessian_zero_left (u : E → ℝ) (x b : E) :
    realHessian u x 0 b = 0
proof:
:= by

name: PshLines.realHessian_zero_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem realHessian_zero_right (u : E → ℝ) (x a : E) :
    realHessian u x a 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [realHessian_eq_fderiv]

name: PshLines.realHessian_smul_left
statement:
theorem realHessian_smul_left (u : E → ℝ) (x a b : E) (c : ℝ) :
    realHessian u x (c • a) b = c * realHessian u x a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [realHessian_eq_fderiv]

name: PshLines.realHessian_smul_right
statement:
theorem realHessian_smul_right (u : E → ℝ) (x a b : E) (c : ℝ) :
    realHessian u x a (c • b) = c * realHessian u x a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [realHessian_eq_fderiv]

name: PshLines.realHessian_comp_affine
statement:
theorem realHessian_comp_affine {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    [NormedSpace ℝ F] {u : E → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (A : F →L[ℝ] E) (x : E) (z a b : F) :
    realHessian (fun y ↦ u (x + A y)) z a b =
      realHessian u (x + A z) (A a) (A b)
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y : E ↦ u (x + y)) :=
    hu.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id)
  have h := congrArg (fun B ↦ B ![a, b])
    (A.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right hshift z (i := 2) le_rfl)
  have hvec : (fun i ↦ A (![a, b] i)) = ![A a, A b] := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  simpa only [realHessian, Function.comp_def,
    ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left, hvec] using h

name: PshLines.realHessian_norm_sq
statement:
theorem realHessian_norm_sq (x a b : H) :
    realHessian (fun y : H ↦ ‖y‖ ^ 2) x a b = 2 * inner ℝ a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [realHessian_eq_fderiv, fderiv_norm_sq,
    fderiv_const_smul (innerSL ℝ).differentiableAt]
  simp
  rfl

name: PshLines.leviForm_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem leviForm_const (c : ℝ) (x v : E) :
    leviForm (fun _ : E ↦ c) x v = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [leviForm]

name: PshLines.leviForm_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem leviForm_zero (u : E → ℝ) (x : E) : leviForm u x 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [leviForm]

name: PshLines.leviForm_add
proof:
:= by
  simp only [leviForm, realHessian_add hu hv]
  ring

name: PshLines.leviForm_smul
statement:
theorem leviForm_smul {u : E → ℝ} {x : E} (hu : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 u x)
    (c : ℝ) (a : E) :
    leviForm (c • u) x a = c * leviForm u x a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [leviForm, realHessian_smul hu]

name: PshLines.leviForm_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem leviForm_neg (u : E → ℝ) (x a : E) :

proof:

name: PshLines.complexLineLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem complexLineLinear_apply (v : E) (z : ℂ) :
    complexLineLinear v z = z • v
proof: := rfl

name: PshLines.realHessian_complexLine
statement:
theorem realHessian_complexLine {u : E → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (x v : E) (z a b : ℂ) :
    realHessian (fun t : ℂ ↦ u (x + t • v)) z a b =
      realHessian u (x + z • v) (a • v) (b • v)
proof:
:= by
  exact realHessian_comp_affine hu (complexLineLinear v) x z a b

name: PshLines.laplacian_complexLine
statement:
theorem laplacian_complexLine {u : E → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (x v : E) (z : ℂ) :
    Δ (fun t : ℂ ↦ u (x + t • v)) z = 4 * leviForm u (x + z • v) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_complexPlane]
  change realHessian (fun t : ℂ ↦ u (x + t • v)) z 1 1 +
    realHessian (fun t : ℂ ↦ u (x + t • v)) z Complex.I Complex.I = _
  rw [realHessian_complexLine hu, realHessian_complexLine hu]
  simp only [one_smul, leviForm]
  ring

name: PshLines.laplacian_complexLine_nonneg_iff
statement:
theorem laplacian_complexLine_nonneg_iff {u : E → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (x v : E) (z : ℂ) :
    0 ≤ Δ (fun t : ℂ ↦ u (x + t • v)) z ↔ 0 ≤ leviForm u (x + z • v) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [laplacian_complexLine hu]
  exact mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4)

name: PshLines.leviForm_norm_sq
statement:
theorem leviForm_norm_sq (x v : E) :
    leviForm (fun y : E ↦ ‖y‖ ^ 2) x v = ‖v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [leviForm, realHessian_norm_sq, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
    norm_smul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul]
  ring

name: PshLines.leviForm_norm_sq_nonneg
statement:
theorem leviForm_norm_sq_nonneg (x v : E) :
    0 ≤ leviForm (fun y : E ↦ ‖y‖ ^ 2) x v
proof:
:= by
  rw [leviForm_norm_sq]
  positivity

name: PshLines.leviForm_norm_sq_pos
statement:
theorem leviForm_norm_sq_pos (x : E) {v : E} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    0 < leviForm (fun y : E ↦ ‖y‖ ^ 2) x v
proof:
:= by
  rw [leviForm_norm_sq]
  exact sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hv)

name: PshLines.circleAverage_pairing_le_of_pointwise_circle_lintegral
statement:
theorem circleAverage_pairing_le_of_pointwise_circle_lintegral
    {D : E → ℝ≥0∞} {f φ : E → ℝ}
    (hDm : Measurable D) (hDf : D =ᵐ[μ] fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x))
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 2 φ) (hφn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (v : E) (r : ℝ)
    (hpoint : ∀ x ∈ Function.support φ,
      (∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi), D (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * D x) :
    Real.circleAverage (fun z : ℂ => translationPairing μ f φ (z • v)) 0 r ≤
      translationPairing μ f φ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hm := weighted_circle_lintegral_le_of_pointwise μ hDm
    hφ.continuous.measurable.ennreal_ofReal v r (κ := ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi)) (by
      intro x hx
      apply hpoint x
      intro hx0
      exact hx (by simp [hx0]))
  have hinner (a : E) := lintegral_deficit_translate_eq_ofReal_pairing
    hDf hf hfn hφs hφ.continuous hφn a
  have hzero : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x) * D x ∂μ) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (translationPairing μ f φ 0) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using hinner 0
  simp_rw [hinner] at hm
  rw [hzero] at hm
  have hn (z : ℂ) : 0 ≤ translationPairing μ f φ (z • v) :=
    integral_nonneg (fun x => mul_nonneg (hfn x) (hφn (x - z • v)))
  simpa only [zero_smul] using circleAverage_le_of_lintegral_ofReal_le
    (contDiff_translationPairing_complexLine hf hφs hφ v).continuous hn r
      (by simpa only [zero_smul] using hm)

name: PshLines.integral_mul_leviForm_nonpos_of_pointwise_circle_lintegral
statement:
theorem integral_mul_leviForm_nonpos_of_pointwise_circle_lintegral
    {D : E → ℝ≥0∞} {f φ : E → ℝ}
    (hDm : Measurable D) (hDf : D =ᵐ[μ] fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x))
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 2 φ) (hφn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (v : E) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hpoint : ∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 R, ∀ x ∈ Function.support φ,
      (∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi), D (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * D x) :
    (∫ x, f x * leviForm φ x v ∂μ) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  let h : ℂ → ℝ := fun z => translationPairing μ f φ (z • v)
  have hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h := contDiff_translationPairing_complexLine hf hφs hφ v
  have hmean (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioo 0 R) : (-h) 0 ≤ Real.circleAverage (-h) 0 r := by
    have hm := circleAverage_pairing_le_of_pointwise_circle_lintegral
      hDm hDf hf hfn hφs hφ hφn v r (hpoint r hr)
    have hneg : Real.circleAverage (-h) 0 r = -Real.circleAverage h 0 r := by
      simpa only [neg_one_smul] using
        (Real.circleAverage_smul (f := h) (c := 0) (R := r) (a := (-1 : ℝ)))
    rw [hneg]
    simpa only [h, Pi.neg_apply, zero_smul] using neg_le_neg hm
  have hΔ := laplacian_nonneg_of_circleAverage_submean hh.neg 0 hR hmean
  have hline := laplacian_complexLine (contDiff_translationPairing hf hφs hφ)
    (0 : E) v (0 : ℂ)
  simp only [zero_add, zero_smul] at hline
  rw [leviForm_translationPairing hf hφs hφ] at hline
  simp only [sub_zero] at hline
  change 0 ≤ Δ (-h) 0 at hΔ
  rw [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_neg, Pi.neg_apply] at hΔ
  change 0 ≤ -Δ (fun z : ℂ => translationPairing μ f φ (z • v)) 0 at hΔ
  rw [hline] at hΔ
  linarith

name: PshLines.continuous_finiteDeficit
statement:
theorem continuous_finiteDeficit (C : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun z : EReal => ((C : EReal) - z).toENNReal)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Continuous (fun z : EReal => ((C : EReal), -z)) :=
    continuous_const.prodMk continuous_neg
  have hs : Continuous (fun z : EReal => (C : EReal) - z) := by
    apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
    intro z
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, Function.comp_def] using!
      (EReal.continuousAt_add (p := ((C : EReal), -z))
        (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_top C)) (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_bot C))).comp
        (f := fun z : EReal => ((C : EReal), -z)) (x := z) hp.continuousAt
  exact EReal.continuous_toENNReal.comp hs

name: PshLines.finiteDeficit_iInf
statement:
theorem finiteDeficit_iInf {ι : Sort*} (C : ℝ) (z : ι → EReal) :
    ((C : EReal) - ⨅ i, z i).toENNReal =
      ⨆ i, ((C : EReal) - z i).toENNReal
proof:
:= by
  apply Antitone.map_iInf_of_continuousAt
    (continuous_finiteDeficit C).continuousAt
  · intro a b hab
    exact EReal.toENNReal_le_toENNReal (EReal.sub_le_sub le_rfl hab)
  · simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: PshLines.circleDeficit_iInf_of_antitone_of_measurable
statement:
theorem circleDeficit_iInf_of_antitone_of_measurable
    {u : ℕ → E → EReal} (x v : E) {r : ℝ} (C : ℝ)
    (hm : ∀ n, Measurable fun t : ℝ =>
      ((C : EReal) - u n (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)).toENNReal)
    (hanti : ∀ t : ℝ, Antitone fun n =>
      u n (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)) :
    circleDeficit (fun y => ⨅ n, u n y) x v r C =
      ⨆ n, circleDeficit (u n) x v r C
proof:
:= by
  unfold circleDeficit
  simp_rw [finiteDeficit_iInf]
  apply lintegral_iSup hm
  intro m n hmn t
  exact EReal.toENNReal_le_toENNReal
    (EReal.sub_le_sub le_rfl (hanti t hmn))

name: PshLines.circleDeficit_iInf_of_antitone
statement:
theorem circleDeficit_iInf_of_antitone {u : ℕ → E → EReal} {U : Set E}
    (hu : ∀ n, DiscPshOn (u n) U)
    (hanti : ∀ y ∈ U, Antitone (fun n => u n y))
    (x v : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hD : affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ U) (C : ℝ) :
    circleDeficit (fun y => ⨅ n, u n y) x v r C =
      ⨆ n, circleDeficit (u n) x v r C
proof:
:= by
  apply circleDeficit_iInf_of_antitone_of_measurable x v C
  · intro n
    exact (hu n).measurable_circle_deficit x v hr hD C
  · intro t
    exact hanti _ (hD (circle_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr t))

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.iInf_of_antitone
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.iInf_of_antitone {u : ℕ → E → EReal} {U : Set E}
    (hu : ∀ n, DiscPshOn (u n) U)
    (hanti : ∀ y ∈ U, Antitone (fun n => u n y)) :
    DiscPshOn (fun y => ⨅ n, u n y) U
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, upperSemicontinuousOn_iInf (fun n => (hu n).upperSemicontinuousOn), ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    exact ne_of_lt ((iInf_le (fun n => u n y) 0).trans_lt
      (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr ((hu 0).ne_top y hy)))
  · intro x v r hr hD C hC
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := (hu 0).exists_disc_upper_bound x v hr.le hD
    let a : ℝ := Max.max 0 (B - C)
    have ha : 0 ≤ a := le_max_left _ _
    have hBC : B ≤ C + a := by
      have : B - C ≤ a := le_max_right _ _
      linarith
    have hbound : ∀ n, ∀ y ∈ affineClosedDisc x v r,
        u n y ≤ ((C + a : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      intro n y hy
      exact (hanti y (hD hy) (Nat.zero_le n)).trans
        ((hB y hy).trans (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr hBC))
    apply (discSubmean_add_bound_iff x v hr.le C a ha hC).mp
    rw [circleDeficit_iInf_of_antitone hu hanti x v hr.le hD]
    apply iSup_le
    intro n
    apply ((hu n).submean x v r hr hD (C + a) (hbound n)).trans
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (EReal.toENNReal_le_toENNReal (EReal.sub_le_sub le_rfl
        (iInf_le (fun n => u n x) n))) zero_le

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.plurisubharmonicOn_iInf_of_antitone
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.plurisubharmonicOn_iInf_of_antitone
    {u : ℕ → E → EReal} {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hu : ∀ n, DiscPshOn (u n) U)
    (hanti : ∀ y ∈ U, Antitone (fun n => u n y)) :
    PlurisubharmonicOn (fun y => ⨅ n, u n y) U
proof:
:=
  (DiscPshOn.iInf_of_antitone hu hanti).plurisubharmonicOn hU

name: PshLines.testFunctionToCompactlySupportedLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem testFunctionToCompactlySupportedLM_apply (φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (x : Ω) :
    testFunctionToCompactlySupportedLM Ω φ x = φ x
proof: := rfl

name: PshLines.testFunctionToCompactlySupportedLM_injective
statement:
theorem testFunctionToCompactlySupportedLM_injective :
    Injective (testFunctionToCompactlySupportedLM Ω)
proof:
:= by
  intro φ ψ h
  apply TestFunction.ext
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Ω
  · exact congrArg (fun f : C_c(Ω, ℝ) => f ⟨x, hx⟩) h
  · rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (φ.tsupport_subset h)),
      image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (ψ.tsupport_subset h))]

name: PshLines.exists_nonneg_testFunction_one_le_on_compact
proof:
:= by
  rcases K.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hKe | hKn
  · subst K
    exact ⟨0, fun _ => le_rfl, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hVo, hKV, hVΩ, hVc⟩ :=
    exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hK Ω.isOpen hKΩ
  obtain ⟨g, hgs, hgd, hgr⟩ := hVo.exists_contDiff_support_eq (n := ⊤)
  have hgn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x := fun x => (hgr (mem_range_self x)).1
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hmin⟩ := hK.exists_isMinOn hKn hgd.continuous.continuousOn
  have hga : 0 < g a := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (hgn a) (Ne.symm ?_)
    have : a ∈ support g := hgs.symm ▸ hKV ha
    exact this
  let φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ) :=
    ⟨g, hgd, by simpa only [HasCompactSupport, tsupport, hgs] using hVc,
      by simpa only [tsupport, hgs] using hVΩ⟩
  refine ⟨(g a)⁻¹ • φ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hga.le) (hgn x)
  · intro x hx
    change 1 ≤ (g a)⁻¹ * g x
    calc
      1 = (g a)⁻¹ * g a := (inv_mul_cancel₀ hga.ne').symm
      _ ≤ (g a)⁻¹ * g x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmin hx) (inv_nonneg.mpr hga.le)

name: PshLines.exists_nonneg_testFunction_abs_le
statement:
theorem exists_nonneg_testFunction_abs_le (f : C_c(Ω, ℝ)) :
    ∃ φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ), (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) ∧ ∀ x : Ω, |f x| ≤ φ x
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set E := Subtype.val '' tsupport f
  have hK : IsCompact K := f.hasCompactSupport.image continuous_subtype_val
  have hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω := by rintro x ⟨y, _, rfl⟩; exact y.property
  obtain ⟨χ, hχn, hχK⟩ := exists_nonneg_testFunction_one_le_on_compact hK hKΩ
  let M : ℝ := ‖f.toBoundedContinuousFunction‖
  have hMn : 0 ≤ M := norm_nonneg _
  refine ⟨M • χ, fun x => mul_nonneg hMn (hχn x), ?_⟩
  intro x
  change |f x| ≤ M * χ x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ tsupport f
  · calc
      |f x| ≤ M := by
        change ‖f.toBoundedContinuousFunction x‖ ≤ ‖f.toBoundedContinuousFunction‖
        exact f.toBoundedContinuousFunction.norm_coe_le_norm x
      _ ≤ M * χ x := le_mul_of_one_le_right hMn (hχK x ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
  · rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx, abs_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg hMn (hχn x)

name: PshLines.PositiveDistribution.exists_positiveLinearMap
statement:
theorem PositiveDistribution.exists_positiveLinearMap {T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)}
    (hT : PositiveDistribution T) :
    ∃ Λ : C_c(Ω, ℝ) →ₚ[ℝ] ℝ,
      ∀ φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ), Λ (testFunctionToCompactlySupportedLM Ω φ) = T φ
proof:
:= by
  let i := testFunctionToCompactlySupportedLM Ω
  let e := LinearEquiv.ofInjective i testFunctionToCompactlySupportedLM_injective
  let p : C_c(Ω, ℝ) →ₗ.[ℝ] ℝ :=
    ⟨i.range, T.toLinearMap.comp e.symm.toLinearMap⟩
  let s : PointedCone ℝ C_c(Ω, ℝ) :=
    { carrier := {f | ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x}
      zero_mem' := fun _ => le_rfl
      add_mem' := fun hf hg x => add_nonneg (hf x) (hg x)
      smul_mem' := fun c _ hf x => mul_nonneg c.property (hf x) }
  have hp : ∀ x : p.domain, (x : C_c(Ω, ℝ)) ∈ s → 0 ≤ p x := by
    intro x hx
    change 0 ≤ T (e.symm x)
    apply hT
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ Ω
    · have hi : i (e.symm x) = (x : C_c(Ω, ℝ)) :=
        LinearEquiv.ofInjective_symm_apply i x
      have hxz : 0 ≤ (x : C_c(Ω, ℝ)) ⟨z, hz⟩ := hx ⟨z, hz⟩
      rw [← hi] at hxz
      exact hxz
    · rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
        (fun h => hz ((e.symm x).tsupport_subset h))]
  have hcofinal : ∀ y : C_c(Ω, ℝ), ∃ x : p.domain, (x : C_c(Ω, ℝ)) + y ∈ s := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨φ, _, hφ⟩ := exists_nonneg_testFunction_abs_le y
    refine ⟨⟨i φ, ⟨φ, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    change ∀ z : Ω, 0 ≤ φ z + y z
    intro z
    have := (neg_le_abs (y z)).trans (hφ z)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgn⟩ := riesz_extension s p hp hcofinal
  let Λ : C_c(Ω, ℝ) →ₚ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    { toFun := g
      map_add' := g.map_add
      map_smul' := g.map_smul
      monotone' := by
        intro f₁ f₂ hf
        have := hgn (f₂ - f₁) (fun x => sub_nonneg.mpr (hf x))
        rw [g.map_sub] at this
        exact sub_nonneg.mp this }
  refine ⟨Λ, fun φ => ?_⟩
  calc
    Λ (i φ) = T (e.symm (e φ)) := hgp (e φ)
    _ = T φ := by rw [e.symm_apply_apply]

name: PshLines.PositiveDistribution.exists_regular_measure
statement:
theorem PositiveDistribution.exists_regular_measure {T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)}
    (hT : PositiveDistribution T) :
    ∃ ν : Measure Ω, ν.Regular ∧ IsLocallyFiniteMeasure ν ∧
      ∀ φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ), (∫ x : Ω, φ x ∂ν) = T φ
proof:
:= by
  let : LocallyCompactSpace Ω := Ω.isOpen.locallyCompactSpace
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ := hT.exists_positiveLinearMap
  refine ⟨RealRMK.rieszMeasure Λ, inferInstance, inferInstance, fun φ => ?_⟩
  exact (RealRMK.integral_rieszMeasure Λ (testFunctionToCompactlySupportedLM Ω φ)).trans (hΛ φ)

name: PshLines.affineClosedDisc_subset_ball
statement:
theorem affineClosedDisc_subset_ball (a v : E) {R : ℝ} (hv : ‖v‖ < R) :
    affineClosedDisc a v 1 ⊆ ball a R
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul]
  exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg v) (by simpa using hz)).trans_lt hv

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.measurable_indicator_deficit
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsc : UpperSemicontinuousOn (fun x : s => u x) univ :=
    hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.comp continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn
      (fun x _ => hsU x.property)
  have hm : Measurable (fun x : s => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) :=
    (continuous_finiteDeficit C).measurable.comp
      (upperSemicontinuousOn_univ_iff.mp hsc).measurable
  refine measurable_of_restrict_of_restrict_compl hs ?_ ?_
  · convert hm using 1
    funext x
    simp [Set.domRestrict, x.property]
  · have hzero : sᶜ.domRestrict
        (s.indicator (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal)) =
        fun _ : (sᶜ : Set E) => (0 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
      funext x
      change s.indicator (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) (x : E) = 0
      exact Set.indicator_of_notMem x.property _
    rw [hzero]
    exact measurable_const

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.aemeasurable_deficit_restrict
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.aemeasurable_deficit_restrict {u : E → EReal} {U s : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn u U) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hsU : s ⊆ U) (C : ℝ)
    (μ : Measure E) :
    AEMeasurable (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) (μ.restrict s)
proof:
:=
  (aemeasurable_indicator_iff hs).mp
    (hu.measurable_indicator_deficit hs hsU C).aemeasurable

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.exists_compact_upper_bound
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hmax⟩ := (hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.mono hKU).exists_isMaxOn hne hK
  obtain ⟨C, hC, _⟩ := EReal.exists_rat_btwn_of_lt
    (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr (hu.ne_top y (hKU hy)))
  exact ⟨C, fun z hz => (hmax hz).trans hC.le⟩

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.ball_deficit_le
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.ball_deficit_le {u : E → EReal} {U : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn u U) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (a : E) (R C : ℝ) (hBU : ball a R ⊆ U)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ ball a R, u y ≤ (C : EReal)) :
    ∫⁻ x in ball a R, ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal ∂μ ≤
      μ (ball 0 R) * ((C : EReal) - u a).toENNReal
proof:
:= by
  let d : E → ℝ≥0∞ := fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal
  let f : E → ℝ≥0∞ := (ball a R).indicator d
  have hm : Measurable f := hu.measurable_indicator_deficit measurableSet_ball hBU C
  have hf : ∫⁻ x in ball a R, f x ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in ball a R, d x ∂μ :=
    setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_ball (fun x hx => by simp [f, hx])
  have hrot (t : ℝ) :
      ∫⁻ v in ball 0 R, f (a + circleMap 0 1 t • v) ∂μ =
        ∫⁻ x in ball a R, d x ∂μ :=
    (lintegral_ball_add_circleMap_smul μ f a t R).trans hf
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : E × ℝ => a + circleMap 0 1 p.2 • p.1) := by
    fun_prop
  have hswap := lintegral_lintegral_swap
    (μ := μ.restrict (ball 0 R)) (ν := volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi)))
    (f := fun v t => f (a + circleMap 0 1 t • v)) (hm.comp hc.measurable).aemeasurable
  have hangle (v : E) (hv : v ∈ ball 0 R) :
      ∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi), f (a + circleMap 0 1 t • v) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * d a := by
    have hD := affineClosedDisc_subset_ball a v (by simpa using hv)
    have heq :
        ∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi), f (a + circleMap 0 1 t • v) =
          circleDeficit u a v 1 C := by
      apply lintegral_congr
      intro t
      have ht := hD (circle_mem_affineClosedDisc a v (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) t)
      simp [f, d, ht]
    rw [heq]
    exact hu.submean a v 1 (by norm_num) (hD.trans hBU) C (fun y hy => hC y (hD hy))
  have hmul : (∫⁻ x in ball a R, d x ∂μ) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) ≤
      (μ (ball 0 R) * d a) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) := by
    calc
      (∫⁻ x in ball a R, d x ∂μ) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) =
          ∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi),
            ∫⁻ v in ball 0 R, f (a + circleMap 0 1 t • v) ∂μ := by
              simp_rw [hrot]
              simp
      _ = ∫⁻ v in ball 0 R,
          (∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi), f (a + circleMap 0 1 t • v)) ∂μ := hswap.symm
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ _v in ball 0 R, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * d a ∂μ :=
        setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_ball hangle
      _ = (μ (ball 0 R) * d a) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) := by
        simp [mul_comm, mul_assoc]
  exact (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_left
    (ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos)))
    ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mp hmul

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.ae_finite_and_integrableOn_ball
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.ae_finite_and_integrableOn_ball {u : E → EReal} {U : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn u U) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (a : E) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hB : closedBall a R ⊆ U) (ha : u a ≠ ⊥) :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict (ball a R), u x ≠ ⊤ ∧ u x ≠ ⊥) ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun x => (u x).toReal) (ball a R) μ ∧
      ((fun x => ((u x).toReal : EReal)) =ᶠ[ae (μ.restrict (ball a R))] u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hu.exists_compact_upper_bound (isCompact_closedBall a R)
    ⟨a, mem_closedBall_self hR.le⟩ hB
  have hBU : ball a R ⊆ U := ball_subset_closedBall.trans hB
  have hCa : u a ≠ ⊤ := hu.ne_top a (hB (mem_closedBall_self hR.le))
  have hda : ((C : EReal) - u a).toENNReal < ⊤ := by
    rw [← EReal.coe_toReal hCa ha, ← EReal.coe_sub, EReal.real_coe_toENNReal]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hI := (hu.ball_deficit_le μ a R C hBU
    (fun y hy => hC y (ball_subset_closedBall hy))).trans_lt
      (ENNReal.mul_lt_top measure_ball_lt_top hda)
  refine ae_finite_and_integrableOn_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top measure_ball_lt_top ?_
    (hu.aemeasurable_deficit_restrict measurableSet_ball hBU C μ) hI
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball] with x hx
  exact hC x (ball_subset_closedBall hx)

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.exists_uniform_indicator_deficit_bound
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.exists_uniform_indicator_deficit_bound
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u U) (hS : IsCompact S) (hSU : S ⊆ U)
    (v : E) {R₀ : ℝ} (hR₀ : 0 < R₀) (hSK : S ⊆ K)
    (hdiscs : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ r : ℝ, r ≤ R₀ → affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ K)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≤ (C : EReal)) :
    ∃ R > 0, ∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 R, ∀ x ∈ S,
      (∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi),
        K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal)
          (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) *
          K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Rg, hRg, hbound⟩ := hu.exists_uniform_circleDeficit_bound hS hSU v
  refine ⟨Min.min Rg R₀, lt_min hRg hR₀, ?_⟩
  intro r hr x hx
  have hrg : r ≤ Rg := hr.2.le.trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hr₀ : r ≤ R₀ := hr.2.le.trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hdisc := hdiscs x hx r hr₀
  have hpoint := hbound x hx r hr.1 hrg C (fun y hy => hC y (hdisc hy))
  have hcircle (t : ℝ) :
      K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal)
        (x + circleMap 0 r t • v) =
          ((C : EReal) - u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)).toENNReal :=
    Set.indicator_of_mem (hdisc (circle_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr.1.le t)) _
  have hcenter : K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal) x =
      ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal := Set.indicator_of_mem (hSK hx) _
  simpa only [circleDeficit, hcircle, hcenter] using hpoint

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_locallyIntegrable
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_locallyIntegrable
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω)
    (huL : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => (u x).toReal) Ω μ)
    (hfin : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict Ω, u x ≠ ⊤ ∧ u x ≠ ⊥) :
    HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
      (regularDistribution μ (fun x => (u x).toReal) huL)
proof:
:= by
  intro v φ hφn
  obtain ⟨Rc, hRc, K, hK, hKΩ, hφK, hdiscs⟩ :=
    exists_compact_affineClosedDisc_family φ.hasCompactSupport Ω.isOpen φ.tsupport_subset v
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := hu.exists_nonnegative_compact_upper_bound hK hKΩ
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hangular⟩ := hu.exists_uniform_indicator_deficit_bound
    φ.hasCompactSupport φ.tsupport_subset v hRc hφK hdiscs C hC
  let f : E → ℝ := K.indicator (fun x => C - (u x).toReal)
  let D : E → ℝ≥0∞ := K.indicator (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal)
  have hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ :=
    locallyIntegrable_indicator_realDeficit_of_isCompact hK hKΩ huL C
  have hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x := indicator_realDeficit_nonneg hC0 hC
  have hDm : Measurable D := hu.measurable_indicator_deficit hK.measurableSet hKΩ C
  have hDf : D =ᵐ[μ] fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x) :=
    indicator_deficit_ae_eq_ofReal_of_isCompact hK hKΩ hfin C
  have hφ2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 (φ : E → ℝ) :=
    φ.contDiff.of_le (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)
  have hpair := integral_mul_leviForm_nonpos_of_pointwise_circle_lintegral
    hDm hDf hf hfn φ.hasCompactSupport hφ2 hφn v hR (by
      intro r hr x hx
      exact hangular r hr x (subset_closure hx))
  change (∫ x, K.indicator (fun y => C - (u y).toReal) x * leviForm φ x v ∂μ) ≤ 0 at hpair
  rw [integral_indicator_deficit_mul_leviForm_testFunction huL φ hφK C v] at hpair
  exact neg_nonpos.mp hpair

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.pshRegularDistribution_hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.pshRegularDistribution_hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω) (hΩ : IsPreconnected (Ω : Set E))
    (hne : ∃ a ∈ Ω, u a ≠ ⊥) :
    HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi (pshRegularDistribution hu μ hΩ hne)
proof:
:= by
  apply hu.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_locallyIntegrable
  exact hu.ae_finite μ hΩ hne

name: PshLines.continuous_laplacian_complex
statement:
theorem continuous_laplacian_complex {u : ℂ → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) :
    Continuous (Δ u)
proof:
:= by
  have hD : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u)) :=
    (hu.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)
  have h₁ := (hD.clm_apply (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℂ ↦ (1 : ℂ)))).clm_apply
    (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℂ ↦ (1 : ℂ)))
  have hI := (hD.clm_apply (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℂ ↦ I))).clm_apply
    (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℂ ↦ I))
  simpa [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_complexPlane,
    iteratedFDeriv_two_apply] using! h₁.add hI

name: PshLines.laplacian_complex_norm_sub_sq
statement:
theorem laplacian_complex_norm_sub_sq (c z : ℂ) :
    Δ (fun w : ℂ ↦ ‖w - c‖ ^ 2) z = 4
proof:
:= by
  have h := laplacian_complexLine
    (u := fun w : ℂ ↦ ‖w‖ ^ 2)
    (contDiff_norm_sq ℂ) (-c) 1 z
  simpa [leviForm_norm_sq, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using h

name: PshLines.circleAverage_complex_norm_sub_sq
statement:
theorem circleAverage_complex_norm_sub_sq (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ) :
    Real.circleAverage (fun z : ℂ ↦ ‖z - c‖ ^ 2) c R = R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Real.circleAverage (fun z : ℂ ↦ ‖z - c‖ ^ 2) c R =
        Real.circleAverage (fun _ : ℂ ↦ R ^ 2) c R := by
      apply Real.circleAverage_congr_sphere
      intro z hz
      have hz' : ‖z - c‖ = |R| := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm] using hz
      simp only [hz', sq_abs]
    _ = R ^ 2 := Real.circleAverage_const _ _ _

name: PshLines.quadratic_submean_of_laplacian_lower_bound
statement:
theorem quadratic_submean_of_laplacian_lower_bound {u : ℂ → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (c : ℂ) {R k : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hΔ : ∀ z ∈ closedBall c R, 4 * k ≤ Δ u z) :
    u c + k * R ^ 2 ≤ Real.circleAverage u c R
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℂ → ℝ := fun z ↦ ‖z - c‖ ^ 2
  have hq : ContDiff ℝ 2 q := (contDiff_norm_sq ℂ).comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  have hkq : ContDiff ℝ 2 (k • q) := hq.const_smul k
  have hmod : ContDiff ℝ 2 (u - k • q) := hu.sub hkq
  have hmodΔ : ∀ z ∈ closedBall c R, 0 ≤ Δ (u - k • q) z := by
    intro z hz
    rw [ContDiffAt.laplacian_sub (f₁ := u) (f₂ := k • q) hu.contDiffAt hkq.contDiffAt,
      InnerProductSpace.laplacian_smul (f := q) k hq.contDiffAt]
    change 0 ≤ Δ u z - k * Δ (fun w : ℂ ↦ ‖w - c‖ ^ 2) z
    rw [laplacian_complex_norm_sub_sq]
    linarith [hΔ z hz]
  have hm := submean_of_laplacian_nonneg (u := u - k • q) hmod c hR hmodΔ
  rw [Real.circleAverage_sub (ContinuousOn.circleIntegrable hR hu.continuous.continuousOn)
    (ContinuousOn.circleIntegrable hR hkq.continuous.continuousOn),
    Real.circleAverage_smul] at hm
  have hqmean : Real.circleAverage q c R = R ^ 2 := circleAverage_complex_norm_sub_sq c R
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hqmean, q,
    sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), mul_zero, sub_zero] at hm
  linarith

name: PshLines.laplacian_nonneg_of_eventually_circleAverage_submean
statement:
theorem laplacian_nonneg_of_eventually_circleAverage_submean {u : ℂ → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (c : ℂ)
    (hmean : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), u c ≤ Real.circleAverage u c r) :
    0 ≤ Δ u c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnonneg
  have hneg : Δ u c < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hnonneg
  let k : ℝ := -Δ u c / 8
  have hk : 0 < k := by dsimp [k]; linarith
  have hkΔ : 4 * k < Δ (-u) c := by
    simp only [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_neg, Pi.neg_apply]
    dsimp [k]
    linarith
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 c, 4 * k < Δ (-u) z :=
    (continuous_laplacian_complex (u := -u) hu.neg).continuousAt.eventually
      (lt_mem_nhds hkΔ)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hnear
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), r < δ :=
    nhdsWithin_le_nhds (gt_mem_nhds hδ)
  have hpos : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), 0 < r := self_mem_nhdsWithin
  obtain ⟨r, hm, hrδ, hr⟩ := (hmean.and (hsmall.and hpos)).exists
  have hmod := quadratic_submean_of_laplacian_lower_bound (u := -u) hu.neg c hr.le
    (k := k) (fun z hz ↦ (hball (lt_of_le_of_lt (mem_closedBall.mp hz) hrδ)).le)
  have hmean_neg : Real.circleAverage (-u) c r = -Real.circleAverage u c r := by
    simpa only [neg_one_smul] using
      (Real.circleAverage_smul (f := u) (c := c) (R := r) (a := (-1 : ℝ)))
  rw [hmean_neg] at hmod
  have hstrict : 0 < k * r ^ 2 := mul_pos hk (sq_pos_of_pos hr)
  simp only [Pi.neg_apply] at hmod
  linarith

name: PshLines.laplacian_nonneg_of_circleAverage_submean
statement:
theorem laplacian_nonneg_of_circleAverage_submean {u : ℂ → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (c : ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hmean : ∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 R, u c ≤ Real.circleAverage u c r) :
    0 ≤ Δ u c
proof:
:= by
  apply laplacian_nonneg_of_eventually_circleAverage_submean hu c
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), r < R :=
    nhdsWithin_le_nhds (gt_mem_nhds hR)
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hsmall] with r hr hrR
  exact hmean r ⟨hr, hrR⟩

name: PshLines.circleDeficit_coe_eq
statement:
theorem circleDeficit_coe_eq {u : E → ℝ} (x v : E) (r C : ℝ)
    (hu : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v))
      volume 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hC : ∀ t : ℝ, u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v) ≤ C) :
    circleDeficit (fun y => (u y : EReal)) x v r C =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * Real.pi) * C -
        ∫ t in 0..2 * Real.pi, u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have hfi : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => C - u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v))
      (Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) := (intervalIntegrable_const.sub hu).1
  have hnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi))]
      (fun t : ℝ => C - u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)) :=
    ae_of_all _ (fun t => sub_nonneg.mpr (hC t))
  simp only [circleDeficit, ← EReal.coe_sub, EReal.real_coe_toENNReal]
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hfi hnn,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hp,
    intervalIntegral.integral_sub intervalIntegrable_const hu,
    intervalIntegral.integral_const]
  simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]

name: PshLines.circleDeficit_coe_le_iff
statement:
theorem circleDeficit_coe_le_iff {u : E → ℝ} (x v : E) (r C : ℝ)
    (hu : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v))
      volume 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hC : ∀ t : ℝ, u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v) ≤ C) (hxC : u x ≤ C) :
    (circleDeficit (fun y => (u y : EReal)) x v r C ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * ((C : EReal) - (u x : EReal)).toENNReal) ↔
    u x ≤ Real.circleAverage (fun z : ℂ => u (x + z • v)) 0 r
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  rw [circleDeficit_coe_eq x v r C hu hC, ← EReal.coe_sub,
    EReal.real_coe_toENNReal, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hp.le,
    ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (mul_nonneg hp.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hxC))]
  simp only [Real.circleAverage, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← div_eq_inv_mul, le_div_iff₀ hp]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

name: PshLines.discPshOn_of_circleAverage
statement:
theorem discPshOn_of_circleAverage {u : E → ℝ} {U : Set E} (hu : Continuous u)
    (hmean : ∀ (x v : E) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ U →
      u x ≤ Real.circleAverage (fun z : ℂ => u (x + z • v)) 0 r) :
    DiscPshOn (fun y => (u y : EReal)) U
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ => EReal.coe_ne_top _,
    (continuous_coe_real_ereal.comp hu).upperSemicontinuous.upperSemicontinuousOn U, ?_⟩
  intro x v r hr hD C hC
  have hcirc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)) := by fun_prop
  apply (circleDeficit_coe_le_iff x v r C (hcirc.intervalIntegrable _ _)
    (fun t => EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp (hC _ (circle_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr.le t)))
    (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp (hC x (center_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr.le)))).mpr
  exact hmean x v r hr hD

name: PshLines.realHessian_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
statement:
theorem realHessian_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport {f : E → ℝ} {x : E}
    (hx : x ∉ tsupport f) (v w : E) : realHessian f x v w = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hD : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x = 0 :=
    image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun hxD =>
      hx (tsupport_iteratedFDeriv_subset (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := f) 2 hxD))
  simp only [realHessian, hD, zero_apply]

name: PshLines.tsupport_realHessian_subset
statement:
theorem tsupport_realHessian_subset (f : E → ℝ) (v w : E) :
    tsupport (fun x => realHessian f x v w) ⊆ tsupport f
proof:
:= by
  apply closure_minimal _ (isClosed_tsupport f)
  intro x hx
  by_contra hxf
  exact hx (realHessian_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hxf v w)

name: PshLines.testFunction_lineDerivCLM_lineDerivCLM_apply
statement:
theorem testFunction_lineDerivCLM_lineDerivCLM_apply (φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (x v w : E) :
    TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ v
      (TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ w φ) x =
      realHessian φ x v w
proof:
:= by
  have hinner :
      ((TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ w φ) : E → ℝ) =
        fun y => fderiv ℝ φ y w :=
    funext (fun y => testFunction_lineDerivCLM_apply_eq_fderiv φ w y)
  rw [testFunction_lineDerivCLM_apply_eq_fderiv, hinner,
    fderiv_fderiv_apply_eq_realHessian
      (φ.contDiff.of_le (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2))]

name: PshLines.integrable_mul_realHessian_testFunction
statement:
theorem integrable_mul_realHessian_testFunction (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ)
    (φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (v w : E) :
    Integrable (fun x => u x * realHessian φ x v w) μ
proof:
:= by
  have h := TestFunction.integrable_bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) hu
    (TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ v
      (TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ w φ))
  simpa only [testFunction_lineDerivCLM_lineDerivCLM_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply', mul_comm] using h

name: PshLines.integrable_mul_leviForm_testFunction
statement:
theorem integrable_mul_leviForm_testFunction (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ)
    (φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (v : E) :
    Integrable (fun x => u x * leviForm φ x v) μ
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((integrable_mul_realHessian_testFunction hu φ v v).add
    (integrable_mul_realHessian_testFunction hu φ (Complex.I • v) (Complex.I • v))).div_const 4
  exact h.congr (Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by simp only [leviForm, Pi.add_apply]; ring))

name: PshLines.distributionalLeviCLM_regularDistribution_apply
statement:
theorem distributionalLeviCLM_regularDistribution_apply
    (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ) (φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (v : E) :
    distributionalLeviCLM v (regularDistribution μ u hu) φ =
      ∫ x, u x * leviForm φ x v ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hA : Integrable (fun x => realHessian φ x v v * u x) μ := by
    simpa only [mul_comm] using integrable_mul_realHessian_testFunction hu φ v v
  have hB : Integrable
      (fun x => realHessian φ x (Complex.I • v) (Complex.I • v) * u x) μ := by
    simpa only [mul_comm] using
      integrable_mul_realHessian_testFunction hu φ (Complex.I • v) (Complex.I • v)
  rw [distributionalLeviCLM_apply, regularDistribution_apply, regularDistribution_apply]
  simp only [testFunction_lineDerivCLM_lineDerivCLM_apply]
  rw [← integral_add hA hB, ← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by simp only [leviForm]; ring)

name: PshLines.leviForm_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
statement:
theorem leviForm_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport {f : E → ℝ} {x : E}
    (hx : x ∉ tsupport f) (v : E) : leviForm f x v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [leviForm, realHessian_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx,
    realHessian_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx]
  norm_num

name: PshLines.tsupport_leviForm_subset
statement:
theorem tsupport_leviForm_subset (f : E → ℝ) (v : E) :
    tsupport (fun x => leviForm f x v) ⊆ tsupport f
proof:
:= by
  apply closure_minimal _ (isClosed_tsupport f)
  intro x hx
  by_contra hxf
  exact hx (leviForm_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hxf v)

name: PshLines.integral_realHessian_testFunction
statement:
theorem integral_realHessian_testFunction (φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (v w : E) :
    (∫ x, realHessian φ x v w ∂μ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (fun T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ) =>
      T (TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ w φ))
    (lineDerivCLM_regularDistribution (μ := μ)
      (show ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun _ : E => (1 : ℝ)) from contDiff_const) v)
  simp only [Distribution.lineDerivCLM_apply, regularDistribution_apply,
    testFunction_lineDerivCLM_lineDerivCLM_apply, fderiv_const_apply,
    zero_apply, mul_one, mul_zero, integral_zero] at h
  exact neg_eq_zero.mp h

name: PshLines.integral_leviForm_testFunction
statement:
theorem integral_leviForm_testFunction (φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (v : E) :
    (∫ x, leviForm φ x v ∂μ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun _ : E => (1 : ℝ)) Ω μ :=
    locallyIntegrableOn_const 1
  have hA : Integrable (fun x => realHessian φ x v v) μ := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using integrable_mul_realHessian_testFunction hc φ v v
  have hB : Integrable (fun x => realHessian φ x (Complex.I • v) (Complex.I • v)) μ := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      integrable_mul_realHessian_testFunction hc φ (Complex.I • v) (Complex.I • v)
  simp only [leviForm]
  rw [integral_div, integral_add hA hB, integral_realHessian_testFunction,
    integral_realHessian_testFunction]
  norm_num

name: PshLines.integral_indicator_deficit_mul_leviForm_testFunction
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have heq : (fun x => K.indicator (fun y => C - u y) x * leviForm φ x v) =
      fun x => C * leviForm φ x v - u x * leviForm φ x v := by
    funext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ K
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      ring
    · have hzero : leviForm φ x v = 0 :=
        leviForm_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun hxφ => hx (hφK hxφ)) v
      simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, hzero, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  have hconst : Integrable (fun x => C * leviForm φ x v) μ :=
    integrable_mul_leviForm_testFunction (locallyIntegrableOn_const C) φ v
  rw [heq, integral_sub hconst (integrable_mul_leviForm_testFunction hu φ v),
    integral_const_mul, integral_leviForm_testFunction, mul_zero, zero_sub,
    distributionalLeviCLM_regularDistribution_apply]

name: PshLines.exists_open_compact_closedBall_neighborhood
statement:
theorem exists_open_compact_closedBall_neighborhood {S V : Set E}
    (hS : IsCompact S) (hV : IsOpen V) (hSV : S ⊆ V) :
    ∃ R > 0, ∃ U K : Set E, IsOpen U ∧ S ⊆ U ∧ U ⊆ K ∧
      IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ V ∧ ∀ z ∈ U, closedBall z R ⊆ K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεV⟩ := hS.exists_thickening_subset_open hV hSV
  let δ : ℝ := ε / 3
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  have hδε : δ + δ < ε := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, thickening δ S, cthickening (δ + δ) S, isOpen_thickening,
    self_subset_thickening hδ S, ?_, hS.cthickening,
    (cthickening_subset_thickening' hε hδε S).trans hεV, ?_⟩
  · exact thickening_subset_cthickening_of_le (by linarith) S
  · intro z hz
    exact (closedBall_subset_cthickening hz δ).trans
      (cthickening_thickening_subset hδ.le δ S)

name: PshLines.mollify_indicator_eq_of_closedBall_subset
statement:
theorem mollify_indicator_eq_of_closedBall_subset
    (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : E)) (z : E) (hzK : closedBall z φ.rOut ⊆ K) :
    mollify μ (K.indicator u) φ z = mollify μ u φ z
proof:
:=
  translationPairing_indicator_eq u (φ.normed μ) z
    ((tsupport_mollifier_translate_subset μ φ z).trans hzK)

name: PshLines.ae_tendsto_mollify_indicator_on
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_mollify_indicator_on
    (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω)
    (hU : MeasurableSet U) (hUK : U ⊆ K) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict U,
      Tendsto (fun n => mollify μ (K.indicator u) (shrinkingBump R hR n) x)
        atTop (𝓝 (u x))
proof:
:= by
  have hg := (integrable_indicator_of_locallyIntegrableOn_isCompact hu hK hKΩ).locallyIntegrable
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_tendsto_mollify μ hg R hR),
    ae_restrict_mem hU] with x hx hxU
  simpa only [indicator_of_mem (hUK hxU)] using hx

name: PshLines.exists_smooth_psh_ae_approximation
statement:
theorem exists_smooth_psh_ae_approximation
    (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ)
    (hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi (regularDistribution μ u hu))
    {S : Set E} (hS : IsCompact S) (hSΩ : S ⊆ Ω) :
    ∃ (U : Set E) (f : ℕ → E → ℝ), IsOpen U ∧ S ⊆ U ∧ U ⊆ Ω ∧
      (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (f n)) ∧
      (∀ n, DiscPshOn (fun x => (f n x : EReal)) U) ∧
      (∀ n, PlurisubharmonicOn (fun x => (f n x : EReal)) U) ∧
      ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict U, Tendsto (fun n => f n x) atTop (𝓝 (u x))
proof:
:= by
  let : ProperSpace E := FiniteDimensional.proper ℝ E
  obtain ⟨R, hR, U, K, hU, hSU, hUK, hK, hKΩ, hball⟩ :=
    exists_open_compact_closedBall_neighborhood hS Ω.isOpen hSΩ
  let f : ℕ → E → ℝ := fun n => mollify μ (K.indicator u) (shrinkingBump R hR n)
  have hg := (integrable_indicator_of_locallyIntegrableOn_isCompact hu hK hKΩ).locallyIntegrable
  have hs (n : ℕ) (z : E) (hz : z ∈ U) :
      tsupport (fun x => (shrinkingBump R hR n).normed μ (x - z)) ⊆ K :=
    (tsupport_mollifier_translate_subset μ (shrinkingBump R hR n) z).trans
      ((closedBall_subset_closedBall (shrinkingBump_rOut_le R hR n)).trans (hball z hz))
  have hf (n : ℕ) : DiscPshOn (fun x => (f n x : EReal)) U :=
    discPshOn_translationPairing_indicator hu hT
      (shrinkingBump R hR n).hasCompactSupport_normed
      (shrinkingBump R hR n).contDiff_normed
      (shrinkingBump R hR n).nonneg_normed hK hKΩ (hs n)
  refine ⟨U, f, hU, hSU, hUK.trans hKΩ, ?_, hf, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fun n => contDiff_mollify μ hg (shrinkingBump R hR n)
  · exact fun n => (hf n).plurisubharmonicOn hU
  · exact ae_tendsto_mollify_indicator_on hu hK hKΩ hU.measurableSet hUK R hR

name: PshLines.affineClosedDisc_mono_radius
statement:
theorem affineClosedDisc_mono_radius (x v : E) {r R : ℝ} (hrR : r ≤ R) :
    affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ affineClosedDisc x v R
proof:
:=
  image_mono (closedBall_subset_closedBall hrR)

name: PshLines.affineClosedDisc_subset_closedBall
statement:
theorem affineClosedDisc_subset_closedBall (x v : E) (r : ℝ) :
    affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ closedBall x (r * ‖v‖)
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  have hz' : ‖z‖ ≤ r := by simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hz
  simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul] using
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hz' (norm_nonneg v)

name: PshLines.affineClosedDisc_subset_cthickening
statement:
theorem affineClosedDisc_subset_cthickening {K : Set E} {x : E} (hx : x ∈ K)
    (v : E) {r δ : ℝ} (hrδ : r * ‖v‖ ≤ δ) :
    affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ cthickening δ K
proof:
:=
  (affineClosedDisc_subset_closedBall x v r).trans
    ((closedBall_subset_closedBall hrδ).trans (closedBall_subset_cthickening hx δ))

name: PshLines.exists_compact_affineClosedDisc_neighborhood
statement:
theorem exists_compact_affineClosedDisc_neighborhood [ProperSpace E]
    {K U : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hU : IsOpen U) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (v : E) :
    ∃ R > 0, ∃ L : Set E, IsCompact L ∧ L ⊆ U ∧
      ∀ x ∈ K, affineClosedDisc x v R ⊆ L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεU⟩ := hK.exists_thickening_subset_open hU hKU
  let δ : ℝ := ε / 2
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  have hδε : δ < ε := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
  have hδU : cthickening δ K ⊆ U :=
    (cthickening_subset_thickening' hε hδε K).trans hεU
  have hv : 0 < ‖v‖ + 1 := by positivity
  let R : ℝ := δ / (‖v‖ + 1)
  have hR : 0 < R := div_pos hδ hv
  have hRδ : R * ‖v‖ ≤ δ := by
    calc
      R * ‖v‖ ≤ R * (‖v‖ + 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hR.le
      _ = δ := div_mul_cancel₀ δ (ne_of_gt hv)
  refine ⟨R, hR, cthickening δ K, hK.cthickening, hδU, ?_⟩
  exact fun x hx ↦ affineClosedDisc_subset_cthickening hx v hRδ

name: PshLines.exists_compact_affineClosedDisc_family
statement:
theorem exists_compact_affineClosedDisc_family [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {K U : Set E}
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hU : IsOpen U) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (v : E) :
    ∃ R > 0, ∃ L : Set E, IsCompact L ∧ L ⊆ U ∧ K ⊆ L ∧
      ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ r : ℝ, r ≤ R → affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ L
proof:
:= by
  let : ProperSpace E := FiniteDimensional.proper ℝ E
  obtain ⟨R, hR, L, hL, hLU, hdisc⟩ :=
    exists_compact_affineClosedDisc_neighborhood hK hU hKU v
  refine ⟨R, hR, L, hL, hLU, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact hdisc x hx (center_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hR.le)
  · intro x hx r hr
    exact (affineClosedDisc_mono_radius x v hr).trans (hdisc x hx)

name: PshLines.testFunction_inclusion_coe
statement:
theorem testFunction_inclusion_coe (hUΩ : U ≤ Ω) (φ : 𝓓(U, ℝ)) :
    ((TestFunction.monoCLM ℝ φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) : E → ℝ) = φ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [TestFunction.monoCLM_apply, le_refl, hUΩ, and_self, ite_true]

name: PshLines.restrictDistribution_apply
statement:
theorem restrictDistribution_apply (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (hUΩ : U ≤ Ω)
    (φ : 𝓓(U, ℝ)) :
    restrictDistribution T hUΩ φ = T (TestFunction.monoCLM ℝ φ)
proof: := rfl

name: PshLines.restrictDistribution_self
statement:
theorem restrictDistribution_self (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) :
    restrictDistribution T le_rfl = T
proof:
:= by
  ext φ
  rw [restrictDistribution_apply]
  congr 1
  apply TestFunction.ext
  intro x
  exact congrFun (testFunction_inclusion_coe le_rfl φ) x

name: PshLines.restrictDistribution_trans
statement:
theorem restrictDistribution_trans {V : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ))
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (hUΩ : U ≤ Ω) :
    restrictDistribution (restrictDistribution T hUΩ) hVU =
      restrictDistribution T (hVU.trans hUΩ)
proof:
:= by
  ext φ
  simp only [restrictDistribution_apply]
  congr 1
  apply TestFunction.ext
  intro x
  calc
    ((TestFunction.monoCLM ℝ (TestFunction.monoCLM ℝ φ) : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) : E → ℝ) x =
        ((TestFunction.monoCLM ℝ φ : 𝓓(U, ℝ)) : E → ℝ) x :=
      congrFun (testFunction_inclusion_coe hUΩ (TestFunction.monoCLM ℝ φ)) x
    _ = φ x := congrFun (testFunction_inclusion_coe hVU φ) x
    _ = ((TestFunction.monoCLM ℝ φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) : E → ℝ) x :=
      (congrFun (testFunction_inclusion_coe (hVU.trans hUΩ) φ) x).symm

name: PshLines.restrictDistribution_regularDistribution
statement:
theorem restrictDistribution_regularDistribution (μ : Measure E)
    {u : E → ℝ} (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ) (hUΩ : U ≤ Ω) :
    restrictDistribution (regularDistribution μ u hu) hUΩ =
      regularDistribution μ u (hu.mono_set hUΩ)
proof:
:= by
  ext φ
  rw [restrictDistribution_apply, regularDistribution_apply,
    regularDistribution_apply]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
    change (TestFunction.monoCLM ℝ φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) x * u x = φ x * u x
    rw [congrFun (testFunction_inclusion_coe hUΩ φ) x]

name: PshLines.IsPshRepresentative.restrict
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨huPsh, huFinite, huLocal, huT⟩ := hu
  have huLocalU := huLocal.mono_set hUΩ
  refine ⟨huPsh.mono hUΩ,
    ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset hUΩ huFinite, huLocalU, ?_⟩
  calc
    restrictDistribution T hUΩ =
        restrictDistribution (regularDistribution μ (fun x => (u x).toReal) huLocal) hUΩ :=
      congrArg (fun S : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ) => restrictDistribution S hUΩ) huT
    _ = regularDistribution μ (fun x => (u x).toReal) huLocalU :=
      restrictDistribution_regularDistribution μ huLocal hUΩ

name: PshLines.lintegral_deficit_translate_eq_ofReal_pairing
statement:
theorem lintegral_deficit_translate_eq_ofReal_pairing
    {D : E → ℝ≥0∞} {f φ : E → ℝ}
    (hD : D =ᵐ[μ] fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x))
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : Continuous φ) (hφn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (a : E) :
    ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x) * D (x + a) ∂μ =
      ENNReal.ofReal (translationPairing μ f φ a)
proof:
:= by
  have htrans := (measurePreserving_add_right μ a).lintegral_comp_emb
    (MeasurableEquiv.addRight a).measurableEmbedding
    (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (φ (y - a)) * D y)
  calc
    (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x) * D (x + a) ∂μ) =
        ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (φ (y - a)) * D y ∂μ := by
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using htrans
    _ = ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (f y * φ (y - a)) ∂μ := by
      apply lintegral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hD] with y hy
      rw [hy, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (hfn y), mul_comm]
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (translationPairing μ f φ a) :=
      (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal
        (integrable_translationPairing hf hφs hφ a)
        (ae_of_all _ (fun y => mul_nonneg (hfn y) (hφn (y - a))))).symm

name: PshLines.circleAverage_le_of_lintegral_ofReal_le
statement:
theorem circleAverage_le_of_lintegral_ofReal_le {h : ℂ → ℝ}
    (hh : Continuous h) (hn : ∀ z, 0 ≤ h z) (r : ℝ)
    (hm : (∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi), ENNReal.ofReal (h (circleMap 0 r t))) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * ENNReal.ofReal (h 0)) :
    Real.circleAverage h 0 r ≤ h 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => h (circleMap 0 r t)) volume
      0 (2 * Real.pi) := (hh.comp (by fun_prop)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi.1
    (ae_of_all _ (fun t => hn (circleMap 0 r t))),
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hp.le,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hp.le,
    ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (mul_nonneg hp.le (hn 0))] at hm
  simp only [Real.circleAverage, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← div_eq_inv_mul, div_le_iff₀ hp]
  simpa only [mul_comm] using hm

name: PshLines.HasDiscSubmeanOn.circleAverage_deficit_pairing_le
statement:
theorem HasDiscSubmeanOn.circleAverage_deficit_pairing_le {u : E → EReal} {U K : Set E}
    (hu : HasDiscSubmeanOn u U) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (C : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≤ (C : EReal))
    (hDm : Measurable (K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal))) {f φ : E → ℝ}
    (hD : K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (f y))
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 2 φ) (hφn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (v : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hdisc : ∀ x ∈ Function.support φ, affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ K) :
    Real.circleAverage (fun z : ℂ => translationPairing μ f φ (z • v)) 0 r ≤
      translationPairing μ f φ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hm := hu.weighted_circle_deficit_le μ hKU C hC hDm
    (hφ.continuous.measurable.ennreal_ofReal) v hr (by
      intro x hx
      apply hdisc x
      intro hx0
      exact hx (by simp [hx0]))
  have hinner (a : E) := lintegral_deficit_translate_eq_ofReal_pairing
    hD hf hfn hφs hφ.continuous hφn a
  have hzero : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x) *
      K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal) x ∂μ) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (translationPairing μ f φ 0) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using hinner 0
  simp_rw [hinner] at hm
  rw [hzero] at hm
  have hn (z : ℂ) : 0 ≤ translationPairing μ f φ (z • v) :=
    integral_nonneg (fun x => mul_nonneg (hfn x) (hφn (x - z • v)))
  simpa only [zero_smul] using circleAverage_le_of_lintegral_ofReal_le
    (contDiff_translationPairing_complexLine hf hφs hφ v).continuous hn r
      (by simpa only [zero_smul] using hm)

name: PshLines.HasDiscSubmeanOn.integral_deficit_mul_leviForm_nonpos
statement:
theorem HasDiscSubmeanOn.integral_deficit_mul_leviForm_nonpos {u : E → EReal} {U K : Set E}
    (hu : HasDiscSubmeanOn u U) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (C : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≤ (C : EReal))
    (hDm : Measurable (K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal))) {f φ : E → ℝ}
    (hD : K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (f y))
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 2 φ) (hφn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (v : E) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hdisc : ∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 R, ∀ x ∈ Function.support φ, affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ K) :
    (∫ x, f x * leviForm φ x v ∂μ) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  let h : ℂ → ℝ := fun z => translationPairing μ f φ (z • v)
  have hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h := contDiff_translationPairing_complexLine hf hφs hφ v
  have hmean (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioo 0 R) : (-h) 0 ≤ Real.circleAverage (-h) 0 r := by
    have hm := hu.circleAverage_deficit_pairing_le hKU C hC hDm hD hf hfn hφs hφ hφn
      v hr.1 (hdisc r hr)
    have hneg : Real.circleAverage (-h) 0 r = -Real.circleAverage h 0 r := by
      simpa only [neg_one_smul] using
        (Real.circleAverage_smul (f := h) (c := 0) (R := r) (a := (-1 : ℝ)))
    rw [hneg]
    simpa only [h, Pi.neg_apply, zero_smul] using neg_le_neg hm
  have hΔ := laplacian_nonneg_of_circleAverage_submean hh.neg 0 hR hmean
  have hline := laplacian_complexLine (contDiff_translationPairing hf hφs hφ)
    (0 : E) v (0 : ℂ)
  simp only [zero_add, zero_smul] at hline
  rw [leviForm_translationPairing hf hφs hφ] at hline
  simp only [sub_zero] at hline
  change 0 ≤ Δ (-h) 0 at hΔ
  rw [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_neg, Pi.neg_apply] at hΔ
  change 0 ≤ -Δ (fun z : ℂ => translationPairing μ f φ (z • v)) 0 at hΔ
  rw [hline] at hΔ
  linarith

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.circleAverage_deficit_pairing_le
statement:
