theorem DiscPshOn.circleAverage_deficit_pairing_le {u : E → EReal} {U K : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn u U) (hK : MeasurableSet K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (C : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≤ (C : EReal)) {f φ : E → ℝ}
    (hD : K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (f y))
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 2 φ) (hφn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (v : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hdisc : ∀ x ∈ Function.support φ, affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ K) :
    Real.circleAverage (fun z : ℂ => translationPairing μ f φ (z • v)) 0 r ≤
      translationPairing μ f φ 0
proof:
:=
  hu.submean.circleAverage_deficit_pairing_le hKU C hC
    (hu.measurable_indicator_deficit hK hKU C) hD hf hfn hφs hφ hφn v hr hdisc

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.integral_deficit_mul_leviForm_nonpos
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.integral_deficit_mul_leviForm_nonpos {u : E → EReal} {U K : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn u U) (hK : MeasurableSet K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (C : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≤ (C : EReal)) {f φ : E → ℝ}
    (hD : K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (f y))
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 2 φ) (hφn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (v : E) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hdisc : ∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 R, ∀ x ∈ Function.support φ, affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ K) :
    (∫ x, f x * leviForm φ x v ∂μ) ≤ 0
proof:
:=
  hu.submean.integral_deficit_mul_leviForm_nonpos hKU C hC
    (hu.measurable_indicator_deficit hK hKU C) hD hf hfn hφs hφ hφn v hR hdisc

name: PshLines.shrinkingBump_rOut_le
statement:
theorem shrinkingBump_rOut_le (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (n : ℕ) :
    (shrinkingBump (E := E) R hR n).rOut ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  change R / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ R
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]

name: PshLines.shrinkingBump_radius_ratio
statement:
theorem shrinkingBump_radius_ratio (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (n : ℕ) :
    (shrinkingBump (E := E) R hR n).rOut =
      2 * (shrinkingBump (E := E) R hR n).rIn
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [shrinkingBump]
  ring

name: PshLines.tendsto_shrinkingBump_rOut
statement:
theorem tendsto_shrinkingBump_rOut (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (shrinkingBump (E := E) R hR n).rOut) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
      tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp
        ((tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1))
  simpa only [shrinkingBump, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_zero] using
    (tendsto_const_nhds.mul h : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => R * ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 (R * 0)))

name: PshLines.mollify_eq_convolution
statement:
theorem mollify_eq_convolution (u : E → ℝ) (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : E)) :
    mollify μ u φ = φ.normed μ ⋆[ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ, μ] u
proof:
:= by
  funext z
  simp only [mollify, translationPairing, convolution_eq_swap,
    ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
    change u x * φ.normed μ (x - z) = φ.normed μ (z - x) * u x
    have hφ : φ.normed μ (x - z) = φ.normed μ (z - x) := by
      rw [← φ.normed_neg (x - z), neg_sub]
    rw [hφ, mul_comm])

name: PshLines.contDiff_mollify
statement:
theorem contDiff_mollify {u : E → ℝ} (hu : LocallyIntegrable u μ)
    (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : E)) {n : ℕ∞} : ContDiff ℝ n (mollify μ u φ)
proof:
:=
  contDiff_translationPairing hu φ.hasCompactSupport_normed φ.contDiff_normed

name: PshLines.abs_mollify_le_of_ae_abs_le
statement:
theorem abs_mollify_le_of_ae_abs_le
    {u : E → ℝ} (hu : LocallyIntegrable u μ) {C : ℝ} (_hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (huC : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |u x| ≤ C) (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : E)) (z : E) :
    |mollify μ u φ z| ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : Integrable
      (fun x : E ↦ u x * φ.normed μ (x - z)) μ :=
    integrable_translationPairing hu φ.hasCompactSupport_normed
      φ.continuous_normed z
  have hleft : Integrable
      (fun x : E ↦ |u x| * φ.normed μ (x - z)) μ := by
    convert hpair.norm using 1
    funext x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (φ.nonneg_normed (x - z))]
  have hright : Integrable
      (fun x : E ↦ C * φ.normed μ (x - z)) μ :=
    integrable_translationPairing (locallyIntegrable_const C)
      φ.hasCompactSupport_normed φ.continuous_normed z
  calc
    |mollify μ u φ z| =
        |∫ x : E, u x * φ.normed μ (x - z) ∂μ| := rfl
    _ ≤ ∫ x : E, |u x * φ.normed μ (x - z)| ∂μ :=
      abs_integral_le_integral_abs
    _ = ∫ x : E, |u x| * φ.normed μ (x - z) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (φ.nonneg_normed (x - z))]
    _ ≤ ∫ x : E, C * φ.normed μ (x - z) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hleft hright
      filter_upwards [huC] with x hx
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx (φ.nonneg_normed (x - z))
    _ = C := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_sub_right_eq_self, φ.integral_normed, mul_one]

name: PshLines.tsupport_mollifier_translate_subset
statement:
theorem tsupport_mollifier_translate_subset (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : E)) (z : E) :
    tsupport (fun x => φ.normed μ (x - z)) ⊆ closedBall z φ.rOut
proof:
:= by
  apply closure_minimal _ isClosed_closedBall
  intro x hx
  have hx' : x - z ∈ Function.support (φ.normed μ) := hx
  rw [φ.support_normed_eq] at hx'
  have hnorm : ‖x - z‖ < φ.rOut := by
    simpa only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hx'
  simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hnorm.le

name: PshLines.ae_tendsto_mollify
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_mollify {u : E → ℝ} (hu : LocallyIntegrable u μ)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => mollify μ u (shrinkingBump R hR n) x)
      atTop (𝓝 (u x))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mollify_eq_convolution]
  apply ContDiffBump.ae_convolution_tendsto_right_of_locallyIntegrable
    (tendsto_shrinkingBump_rOut R hR) (K := 2) _ hu
  exact Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (shrinkingBump_radius_ratio R hR n).le)

name: PshLines.PositiveDistribution.add
proof:
:= by
  intro φ hφ
  exact add_nonneg (hS φ hφ) (hT φ hφ)

name: PshLines.PositiveDistribution.smul
statement:
theorem PositiveDistribution.smul {T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)} (hT : PositiveDistribution T)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) : PositiveDistribution (c • T)
proof:
:= by
  intro φ hφ
  exact mul_nonneg hc (hT φ hφ)

name: PshLines.regularDistribution_apply
statement:
theorem regularDistribution_apply (μ : Measure E) (u : E → ℝ)
    (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ) (φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) :
    regularDistribution μ u hu φ = ∫ x, φ x * u x ∂μ
proof:
:=
  TestFunction.integralAgainstBilinCLM_eq_integral hu

name: PshLines.regularDistribution_congr_ae
proof:
:= by
  ext φ
  rw [regularDistribution_apply, regularDistribution_apply]
  exact integral_congr_ae (heq.mono (fun x hx => congrArg (φ x * ·) hx))

name: PshLines.positive_regularDistribution
proof:
:= by
  intro φ hφ
  rw [regularDistribution_apply]
  exact integral_nonneg_of_ae (hpos.mono (fun x hx => mul_nonneg (hφ x) hx))

name: PshLines.distributionalLeviCLM_apply
statement:
theorem distributionalLeviCLM_apply (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (v : E) (φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) :
    distributionalLeviCLM v T φ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
      (T (TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ v
          (TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ v φ)) +
       T (TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ (Complex.I • v)
         (TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ (Complex.I • v) φ)))
proof:
:= by
  simp [distributionalLeviCLM, Distribution.lineDerivCLM_apply, mul_add]

name: PshLines.HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi.add
statement:
theorem HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi.add {S T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)}
    (hS : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi S)
    (hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi T) :
    HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi (S + T)
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  rw [map_add]
  exact (hS v).add (hT v)

name: PshLines.HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi.smul
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  rw [map_smul]
  exact (hT v).smul hc

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_locallyIntegrable
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_locallyIntegrable
    (hu : DiscPshOn u Ω)
    (huL : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => (u x).toReal) Ω μ)
    (hfin : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict Ω, u x ≠ ⊤ ∧ u x ≠ ⊥) :
    HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
      (regularDistribution μ (fun x => (u x).toReal) huL)
proof:
:= by
  intro v φ hφn
  obtain ⟨R, hR, K, hK, hKΩ, hφK, hdiscs⟩ :=
    exists_compact_affineClosedDisc_family φ.hasCompactSupport Ω.isOpen φ.tsupport_subset v
  have hmajorant : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, u x ≤ (C : EReal) := by
    by_cases hne : K.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hu.exists_compact_upper_bound hK hne hKΩ
      refine ⟨Max.max C 0, le_max_right C 0, ?_⟩
      intro x hx
      exact (hC x hx).trans (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (le_max_left C 0))
    · refine ⟨0, le_rfl, ?_⟩
      intro x hx
      exact (hne ⟨x, hx⟩).elim
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := hmajorant
  let f : E → ℝ := K.indicator (fun x => C - (u x).toReal)
  have hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ :=
    locallyIntegrable_indicator_realDeficit_of_isCompact hK hKΩ huL C
  have hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x := indicator_realDeficit_nonneg hC0 hC
  have hD : K.indicator (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x) :=
    indicator_deficit_ae_eq_ofReal_of_isCompact hK hKΩ hfin C
  have hφ2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 (φ : E → ℝ) :=
    φ.contDiff.of_le (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)
  have hpair := hu.integral_deficit_mul_leviForm_nonpos hK.measurableSet hKΩ C hC
    hD hf hfn φ.hasCompactSupport hφ2 hφn v hR (by
      intro r hr x hx
      exact hdiscs x (subset_closure hx) r hr.2.le)
  change (∫ x, K.indicator (fun y => C - (u y).toReal) x * leviForm φ x v ∂μ) ≤ 0 at hpair
  rw [integral_indicator_deficit_mul_leviForm_testFunction huL φ hφK C v] at hpair
  exact neg_nonpos.mp hpair

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.pshRegularDistribution_hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.pshRegularDistribution_hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
    (hu : DiscPshOn u Ω) (hΩ : IsPreconnected (Ω : Set E))
    (hne : ∃ a ∈ Ω, u a ≠ ⊥) :
    HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
      (pshRegularDistribution (hu.plurisubharmonicOn Ω.isOpen) μ hΩ hne)
proof:
:= by
  apply hu.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_locallyIntegrable
  exact (hu.plurisubharmonicOn Ω.isOpen).ae_finite μ hΩ hne

name: PshLines.translationPairing_eq_convolution
statement:
theorem translationPairing_eq_convolution (u φ : E → ℝ) :
    translationPairing μ u φ = u ⋆[ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ, μ] (fun x => φ (-x))
proof:
:= by
  funext z
  simp only [translationPairing, convolution_def, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply', neg_sub]

name: PshLines.integrable_translationPairing
proof:
:= by
  have hs : HasCompactSupport (fun x => φ (-x)) :=
    hφs.comp_homeomorph (Homeomorph.neg E)
  simpa only [ConvolutionExistsAt, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply', neg_sub] using
    hs.convolutionExists_right (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) hu
      (hφ.comp continuous_neg) z

name: PshLines.contDiff_translationPairing
proof:
:= by
  rw [translationPairing_eq_convolution]
  exact (hφs.comp_homeomorph (Homeomorph.neg E)).contDiff_convolution_right
    (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) hu (hφ.comp contDiff_neg)

name: PshLines.fderiv_translationPairing
statement:
theorem fderiv_translationPairing {u φ : E → ℝ}
    (hu : LocallyIntegrable u μ) (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ)
    (z v : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (translationPairing μ u φ) z v =
      -translationPairing μ u (fun x => fderiv ℝ φ x v) z
proof:
:= by
  let ψ : E → ℝ := fun x => φ (-x)
  have hψs : HasCompactSupport ψ := hφs.comp_homeomorph (Homeomorph.neg E)
  have hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ := hφ.comp contDiff_neg
  have hdψ (x : E) : fderiv ℝ ψ x v = -fderiv ℝ φ (-x) v := by
    have h := (hφ.differentiable one_ne_zero (-x)).hasFDerivAt.comp x
      (hasFDerivAt_id x).neg
    simpa only [ψ, Function.comp_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, neg_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, map_neg] using congrArg (fun A => A v) h.fderiv
  rw [translationPairing_eq_convolution,
    (hψs.hasFDerivAt_convolution_right (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) hu hψ z).fderiv,
    convolution_precompR_apply (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) hu (hψs.fderiv ℝ)
      (hψ.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero)]
  simp only [convolution_def, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply', hdψ, neg_sub,
    mul_neg, integral_neg, translationPairing]

name: PshLines.realHessian_translationPairing
statement:
theorem realHessian_translationPairing {u φ : E → ℝ}
    (hu : LocallyIntegrable u μ) (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 2 φ)
    (z v w : E) :
    realHessian (translationPairing μ u φ) z v w =
      ∫ x, u x * realHessian φ (x - z) v w ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ContDiff ℝ 2 (translationPairing μ u φ) :=
    contDiff_translationPairing hu hφs hφ
  rw [← fderiv_fderiv_apply_eq_realHessian hp]
  have hfirst : (fun y => fderiv ℝ (translationPairing μ u φ) y w) =
      -translationPairing μ u (fun x => fderiv ℝ φ x w) := by
    funext y
    exact fderiv_translationPairing hu hφs (hφ.of_le (by norm_num)) y w
  rw [hfirst, fderiv_neg, neg_apply,
    fderiv_translationPairing hu (hφs.fderiv_apply ℝ w)
      (contDiff_fderiv_apply_of_two hφ w), neg_neg]
  simp only [translationPairing, fderiv_fderiv_apply_eq_realHessian hφ]

name: PshLines.integrable_translationPairing_realHessian
statement:
theorem integrable_translationPairing_realHessian {u φ : E → ℝ}
    (hu : LocallyIntegrable u μ) (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 2 φ)
    (z v w : E) :
    Integrable (fun x => u x * realHessian φ (x - z) v w) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hs : HasCompactSupport (fun x => realHessian φ x v w) := by
    simpa only [fderiv_fderiv_apply_eq_realHessian hφ] using
      (hφs.fderiv_apply ℝ w).fderiv_apply ℝ v
  exact integrable_translationPairing hu hs (continuous_realHessian hφ v w) z

name: PshLines.leviForm_translationPairing
statement:
theorem leviForm_translationPairing {u φ : E → ℝ}
    (hu : LocallyIntegrable u μ) (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 2 φ)
    (z v : E) :
    leviForm (translationPairing μ u φ) z v =
      ∫ x, u x * leviForm φ (x - z) v ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [leviForm, realHessian_translationPairing hu hφs hφ,
    realHessian_translationPairing hu hφs hφ,
    ← integral_add (integrable_translationPairing_realHessian hu hφs hφ z v v)
      (integrable_translationPairing_realHessian hu hφs hφ z
        (Complex.I • v) (Complex.I • v)), ← integral_div]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by simp only [leviForm]; ring)

name: PshLines.contDiff_translationPairing_complexLine
proof:
:=
  (contDiff_translationPairing hu hφs hφ).comp (complexLineLinear v).contDiff

name: PshLines.laplacian_translationPairing_complexLine
statement:
theorem laplacian_translationPairing_complexLine {u φ : E → ℝ}
    (hu : LocallyIntegrable u μ) (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 2 φ)
    (z : ℂ) (v : E) :
    Laplacian.laplacian (fun t : ℂ => translationPairing μ u φ (t • v)) z =
      ∫ x, u x * (realHessian φ (x - z • v) v v +
        realHessian φ (x - z • v) (Complex.I • v) (Complex.I • v)) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ContDiff ℝ 2 (translationPairing μ u φ) :=
    contDiff_translationPairing hu hφs hφ
  have h := laplacian_complexLine hp (0 : E) v z
  simp only [zero_add, leviForm_translationPairing hu hφs hφ] at h
  rw [h, ← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by simp only [leviForm]; ring)

name: PshLines.measurePreserving_linearIsometryEquiv_addHaar
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_linearIsometryEquiv_addHaar
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) :
    MeasurePreserving e μ μ
proof:
:= by
  let K : PositiveCompacts E :=
    { carrier := closedBall 0 1
      isCompact' := isCompact_closedBall 0 1
      interior_nonempty' := ⟨0, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr (closedBall_mem_nhds 0 (by norm_num))⟩ }
  have hpre : e ⁻¹' (K : Set E) = K := by
    ext x
    change e x ∈ closedBall (0 : E) 1 ↔ x ∈ closedBall (0 : E) 1
    simp [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
  have hmap : μ.map e (K : Set E) = μ K := by
    rw [Measure.map_apply e.continuous.measurable K.isCompact.measurableSet, hpre]
  let : (μ.map e).IsAddHaarMeasure :=
    e.toContinuousLinearEquiv.isAddHaarMeasure_map μ
  refine ⟨e.continuous.measurable, ?_⟩
  calc
    μ.map e = μ.map e K • Measure.addHaarMeasure K := Measure.addHaarMeasure_unique _ K
    _ = μ K • Measure.addHaarMeasure K := by rw [hmap]
    _ = μ := (Measure.addHaarMeasure_unique μ K).symm

name: PshLines.lintegral_ball_linearIsometryEquiv
statement:
theorem lintegral_ball_linearIsometryEquiv (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (f : E → ℝ≥0∞) (R : ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ x in ball 0 R, f (e x) ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in ball 0 R, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hpre : e ⁻¹' ball 0 R = ball 0 R := by
    ext x
    simp [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
  have hpres := (measurePreserving_linearIsometryEquiv_addHaar μ e).restrict_preimage
    (s := ball 0 R) measurableSet_ball
  rw [hpre] at hpres
  exact (MeasurePreserving.lintegral_map_equiv f e.toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv hpres).symm

name: PshLines.lintegral_ball_add
statement:
theorem lintegral_ball_add (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (f : E → ℝ≥0∞) (a : E) (R : ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ w in ball 0 R, f (a + w) ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in ball a R, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hpre : (fun w : E => a + w) ⁻¹' ball a R = ball 0 R := by
    ext w
    simp [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
  have hpres := (measurePreserving_add_left μ a).restrict_preimage
    (s := ball a R) measurableSet_ball
  rw [hpre] at hpres
  exact (MeasurePreserving.lintegral_map_equiv f
    (Homeomorph.addLeft a).toMeasurableEquiv hpres).symm

name: PshLines.complexRotation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem complexRotation_apply (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (x : E) :
    complexRotation z hz x = z • x
proof: := rfl

name: PshLines.measurePreserving_smul_of_norm_eq_one
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_smul_of_norm_eq_one (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) : MeasurePreserving (fun x : E => z • x) μ μ
proof:
:=
  measurePreserving_linearIsometryEquiv_addHaar μ (complexRotation z hz)

name: PshLines.lintegral_ball_smul_of_norm_eq_one
statement:
theorem lintegral_ball_smul_of_norm_eq_one (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (f : E → ℝ≥0∞) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (R : ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ x in ball 0 R, f (z • x) ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in ball 0 R, f x ∂μ
proof:
:=
  lintegral_ball_linearIsometryEquiv μ (complexRotation z hz) f R

name: PshLines.lintegral_ball_add_smul_of_norm_eq_one
statement:
theorem lintegral_ball_add_smul_of_norm_eq_one (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (f : E → ℝ≥0∞) (a : E) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (R : ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ w in ball 0 R, f (a + z • w) ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in ball a R, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_ball_smul_of_norm_eq_one μ (fun x => f (a + x)) z hz,
    lintegral_ball_add]

name: PshLines.lintegral_ball_add_circleMap_smul
statement:
theorem lintegral_ball_add_circleMap_smul (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (f : E → ℝ≥0∞) (a : E) (t R : ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ w in ball 0 R, f (a + circleMap 0 1 t • w) ∂μ =
      ∫⁻ x in ball a R, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  apply lintegral_ball_add_smul_of_norm_eq_one
  simp

name: PshLines.testFunction_lineDerivCLM_apply_eq_fderiv
statement:
theorem testFunction_lineDerivCLM_apply_eq_fderiv (φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (v x : E) :
    TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ v φ x = fderiv ℝ φ x v
proof:
:= by
  rw [TestFunction.lineDerivCLM_eq_fderivCLM,
    TestFunction.fderivCLM_apply_of_le φ (by simp)]

name: PshLines.contDiff_fderiv_apply_of_two
statement:
theorem contDiff_fderiv_apply_of_two {u : E → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (v : E) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => fderiv ℝ u x v)
proof:
:=
  (hu.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).clm_apply contDiff_const

name: PshLines.fderiv_fderiv_apply_eq_realHessian
statement:
theorem fderiv_fderiv_apply_eq_realHessian {u : E → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (x v w : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y w) x v = realHessian u x v w
proof:
:= by
  have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x :=
    (hu.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiable (by norm_num) x
  rw [fderiv_clm_apply hD (differentiableAt_const w)]
  simp [realHessian_eq_fderiv]

name: PshLines.continuous_realHessian
statement:
theorem continuous_realHessian {u : E → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (v w : E) :
    Continuous (fun x => realHessian u x v w)
proof:
:= by
  have hD : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u)) :=
    (hu.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)
  have h : Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x v w) :=
    (hD.clm_apply continuous_const).clm_apply continuous_const
  simpa only [realHessian_eq_fderiv] using h

name: PshLines.continuous_leviForm
statement:
theorem continuous_leviForm [NormedSpace ℂ E] {u : E → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (v : E) : Continuous (fun x => leviForm u x v)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((continuous_realHessian hu v v).add
    (continuous_realHessian hu (Complex.I • v) (Complex.I • v))).div_const 4

name: PshLines.locallyIntegrableOn_fderiv_of_contDiff
proof:
:=
  ((hu.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).clm_apply continuous_const).locallyIntegrable
    |>.locallyIntegrableOn Ω

name: PshLines.lineDerivCLM_regularDistribution
statement:
theorem lineDerivCLM_regularDistribution {u : E → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ 1 u) (v : E) :
    Distribution.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) v
        (regularDistribution μ u (hu.continuous.locallyIntegrable.locallyIntegrableOn Ω)) =
      regularDistribution μ (fun x => fderiv ℝ u x v)
        (locallyIntegrableOn_fderiv_of_contDiff hu v)
proof:
:= by
  ext φ
  have huL : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ :=
    hu.continuous.locallyIntegrable.locallyIntegrableOn Ω
  have hduL : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ u x v) Ω μ :=
    locallyIntegrableOn_fderiv_of_contDiff hu v
  let ψ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ) := TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ v φ
  have hψ : ∀ x, ψ x = fderiv ℝ φ x v :=
    fun x => testFunction_lineDerivCLM_apply_eq_fderiv φ v x
  have hψu : Integrable (fun x => ψ x * u x) μ :=
    TestFunction.integrable_bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) huL ψ
  have hdφu : Integrable (fun x => fderiv ℝ φ x v * u x) μ := by
    simpa only [hψ] using hψu
  have hφdu : Integrable (fun x => φ x * fderiv ℝ u x v) μ :=
    TestFunction.integrable_bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) hduL φ
  have hφu : Integrable (fun x => φ x * u x) μ :=
    TestFunction.integrable_bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) huL φ
  have hibp := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable hdφu hφdu hφu
    (fun x _ => φ.contDiff.differentiable (by simp) x)
    (fun x _ => hu.differentiable (by norm_num) x)
  rw [Distribution.lineDerivCLM_apply, regularDistribution_apply, regularDistribution_apply]
  simpa only [testFunction_lineDerivCLM_apply_eq_fderiv] using hibp.symm

name: PshLines.lineDerivCLM_lineDerivCLM_regularDistribution
statement:
theorem lineDerivCLM_lineDerivCLM_regularDistribution {u : E → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (v w : E) :
    Distribution.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) v
      (Distribution.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) w
        (regularDistribution μ u (hu.continuous.locallyIntegrable.locallyIntegrableOn Ω))) =
      regularDistribution μ (fun x => realHessian u x v w)
        ((continuous_realHessian hu v w).locallyIntegrable.locallyIntegrableOn Ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hu1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 u := hu.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hdu : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => fderiv ℝ u x w) :=
    contDiff_fderiv_apply_of_two hu w
  rw [lineDerivCLM_regularDistribution hu1 w, lineDerivCLM_regularDistribution hdu v]
  exact regularDistribution_congr_ae
    (locallyIntegrableOn_fderiv_of_contDiff hdu v)
    ((continuous_realHessian hu v w).locallyIntegrable.locallyIntegrableOn Ω)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => fderiv_fderiv_apply_eq_realHessian hu x v w))

name: PshLines.locallyIntegrableOn_leviForm_of_contDiff
proof:
:=
  (continuous_leviForm hu v).locallyIntegrable.locallyIntegrableOn Ω

name: PshLines.distributionalLeviCLM_regularDistribution
statement:
theorem distributionalLeviCLM_regularDistribution {u : E → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (v : E) :
    distributionalLeviCLM v
        (regularDistribution μ u (hu.continuous.locallyIntegrable.locallyIntegrableOn Ω)) =
      regularDistribution μ (fun x => leviForm u x v)
        (locallyIntegrableOn_leviForm_of_contDiff hu v)
proof:
:= by
  ext φ
  simp only [distributionalLeviCLM, smul_apply, add_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [lineDerivCLM_lineDerivCLM_regularDistribution hu v v,
    lineDerivCLM_lineDerivCLM_regularDistribution hu (Complex.I • v) (Complex.I • v)]
  simp only [regularDistribution_apply]
  have hA : Integrable (fun x => φ x * realHessian u x v v) μ :=
    TestFunction.integrable_bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ)
      ((continuous_realHessian hu v v).locallyIntegrable.locallyIntegrableOn Ω) φ
  have hB : Integrable
      (fun x => φ x * realHessian u x (Complex.I • v) (Complex.I • v)) μ :=
    TestFunction.integrable_bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ)
      ((continuous_realHessian hu (Complex.I • v) (Complex.I • v)).locallyIntegrable
        |>.locallyIntegrableOn Ω) φ
  rw [← integral_add hA hB, ← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by simp only [leviForm]; ring)

name: PshLines.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_regularDistribution
statement:
theorem hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_regularDistribution {u : E → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (hL : ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∀ v : E, 0 ≤ leviForm u x v) :
    HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
      (regularDistribution μ u (hu.continuous.locallyIntegrable.locallyIntegrableOn Ω))
proof:
:= by
  intro v φ hφ
  rw [distributionalLeviCLM_regularDistribution hu v, regularDistribution_apply]
  apply integral_nonneg
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Ω
  · exact mul_nonneg (hφ x) (hL x hx v)
  · have hφx : φ x = 0 :=
      image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (φ.tsupport_subset h))
    simp [hφx]

name: PshLines.finiteDeficit_add
statement:
theorem finiteDeficit_add (C D : ℝ) {z w : EReal}
    (hz : z ≤ (C : EReal)) (hw : w ≤ (D : EReal)) :
    (((C + D : ℝ) : EReal) - (z + w)).toENNReal =
      ((C : EReal) - z).toENNReal + ((D : EReal) - w).toENNReal
proof:
:= by
  have hzT : z ≠ ⊤ := ne_of_lt (hz.trans_lt (EReal.coe_lt_top C))
  have hwT : w ≠ ⊤ := ne_of_lt (hw.trans_lt (EReal.coe_lt_top D))
  have hzN : 0 ≤ (C : EReal) - z :=
    (EReal.sub_nonneg (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_top C))
      (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_bot C))).mpr hz
  have hwN : 0 ≤ (D : EReal) - w :=
    (EReal.sub_nonneg (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_top D))
      (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_bot D))).mpr hw
  have heq : ((C + D : ℝ) : EReal) - (z + w) =
      ((C : EReal) - z) + ((D : EReal) - w) := by
    rw [EReal.coe_add, sub_eq_add_neg, EReal.neg_add (Or.inr hwT) (Or.inl hzT)]
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg]
    ac_rfl
  rw [heq, EReal.toENNReal_add hzN hwN]

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.circleDeficit_add
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.circleDeficit_add {u w : E → EReal} {U : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn u U) (x v : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hD : affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ U) (C D : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ affineClosedDisc x v r, u y ≤ (C : EReal))
    (hW : ∀ y ∈ affineClosedDisc x v r, w y ≤ (D : EReal)) :
    circleDeficit (fun y => u y + w y) x v r (C + D) =
      circleDeficit u x v r C + circleDeficit w x v r D
proof:
:= by
  unfold circleDeficit
  simp_rw [finiteDeficit_add C D
    (hC _ (circle_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr _))
    (hW _ (circle_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr _))]
  exact lintegral_add_left (hu.measurable_circle_deficit x v hr hD C) _

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.add
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun y hy => EReal.add_ne_top (hu.ne_top y hy) (hw.ne_top y hy), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    exact UpperSemicontinuousWithinAt.add'
      (hu.upperSemicontinuousOn y hy) (hw.upperSemicontinuousOn y hy)
      (EReal.continuousAt_add (Or.inl (hu.ne_top y hy)) (Or.inr (hw.ne_top y hy)))
  · intro x v r hr hD C hC
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := hu.exists_disc_upper_bound x v hr.le hD
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hw.exists_disc_upper_bound x v hr.le hD
    let D : ℝ := Max.max A (C - B)
    have hAD : A ≤ D := le_max_left _ _
    have hCD : C ≤ D + B := by
      have : C - B ≤ D := le_max_right _ _
      linarith
    have hDu : ∀ y ∈ affineClosedDisc x v r, u y ≤ (D : EReal) :=
      fun y hy => (hA y hy).trans (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr hAD)
    have hsum : circleDeficit (fun y => u y + w y) x v r (D + B) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * (((D + B : ℝ) : EReal) - (u x + w x)).toENNReal := by
      rw [hu.circleDeficit_add x v hr.le hD D B hDu hB,
        finiteDeficit_add D B (hDu x (center_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr.le))
          (hB x (center_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr.le)), mul_add]
      exact add_le_add (hu.submean x v r hr hD D hDu) (hw.submean x v r hr hD B hB)
    apply (discSubmean_add_bound_iff x v hr.le C (D + B - C)
      (sub_nonneg.mpr hCD) hC).mp
    have hboundeq : C + (D + B - C) = D + B := by ring
    simpa only [hboundeq] using hsum

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicAt.add
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, hu⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hw⟩ := hw
  exact ⟨U ∩ V, hU.inter hV, ⟨hxU, hxV⟩,
    (hu.mono inter_subset_left).add (hw.mono inter_subset_right)⟩

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.add
proof:
:=
  fun x hx => (hu x hx).add (hw x hx)

name: PshLines.center_mem_affineClosedDisc
statement:
theorem center_mem_affineClosedDisc (x v : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    x ∈ affineClosedDisc x v r
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, ?_, by simp⟩
  simpa using hr

name: PshLines.circle_mem_affineClosedDisc
statement:
theorem circle_mem_affineClosedDisc (x v : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (t : ℝ) :
    x + circleMap 0 r t • v ∈ affineClosedDisc x v r
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨circleMap 0 r t, ?_, rfl⟩
  exact sphere_subset_closedBall (circleMap_mem_sphere 0 hr t)

name: PshLines.isCompact_affineClosedDisc
statement:
theorem isCompact_affineClosedDisc (x v : E) (r : ℝ) :
    IsCompact (affineClosedDisc x v r)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) r).image
  fun_prop

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.exists_disc_upper_bound
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.exists_disc_upper_bound {u : E → EReal} {U : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn u U) (x v : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hD : affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ U) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ affineClosedDisc x v r, u y ≤ (C : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hmax⟩ := (hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.mono hD).exists_isMaxOn
    ⟨x, center_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr⟩ (isCompact_affineClosedDisc x v r)
  obtain ⟨C, hC, _⟩ := EReal.exists_rat_btwn_of_lt (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr (hu.ne_top y (hD hy)))
  exact ⟨C, fun z hz => (hmax hz).trans hC.le⟩

name: PshLines.HasDiscSubmeanOn.mono
statement:
theorem HasDiscSubmeanOn.mono {u : E → EReal} {U V : Set E}
    (hu : HasDiscSubmeanOn u U) (hVU : V ⊆ U) : HasDiscSubmeanOn u V
proof:
:= by
  intro x v r hr hD C hC
  exact hu x v r hr (hD.trans hVU) C hC

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.mono
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.mono {u : E → EReal} {U V : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn u U) (hVU : V ⊆ U) : DiscPshOn u V
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x hx => hu.ne_top x (hVU hx), hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.mono hVU,
    hu.submean.mono hVU⟩

name: PshLines.circleDeficit_antitone
statement:
theorem circleDeficit_antitone {u w : E → EReal} (x v : E) (r C : ℝ)
    (huw : ∀ t : ℝ, u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v) ≤
      w (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)) :
    circleDeficit w x v r C ≤ circleDeficit u x v r C
proof:
:= by
  unfold circleDeficit
  apply lintegral_mono
  intro t
  exact EReal.toENNReal_le_toENNReal (EReal.sub_le_sub le_rfl (huw t))

name: PshLines.HasDiscSubmeanOn.max
proof:
:= by
  intro x v r hr hD C hC
  have hCu : ∀ y ∈ affineClosedDisc x v r, u y ≤ (C : EReal) :=
    fun y hy => (le_max_left _ _).trans (hC y hy)
  have hCw : ∀ y ∈ affineClosedDisc x v r, w y ≤ (C : EReal) :=
    fun y hy => (le_max_right _ _).trans (hC y hy)
  rcases le_total (u x) (w x) with h | h
  · have hmono := circleDeficit_antitone (u := w)
      (w := fun y => Max.max (u y) (w y)) x v r C (fun _ => le_max_right _ _)
    simpa only [max_eq_right h] using hmono.trans (hw x v r hr hD C hCw)
  · have hmono := circleDeficit_antitone (u := u)
      (w := fun y => Max.max (u y) (w y)) x v r C (fun _ => le_max_left _ _)
    simpa only [max_eq_left h] using hmono.trans (hu x v r hr hD C hCu)

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.max
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.sup hw.upperSemicontinuousOn,
    hu.submean.max hw.submean⟩
  intro x hx
  exact ne_of_lt (max_lt (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr (hu.ne_top x hx))
    (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr (hw.ne_top x hx)))

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.plurisubharmonicOn
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.plurisubharmonicOn {u : E → EReal} {U : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn u U) (hU : IsOpen U) : PlurisubharmonicOn u U
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx => ⟨U, hU, hx, hu⟩

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicAt.max
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, hu⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hw⟩ := hw
  exact ⟨U ∩ V, hU.inter hV, ⟨hxU, hxV⟩,
    (hu.mono inter_subset_left).max (hw.mono inter_subset_right)⟩

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.max
proof:
:=
  fun x hx => (hu x hx).max (hw x hx)

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.mono
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.mono {u : E → EReal} {U V : Set E}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u U) (hVU : V ⊆ U) : PlurisubharmonicOn u V
proof:
:=
  fun x hx => hu x (hVU hx)

name: PshLines.HasDiscSubmeanOn.congr
statement:
theorem HasDiscSubmeanOn.congr {u w : E → EReal} {U : Set E}
    (hu : HasDiscSubmeanOn u U) (heq : EqOn u w U) : HasDiscSubmeanOn w U
proof:
:= by
  intro x v r hr hD C hC
  have hx : x ∈ U := hD (center_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr.le)
  have hcircle : circleDeficit u x v r C = circleDeficit w x v r C := by
    apply lintegral_congr
    intro t
    rw [heq (hD (circle_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr.le t))]
  rw [← hcircle, ← heq hx]
  exact hu x v r hr hD C (fun y hy => (heq (hD hy)).trans_le (hC y hy))

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.congr
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.congr {u w : E → EReal} {U : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn u U) (heq : EqOn u w U) : DiscPshOn w U
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x hx => (heq hx) ▸ hu.ne_top x hx, ?_, hu.submean.congr heq⟩
  intro x hx
  apply (hu.upperSemicontinuousOn x hx).congr_of_eventuallyEq hx
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hy
  intro c
  rw [heq hy]

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicAt.congr
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, hu⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨V, hVsub, hV, hxV⟩ := _root_.mem_nhds_iff.mp heq
  refine ⟨U ∩ V, hU.inter hV, ⟨hxU, hxV⟩, ?_⟩
  exact (hu.mono inter_subset_left).congr (fun _ hy => hVsub hy.2)

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicAt.ne_top
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicAt.ne_top {u : E → EReal} {x : E}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicAt u x) : u x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, hx, hu⟩ := hu
  exact hu.ne_top x hx

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicAt.upperSemicontinuousAt
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicAt.upperSemicontinuousAt {u : E → EReal} {x : E}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicAt u x) : UpperSemicontinuousAt u x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hx, hu⟩ := hu
  intro c hc
  have h := hu.upperSemicontinuousOn x hx c hc
  rwa [nhdsWithin_eq_nhds.mpr (hU.mem_nhds hx)] at h

name: PshLines.circleDeficit_const
statement:
theorem circleDeficit_const (a : EReal) (x v : E) (r C : ℝ) :
    circleDeficit (fun _ => a) x v r C =
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * ((C : EReal) - a).toENNReal
proof:
:= by
  simp [circleDeficit, mul_comm]

name: PshLines.discPshOn_const
statement:
theorem discPshOn_const (a : EReal) (ha : a ≠ ⊤) (U : Set E) :
    DiscPshOn (fun _ => a) U
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ => ha, upperSemicontinuousOn_const, ?_⟩
  intro x v r _ _ C _
  exact (circleDeficit_const a x v r C).le

name: PshLines.plurisubharmonicAt_const
statement:
theorem plurisubharmonicAt_const (a : EReal) (ha : a ≠ ⊤) (x : E) :
    PlurisubharmonicAt (fun _ => a) x
proof:
:=
  ⟨univ, isOpen_univ, mem_univ x, discPshOn_const a ha univ⟩

name: PshLines.gluedMax_plurisubharmonic
statement:
theorem gluedMax_plurisubharmonic {U U' : Set E} {u w : E → EReal}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hclosure : closure U' ⊆ U)
    (hcollar : ∀ x ∈ U \ U', u x ≤ w x)
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u U) (hw : PlurisubharmonicOn w univ) :
    PlurisubharmonicOn (gluedMax U u w) univ
proof:
:= by
  intro x _
  by_cases hx : x ∈ U
  · exact ((hu x hx).max (hw x (mem_univ x))).congr
      (gluedMax_eventually_eq_max hU hx).symm
  · exact (hw x (mem_univ x)).congr
      (gluedMax_eventually_eq_global hclosure hcollar hx).symm

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.measurable_circle
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.measurable_circle {u : E → EReal} {U : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn u U) (x v : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hD : affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ U) :
    Measurable (fun t : ℝ => u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v))
proof:
:= by
  have hsc : UpperSemicontinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)) univ :=
    hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.comp (by fun_prop)
      (fun t _ => hD (circle_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr t))
  exact (upperSemicontinuousOn_univ_iff.mp hsc).measurable

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.measurable_circle_deficit
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.measurable_circle_deficit {u : E → EReal} {U : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn u U) (x v : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hD : affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ U) (C : ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun t : ℝ => ((C : EReal) - u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)).toENNReal)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Measurable (fun z : EReal => (C : EReal) - z) :=
    EReal.measurable_of_measurable_real (by
      simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, id_eq, EReal.coe_sub] using
        ((measurable_const : Measurable (fun _ : ℝ => C)).sub measurable_id).coe_real_ereal)
  exact (hsub.comp (hu.measurable_circle x v hr hD)).ereal_toENNReal

name: PshLines.finiteDeficit_add_bound
statement:
theorem finiteDeficit_add_bound (C a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (z : EReal)
    (hz : z ≤ (C : EReal)) :
    (((C + a : ℝ) : EReal) - z).toENNReal =
      ENNReal.ofReal a + ((C : EReal) - z).toENNReal
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 ≤ (C : EReal) - z :=
    (EReal.sub_nonneg (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_top C)) (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_bot C))).mpr hz
  have heq : ((C + a : ℝ) : EReal) - z = (a : EReal) + ((C : EReal) - z) := by
    rw [EReal.coe_add]
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg]
    ac_rfl
  rw [heq, EReal.toENNReal_add (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr ha) hn,
    EReal.real_coe_toENNReal]

name: PshLines.circleDeficit_add_bound
statement:
theorem circleDeficit_add_bound {u : E → EReal} (x v : E) {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (C a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ affineClosedDisc x v r, u y ≤ (C : EReal)) :
    circleDeficit u x v r (C + a) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * ENNReal.ofReal a + circleDeficit u x v r C
proof:
:= by
  unfold circleDeficit
  simp_rw [finiteDeficit_add_bound C a ha _
    (hC _ (circle_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr _))]
  rw [lintegral_add_left measurable_const]
  simp [mul_comm]

name: PshLines.discSubmean_add_bound_iff
statement:
theorem discSubmean_add_bound_iff {u : E → EReal} (x v : E) {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (C a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ affineClosedDisc x v r, u y ≤ (C : EReal)) :
    (circleDeficit u x v r (C + a) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) *
      (((C + a : ℝ) : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) ↔
    (circleDeficit u x v r C ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) *
      ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleDeficit_add_bound x v hr C a ha hC,
    finiteDeficit_add_bound C a ha _ (hC x (center_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr)), mul_add]
  exact ENNReal.add_le_add_iff_left
    (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.le_of_ae_le
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.le_of_ae_le {u v : E → EReal} {Ω : Set E}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω)
    (hv : UpperSemicontinuousOn v Ω)
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hae : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.restrict Ω, u y ≤ v y) :
    ∀ x ∈ Ω, u x ≤ v x
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  by_contra hle
  have hlt : v x < u x := lt_of_not_ge hle
  obtain ⟨q, hvq, hqu⟩ := EReal.exists_rat_btwn_of_lt hlt
  have hux := hu x hx
  have hxbot : u x ≠ ⊥ := ne_of_gt (bot_le.trans_lt hlt)
  have hxreal : ((u x).toReal : EReal) = u x := EReal.coe_toReal hux.ne_top hxbot
  have hqreal : (q : ℝ) < (u x).toReal := by
    apply EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp
    exact hqu.trans_le hxreal.symm.le
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, hdisc⟩ := hux
  have hvc : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, v y < ((q : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    have h := hv x hx _ hvq
    rwa [nhdsWithin_eq_nhds.mpr (hΩ.mem_nhds hx)] at h
  have hnbhd : {y | y ∈ U ∧ y ∈ Ω ∧ v y < ((q : ℝ) : EReal)} ∈ 𝓝 x := by
    filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hxU, hΩ.mem_nhds hx, hvc] with y hyU hyΩ hyv
    exact ⟨hyU, hyΩ, hyv⟩
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnbhd
  have hR : 0 < ε / 2 := half_pos hε
  have hsmall : closedBall x (ε / 2) ⊆
      {y | y ∈ U ∧ y ∈ Ω ∧ v y < ((q : ℝ) : EReal)} :=
    (closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hε)).trans hεsub
  have hBU : ball x (ε / 2) ⊆ U :=
    fun y hy => (hsmall (ball_subset_closedBall hy)).1
  have hBΩ : ball x (ε / 2) ⊆ Ω :=
    fun y hy => (hsmall (ball_subset_closedBall hy)).2.1
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hdisc.exists_compact_upper_bound
    (isCompact_closedBall x (ε / 2)) ⟨x, mem_closedBall_self hR.le⟩
    (fun y hy => (hsmall hy).1)
  have hxC : (u x).toReal ≤ C := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp
    (hxreal.le.trans (hC x (mem_closedBall_self hR.le)))
  have huc : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.restrict (ball x (ε / 2)), u y ≤ ((q : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset hBΩ hae,
      ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball] with y hy hyB
    exact hy.trans (hsmall (ball_subset_closedBall hyB)).2.2.le
  have hlower : ENNReal.ofReal (C - (q : ℝ)) * μ (ball 0 (ε / 2)) ≤
      ∫⁻ y in ball x (ε / 2), ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal ∂μ := by
    calc
      _ = ∫⁻ y in ball x (ε / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (C - (q : ℝ)) ∂μ := by
        simp [lintegral_const, μ.addHaar_ball_center x (ε / 2)]
      _ ≤ _ := lintegral_mono_ae (huc.mono (fun y hy => by
        calc
          ENNReal.ofReal (C - (q : ℝ)) =
              ((C : EReal) - ((q : ℝ) : EReal)).toENNReal := by
            rw [← EReal.coe_sub, EReal.real_coe_toENNReal]
          _ ≤ _ := EReal.toENNReal_le_toENNReal (EReal.sub_le_sub le_rfl hy)))
  have hupper := hdisc.ball_deficit_le μ x (ε / 2) C hBU
    (fun y hy => hC y (ball_subset_closedBall hy))
  have hcenter : ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal =
      ENNReal.ofReal (C - (u x).toReal) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hxreal]
    rw [← EReal.coe_sub, EReal.real_coe_toENNReal]
  rw [hcenter, mul_comm (μ (ball 0 (ε / 2)))] at hupper
  have hdeficit : ENNReal.ofReal (C - (q : ℝ)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (C - (u x).toReal) :=
    (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_left (ne_of_gt (Metric.measure_ball_pos μ (0 : E) hR))
      measure_ball_ne_top).mp (hlower.trans hupper)
  have hreal := (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (sub_nonneg.mpr hxC)).mp hdeficit
  linarith

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.eqOn_of_ae_eq
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.eqOn_of_ae_eq {u v : E → EReal} {Ω : Set E}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω) (hv : PlurisubharmonicOn v Ω) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω)
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hae : u =ᵐ[μ.restrict Ω] v) : EqOn u v Ω
proof:
:= by
  have huv := hu.le_of_ae_le hΩ hv.upperSemicontinuousOn μ (hae.mono (fun _ h => h.le))
  have hvu := hv.le_of_ae_le hΩ hu.upperSemicontinuousOn μ (hae.mono (fun _ h => h.ge))
  exact fun x hx => le_antisymm (huv x hx) (hvu x hx)

name: PshLines.ae_eq_of_regularDistribution_eq
statement:
theorem ae_eq_of_regularDistribution_eq {Ω : Opens E} {f g : E → ℝ}
    (μ : Measure E) (hf : LocallyIntegrableOn f Ω μ) (hg : LocallyIntegrableOn g Ω μ)
    (heq : regularDistribution μ f hf = regularDistribution μ g hg) :
    f =ᵐ[μ.restrict Ω] g
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Ω → (f - g) x = 0 := by
    apply Ω.isOpen.ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero (hf.sub hg)
    intro φ hφ hφc hφΩ
    let ψ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ) := ⟨φ, hφ, hφc, hφΩ⟩
    have htest := congrArg (fun T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ) => T ψ) heq
    rw [regularDistribution_apply, regularDistribution_apply] at htest
    simp only [ψ, TestFunction.coe_mk] at htest
    have hfφ : Integrable (fun x => φ x * f x) μ := by
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply', ψ, TestFunction.coe_mk] using
        ψ.integrable_bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) hf
    have hgφ : Integrable (fun x => φ x * g x) μ := by
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply', ψ, TestFunction.coe_mk] using
        ψ.integrable_bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) hg
    change (∫ x, φ x * (f x - g x) ∂μ) = 0
    simp_rw [mul_sub]
    rw [integral_sub hfφ hgφ]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr htest
  apply (ae_restrict_iff' Ω.isOpen.measurableSet).mpr
  exact hzero.mono (fun x hx hxΩ => sub_eq_zero.mp (hx hxΩ))

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.eqOn_of_regularDistribution_eq
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.eqOn_of_regularDistribution_eq
    {u v : E → EReal} {Ω : Opens E}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω) (hv : PlurisubharmonicOn v Ω)
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hui : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => (u x).toReal) Ω μ)
    (hvi : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => (v x).toReal) Ω μ)
    (hua : (fun x => ((u x).toReal : EReal)) =ᵐ[μ.restrict Ω] u)
    (hva : (fun x => ((v x).toReal : EReal)) =ᵐ[μ.restrict Ω] v)
    (heq : regularDistribution μ (fun x => (u x).toReal) hui =
      regularDistribution μ (fun x => (v x).toReal) hvi) : EqOn u v Ω
proof:
:= by
  apply hu.eqOn_of_ae_eq hv Ω.isOpen μ
  have hreal := ae_eq_of_regularDistribution_eq μ hui hvi heq
  filter_upwards [hua, hva, hreal] with x hux hvx hrealx
  exact hux.symm.trans ((congrArg (fun r : ℝ => (r : EReal)) hrealx).trans hvx)

name: PshLines.pshRegularDistribution_eq_iff
statement:
theorem pshRegularDistribution_eq_iff {u v : E → EReal} {Ω : Opens E}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω) (hv : PlurisubharmonicOn v Ω)
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] (hΩ : IsPreconnected (Ω : Set E))
    (hnu : ∃ a ∈ Ω, u a ≠ ⊥) (hnv : ∃ a ∈ Ω, v a ≠ ⊥) :
    pshRegularDistribution hu μ hΩ hnu = pshRegularDistribution hv μ hΩ hnv ↔
      EqOn u v Ω
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    exact hu.eqOn_of_regularDistribution_eq hv μ
      (hu.locallyIntegrableOn_toReal μ hΩ hnu) (hv.locallyIntegrableOn_toReal μ hΩ hnv)
      (hu.ae_coe_toReal μ hΩ hnu) (hv.ae_coe_toReal μ hΩ hnv) heq
  · intro heq
    apply pshRegularDistribution_congr_ae_on hu hv μ hΩ hnu hnv
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem Ω.isOpen.measurableSet] with x hx
    exact heq hx

name: PshLines.discPshOn_of_levi_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  apply discPshOn_of_circleAverage hu.continuous
  intro x v r hr hD
  have hline : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : ℂ => u (x + z • v)) := by
    exact hu.comp (contDiff_const.add (complexLineLinear v).contDiff)
  have hΔ : ∀ z ∈ closedBall (0 : ℂ) r,
      0 ≤ Δ (fun t : ℂ => u (x + t • v)) z := by
    intro z hz
    apply (laplacian_complexLine_nonneg_iff hu x v z).mpr
    exact hL _ (hD ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩) v
  simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero] using
    submean_of_laplacian_nonneg hline 0 hr.le hΔ

name: PshLines.plurisubharmonicOn_of_levi_nonneg
statement:
theorem plurisubharmonicOn_of_levi_nonneg {u : E → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hL : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ v : E, 0 ≤ leviForm u x v) :
    PlurisubharmonicOn (fun y => (u y : EReal)) U
proof:
:=
  (discPshOn_of_levi_nonneg hu hL).plurisubharmonicOn hU

name: PshLines.discPshOn_norm_sq
statement:
theorem discPshOn_norm_sq (U : Set H) :
    DiscPshOn (fun y : H => ((‖y‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : EReal)) U
proof:
:=
  discPshOn_of_levi_nonneg (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ)
    (fun x _ v => leviForm_norm_sq_nonneg x v)

name: PshLines.plurisubharmonicAt_norm_sq
statement:
theorem plurisubharmonicAt_norm_sq (x : H) :
    PlurisubharmonicAt (fun y : H => ((‖y‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : EReal)) x
proof:
:=
  (discPshOn_norm_sq univ).plurisubharmonicOn isOpen_univ x (mem_univ x)

name: PshLines.isOpen_pshIntegrabilityLocus
statement:
theorem isOpen_pshIntegrabilityLocus (u : E → EReal) (μ : Measure E) :
    IsOpen (pshIntegrabilityLocus u μ)
proof:
:= by
  apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
  rintro x ⟨V, hV, hxV, hae, hI⟩
  exact mem_of_superset (hV.mem_nhds hxV)
    (fun y hy => ⟨V, hV, hy, hae, hI⟩)

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicAt.mem_pshIntegrabilityLocus
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicAt.mem_pshIntegrabilityLocus
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicAt u x) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hx : u x ≠ ⊥) : x ∈ pshIntegrabilityLocus u μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, huW⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hB⟩ := Metric.nhds_basis_closedBall.mem_iff.mp (hW.mem_nhds hxW)
  have hball := huW.ae_finite_and_integrableOn_ball μ x hR hB hx
  exact ⟨ball x R, isOpen_ball, mem_ball_self hR, hball.1, hball.2.1⟩

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicAt.integrableAtFilter_toReal
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicAt.integrableAtFilter_toReal
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicAt u x) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hx : u x ≠ ⊥) : IntegrableAtFilter (fun y => (u y).toReal) (𝓝 x) μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, _, hI⟩ := hu.mem_pshIntegrabilityLocus μ hx
  exact ⟨V, hV.mem_nhds hxV, hI⟩

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicAt.mem_pshIntegrabilityLocus_of_mem_closure
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicAt.mem_pshIntegrabilityLocus_of_mem_closure
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicAt u x) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hx : x ∈ closure (pshIntegrabilityLocus u μ)) :
    x ∈ pshIntegrabilityLocus u μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, huW⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hB⟩ := Metric.nhds_basis_closedBall.mem_iff.mp (hW.mem_nhds hxW)
  obtain ⟨z, hzG, hxz⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hx (R / 4) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hzV, hae, _⟩ := hzG
  have hzB : z ∈ ball x (R / 4) := by
    simpa only [mem_ball, dist_comm] using hxz
  have hpos : 0 < μ (V ∩ ball x (R / 4)) :=
    (hV.inter isOpen_ball).measure_pos μ ⟨z, hzV, hzB⟩
  have hae' : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.restrict (V ∩ ball x (R / 4)), u y ≠ ⊤ ∧ u y ≠ ⊥ :=
    ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset inter_subset_left hae
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hfin⟩ :=
    Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae (μ := μ) hpos.ne' hae'
  have hyx : dist y x < R / 4 := hy.2
  have hxB : x ∈ ball y (R / 2) := by
    rw [mem_ball, dist_comm]
    linarith
  have hyB : closedBall y (R / 2) ⊆ W := by
    intro w hw
    apply hB
    rw [mem_closedBall] at hw ⊢
    have htriangle := dist_triangle w y x
    linarith
  have hball := huW.ae_finite_and_integrableOn_ball μ y (by positivity) hyB hfin.2
  exact ⟨ball y (R / 2), isOpen_ball, hxB, hball.1, hball.2.1⟩

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.subset_pshIntegrabilityLocus
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.subset_pshIntegrabilityLocus {U : Set E}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u U) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hU : IsPreconnected U) (hne : ∃ a ∈ U, u a ≠ ⊥) :
    U ⊆ pshIntegrabilityLocus u μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, haU, ha⟩ := hne
  apply hU.subset_of_closure_inter_subset (isOpen_pshIntegrabilityLocus u μ)
    ⟨a, haU, (hu a haU).mem_pshIntegrabilityLocus μ ha⟩
  rintro x ⟨hxG, hxU⟩
  exact (hu x hxU).mem_pshIntegrabilityLocus_of_mem_closure μ hxG

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.locallyIntegrableOn_toReal
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.locallyIntegrableOn_toReal {U : Set E}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u U) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hU : IsPreconnected U) (hne : ∃ a ∈ U, u a ≠ ⊥) :
    LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => (u x).toReal) U μ
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, _, hI⟩ := hu.subset_pshIntegrabilityLocus μ hU hne hx
  exact ⟨V, mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds (hV.mem_nhds hxV), hI⟩

name: PshLines.HasDiscSubmeanOn.weighted_circle_deficit_le
statement:
theorem HasDiscSubmeanOn.weighted_circle_deficit_le {u : E → EReal} {U K : Set E}
    (hu : HasDiscSubmeanOn u U) (μ : Measure E) [SFinite μ]
    (hKU : K ⊆ U) (C : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≤ (C : EReal))
    (hDm : Measurable (K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal)))
    {w : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hw : Measurable w) (v : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hdisc : ∀ x ∈ Function.support w, affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ K) :
    ∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi),
        ∫⁻ x, w x * K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal)
          (x + circleMap 0 r t • v) ∂μ ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) *
        ∫⁻ x, w x * K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal) x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D : E → ℝ≥0∞ := K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal)
  have hD : Measurable D := hDm
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : E × ℝ => p.1 + circleMap 0 r p.2 • v) := by
    fun_prop
  have hm : Measurable (fun p : E × ℝ => w p.1 * D (p.1 + circleMap 0 r p.2 • v)) :=
    (hw.comp measurable_fst).mul (hD.comp hc.measurable)
  have hswap := lintegral_lintegral_swap (μ := μ)
    (ν := volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi)))
    (f := fun x t => w x * D (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)) hm.aemeasurable
  have hpoint (x : E) :
      ∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi), w x * D (x + circleMap 0 r t • v) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * (w x * D x) := by
    by_cases hx : w x = 0
    · simp [hx]
    have hdiscK := hdisc x hx
    have hxK : x ∈ K := hdiscK (center_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr.le)
    have htK (t : ℝ) : x + circleMap 0 r t • v ∈ K :=
      hdiscK (circle_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr.le t)
    have hmangle : Measurable (fun t : ℝ => D (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)) :=
      hD.comp (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => x + circleMap 0 r t • v)).measurable
    rw [lintegral_const_mul (w x) hmangle]
    have hangle : (∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi), D (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)) =
        circleDeficit u x v r C := by
      apply lintegral_congr
      intro t
      simp [D, htK t]
    rw [hangle]
    have hs : w x * circleDeficit u x v r C ≤
        w x * (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) := by
      gcongr
      exact hu x v r hr (hdiscK.trans hKU) C (fun y hy => hC y (hdiscK hy))
    simpa [D, hxK, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hs
  change (∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi),
      ∫⁻ x, w x * D (x + circleMap 0 r t • v) ∂μ) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * ∫⁻ x, w x * D x ∂μ
  rw [← hswap]
  exact (lintegral_mono hpoint).trans_eq
    (lintegral_const_mul (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi)) (hw.mul hD))

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.weighted_circle_deficit_le
statement:
theorem DiscPshOn.weighted_circle_deficit_le {u : E → EReal} {U K : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn u U) (μ : Measure E) [SFinite μ]
    (hK : MeasurableSet K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (C : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≤ (C : EReal))
    {w : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hw : Measurable w) (v : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hdisc : ∀ x ∈ Function.support w, affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ K) :
    ∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi),
        ∫⁻ x, w x * K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal)
          (x + circleMap 0 r t • v) ∂μ ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) *
        ∫⁻ x, w x * K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - u y).toENNReal) x ∂μ
proof:
:=
  hu.submean.weighted_circle_deficit_le μ hKU C hC
    (hu.measurable_indicator_deficit hK hKU C) hw v hr hdisc

name: PshLines.translatedTestFunction_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem translatedTestFunction_apply (φ : E → ℝ) (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ) (z : E)
    (hzΩ : tsupport (fun x => φ (x - z)) ⊆ Ω) (x : E) :
    translatedTestFunction φ hφs hφ z hzΩ x = φ (x - z)
proof: := rfl

name: PshLines.realHessian_comp_sub
statement:
theorem realHessian_comp_sub (φ : E → ℝ) (z x v w : E) :
    realHessian (fun y => φ (y - z)) x v w = realHessian φ (x - z) v w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [realHessian, iteratedFDeriv_comp_sub]

name: PshLines.leviForm_comp_sub
statement:
theorem leviForm_comp_sub (φ : E → ℝ) (z x v : E) :
    leviForm (fun y => φ (y - z)) x v = leviForm φ (x - z) v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [leviForm, realHessian_comp_sub]

name: PshLines.leviForm_translationPairing_eq_distributionalLevi_of_eqOn
statement:
theorem leviForm_translationPairing_eq_distributionalLevi_of_eqOn
    (hg : LocallyIntegrable g μ) (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ)
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ)
    (z : E) (hzΩ : tsupport (fun x => φ (x - z)) ⊆ Ω)
    (hgu : EqOn g u (tsupport (fun x => φ (x - z)))) (v : E) :
    leviForm (translationPairing μ g φ) z v =
      distributionalLeviCLM v (regularDistribution μ u hu)
        (translatedTestFunction φ hφs hφ z hzΩ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [leviForm_translationPairing hg hφs
      (hφ.of_le (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)),
    distributionalLeviCLM_regularDistribution_apply]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with x
  change g x * leviForm φ (x - z) v =
    u x * leviForm (fun y => φ (y - z)) x v
  rw [leviForm_comp_sub]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ tsupport (fun y => φ (y - z))
  · rw [hgu hx]
  · have hzero : leviForm φ (x - z) v = 0 := by
      simpa only [leviForm_comp_sub] using
        leviForm_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx v
    rw [hzero, mul_zero, mul_zero]

name: PshLines.leviForm_translationPairing_nonneg_of_eqOn
statement:
theorem leviForm_translationPairing_nonneg_of_eqOn
    (hg : LocallyIntegrable g μ) (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ)
    (hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi (regularDistribution μ u hu))
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ)
    (hφn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) (z : E)
    (hzΩ : tsupport (fun x => φ (x - z)) ⊆ Ω)
    (hgu : EqOn g u (tsupport (fun x => φ (x - z)))) (v : E) :
    0 ≤ leviForm (translationPairing μ g φ) z v
proof:
:= by
  rw [leviForm_translationPairing_eq_distributionalLevi_of_eqOn
    hg hu hφs hφ z hzΩ hgu v]
  exact hT v (translatedTestFunction φ hφs hφ z hzΩ) (fun x => hφn (x - z))

name: PshLines.leviForm_translationPairing_nonneg
statement:
theorem leviForm_translationPairing_nonneg
    (hu : LocallyIntegrable u μ)
    (hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
      (regularDistribution μ u (hu.locallyIntegrableOn Ω)))
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ)
    (hφn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) (z : E)
    (hzΩ : tsupport (fun x => φ (x - z)) ⊆ Ω) (v : E) :
    0 ≤ leviForm (translationPairing μ u φ) z v
proof:
:=
  leviForm_translationPairing_nonneg_of_eqOn hu (hu.locallyIntegrableOn Ω) hT
    hφs hφ hφn z hzΩ (fun _ _ => rfl) v

name: PshLines.discPshOn_translationPairing
statement:
theorem discPshOn_translationPairing
    (hu : LocallyIntegrable u μ)
    (hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
      (regularDistribution μ u (hu.locallyIntegrableOn Ω)))
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ)
    (hφn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (hUΩ : ∀ z ∈ U, tsupport (fun x => φ (x - z)) ⊆ Ω) :
    DiscPshOn (fun z => (translationPairing μ u φ z : EReal)) U
proof:
:= by
  apply discPshOn_of_levi_nonneg
    (contDiff_translationPairing hu hφs
      (hφ.of_le (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)))
  intro z hz v
  exact leviForm_translationPairing_nonneg hu hT hφs hφ hφn z (hUΩ z hz) v

name: PshLines.plurisubharmonicOn_translationPairing
statement:
theorem plurisubharmonicOn_translationPairing
    (hu : LocallyIntegrable u μ)
    (hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
      (regularDistribution μ u (hu.locallyIntegrableOn Ω)))
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ)
    (hφn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hUΩ : ∀ z ∈ U, tsupport (fun x => φ (x - z)) ⊆ Ω) :
    PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z => (translationPairing μ u φ z : EReal)) U
proof:
:=
  (discPshOn_translationPairing hu hT hφs hφ hφn hUΩ).plurisubharmonicOn hU

name: PshLines.integrable_indicator_of_locallyIntegrableOn_isCompact
statement:
theorem integrable_indicator_of_locallyIntegrableOn_isCompact
    (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω) :
    Integrable (K.indicator u) μ
proof:
:=
  ((hu.mono_set hKΩ).integrableOn_isCompact hK).integrable_indicator hK.measurableSet

name: PshLines.translationPairing_indicator_eq
statement:
theorem translationPairing_indicator_eq (u φ : E → ℝ) (z : E)
    (hzK : tsupport (fun x => φ (x - z)) ⊆ K) :
    translationPairing μ (K.indicator u) φ z = translationPairing μ u φ z
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ K
  · rw [indicator_of_mem hx]
  · have hzero : φ (x - z) = 0 :=
      image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (f := fun y => φ (y - z))
        (fun hxs => hx (hzK hxs))
    rw [hzero, mul_zero, mul_zero]

name: PshLines.contDiffOn_translationPairing_of_locallyIntegrableOn
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_translationPairing_of_locallyIntegrableOn
    (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ)
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω)
    (hUK : ∀ z ∈ U, tsupport (fun x => φ (x - z)) ⊆ K) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (translationPairing μ u φ) U
proof:
:= by
  have hg := (integrable_indicator_of_locallyIntegrableOn_isCompact hu hK hKΩ).locallyIntegrable
  apply (contDiff_translationPairing hg hφs hφ).contDiffOn.congr
  intro z hz
  exact (translationPairing_indicator_eq u φ z (hUK z hz)).symm

name: PshLines.leviForm_translationPairing_indicator_nonneg
statement:
theorem leviForm_translationPairing_indicator_nonneg
    (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ)
    (hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi (regularDistribution μ u hu))
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ)
    (hφn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω)
    (z : E) (hzK : tsupport (fun x => φ (x - z)) ⊆ K) (v : E) :
    0 ≤ leviForm (translationPairing μ (K.indicator u) φ) z v
proof:
:= by
  apply leviForm_translationPairing_nonneg_of_eqOn
    (integrable_indicator_of_locallyIntegrableOn_isCompact hu hK hKΩ).locallyIntegrable
    hu hT hφs hφ hφn z (hzK.trans hKΩ) _ v
  intro x hx
  exact indicator_of_mem (hzK hx) u

name: PshLines.discPshOn_translationPairing_indicator
statement:
theorem discPshOn_translationPairing_indicator
    (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ)
    (hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi (regularDistribution μ u hu))
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ)
    (hφn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω)
    (hUK : ∀ z ∈ U, tsupport (fun x => φ (x - z)) ⊆ K) :
    DiscPshOn (fun z => (translationPairing μ (K.indicator u) φ z : EReal)) U
proof:
:= by
  apply discPshOn_of_levi_nonneg
    (contDiff_translationPairing
      (integrable_indicator_of_locallyIntegrableOn_isCompact hu hK hKΩ).locallyIntegrable
      hφs (hφ.of_le (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)))
  intro z hz v
  exact leviForm_translationPairing_indicator_nonneg hu hT hφs hφ hφn
    hK hKΩ z (hUK z hz) v

name: PshLines.discPshOn_translationPairing_of_locallyIntegrableOn
statement:
theorem discPshOn_translationPairing_of_locallyIntegrableOn
    (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ)
    (hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi (regularDistribution μ u hu))
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ)
    (hφn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω)
    (hUK : ∀ z ∈ U, tsupport (fun x => φ (x - z)) ⊆ K) :
    DiscPshOn (fun z => (translationPairing μ u φ z : EReal)) U
proof:
:= by
  apply (discPshOn_translationPairing_indicator hu hT hφs hφ hφn hK hKΩ hUK).congr
  intro z hz
  exact congrArg (fun t : ℝ => (t : EReal))
    (translationPairing_indicator_eq u φ z (hUK z hz))

name: PshLines.plurisubharmonicOn_translationPairing_of_locallyIntegrableOn
statement:
theorem plurisubharmonicOn_translationPairing_of_locallyIntegrableOn
    (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ)
    (hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi (regularDistribution μ u hu))
    (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ)
    (hφn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hUK : ∀ z ∈ U, tsupport (fun x => φ (x - z)) ⊆ K) :
    PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z => (translationPairing μ u φ z : EReal)) U
proof:
:=
  (discPshOn_translationPairing_of_locallyIntegrableOn
    hu hT hφs hφ hφn hK hKΩ hUK).plurisubharmonicOn hU

name: PshLines.image_affineClosedDisc
statement:
theorem image_affineClosedDisc (L : E →L[ℂ] F) (b : F) (x v : E) (r : ℝ) :
    (fun y => b + L y) '' affineClosedDisc x v r =
      affineClosedDisc (b + L x) (L v) r
proof:
:= by
  unfold affineClosedDisc
  rw [image_image]
  congr 1
  funext z
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, add_assoc]

name: PshLines.circleDeficit_comp_affine
statement:
theorem circleDeficit_comp_affine (u : F → EReal) (L : E →L[ℂ] F) (b : F)
    (x v : E) (r C : ℝ) :
    circleDeficit (fun y => u (b + L y)) x v r C =
      circleDeficit u (b + L x) (L v) r C
proof:
:= by
  simp only [circleDeficit, map_add, map_smul, add_assoc]

name: PshLines.HasDiscSubmeanOn.comp_affine
proof:
:= by
  intro x v r hr hD C hC
  have hDU : affineClosedDisc (b + L x) (L v) r ⊆ U := by
    rw [← image_affineClosedDisc L b]
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact hD hy
  have hbound : ∀ z ∈ affineClosedDisc (b + L x) (L v) r, u z ≤ (C : EReal) := by
    rw [← image_affineClosedDisc L b]
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact hC y hy
  rw [circleDeficit_comp_affine]
  exact hu (b + L x) (L v) r hr hDU C hbound

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.comp_affine
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun y hy => hu.ne_top (b + L y) hy, ?_, hu.submean.comp_affine L b⟩
  exact hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.comp
    (continuous_const.add L.continuous).continuousOn (fun _ hy => hy)

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicAt.comp_affine
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicAt.comp_affine (L : E →L[ℂ] F) (b : F)
    {u : F → EReal} {x : E} (hu : PlurisubharmonicAt u (b + L x)) :
    PlurisubharmonicAt (fun y => u (b + L y)) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hx, hu⟩ := hu
  exact ⟨(fun y => b + L y) ⁻¹' U,
    hU.preimage (continuous_const.add L.continuous), hx, hu.comp_affine L b⟩

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.comp_affine
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact PlurisubharmonicAt.comp_affine L b (hu (b + L x) hx)

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.comp_continuousLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [zero_add] using hu.comp_affine L 0

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicAt.comp_continuousLinearMap
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicAt.comp_continuousLinearMap (L : E →L[ℂ] F)
    {u : F → EReal} {x : E} (hu : PlurisubharmonicAt u (L x)) :
    PlurisubharmonicAt (fun y => u (L y)) x
proof:
:= by
  have h : PlurisubharmonicAt u (0 + L x) := by simpa only [zero_add] using hu
  simpa only [zero_add] using PlurisubharmonicAt.comp_affine L 0 h

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.comp_continuousLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [zero_add] using hu.comp_affine L 0

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.submodule
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Submodule.coe_subtypeL, Submodule.coe_subtype] using!
    hu.comp_continuousLinearMap S.subtypeL

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicAt.submodule
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicAt.submodule {u : E → EReal} (S : Submodule ℂ E)
    {x : S} (hu : PlurisubharmonicAt u (x : E)) :
    PlurisubharmonicAt (fun y : S => u y) x
proof:
:= by
  exact PlurisubharmonicAt.comp_continuousLinearMap S.subtypeL hu

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.submodule
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Submodule.coe_subtypeL, Submodule.coe_subtype] using!
    hu.comp_continuousLinearMap S.subtypeL

name: PshLines.indicator_realDeficit_nonneg
statement:
theorem indicator_realDeficit_nonneg (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (huC : ∀ x ∈ K, u x ≤ (C : EReal)) (x : X) :
    0 ≤ K.indicator (fun y => C - (u y).toReal) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : x ∈ K
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
    by_cases hbot : u x = ⊥
    · simpa only [hbot, EReal.toReal_bot, sub_zero] using hC
    · exact sub_nonneg.mpr (by
        simpa only [EReal.toReal_coe] using
          EReal.toReal_le_toReal (huC x hx) hbot (EReal.coe_ne_top C))
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, le_refl]

name: PshLines.integrable_indicator_realDeficit
statement:
theorem integrable_indicator_realDeficit (hK : MeasurableSet K) (hμK : μ K ≠ ⊤)
    (hu : IntegrableOn (fun x => (u x).toReal) K μ) (C : ℝ) :
    Integrable (K.indicator (fun x => C - (u x).toReal)) μ
proof:
:=
  ((integrableOn_const (C := C) hμK).sub hu).integrable_indicator hK

name: PshLines.indicator_deficit_ae_eq_ofReal
statement:
theorem indicator_deficit_ae_eq_ofReal (hK : MeasurableSet K)
    (hfin : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict K, u x ≠ ⊤ ∧ u x ≠ ⊥) (C : ℝ) :
    K.indicator (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (K.indicator (fun y => C - (u y).toReal) x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  filter_upwards [(ae_restrict_iff' hK).mp hfin] with x hx
  by_cases hxK : x ∈ K
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hxK]
    rw [← EReal.coe_toReal (hx hxK).1 (hx hxK).2, ← EReal.coe_sub,
      EReal.real_coe_toENNReal, EReal.toReal_coe]
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxK, ENNReal.ofReal_zero]

name: PshLines.integrable_indicator_realDeficit_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem integrable_indicator_realDeficit_of_isCompact (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U)
    (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => (u x).toReal) U μ) (C : ℝ) :
    Integrable (K.indicator (fun x => C - (u x).toReal)) μ
proof:
:=
  integrable_indicator_realDeficit hK.measurableSet hK.measure_ne_top
    ((hu.mono_set hKU).integrableOn_isCompact hK) C

name: PshLines.locallyIntegrable_indicator_realDeficit_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem locallyIntegrable_indicator_realDeficit_of_isCompact
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U)
    (hu : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => (u x).toReal) U μ) (C : ℝ) :
    LocallyIntegrable (K.indicator (fun x => C - (u x).toReal)) μ
proof:
:=
  (integrable_indicator_realDeficit_of_isCompact hK hKU hu C).locallyIntegrable

name: PshLines.indicator_deficit_ae_eq_ofReal_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem indicator_deficit_ae_eq_ofReal_of_isCompact
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U)
    (hfin : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict U, u x ≠ ⊤ ∧ u x ≠ ⊥) (C : ℝ) :
    K.indicator (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (K.indicator (fun y => C - (u y).toReal) x)
proof:
:=
  indicator_deficit_ae_eq_ofReal hK.measurableSet
    (ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset hKU hfin) C

name: PshLines.eventually_lt_of_semicontinuous
statement:
theorem eventually_lt_of_semicontinuous {A : Type*} [LinearOrder A]
    [DenselyOrdered A] {f g : X → A} {x : X}
    (hg : UpperSemicontinuousAt g x) (hf : LowerSemicontinuousAt f x)
    (h : g x < f x) : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, g y < f y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hgc, hcf⟩ := exists_between h
  filter_upwards [hg c hgc, hf c hcf] with y hgy hfy
  exact hgy.trans hfy

name: PshLines.eventually_lt_real_of_eq_bot
proof:
:= by
  apply eventually_lt_of_semicontinuous hg
    (continuous_coe_real_ereal.continuousAt.comp hf).lowerSemicontinuousAt
  simp [hbot]

name: PshLines.eventually_max_eq_real_of_eq_bot
statement:
theorem eventually_max_eq_real_of_eq_bot {g : X → EReal} {f : X → ℝ} {x : X}
    (hg : UpperSemicontinuousAt g x) (hbot : g x = ⊥)
    (hf : ContinuousAt f x) :
    (fun y => max (f y : EReal) (g y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => (f y : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_lt_real_of_eq_bot hg hbot hf] with y hy
  exact max_eq_left hy.le

name: PshLines.gluedMax_eq_max
statement:
theorem gluedMax_eq_max {U : Set X} {f g : X → A} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    gluedMax U f g x = max (f x) (g x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [gluedMax, hx]

name: PshLines.gluedMax_eq_global
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hxU : x ∈ U
  · simp [gluedMax, hxU, max_eq_right (hcollar x ⟨hxU, hx⟩)]
  · simp [gluedMax, hxU]

name: PshLines.gluedMax_eventually_eq_max
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
  exact gluedMax_eq_max hy

name: PshLines.gluedMax_eventually_eq_global
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x ∈ (closure U')ᶜ := fun hc => hx (hclosure hc)
  filter_upwards [isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hx'] with y hy
  exact gluedMax_eq_global hcollar (fun h => hy (subset_closure h))

name: PshLines.gluedMax_local
statement:
theorem gluedMax_local {U U' : Set X} {f g : X → A}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hclosure : closure U' ⊆ U)
    (hcollar : ∀ x ∈ U \ U', f x ≤ g x) (x : X) :
    (x ∈ U ∧ gluedMax U f g =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => max (f y) (g y))) ∨
      gluedMax U f g =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ U
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hx, gluedMax_eventually_eq_max hU hx⟩
  · exact Or.inr (gluedMax_eventually_eq_global hclosure hcollar hx)

name: PshLines.gluedMax_upperSemicontinuous
statement:
theorem gluedMax_upperSemicontinuous {U U' : Set X} {f g : X → A}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hclosure : closure U' ⊆ U)
    (hcollar : ∀ x ∈ U \ U', f x ≤ g x)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ U, UpperSemicontinuousAt f x) (hg : UpperSemicontinuous g) :
    UpperSemicontinuous (gluedMax U f g)
proof:
:= by
  intro x c hc
  by_cases hx : x ∈ U
  · rw [gluedMax_eq_max (f := f) (g := g) hx] at hc
    obtain ⟨hfc, hgc⟩ := max_lt_iff.mp hc
    filter_upwards [gluedMax_eventually_eq_max (f := f) (g := g) hU hx,
      hf x hx c hfc, hg x c hgc]
      with y hy hfy hgy
    rw [hy]
    exact max_lt hfy hgy
  · have hgc : g x < c := by simpa [gluedMax, hx] using hc
    filter_upwards [gluedMax_eventually_eq_global hclosure hcollar hx, hg x c hgc]
      with y hy hgy
    simpa only [hy] using hgy

name: PshLines.gluedMax_eventually_eq_real
statement:
theorem gluedMax_eventually_eq_real {U : Set X} {f : X → ℝ} {g : X → EReal}
    (hU : IsOpen U) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U)
    (hg : UpperSemicontinuousAt g x) (hbot : g x = ⊥)
    (hf : ContinuousAt f x) :
    gluedMax U (fun y => (f y : EReal)) g =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => (f y : EReal))
proof:
:=
  (gluedMax_eventually_eq_max hU hx).trans
    (eventually_max_eq_real_of_eq_bot hg hbot hf)

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.upperSemicontinuousOn
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.upperSemicontinuousOn (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u U) :
    UpperSemicontinuousOn u U
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx c hc
  exact nhdsWithin_le_nhds ((hu x hx).upperSemicontinuousAt c hc)

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.exists_nonnegative_compact_upper_bound
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.exists_nonnegative_compact_upper_bound
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u U) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, u x ≤ (C : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hne : K.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, hmax⟩ :=
      (hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.mono hKU).exists_isMaxOn hne hK
    obtain ⟨B, hB, _⟩ := EReal.exists_rat_btwn_of_lt
      (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr ((hu y (hKU hy)).ne_top))
    refine ⟨Max.max (B : ℝ) 0, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    exact ((hmax hx).trans hB.le).trans
      (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (le_max_left _ _))
  · exact ⟨0, le_rfl, fun x hx => False.elim (hne ⟨x, hx⟩)⟩

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.exists_uniform_disc_neighborhoods
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.exists_uniform_disc_neighborhoods
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u U) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (v : E) :
    ∃ R > 0, ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ W : Set E, IsOpen W ∧ x ∈ W ∧ DiscPshOn u W ∧
      ∀ r : ℝ, r ≤ R → affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ W
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose W hW hxW huW using fun x : K => hu x (hKU x.property)
  have hcover : K ⊆ ⋃ x : K, W x := by
    intro x hx
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hxW ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hballs⟩ := lebesgue_number_lemma_of_metric hK hW hcover
  let R : ℝ := δ / (2 * (‖v‖ + 1))
  have hden : 0 < 2 * (‖v‖ + 1) := by positivity
  have hR : 0 < R := div_pos hδ hden
  have hRmul : R * (2 * (‖v‖ + 1)) = δ := div_mul_cancel₀ δ (ne_of_gt hden)
  have hRδ : R * ‖v‖ < δ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg v]
  refine ⟨R, hR, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hballs x hx
  refine ⟨W i, hW i, hi (mem_ball_self hδ), huW i, ?_⟩
  intro r hr y hy
  apply hi
  have hdist := mem_closedBall.mp (affineClosedDisc_subset_closedBall x v r hy)
  exact mem_ball.mpr (hdist.trans_lt
    ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr (norm_nonneg v)).trans_lt hRδ))

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.exists_uniform_circleDeficit_bound
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.exists_uniform_circleDeficit_bound
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u U) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (v : E) :
    ∃ R > 0, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ R → ∀ C : ℝ,
      (∀ y ∈ affineClosedDisc x v r, u y ≤ (C : EReal)) →
      circleDeficit u x v r C ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hlocal⟩ := hu.exists_uniform_disc_neighborhoods hK hKU v
  refine ⟨R, hR, ?_⟩
  intro x hx r hr hrR C hC
  obtain ⟨W, _, _, hW, hdisc⟩ := hlocal x hx
  exact hW.submean x v r hr (hdisc r hrR) C hC

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.measurable_indicator_deficit
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.measurable_indicator_deficit (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u U)
    (hK : MeasurableSet K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (C : ℝ) :
    Measurable (K.indicator (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsc : UpperSemicontinuousOn (fun x : K => u x) univ :=
    hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.comp continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn
      (fun x _ => hKU x.property)
  have hm : Measurable (fun x : K => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) :=
    (continuous_finiteDeficit C).measurable.comp
      (upperSemicontinuousOn_univ_iff.mp hsc).measurable
  refine measurable_of_restrict_of_restrict_compl hK ?_ ?_
  · convert hm using 1
    funext x
    simp [Set.domRestrict, x.property]
  · have hzero : Kᶜ.domRestrict
        (K.indicator (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal)) =
        fun _ : (Kᶜ : Set E) => (0 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
      funext x
      change K.indicator (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) (x : E) = 0
      exact Set.indicator_of_notMem x.property _
    rw [hzero]
    exact measurable_const

name: PshLines.IsPshRepresentative.unique
statement:
theorem IsPshRepresentative.unique (hu : IsPshRepresentative μ T u)
    (hv : IsPshRepresentative μ T v) : EqOn u v Ω
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨huP, huF, huL, huT⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨hvP, hvF, hvL, hvT⟩ := hv
  exact huP.eqOn_of_regularDistribution_eq hvP μ huL hvL
    (huF.mono (fun _ hx => EReal.coe_toReal hx.1 hx.2))
    (hvF.mono (fun _ hx => EReal.coe_toReal hx.1 hx.2))
    (huT.symm.trans hvT)

name: PshLines.IsPshRepresentative.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
statement:
theorem IsPshRepresentative.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
    (hu : IsPshRepresentative μ T u) : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨huP, huF, huL, rfl⟩ := hu
  exact huP.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_locallyIntegrable huL huF

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.ofSupportedIn_convolution_eq_radialConvolution
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.ofSupportedIn_convolution_eq_radialConvolution
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (j : ℕ)
    (φ : 𝓓(D.inner, ℝ)) :
    TestFunction.ofSupportedIn D.cutoffCompact_subset
        (D.convolutionTestFunctionSupportedIn j φ) =
      TestFunction.ofSupportedIn D.compact_subset
        (D.testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn j φ)
proof:
:= by
  apply TestFunction.ext
  intro y
  change D.convolutionTestFunctionSupportedIn j φ y =
    D.testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn j φ y
  rw [D.convolutionTestFunctionSupportedIn_apply,
    D.testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn_apply]
  rfl

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.tendsto_ambientConvolutionTestFunction
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.tendsto_ambientConvolutionTestFunction
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (φ : 𝓓(D.inner, ℝ)) :
    Tendsto
        (fun j ↦ TestFunction.ofSupportedIn D.cutoffCompact_subset
          (D.convolutionTestFunctionSupportedIn j φ))
        atTop (𝓝 (TestFunction.monoCLM ℝ φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [D.ofSupportedIn_convolution_eq_radialConvolution] using
    (D.tendsto_ofSupportedIn_testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn φ)

name: PshLines.Regularization.exists_local_decreasing_psh_regularization
statement:
theorem exists_local_decreasing_psh_regularization
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedSpace ℂ E] [IsScalarTower ℝ ℂ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {Ω : Opens E} {T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)}
    (hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi T) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ Ω) :
    ∃ (U : Opens E) (hUΩ : U ≤ Ω) (f : ℕ → E → ℝ), x ∈ U ∧
