      IsDecreasingSmoothPshApproximation μ (restrictDistribution T hUΩ) f
proof:
:= by
  let D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x :=
    Classical.choice (exists_adaptedRadialKernelData μ hx)
  refine ⟨D.inner, D.inner_le, fun j ↦ D.distributionRegularizedValue T j,
    D.center_mem, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨fun j ↦ D.distributionRegularizedValue_contDiff T j,
    fun j ↦ D.discPshOn_distributionRegularizedValue T hT j, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz a b hab
    exact D.distributionRegularizedValue_antitone T hT hab (subset_closure hz)
  · intro φ
    have hpairing := Filter.Tendsto.comp T.continuous.continuousAt
      (D.tendsto_ambientConvolutionTestFunction φ)
    rw [restrictDistribution_apply]
    refine hpairing.congr fun n ↦ ?_
    exact (D.distribution_convolution_transpose T n φ).symm

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonSlope.radialPoissonSlope_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem radialPoissonSlope_hasDerivAt
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    HasDerivAt (radialPoissonSlope n g)
      (g s / (4 * s) - (n : ℝ) * radialPoissonSlope n g s / s) s
proof:
:= by
  have hC := radialWeightedCumulative_hasDerivAt (n := n) hg s
  have hD : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 4 * t ^ n)
      (4 * ((n : ℝ) * s ^ (n - 1))) s := by
    have hfun : (fun y : ℝ => 4 * (id ^ n) y) =
        (fun t : ℝ => 4 * t ^ n) := by
      funext t
      rfl
    have hraw := hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mp
      ((hasDerivAt_id s).pow n |>.const_mul 4)
    rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope, ← hfun]
    simpa only [id_eq, mul_one, mul_assoc] using hraw
  have hquot := hC.div hD
    (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero n hs.ne'))
  apply hquot.congr_deriv
  rw [radialPoissonSlope]
  have hn' : n = n - 1 + 1 := by omega
  have hsn : s ^ n = s ^ (n - 1) * s :=
    (congrArg (fun k : ℕ => s ^ k) hn').trans (pow_succ _ _)
  field_simp [hs.ne', pow_ne_zero n hs.ne']
  rw [hsn]
  ring

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonSlope.radialPoissonSlope_ode
statement:
theorem radialPoissonSlope_ode
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    4 * (s * deriv (radialPoissonSlope n g) s +
      (n : ℝ) * radialPoissonSlope n g s) = g s
proof:
:= by
  rw [(radialPoissonSlope_hasDerivAt hn hg hs).deriv]
  field_simp
  ring

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonSlope.radialPoissonSlope_nonpos
statement:
theorem radialPoissonSlope_nonpos
    {n : ℕ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hC : radialWeightedCumulative n g s ≤ 0) :
    radialPoissonSlope n g s ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [radialPoissonSlope]
  exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hC
    (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (pow_nonneg hs.le n))

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialLeviPreimage.leviForm_comp_complexLinearMap
statement:
theorem leviForm_comp_complexLinearMap
    (A : E →L[ℂ] F) {u : F → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u)
    (x v : E) :
    leviForm (fun y : E ↦ u (A y)) x v = leviForm u (A x) (A v)
proof:
:= by
  let AR : E →L[ℝ] F := A.restrictScalars ℝ
  rw [leviForm, leviForm,
    show realHessian (fun y : E ↦ u (A y)) x v v =
        realHessian u (A x) (A v) (A v) by
      simpa [AR] using realHessian_comp_affine hu AR 0 x v v,
    show realHessian (fun y : E ↦ u (A y)) x (Complex.I • v) (Complex.I • v) =
        realHessian u (A x) (Complex.I • A v) (Complex.I • A v) by
      simpa [AR] using
        realHessian_comp_affine hu AR 0 x
          (Complex.I • v) (Complex.I • v)]

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialLeviPreimage.integral_explicitRadialRaw_eq_haarScalar_mul
statement:
theorem integral_explicitRadialRaw_eq_haarScalar_mul
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    (∫ x : ComplexModel n, explicitRadialRaw R hR j x ∂ν) =
      (Measure.addHaarScalarFactor ν volume : ℝ) *
        ∫ x : ComplexModel n, explicitRadialRaw R hR j x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [integral_smul_nnreal_measure, NNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul] using
    (Measure.integral_isAddLeftInvariant_eq_smul_of_hasCompactSupport ν volume
      (explicitRadialRaw_contDiff R hR j).continuous
      (explicitRadialRaw_hasCompactSupport R hR j))

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialLeviPreimage.coordinateRadialKernel_eq_inv_haarScalar_mul
statement:
theorem coordinateRadialKernel_eq_inv_haarScalar_mul
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) (x : ComplexModel n) :
    coordinateRadialKernel ν R hR j x =
      (Measure.addHaarScalarFactor ν volume : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        explicitRadialKernel R hR j x
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateRadialKernel, explicitRadialKernel,
    integral_explicitRadialRaw_eq_haarScalar_mul ν R hR j]
  have hc : (Measure.addHaarScalarFactor ν volume : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast
      (Measure.addHaarScalarFactor_pos_of_isAddHaarMeasure ν volume).ne'
  have hi : (∫ y : ComplexModel n, explicitRadialRaw R hR j y) ≠ 0 :=
    (explicitRadialRaw_integral_pos R hR j).ne'
  field_simp [hc, hi]

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialLeviPreimage.adaptedComplexModelEquiv_adaptedCoordinateVector
statement:
@[simp] theorem adaptedComplexModelEquiv_adaptedCoordinateVector
    (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ E)) :
    adaptedComplexModelEquiv (adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j) =
      coordinateVector j
proof:
:=
  (adaptedComplexModelEquiv (E := E)).apply_symm_apply _

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialLeviPreimage.adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_eq_profile
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_eq_profile
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ) :
    ∃ G : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ x : E,
      adaptedRadialPoissonPotential μ R hR a b x =
        G (‖adaptedComplexModelEquiv x‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun s ↦
      (Measure.addHaarScalarFactor
        (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) volume : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        radialPoissonPrimitive (Module.finrank ℂ E)
          (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference
            (n := Module.finrank ℂ E) R hR a b)
          ((R / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2) s, ?_⟩
  intro x
  rfl

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialLeviPreimage.adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_unitary
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_unitary
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ‖ζ‖ = 1) (x : E) :
    adaptedRadialPoissonPotential μ R hR a b
        (adaptedComplexModelEquiv.symm
          (ζ • adaptedComplexModelEquiv x)) =
      adaptedRadialPoissonPotential μ R hR a b x
proof:
:= by
  simp [adaptedRadialPoissonPotential, explicitRadialPoissonPotential,
    norm_smul, hζ]

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialLeviPreimage.adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_contDiff
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_contDiff
    (hn : 0 < Module.finrank ℂ E)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
      (adaptedRadialPoissonPotential μ R hR a b)
proof:
:= by
  exact contDiff_const.mul
    ((explicitRadialPoissonPotential_contDiff hn R hR a b).comp
      ((adaptedComplexModelEquiv (E := E)).toContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ).contDiff)

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialLeviPreimage.adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_nonneg
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_nonneg
    (hn : 0 < Module.finrank ℂ E)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (x : E) :
    0 ≤ adaptedRadialPoissonPotential μ R hR a b x
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_nonneg
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (NNReal.coe_nonneg
      (Measure.addHaarScalarFactor (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) volume)))
    (explicitRadialPoissonPotential_nonneg hn R hR hab
      (adaptedComplexModelEquiv x))

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialLeviPreimage.adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_eq_zero_of_outer
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_eq_zero_of_outer
    (hn : 0 < Module.finrank ℂ E)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) {x : E}
    (hx : R / ((a : ℝ) + 1) ≤ ‖adaptedComplexModelEquiv x‖) :
    adaptedRadialPoissonPotential μ R hR a b x = 0
proof:
:= by
  change
    (Measure.addHaarScalarFactor
      (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) volume : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        explicitRadialPoissonPotential R hR a b
          (adaptedComplexModelEquiv x) = 0
  rw [explicitRadialPoissonPotential_eq_zero_of_outer hn R hR hab hx,
    mul_zero]

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialLeviPreimage.adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_hasCompactSupport
    (hn : 0 < Module.finrank ℂ E)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    HasCompactSupport
      (adaptedRadialPoissonPotential μ R hR a b)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((explicitRadialPoissonPotential_hasCompactSupport
      hn R hR hab).comp_homeomorph
        (adaptedComplexModelEquiv (E := E)).toHomeomorph).mul_left

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialLeviPreimage.adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_tsupport_subset
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_tsupport_subset
    (hn : 0 < Module.finrank ℂ E)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    tsupport (adaptedRadialPoissonPotential μ R hR a b) ⊆
      adaptedComplexModelEquiv ⁻¹'
        closedBall 0 (R / ((a : ℝ) + 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply closure_minimal
  · intro x hx
    change adaptedComplexModelEquiv x ∈
      closedBall 0 (R / ((a : ℝ) + 1))
    simp only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    by_contra hnorm
    have hrx : R / ((a : ℝ) + 1) ≤ ‖adaptedComplexModelEquiv x‖ :=
      le_of_not_ge hnorm
    exact hx (adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_eq_zero_of_outer
      μ hn R hR hab hrx)
  · exact isClosed_closedBall.preimage adaptedComplexModelEquiv.continuous

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialLeviPreimage.four_mul_sum_leviForm_adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_eq_kernel_sub
statement:
theorem four_mul_sum_leviForm_adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_eq_kernel_sub
    (hn : 0 < Module.finrank ℂ E)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ) (x : E) :
    4 * ∑ j : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ E),
      leviForm (adaptedRadialPoissonPotential μ R hR a b) x
        (adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j) =
      adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR a x -
        adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR b x
proof:
:= by
  let u : ComplexModel (Module.finrank ℂ E) → ℝ :=
    explicitRadialPoissonPotential R hR a b
  have hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u :=
    (explicitRadialPoissonPotential_contDiff hn R hR a b).of_le
      (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)
  have hcomp : ∀ j : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ E),
      leviForm (adaptedRadialPoissonPotential μ R hR a b) x
          (adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j) =
        (Measure.addHaarScalarFactor
          (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) volume : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          leviForm u (adaptedComplexModelEquiv x) (coordinateVector j) := by
    intro j
    change leviForm
      ((Measure.addHaarScalarFactor
        (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) volume : ℝ)⁻¹ •
          fun y : E ↦ u (adaptedComplexModelEquiv y)) x
        (adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j) = _
    rw [leviForm_smul]
    · congr 1
      have hlev := leviForm_comp_complexLinearMap
        (adaptedComplexModelEquiv (E := E)).toContinuousLinearMap hu x
          (adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j)
      have hA :
          (adaptedComplexModelEquiv (E := E)).toContinuousLinearMap
              (adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j) =
            coordinateVector j :=
        (adaptedComplexModelEquiv (E := E)).apply_symm_apply _
      rw [hA] at hlev
      change leviForm
          (fun y : E ↦ u (adaptedComplexModelEquiv y)) x
            (adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j) =
        leviForm u (adaptedComplexModelEquiv x) (coordinateVector j) at hlev
      exact hlev
    · exact (hu.comp
        ((adaptedComplexModelEquiv (E := E)).toContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ).contDiff).contDiffAt
  simp_rw [hcomp]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  change 4 *
      ((Measure.addHaarScalarFactor
        (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) volume : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        coordinateLeviTrace u (adaptedComplexModelEquiv x)) = _
  calc
    _ = (Measure.addHaarScalarFactor
          (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) volume : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        (4 * coordinateLeviTrace u (adaptedComplexModelEquiv x)) := by ring
    _ = (Measure.addHaarScalarFactor
          (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) volume : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        (explicitRadialKernel R hR a (adaptedComplexModelEquiv x) -
          explicitRadialKernel R hR b (adaptedComplexModelEquiv x)) := by
      rw [four_mul_coordinateLeviTrace_explicitRadialPoissonPotential_eq_kernel_sub
        hn R hR a b]
    _ = adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR a x -
        adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR b x := by
      simp only [adaptedRadialKernel,
        coordinateRadialKernel_eq_inv_haarScalar_mul]
      ring

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialLeviPreimage.adaptedRadialKernel_eq_of_finrank_complex_eq_zero
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialKernel_eq_of_finrank_complex_eq_zero
    (hzero : Module.finrank ℂ E = 0)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ) (x : E) :
    adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR a x =
      adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR b x
proof:
:= by
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℂ E := finiteDimensional_complex_of_real
  have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ
      (ComplexModel (Module.finrank ℂ E)) = 0 := by
    rw [hzero]
    exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
  have hall : ∀ y : E, y = 0 :=
    finrank_zero_iff_forall_zero.mp hzero
  have harg :
      adaptedComplexModelEquiv.symm
          (((((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) •
            adaptedComplexModelEquiv x) = x := by
    exact (hall _).trans (hall x).symm
  symm
  rw [adaptedRadialKernel_scale μ R hR a b x,
    hdim, pow_zero, one_mul, harg]

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialLeviPreimage.exists_adaptedRadialScaleDifferenceLeviPreimage
statement:
theorem exists_adaptedRadialScaleDifferenceLeviPreimage
    (hn : 0 < Module.finrank ℂ E)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∃ ψ : E → ℝ,
      (∃ G : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ x : E,
        ψ x = G (‖adaptedComplexModelEquiv x‖ ^ 2)) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x) ∧
      HasCompactSupport ψ ∧
      tsupport ψ ⊆ adaptedComplexModelEquiv ⁻¹'
        closedBall 0 (R / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ∧
      ∀ x,
        4 * ∑ j : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ E),
          leviForm ψ x (adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j) =
            adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR a x -
              adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR b x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨adaptedRadialPoissonPotential μ R hR a b,
    adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_eq_profile μ R hR a b,
    adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_contDiff μ hn R hR a b,
    fun x ↦ adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_nonneg μ hn R hR hab x,
    adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_hasCompactSupport μ hn R hR hab,
    adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_tsupport_subset μ hn R hR hab,
    fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  exact four_mul_sum_leviForm_adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_eq_kernel_sub
    μ hn R hR a b x

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.realHessian_comp_norm_sq
statement:
theorem realHessian_comp_norm_sq {G : ℝ → ℝ} (hG : ContDiff ℝ 2 G)
    (x v w : H) :
    realHessian (fun y : H => G (‖y‖ ^ 2)) x v w =
      4 * deriv (deriv G) (‖x‖ ^ 2) * inner ℝ x v * inner ℝ x w +
        2 * deriv G (‖x‖ ^ 2) * inner ℝ v w
proof:
:= by
  let q : H → ℝ := fun y => ‖y‖ ^ 2
  have hq : ContDiff ℝ 2 q := contDiff_norm_sq ℝ
  have hGdiff : Differentiable ℝ G := hG.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hqdiff : Differentiable ℝ q := hq.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hfirst : fderiv ℝ (fun y : H => G (q y)) =
      fun y => (deriv G (q y)) • fderiv ℝ q y := by
    funext y
    change fderiv ℝ (G ∘ q) y = _
    rw [fderiv_comp y (hGdiff (q y)) (hqdiff y)]
    ext a
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, fderiv_eq_deriv_mul]
  have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun y : H => deriv G (q y))
      ((deriv (deriv G) (q x)) • fderiv ℝ q x) x := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
      ((hG.differentiable_deriv_two (q x)).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt x
        (hqdiff x).hasFDerivAt)
  have hDq : HasFDerivAt (fun y : H => fderiv ℝ q y)
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ q) x) x :=
    ((hq.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiable
      (by norm_num) x).hasFDerivAt
  rw [realHessian_eq_fderiv, hfirst]
  change (fderiv ℝ ((fun y : H => deriv G (q y)) •
    fun y : H => fderiv ℝ q y) x) v w = _
  rw [(hc.smul hDq).fderiv]
  simp only [add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
    smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [show fderiv ℝ q x v = 2 * inner ℝ x v by
        simp [q, fderiv_norm_sq_apply, innerSL_apply_apply],
      show fderiv ℝ q x w = 2 * inner ℝ x w by
        simp [q, fderiv_norm_sq_apply, innerSL_apply_apply],
      show fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ q) x v w = 2 * inner ℝ v w by
        simpa [q, realHessian_eq_fderiv] using realHessian_norm_sq x v w]
  ring

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.leviForm_comp_norm_sq
statement:
theorem leviForm_comp_norm_sq {G : ℝ → ℝ} (hG : ContDiff ℝ 2 G)
    (x v : H) :
    leviForm (fun y : H => G (‖y‖ ^ 2)) x v =
      deriv G (‖x‖ ^ 2) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 +
        deriv (deriv G) (‖x‖ ^ 2) * ‖inner ℂ x v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : (inner ℝ x v) ^ 2 +
      (inner ℝ x (Complex.I • v)) ^ 2 = ‖inner ℂ x v‖ ^ 2 := by
    change (inner ℂ x v).re ^ 2 +
      (inner ℂ x (Complex.I • v)).re ^ 2 = _
    rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]
    simp only [inner_smul_right, Complex.I_mul_re, neg_sq]
    ring
  simp only [leviForm, realHessian_comp_norm_sq hG,
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, norm_smul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul]
  rw [← hpair]
  ring

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.norm_coordinateVector
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_coordinateVector (j : Fin n) :
    ‖coordinateVector j‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateVector]

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.sum_norm_inner_coordinateVector_sq
statement:
theorem sum_norm_inner_coordinateVector_sq (x : ComplexModel n) :
    ∑ j : Fin n, ‖inner ℂ x (coordinateVector j)‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _hj
  simp [coordinateVector, PiLp.inner_apply]

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.coordinateLeviTrace_comp_norm_sq
statement:
theorem coordinateLeviTrace_comp_norm_sq {G : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ 2 G) (x : ComplexModel n) :
    coordinateLeviTrace (fun y : ComplexModel n => G (‖y‖ ^ 2)) x =
      (n : ℝ) * deriv G (‖x‖ ^ 2) +
        ‖x‖ ^ 2 * deriv (deriv G) (‖x‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateLeviTrace]
  simp_rw [leviForm_comp_norm_sq hG]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    sum_norm_inner_coordinateVector_sq]
  simp only [norm_coordinateVector, one_pow, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.explicitRadialPoissonPotential_contDiff
statement:
theorem explicitRadialPoissonPotential_contDiff {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
      (explicitRadialPoissonPotential (n := n) R hR a b)
proof:
:= by
  exact (radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_contDiff
      hn R hR a b ((R / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2)).comp
    (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ)

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.explicitRadialPoissonPotential_nonneg
statement:
theorem explicitRadialPoissonPotential_nonneg {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (x : ComplexModel n) :
    0 ≤ explicitRadialPoissonPotential R hR a b x
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℝ := (R / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2
  let s : ℝ := ‖x‖ ^ 2
  change 0 ≤ radialPoissonPrimitive n
    (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b) A s
  by_cases hsA : s ≤ A
  · apply radialPoissonPrimitive_nonneg hsA
    intro t ht
    by_cases ht0 : t = 0
    · subst t
      simp [radialPoissonSlope, radialWeightedCumulative]
    · have htpos : 0 < t := lt_of_le_of_ne
        ((sq_nonneg ‖x‖).trans ht.1) (Ne.symm ht0)
      exact radialPoissonSlope_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_nonpos
        hn R hR hab htpos
  · rw [radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_zero_of_outer
      hn R hR hab (le_of_not_ge hsA)]

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.explicitRadialPoissonPotential_eq_zero_of_outer
statement:
theorem explicitRadialPoissonPotential_eq_zero_of_outer {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    {x : ComplexModel n} (hx : R / ((a : ℝ) + 1) ≤ ‖x‖) :
    explicitRadialPoissonPotential R hR a b x = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_zero_of_outer
    hn R hR hab
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (by positivity) (norm_nonneg x)).mpr hx

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.explicitRadialPoissonPotential_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem explicitRadialPoissonPotential_hasCompactSupport {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    HasCompactSupport
      (explicitRadialPoissonPotential (n := n) R hR a b)
proof:
:= by
  apply HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ComplexModel n) (R / ((a : ℝ) + 1)))
  intro x hx
  simp only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  by_contra hnorm
  have hrx : R / ((a : ℝ) + 1) ≤ ‖x‖ := le_of_not_ge hnorm
  exact hx (explicitRadialPoissonPotential_eq_zero_of_outer
    hn R hR hab hrx)

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.four_mul_coordinateLeviTrace_explicitRadialPoissonPotential_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem four_mul_coordinateLeviTrace_explicitRadialPoissonPotential_of_ne_zero
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ)
    {x : ComplexModel n} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    4 * coordinateLeviTrace
      (explicitRadialPoissonPotential R hR a b) x =
        explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b (‖x‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ :=
    explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b
  let A : ℝ := (R / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := radialPoissonPrimitive n g A
  have hGinfty : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) G :=
    radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_contDiff
      hn R hR a b A
  have hG2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 G := hGinfty.of_le
    (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)
  have hA : 0 < A := by
    dsimp [A]
    positivity
  have hs : 0 < ‖x‖ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx)
  change 4 * coordinateLeviTrace (fun y : ComplexModel n => G (‖y‖ ^ 2)) x =
    g (‖x‖ ^ 2)
  rw [coordinateLeviTrace_comp_norm_sq hG2]
  calc
    4 * ((n : ℝ) * deriv G (‖x‖ ^ 2) +
        ‖x‖ ^ 2 * deriv (deriv G) (‖x‖ ^ 2)) =
      4 * (‖x‖ ^ 2 * deriv (deriv G) (‖x‖ ^ 2) +
        (n : ℝ) * deriv G (‖x‖ ^ 2)) := by ring
    _ = g (‖x‖ ^ 2) :=
      radialPoissonPrimitive_ode hn
        (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_contDiff R hR a b).continuous
        hA hs

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.four_mul_coordinateLeviTrace_explicitRadialPoissonPotential_of_ne_zero_eq_kernel_sub
statement:
theorem four_mul_coordinateLeviTrace_explicitRadialPoissonPotential_of_ne_zero_eq_kernel_sub
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ)
    {x : ComplexModel n} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    4 * coordinateLeviTrace
      (explicitRadialPoissonPotential R hR a b) x =
        explicitRadialKernel R hR a x - explicitRadialKernel R hR b x
proof:
:= by
  rw [four_mul_coordinateLeviTrace_explicitRadialPoissonPotential_of_ne_zero
      hn R hR a b hx,
    explicitRadialKernel_sub_eq_sqDifference_norm_sq]

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.deriv_radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_zero
statement:
theorem deriv_radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_zero
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ) (A : ℝ) :
    deriv (radialPoissonPrimitive n
      (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b) A) 0 =
        explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b 0 /
          (4 * (n : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ :=
    explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b
  let k : ℝ := g 0 / (4 * (n : ℝ))
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := radialPoissonPrimitive n g A
  let δ : ℝ := min
    ((shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR a).rIn ^ 2)
    ((shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR b).rIn ^ 2)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by
    dsimp [δ]
    exact lt_min
      (sq_pos_of_pos
        (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR a).rIn_pos)
      (sq_pos_of_pos
        (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR b).rIn_pos)
  have hevent : G =ᶠ[𝓝 0] fun s => G 0 + k * s := by
    filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hδ] with s hs
    exact radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_affine
      hn R hR a b A hs
  have hlinear : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => G 0 + k * s) k 0 :=
    (hasDerivAt_const_mul (x := 0) k).const_add (G 0)
  change deriv G 0 = k
  exact (hlinear.congr_of_eventuallyEq hevent).deriv

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.four_mul_coordinateLeviTrace_explicitRadialPoissonPotential
statement:
theorem four_mul_coordinateLeviTrace_explicitRadialPoissonPotential
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ)
    (x : ComplexModel n) :
    4 * coordinateLeviTrace
      (explicitRadialPoissonPotential R hR a b) x =
        explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b (‖x‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · subst x
    let g : ℝ → ℝ :=
      explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b
    let A : ℝ := (R / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2
    let G : ℝ → ℝ := radialPoissonPrimitive n g A
    have hGinfty : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) G :=
      radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_contDiff
        hn R hR a b A
    have hG2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 G := hGinfty.of_le
      (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)
    have hderiv : deriv G 0 = g 0 / (4 * (n : ℝ)) :=
      deriv_radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_zero
        hn R hR a b A
    change 4 * coordinateLeviTrace
      (fun y : ComplexModel n => G (‖y‖ ^ 2)) 0 = g (‖(0 : ComplexModel n)‖ ^ 2)
    rw [coordinateLeviTrace_comp_norm_sq hG2]
    norm_num only [norm_zero, zero_pow]
    rw [hderiv]
    have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn.ne'
    field_simp
    ring
  · exact
      four_mul_coordinateLeviTrace_explicitRadialPoissonPotential_of_ne_zero
        hn R hR a b hx

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.four_mul_coordinateLeviTrace_explicitRadialPoissonPotential_eq_kernel_sub
statement:
theorem four_mul_coordinateLeviTrace_explicitRadialPoissonPotential_eq_kernel_sub
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ)
    (x : ComplexModel n) :
    4 * coordinateLeviTrace
      (explicitRadialPoissonPotential R hR a b) x =
        explicitRadialKernel R hR a x - explicitRadialKernel R hR b x
proof:
:= by
  rw [four_mul_coordinateLeviTrace_explicitRadialPoissonPotential
      hn R hR a b x,
    explicitRadialKernel_sub_eq_sqDifference_norm_sq]

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPolarMass.integral_sqNorm_radial
statement:
theorem integral_sqNorm_radial {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    ∫ x : ComplexModel n, f (‖x‖ ^ 2) ∂volume =
      ((n : ℝ) * volume.real (ball (0 : ComplexModel n) 1)) *
        ∫ s in Ioi (0 : ℝ), s ^ (n - 1) * f s
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, hn⟩⟩
  let _ : Nontrivial (ComplexModel n) := inferInstance
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_fun_norm_addHaar
    (volume : Measure (ComplexModel n)) (fun r : ℝ => f (r ^ 2))]
  rw [finrank_real_complexModel]
  have hsubst := MeasureTheory.integral_comp_rpow_Ioi_of_pos
    (g := fun s : ℝ => s ^ (n - 1) * f s) (p := (2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
  have hpoint :
      (fun r : ℝ => ((2 : ℝ) * r ^ ((2 : ℝ) - 1)) •
          ((r ^ (2 : ℝ)) ^ (n - 1) * f (r ^ (2 : ℝ)))) =
        fun r => 2 * (r ^ (2 * n - 1) * f (r ^ 2)) := by
    funext r
    rw [show 2 * n - 1 = 2 * (n - 1) + 1 by omega, pow_succ, pow_mul]
    norm_num [Real.rpow_two, Real.rpow_one]
    ring
  rw [hpoint, integral_const_mul] at hsubst
  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← hsubst]
  ring

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPolarMass.integral_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_weighted_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_weighted_eq_zero
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ) :
    ∫ s in Ioi (0 : ℝ), s ^ (n - 1) *
        explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b s = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hka : Integrable (explicitRadialKernel (n := n) R hR a) volume :=
    (explicitRadialKernel_contDiff R hR a).continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (explicitRadialKernel_hasCompactSupport R hR a)
  have hkb : Integrable (explicitRadialKernel (n := n) R hR b) volume :=
    (explicitRadialKernel_contDiff R hR b).continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (explicitRadialKernel_hasCompactSupport R hR b)
  have hspatial :
      ∫ x : ComplexModel n,
          (explicitRadialKernel R hR a x - explicitRadialKernel R hR b x) ∂volume = 0 := by
    rw [integral_sub hka hkb, explicitRadialKernel_integral_one,
      explicitRadialKernel_integral_one, sub_self]
  have hprofile :
      ∫ x : ComplexModel n,
          explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b (‖x‖ ^ 2) ∂volume = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ x : ComplexModel n,
          (explicitRadialKernel R hR a x - explicitRadialKernel R hR b x) ∂volume := by
            apply integral_congr_ae
            filter_upwards with x
            exact (explicitRadialKernel_sub_eq_sqDifference_norm_sq R hR a b x).symm
      _ = 0 := hspatial
  have hpolar := integral_sqNorm_radial hn
    (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b)
  have hmul :
      ((n : ℝ) * volume.real (ball (0 : ComplexModel n) 1)) *
          ∫ s in Ioi (0 : ℝ), s ^ (n - 1) *
            explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b s = 0 := by
    rw [← hpolar, hprofile]
  have hnReal : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hvolume : 0 < volume.real (ball (0 : ComplexModel n) 1) :=
    ENNReal.toReal_pos (measure_ball_pos volume 0 one_pos).ne'
      measure_ball_lt_top.ne
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left (mul_ne_zero hnReal.ne' hvolume.ne')

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.explicitRadialRaw_scale
statement:
theorem explicitRadialRaw_scale (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ)
    (x : ComplexModel n) :
    explicitRadialRaw R hR b x =
      explicitRadialRaw R hR a
        ((((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) • x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold explicitRadialRaw
  congr 1
  rw [smul_smul]
  congr 1
  simp only [shrinkingBump]
  field_simp

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.explicitRadialRaw_contDiff
statement:
theorem explicitRadialRaw_contDiff (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (explicitRadialRaw (n := n) R hR j)
proof:
:= by
  let B := ContDiffBumpBase.ofInnerProductSpace (ComplexModel n)
  have hB : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (B.toFun 2) := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro x
    have hwithin := B.smooth (2, x) ⟨by norm_num, mem_univ x⟩
    have hunc := hwithin.contDiffAt
      ((isOpen_Ioi.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds ⟨by norm_num, mem_univ x⟩)
    change ContDiffAt ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
      (Function.uncurry B.toFun ∘ fun y : ComplexModel n ↦ ((2 : ℝ), y)) x
    exact hunc.comp x (by fun_prop)
  have hscale : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
      (fun x : ComplexModel n ↦
        (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn⁻¹ • x) := by
    fun_prop
  change ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (B.toFun 2 ∘ fun x : ComplexModel n ↦
    (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn⁻¹ • x)
  exact hB.comp hscale

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.explicitRadialRaw_support
statement:
theorem explicitRadialRaw_support (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    Function.support (explicitRadialRaw (n := n) R hR j) =
      ball 0 (R / ((j : ℝ) + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ComplexModel n) := shrinkingBump R hR j
  ext x
  change (ContDiffBumpBase.ofInnerProductSpace (ComplexModel n)).toFun 2
      (φ.rIn⁻¹ • x) ≠ 0 ↔ x ∈ ball 0 (R / ((j : ℝ) + 1))
  rw [← Function.mem_support,
    (ContDiffBumpBase.ofInnerProductSpace (ComplexModel n)).support 2 (by norm_num)]
  simp only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_inv, abs_of_pos φ.rIn_pos]
  rw [inv_mul_lt_iff₀ φ.rIn_pos]
  have hratio := shrinkingBump_radius_ratio (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j
  change ‖x‖ < φ.rIn * 2 ↔ _
  rw [mul_comm φ.rIn 2, ← hratio]
  rfl

proof:

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.explicitRadialKernel_integral_one
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernel_integral_one (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    ∫ x : ComplexModel n, explicitRadialKernel R hR j x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [explicitRadialKernel, div_eq_mul_inv,
    mul_comm (explicitRadialRaw R hR j _), ← smul_eq_mul, integral_smul]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (explicitRadialRaw_integral_pos R hR j).ne'

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.explicitRadialKernel_scale
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernel_scale (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ)
    (x : ComplexModel n) :
    explicitRadialKernel R hR b x =
      (((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^
          Module.finrank ℝ (ComplexModel n) *
        explicitRadialKernel R hR a
          ((((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) • x)
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := ((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)
  have hq : 0 < q := by
    dsimp [q]
    positivity
  have hqpow : q ^ Module.finrank ℝ (ComplexModel n) ≠ 0 :=
    pow_ne_zero _ hq.ne'
  have hint :
      (∫ y : ComplexModel n, explicitRadialRaw R hR b y) =
        (q ^ Module.finrank ℝ (ComplexModel n))⁻¹ *
          ∫ y : ComplexModel n, explicitRadialRaw R hR a y := by
    rw [show (fun y : ComplexModel n ↦ explicitRadialRaw R hR b y) =
        fun y ↦ explicitRadialRaw R hR a (q • y) by
      funext y
      exact explicitRadialRaw_scale R hR a b y]
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using
      (Measure.integral_comp_smul_of_nonneg volume
        (explicitRadialRaw (n := n) R hR a) q (hR := hq.le))
  rw [explicitRadialKernel, explicitRadialKernel,
    explicitRadialRaw_scale R hR a b, hint]
  dsimp [q]
  field_simp [hqpow, (explicitRadialRaw_integral_pos (n := n) R hR a).ne']

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.explicitRadialKernel_tsupport
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernel_tsupport (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    tsupport (explicitRadialKernel (n := n) R hR j) =
      closedBall 0 (R / ((j : ℝ) + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := explicitRadialRaw_integral_pos (n := n) R hR j
  rw [tsupport]
  change closure (Function.support (fun x : ComplexModel n ↦
    explicitRadialRaw R hR j x / ∫ y, explicitRadialRaw R hR j y)) = _
  rw [Function.support_div, Function.support_const hpos.ne', inter_univ,
    explicitRadialRaw_support R hR j,
    closure_ball _ (by positivity : R / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0)]

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.explicitRadialKernel_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernel_hasCompactSupport (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    HasCompactSupport (explicitRadialKernel (n := n) R hR j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HasCompactSupport, explicitRadialKernel_tsupport R hR j]
  exact isCompact_closedBall _ _

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.explicitRadialKernel_unitary
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernel_unitary (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ)
    (a : ℂ) (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (x : ComplexModel n) :
    explicitRadialKernel R hR j (a • x) =
      explicitRadialKernel R hR j x
proof:
:= by
  rw [explicitRadialKernel, explicitRadialKernel]
  congr 1
  simp [explicitRadialRaw, ContDiffBumpBase.ofInnerProductSpace, norm_smul, ha]

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.explicitRadialRaw_eq_one_of_mem_closedBall
statement:
theorem explicitRadialRaw_eq_one_of_mem_closedBall
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) (x : ComplexModel n)
    (hx : x ∈ closedBall 0
      (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn) :
    explicitRadialRaw R hR j x = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (ContDiffBumpBase.ofInnerProductSpace (ComplexModel n)).eq_one 2 (by norm_num)
  change ‖(shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn⁻¹ • x‖ ≤ 1
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv,
    abs_of_pos (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn_pos]
  have hx' : ‖x‖ ≤ (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn := by
    simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hx
  simpa only [div_eq_inv_mul] using
    ((div_le_one (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn_pos).2 hx')

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.measure_closedBall_le_explicitRadialRaw_integral
statement:
theorem measure_closedBall_le_explicitRadialRaw_integral
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    volume.real (closedBall (0 : ComplexModel n)
      (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn) ≤
      ∫ x : ComplexModel n, explicitRadialRaw R hR j x
proof:
:= by
  calc
    volume.real (closedBall (0 : ComplexModel n)
        (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn) =
        ∫ _x : ComplexModel n in closedBall 0
          (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn, 1 ∂volume := by simp
    _ = ∫ x : ComplexModel n in closedBall 0
          (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn,
          explicitRadialRaw R hR j x ∂volume :=
      setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_closedBall
        (fun x hx ↦ (explicitRadialRaw_eq_one_of_mem_closedBall R hR j x hx).symm)
    _ ≤ ∫ x : ComplexModel n, explicitRadialRaw R hR j x ∂volume :=
      setIntegral_le_integral (explicitRadialRaw_integrable R hR j)
        (Eventually.of_forall (explicitRadialRaw_nonneg R hR j))

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.explicitRadialKernel_le_div_measure_closedBall
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernel_le_div_measure_closedBall
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) (x : ComplexModel n) :
    explicitRadialKernel R hR j x ≤
      2 ^ Module.finrank ℝ (ComplexModel n) /
        volume.real (closedBall (0 : ComplexModel n)
          (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rOut)
proof:
:= by
  let φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ComplexModel n) := shrinkingBump R hR j
  have htwo : (0 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
  have hmeasure :
      volume.real (closedBall (0 : ComplexModel n) φ.rOut) /
          2 ^ Module.finrank ℝ (ComplexModel n) ≤
        ∫ y : ComplexModel n, explicitRadialRaw R hR j y := by
    apply le_trans _ (measure_closedBall_le_explicitRadialRaw_integral R hR j)
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos htwo _),
      Measure.addHaar_real_closedBall' volume _ φ.rIn_pos.le,
      Measure.addHaar_real_closedBall' volume _ φ.rOut_pos.le,
      mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (2 ^ Module.finrank ℝ (ComplexModel n)), ← mul_assoc,
      ← mul_pow, mul_comm _ 2]
    gcongr
    · exact φ.rOut_pos.le
    · exact (shrinkingBump_radius_ratio (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).le
  have hraw : explicitRadialRaw R hR j x /
        (∫ y : ComplexModel n, explicitRadialRaw R hR j y) ≤
      1 / (∫ y : ComplexModel n, explicitRadialRaw R hR j y) := by
    gcongr
    · exact (explicitRadialRaw_integral_pos R hR j).le
    · exact explicitRadialRaw_le_one R hR j x
  rw [explicitRadialKernel]
  apply hraw.trans
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (explicitRadialRaw_integral_pos R hR j), one_mul,
    ← div_le_iff₀' (pow_pos htwo _)]
  · exact hmeasure
  · exact ENNReal.toReal_pos
      (measure_closedBall_pos volume (0 : ComplexModel n) φ.rOut_pos).ne'
      measure_closedBall_lt_top.ne

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.tsupport_explicitRadialKernel_translate_subset
statement:
theorem tsupport_explicitRadialKernel_translate_subset
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) (z : ComplexModel n) :
    tsupport (fun x : ComplexModel n ↦ explicitRadialKernel R hR j (x - z)) ⊆
      closedBall z (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rOut
proof:
:= by
  apply closure_minimal _ isClosed_closedBall
  intro x hx
  have hx' : x - z ∈ tsupport (explicitRadialKernel (n := n) R hR j) :=
    subset_closure hx
  rw [explicitRadialKernel_tsupport R hR j] at hx'
  simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero, shrinkingBump]
    using hx'

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.explicitRadialKernel_neg
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernel_neg (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ)
    (x : ComplexModel n) :
    explicitRadialKernel R hR j (-x) = explicitRadialKernel R hR j x
proof:
:= by
  simpa using explicitRadialKernel_unitary R hR j (-1 : ℂ) (by norm_num) x

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.translationPairing_explicitRadialKernel_scale
statement:
theorem translationPairing_explicitRadialKernel_scale
    (g : ComplexModel n → ℝ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ)
    (z : ComplexModel n) :
    translationPairing volume g (explicitRadialKernel R hR b) z =
      ∫ y : ComplexModel n,
        g (z + ((((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1))⁻¹ • y)) *
          explicitRadialKernel R hR a y ∂volume
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := ((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)
  let d : ℕ := Module.finrank ℝ (ComplexModel n)
  have hq : 0 < q := by
    dsimp [q]
    positivity
  have hqpow : q ^ d ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hq.ne'
  let f : ComplexModel n → ℝ := fun y ↦
    g (z + q⁻¹ • y) * explicitRadialKernel R hR a y
  have hscale := Measure.integral_comp_smul_of_nonneg volume f q (hR := hq.le)
  calc
    translationPairing volume g (explicitRadialKernel R hR b) z =
        ∫ x : ComplexModel n,
          g (z + x) * explicitRadialKernel R hR b x ∂volume := by
      unfold translationPairing
      rw [← integral_add_left_eq_self
        (fun x : ComplexModel n ↦
          g x * explicitRadialKernel R hR b (x - z)) z]
      simp only [add_sub_cancel_left]
    _ = ∫ x : ComplexModel n,
          q ^ d * (g (z + x) * explicitRadialKernel R hR a (q • x)) ∂volume := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [explicitRadialKernel_scale R hR a b]
      dsimp [q, d]
      ring
    _ = q ^ d * ∫ x : ComplexModel n,
          g (z + x) * explicitRadialKernel R hR a (q • x) ∂volume := by
      rw [integral_const_mul]
    _ = q ^ d * ∫ x : ComplexModel n, f (q • x) ∂volume := by
      congr 1
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with x
      dsimp [f]
      rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq.ne', one_smul]
    _ = q ^ d * ((q ^ d)⁻¹ * ∫ y : ComplexModel n, f y ∂volume) := by
      rw [hscale]
      rfl
    _ = ∫ y : ComplexModel n, f y ∂volume := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hqpow, one_mul]
    _ = ∫ y : ComplexModel n,
          g (z + ((((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1))⁻¹ • y)) *
            explicitRadialKernel R hR a y ∂volume := by
      rfl

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.circleAverage_affineLine_mono_of_smooth_pshOn
statement:
theorem circleAverage_affineLine_mono_of_smooth_pshOn
    {p : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hpSmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ p)
    {Ω : Set (ComplexModel n)} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω)
    (hpPsh : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun x ↦ (p x : EReal)) Ω)
    (z y : ComplexModel n)
    (hlineΩ : ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 → z + ζ • y ∈ Ω)
    {r s : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s) (hs : s ≤ 1) :
    Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ ↦ p (z + ζ • y)) 0 r ≤
      Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ ↦ p (z + ζ • y)) 0 s
proof:
:= by
  have hp2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 p := hpSmooth.of_le
    (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)
  have hline : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun ζ : ℂ ↦ p (z + ζ • y)) :=
    hp2.comp (contDiff_const.add (complexLineLinear y).contDiff)
  have hΔ : ∀ ζ ∈ closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
      0 ≤ Laplacian.laplacian (fun w : ℂ ↦ p (z + w • y)) ζ := by
    intro ζ hζ
    apply (laplacian_complexLine_nonneg_iff hp2 z y ζ).mpr
    exact FirstPass.leviForm_nonneg_of_contDiffOn_plurisubharmonicOn
      (U := ⟨Ω, hΩ⟩) hpSmooth.contDiffOn hpPsh
      (hlineΩ ζ (by simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hζ)) y
  exact (circleAverage_monotoneOn_of_laplacian_nonneg hline 0 (by norm_num) hΔ)
    ⟨hr, hrs.trans hs⟩ ⟨hr.trans hrs, hs⟩ hrs

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.circleAverage_affineLine_mono_of_smooth_psh
statement:
theorem circleAverage_affineLine_mono_of_smooth_psh
    {p : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hpSmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ p)
    (hpPsh : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun x ↦ (p x : EReal)) Set.univ)
    (z y : ComplexModel n) {r s : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s) (hs : s ≤ 1) :
    Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ ↦ p (z + ζ • y)) 0 r ≤
      Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ ↦ p (z + ζ • y)) 0 s
proof:
:= by
  exact circleAverage_affineLine_mono_of_smooth_pshOn hpSmooth isOpen_univ hpPsh z y
    (fun _ _ ↦ mem_univ _) hr hrs hs

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.integrable_circleMap_smul_mul_of_continuous_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem integrable_circleMap_smul_mul_of_continuous_hasCompactSupport
    {p κ : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hp : Continuous p) (hκ : Continuous κ) (hκc : HasCompactSupport κ)
    (z : ComplexModel n) (r : ℝ) :
    Integrable
      (fun q : ℝ × ComplexModel n ↦
        p (z + circleMap 0 r q.1 • q.2) * κ q.2)
      ((volume.restrict (uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))).prod volume)
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ × ComplexModel n → ℝ := fun q ↦
    p (z + circleMap 0 r q.1 • q.2) * κ q.2
  let K : Set (ℝ × ComplexModel n) :=
    uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ tsupport κ
  have hF : Continuous F := by
    dsimp [F]
    fun_prop
  have hK : IsCompact K := isCompact_uIcc.prod hκc
  have hFI : IntegrableOn F K (volume.prod volume) :=
    hF.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK
  have hKind : MeasurableSet K := hK.measurableSet
  have hG : Integrable (K.indicator F) (volume.prod volume) :=
    hFI.integrable_indicator hKind
  rw [Measure.restrict_prod_eq_prod_univ]
  refine (hG.mono_measure Measure.restrict_le_self).congr ?_
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem (μ := volume.prod volume)
    (measurableSet_uIoc.prod MeasurableSet.univ)] with q hq
  by_cases hy : q.2 ∈ tsupport κ
  · rw [indicator_of_mem]
    exact ⟨uIoc_subset_uIcc hq.1, hy⟩
  · have hκ0 : κ q.2 = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hy (subset_closure hne)
    rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem]
    · rw [hκ0, mul_zero]
    · exact fun hqK ↦ hy hqK.2

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.integral_circleAverage_mul_eq_smul
statement:
theorem integral_circleAverage_mul_eq_smul
    {p κ : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hp : Continuous p) (hκ : Continuous κ) (hκc : HasCompactSupport κ)
    (hκrad : ∀ (a : ℂ), ‖a‖ = 1 → ∀ y, κ (a • y) = κ y)
    (z : ComplexModel n) (r : ℝ) :
    ∫ y : ComplexModel n,
        Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ ↦ p (z + ζ • y)) 0 r * κ y ∂volume =
      ∫ y : ComplexModel n, p (z + (r : ℂ) • y) * κ y ∂volume
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ → ComplexModel n → ℝ := fun t y ↦
    p (z + circleMap 0 r t • y) * κ y
  let I : ℝ := ∫ y : ComplexModel n,
    p (z + (r : ℂ) • y) * κ y ∂volume
  have hF : Integrable (Function.uncurry F)
      ((volume.restrict (uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))).prod volume) := by
    exact integrable_circleMap_smul_mul_of_continuous_hasCompactSupport
      hp hκ hκc z r
  have hinner : ∀ t : ℝ, ∫ y : ComplexModel n, F t y ∂volume = I := by
    intro t
    let a : ℂ := circleMap 0 1 t
    have ha : ‖a‖ = 1 := by
      dsimp [a]
      simp [norm_circleMap_zero]
    have hrot := (measurePreserving_smul_of_norm_eq_one volume a ha).integral_comp
      (complexRotation a ha).toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding
      (fun y : ComplexModel n ↦ p (z + (r : ℂ) • y) * κ y)
    simp_rw [hκrad a ha] at hrot
    dsimp [F, I]
    simpa [a, circleMap, smul_smul] using hrot
  simp_rw [Real.circleAverage_def]
  change (∫ y : ComplexModel n,
      ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ t in 0..2 * Real.pi,
        p (z + circleMap 0 r t • y))) * κ y ∂volume) = I
  calc
    (∫ y : ComplexModel n,
        ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ t in 0..2 * Real.pi,
          p (z + circleMap 0 r t • y))) * κ y ∂volume) =
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ y : ComplexModel n,
          (∫ t in 0..2 * Real.pi,
            p (z + circleMap 0 r t • y)) * κ y ∂volume := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with y
      ring
    _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ y : ComplexModel n,
          (∫ t in 0..2 * Real.pi, F t y) ∂volume := by
      congr 1
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with y
      dsimp [F]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
    _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ∫ t in 0..2 * Real.pi, ∫ y : ComplexModel n, F t y ∂volume := by
      rw [intervalIntegral_integral_swap hF]
    _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ _t in 0..2 * Real.pi, I := by
      congr 1
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro t _
      exact hinner t
    _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((2 * Real.pi) * I) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const]
      ring
    _ = I := by
      field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.integral_add_real_smul_mul_mono_of_smooth_pshOn
statement:
theorem integral_add_real_smul_mul_mono_of_smooth_pshOn
    {p κ : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hpSmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ p)
    {Ω : Set (ComplexModel n)} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω)
    (hpPsh : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun x ↦ (p x : EReal)) Ω)
    (hκ : Continuous κ) (hκc : HasCompactSupport κ)
    (hκnonneg : ∀ y, 0 ≤ κ y)
    (hκrad : ∀ (a : ℂ), ‖a‖ = 1 → ∀ y, κ (a • y) = κ y)
    (z : ComplexModel n)
    (hlineΩ : ∀ y ∈ tsupport κ, ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 → z + ζ • y ∈ Ω)
    {r s : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s) (hs : s ≤ 1) :
    (∫ y : ComplexModel n, p (z + (r : ℂ) • y) * κ y ∂volume) ≤
      ∫ y : ComplexModel n, p (z + (s : ℂ) • y) * κ y ∂volume
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_circleAverage_mul_eq_smul hpSmooth.continuous hκ hκc hκrad z r,
    ← integral_circleAverage_mul_eq_smul hpSmooth.continuous hκ hκc hκrad z s]
  have hmean_cont (t : ℝ) : Continuous (fun y : ComplexModel n ↦
      Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ ↦ p (z + ζ • y)) 0 t) := by
    unfold Real.circleAverage
    have hbase : Continuous (fun y : ComplexModel n ↦
        ∫ θ in 0..2 * Real.pi, p (z + circleMap 0 t θ • y)) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
      fun_prop
    change Continuous ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ • fun y : ComplexModel n ↦
      ∫ θ in 0..2 * Real.pi, p (z + circleMap 0 t θ • y))
    exact hbase.const_smul ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹)
  have hint (t : ℝ) : Integrable (fun y : ComplexModel n ↦
      Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ ↦ p (z + ζ • y)) 0 t * κ y) volume :=
    ((hmean_cont t).mul hκ).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hκc.mul_left
  apply integral_mono_ae (hint r) (hint s)
  filter_upwards with y
  by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport κ
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (circleAverage_affineLine_mono_of_smooth_pshOn hpSmooth hΩ hpPsh z y
        (hlineΩ y hy) hr hrs hs)
      (hκnonneg y)
  · have hκ0 : κ y = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hy (subset_closure hne)
    simp [hκ0]

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.ae_tendsto_comp_add_real_smul
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_comp_add_real_smul
    {f : ℕ → ComplexModel n → ℝ} {g : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume,
      Tendsto (fun j ↦ f j x) atTop (𝓝 (g x)))
    (z : ComplexModel n) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᵐ y ∂volume,
      Tendsto (fun j ↦ f j (z + r • y)) atTop
        (𝓝 (g (z + r • y)))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving
      (fun y : ComplexModel n ↦ r • y) volume volume :=
    Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_smul volume hr
  have ht : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving
      (fun y : ComplexModel n ↦ z + y) volume volume :=
    (measurePreserving_add_left volume z).quasiMeasurePreserving
  have haff : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving
      (fun y : ComplexModel n ↦ z + r • y) volume volume := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using ht.comp hs
  exact haff.ae h

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.ae_tendsto_translationPairing_explicitRadialKernel
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_translationPairing_explicitRadialKernel
    {g : ComplexModel n → ℝ} (hg : LocallyIntegrable g volume)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂volume,
      Tendsto (fun j ↦ translationPairing volume g
        (explicitRadialKernel R hR j) z) atTop (𝓝 (g z))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(Besicovitch.vitaliFamily volume).ae_tendsto_average_norm_sub hg]
    with z hz
  have hr : Tendsto
      (fun j ↦ (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rOut)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := tendsto_shrinkingBump_rOut R hR
  have hr' : Tendsto
      (fun j ↦ (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rOut)
      atTop (𝓝[>] 0) :=
    tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.2 ⟨hr, Eventually.of_forall
      (fun j ↦ (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rOut_pos)⟩
  have havg := (hz.comp (Besicovitch.tendsto_filterAt volume z)).comp hr'
  have hlim : Tendsto
      (fun j ↦ ∫ y : ComplexModel n,
        explicitRadialKernel R hR j (z - y) • g y ∂volume)
      atTop (𝓝 (g z)) := by
    apply tendsto_integral_smul_of_tendsto_average_norm_sub
      (2 ^ Module.finrank ℝ (ComplexModel n)) havg
    · filter_upwards with j
      exact hg.integrableOn_isCompact (isCompact_closedBall z _)
    · apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr
      intro j
      rw [← integral_neg_eq_self]
      simp only [sub_neg_eq_add, integral_add_left_eq_self,
        explicitRadialKernel_integral_one]
    · filter_upwards with j
      intro y hy
      have hy' : z - y ∈ tsupport (explicitRadialKernel (n := n) R hR j) :=
        subset_closure hy
      rw [explicitRadialKernel_tsupport R hR j] at hy'
      simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero,
        shrinkingBump, norm_sub_rev] using hy'
    · filter_upwards with j
      intro y
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (explicitRadialKernel_nonneg R hR j (z - y)),
        Measure.addHaar_real_closedBall_center volume z]
      exact explicitRadialKernel_le_div_measure_closedBall R hR j (z - y)
  apply hlim.congr'
  filter_upwards with j
  unfold translationPairing
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with y
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  rw [mul_comm]
  congr 1
  rw [← explicitRadialKernel_neg R hR j (y - z), neg_sub]

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.antitone_translationPairing_explicitRadialKernel_of_locallyBoundedPsh
statement:
theorem antitone_translationPairing_explicitRadialKernel_of_locallyBoundedPsh
    {Ω : Opens (ComplexModel n)} {p : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hp : IsLocallyBoundedPshOn Ω p) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    {N K : Set (ComplexModel n)} (_hN : IsOpen N) (_hNΩ : N ⊆ Ω)
    (_hK : IsCompact K) (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω)
    (hball : ∀ x ∈ N, closedBall x R ⊆ K) :
    ∀ z ∈ N, Antitone (fun j ↦ translationPairing volume (K.indicator p)
      (explicitRadialKernel R hR j) z)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz a b hab
  let q : ℝ := ((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)
  let r : ℝ := q⁻¹
  have hqpos : 0 < q := by
    dsimp [q]
    positivity
  have hqone : 1 ≤ q := by
    dsimp [q]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (a : ℝ) + 1)]
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      (show (a : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (b : ℝ) + 1 by exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right hab 1)
  have hrpos : 0 < r := inv_pos.mpr hqpos
  have hrle : r ≤ 1 := (inv_le_one₀ hqpos).mpr hqone
  have hScompact : IsCompact (closedBall z R) := isCompact_closedBall z R
  have hSΩ : closedBall z R ⊆ Ω := (hball z hz).trans hKΩ
  obtain ⟨U, K₀, f, C, hU, hSU, hUK₀, hK₀, hK₀Ω, hC,
      hfSmooth, _hfDisc, hfPsh, hfBound, hfAE⟩ :=
    FirstPass.MongeAmpere.exists_uniformlyBounded_smoothPsh_aeApproximation_on_compact
      hp hScompact hSΩ
  have hcomplexRealSmul (t : ℝ) (y : ComplexModel n) :
      (t : ℂ) • y = t • y := by
    rfl
  have hpointBall (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (htone : t ≤ 1)
      {y : ComplexModel n}
      (hy : y ∈ tsupport (explicitRadialKernel (n := n) R hR a)) :
      z + t • y ∈ closedBall z R := by
    have hyR : y ∈ closedBall (0 : ComplexModel n) R := by
      rw [explicitRadialKernel_tsupport R hR a] at hy
      exact (closedBall_subset_closedBall
        (shrinkingBump_rOut_le (E := ComplexModel n) R hR a)) hy
    rw [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht]
    have hynorm : ‖y‖ ≤ R := by
      simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hyR
    calc
      t * ‖y‖ ≤ 1 * ‖y‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htone (norm_nonneg y)
      _ ≤ R := by simpa only [one_mul] using hynorm
  have hlineU : ∀ y ∈ tsupport (explicitRadialKernel (n := n) R hR a),
      ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 → z + ζ • y ∈ U := by
    intro y hy ζ hζ
    apply hSU
    rw [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul]
    have hyR := hpointBall 1 zero_le_one le_rfl hy
    have hynorm : ‖y‖ ≤ R := by
      simpa only [one_smul, mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]
        using hyR
    calc
      ‖ζ‖ * ‖y‖ ≤ 1 * ‖y‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hζ (norm_nonneg y)
      _ ≤ R := by simpa only [one_mul] using hynorm
  have hκcont : Continuous (explicitRadialKernel (n := n) R hR a) :=
    (explicitRadialKernel_contDiff R hR a).continuous
  have hκcompact : HasCompactSupport (explicitRadialKernel (n := n) R hR a) :=
    explicitRadialKernel_hasCompactSupport R hR a
  have hκintegrable : Integrable (explicitRadialKernel (n := n) R hR a) volume :=
    hκcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hκcompact
  have hboundIntegrable : Integrable
      (fun y : ComplexModel n ↦ C * explicitRadialKernel R hR a y) volume :=
    hκintegrable.const_mul C
  have hDCT (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
      Tendsto
        (fun j ↦ ∫ y : ComplexModel n,
          f j (z + t • y) * explicitRadialKernel R hR a y ∂volume)
        atTop
        (𝓝 (∫ y : ComplexModel n,
          K₀.indicator p (z + t • y) * explicitRadialKernel R hR a y ∂volume)) := by
    apply tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
      (fun y : ComplexModel n ↦ C * explicitRadialKernel R hR a y)
    · intro j
      exact (((hfSmooth j).continuous.comp (by fun_prop)).mul hκcont).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact hboundIntegrable
    · intro j
      filter_upwards with y
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul,
        abs_of_nonneg (explicitRadialKernel_nonneg R hR a y)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hfBound j (z + t • y))
        (explicitRadialKernel_nonneg R hR a y)
    · filter_upwards [ae_tendsto_comp_add_real_smul hfAE z ht.ne'] with y hy
      exact hy.mul_const (explicitRadialKernel R hR a y)
  have hlocalCut (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (htone : t ≤ 1) :
      (∫ y : ComplexModel n,
          K₀.indicator p (z + t • y) * explicitRadialKernel R hR a y ∂volume) =
        ∫ y : ComplexModel n,
          p (z + t • y) * explicitRadialKernel R hR a y ∂volume := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport (explicitRadialKernel (n := n) R hR a)
    · rw [indicator_of_mem (hUK₀ (hSU (hpointBall t ht htone hy)))]
    · have hκzero : explicitRadialKernel R hR a y = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hy (subset_closure hne)
      simp only [hκzero, mul_zero]
  have hcut (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (htone : t ≤ 1) :
      (∫ y : ComplexModel n,
          K.indicator p (z + t • y) * explicitRadialKernel R hR a y ∂volume) =
        ∫ y : ComplexModel n,
          p (z + t • y) * explicitRadialKernel R hR a y ∂volume := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport (explicitRadialKernel (n := n) R hR a)
    · rw [indicator_of_mem (hball z hz (hpointBall t ht htone hy))]
    · have hκzero : explicitRadialKernel R hR a y = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hy (subset_closure hne)
      simp only [hκzero, mul_zero]
  have hlimr := hDCT r hrpos
  have hlimone := hDCT 1 one_pos
  rw [hlocalCut r hrpos.le hrle] at hlimr
  rw [hlocalCut 1 zero_le_one le_rfl] at hlimone
  have hmono :
      (∫ y : ComplexModel n,
          p (z + r • y) * explicitRadialKernel R hR a y ∂volume) ≤
        ∫ y : ComplexModel n,
          p (z + (1 : ℝ) • y) * explicitRadialKernel R hR a y ∂volume := by
    apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' hlimr hlimone
    intro j
    have hj := integral_add_real_smul_mul_mono_of_smooth_pshOn
      (hfSmooth j) hU (hfPsh j) hκcont hκcompact
      (explicitRadialKernel_nonneg R hR a)
      (explicitRadialKernel_unitary R hR a) z hlineU hrpos.le hrle le_rfl
    simpa only [hcomplexRealSmul] using hj
  calc
    translationPairing volume (K.indicator p) (explicitRadialKernel R hR b) z =
        ∫ y : ComplexModel n,
          K.indicator p (z + r • y) * explicitRadialKernel R hR a y ∂volume := by
      simpa only [q, r] using
        translationPairing_explicitRadialKernel_scale
          (K.indicator p) R hR a b z
    _ = ∫ y : ComplexModel n,
          p (z + r • y) * explicitRadialKernel R hR a y ∂volume :=
      hcut r hrpos.le hrle
    _ ≤ ∫ y : ComplexModel n,
          p (z + (1 : ℝ) • y) * explicitRadialKernel R hR a y ∂volume := hmono
    _ = ∫ y : ComplexModel n,
          K.indicator p (z + (1 : ℝ) • y) * explicitRadialKernel R hR a y ∂volume :=
      (hcut 1 zero_le_one le_rfl).symm
    _ = translationPairing volume (K.indicator p)
          (explicitRadialKernel R hR a) z := by
      symm
      simpa only [div_self (by positivity : (a : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0), inv_one,
        one_smul] using
        translationPairing_explicitRadialKernel_scale
          (K.indicator p) R hR a a z

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.exists_explicitRadialConvolutionSystem_of_locallyBoundedPsh
statement:
theorem exists_explicitRadialConvolutionSystem_of_locallyBoundedPsh
    {Ω : Opens (ComplexModel n)} {p : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hp : IsLocallyBoundedPshOn Ω p) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    {N K : Set (ComplexModel n)} (hN : IsOpen N) (hNΩ : N ⊆ Ω)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω)
    (hball : ∀ x ∈ N, closedBall x R ⊆ K) :
    ∃ S : RadialConvolutionSystem ⟨N, hN⟩ K p R,
      ∀ j x, S.kernel j x = explicitRadialKernel R hR j x
proof:
:= by
  have hNK : N ⊆ K := by
    intro z hz
    exact hball z hz (mem_closedBall_self hR.le)
  let hpL : LocallyIntegrableOn p Ω volume :=
    locallyIntegrableOn_of_plurisubharmonicOn_real hp.1
  have hg : LocallyIntegrable (K.indicator p) volume :=
    (integrable_indicator_of_locallyIntegrableOn_isCompact hpL hK hKΩ).locallyIntegrable
  have hae : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume.restrict N,
      Tendsto (fun j ↦ translationPairing volume (K.indicator p)
        (explicitRadialKernel R hR j) z) atTop (𝓝 (p z)) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae
      (ae_tendsto_translationPairing_explicitRadialKernel hg R hR),
      ae_restrict_mem hN.measurableSet] with z hzlim hzN
    simpa only [indicator_of_mem (hNK hzN)] using hzlim
  let S : RadialConvolutionSystem ⟨N, hN⟩ K p R :=
    { kernel := fun j ↦ explicitRadialKernel R hR j
      kernel_contDiff := fun j ↦ explicitRadialKernel_contDiff R hR j
      kernel_hasCompactSupport := fun j ↦ explicitRadialKernel_hasCompactSupport R hR j
      kernel_nonneg := fun j x ↦ explicitRadialKernel_nonneg R hR j x
      kernel_integral_one := fun j ↦ explicitRadialKernel_integral_one R hR j
      kernel_radial := fun j a ha x ↦ explicitRadialKernel_unitary R hR j a ha x
      kernel_tsupport := fun j ↦ by
        rw [explicitRadialKernel_tsupport R hR j]
      translated_tsupport := fun j z hz ↦ by
        exact (tsupport_explicitRadialKernel_translate_subset R hR j z).trans
          ((closedBall_subset_closedBall
            (shrinkingBump_rOut_le (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j)).trans
              (hball z hz))
      antitone_pairing :=
        antitone_translationPairing_explicitRadialKernel_of_locallyBoundedPsh
          hp hR hN hNΩ hK hKΩ hball
      ae_tendsto_pairing := hae }
  exact ⟨S, fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.exists_decreasingMollifierApproximation
statement:
theorem exists_decreasingMollifierApproximation
    {Ω A : Opens (ComplexModel n)} {p : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hp : IsLocallyBoundedPshOn Ω p) (hA : RelativelyCompactIn A Ω) :
    ∃ f : ℕ → ComplexModel n → ℝ, IsDecreasingApproximation A p f
proof:
:= by
  let _ : ProperSpace (ComplexModel n) := FiniteDimensional.proper ℝ _
  obtain ⟨R, hR, N, K, hN, hclAN, hNK, hK, hKΩ, hball⟩ :=
    exists_open_compact_closedBall_neighborhood hA.1 Ω.isOpen hA.2
  have hAN : (A : Set (ComplexModel n)) ⊆ N := subset_closure.trans hclAN
  have hAΩ : (A : Set (ComplexModel n)) ⊆ Ω := hAN.trans (hNK.trans hKΩ)
  let hpL : LocallyIntegrableOn p Ω volume :=
    locallyIntegrableOn_of_plurisubharmonicOn_real hp.1
  have hpLevi : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
      (regularDistribution volume p hpL) :=
    hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_plurisubharmonicOn_real hp.1
  obtain ⟨S, _hSkernel⟩ :=
    exists_explicitRadialConvolutionSystem_of_locallyBoundedPsh
      hp hR hN (hNK.trans hKΩ) hK hKΩ hball
  let f : ℕ → ComplexModel n → ℝ := fun j ↦
    translationPairing volume (K.indicator p) (S.kernel j)
  have hg : LocallyIntegrable (K.indicator p) volume :=
    (integrable_indicator_of_locallyIntegrableOn_isCompact hpL hK hKΩ).locallyIntegrable
  have hfDisc (j : ℕ) : DiscPshOn (fun x ↦ (f j x : EReal)) N :=
    discPshOn_translationPairing_indicator hpL hpLevi
      (S.kernel_hasCompactSupport j) (S.kernel_contDiff j)
      (S.kernel_nonneg j) hK hKΩ (S.translated_tsupport j)
  have hfPsh (j : ℕ) : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun x ↦ (f j x : EReal)) A :=
    ((hfDisc j).plurisubharmonicOn hN).mono hAN
  have hfSmooth (j : ℕ) : IsSmoothPshOn A (f j) :=
    isSmoothPshOn_of_psh
      (contDiff_translationPairing hg (S.kernel_hasCompactSupport j)
        (S.kernel_contDiff j)).contDiffOn (hfPsh j)
  have hantiN : ∀ x ∈ N, Antitone (fun j ↦ f j x) := by
    intro x hx
    exact S.antitone_pairing x hx
  have hanti : ∀ x ∈ A, Antitone (fun j ↦ f j x) :=
    fun x hx ↦ hantiN x (hAN hx)
  have hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (A : Set (ComplexModel n)),
      Tendsto (fun j ↦ f j x) atTop (𝓝 (p x)) := by
    have haeN := S.ae_tendsto_pairing
    change ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict N,
      Tendsto (fun j ↦ f j x) atTop (𝓝 (p x)) at haeN
    exact ae_mono (Measure.restrict_mono hAN le_rfl) haeN
  have hpoint : ∀ x ∈ A, Tendsto (fun j ↦ f j x) atTop (𝓝 (p x)) :=
    tendsto_everywhere_of_ae_of_antitone_psh (hp.1.mono hAΩ) hfPsh hanti hae
  exact ⟨f, hfSmooth, hanti, hpoint⟩

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.plurisubharmonicOn_coe_comp_of_smooth
statement:
theorem plurisubharmonicOn_coe_comp_of_smooth
    {F : ComplexModel k → ComplexModel n} {p : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    {U : Set (ComplexModel k)} {V : Set (ComplexModel n)}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hF : ContDiffOn ℂ ∞ F U)
    (hpSmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p V) (hFV : MapsTo F U V)
    (hp : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun y => (p y : EReal)) V) :
    PlurisubharmonicOn (fun y => (p (F y) : EReal)) U
proof:
:= by
  let q : ComplexModel k → ℝ := fun y => p (F y)
  have hqSmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U :=
    hpSmooth.comp (hF.restrict_scalars ℝ) hFV
  have hqLevi : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ v : ComplexModel k, 0 ≤ leviForm q y v := by
    intro y hy v
    have hFy : DifferentiableAt ℂ F y :=
      ((hF y hy).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hq2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 q y :=
      ((hqSmooth y hy).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).of_le
        (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)
    have hp2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 p (F y) :=
      ((hpSmooth (F y) (hFV hy)).contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds (hFV hy))).of_le
        (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)
    have hnatural := congrArg
      (fun A : (ComplexModel k) [⋀^Fin 2]→L[ℝ] ℝ =>
        A ![v, Complex.I • v])
      (FirstPass.HolomorphicDDC.smoothDDC_comp hU hV hF hpSmooth hFV hy)
    have hmapI : fderiv ℝ F y (Complex.I • v) =
        Complex.I • fderiv ℝ F y v := by
      rw [hFy.fderiv_restrictScalars ℝ]
      exact (fderiv ℂ F y).map_smul Complex.I v
    have hvec : (fun i => fderiv ℝ F y (![v, Complex.I • v] i)) =
        ![fderiv ℝ F y v, fderiv ℝ F y (Complex.I • v)] := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    simp only [ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply] at hnatural
    change smoothDDC (fun x => p (F x)) y ![v, Complex.I • v] =
      smoothDDC p (F y) (fun i => fderiv ℝ F y (![v, Complex.I • v] i)) at hnatural
    rw [hvec] at hnatural
    change smoothDDC q y ![v, Complex.I • v] =
      smoothDDC p (F y) ![fderiv ℝ F y v,
        fderiv ℝ F y (Complex.I • v)] at hnatural
    rw [hmapI, FirstPass.smoothDDC_complexDiagonal_eq_leviForm hq2 v,
      FirstPass.smoothDDC_complexDiagonal_eq_leviForm hp2 (fderiv ℝ F y v)] at hnatural
    have hpLevi : 0 ≤ leviForm p (F y) (fderiv ℝ F y v) :=
      FirstPass.leviForm_nonneg_of_contDiffOn_plurisubharmonicOn
        (U := ⟨V, hV⟩) hpSmooth hp (hFV hy) _
    have hqDiv : 0 ≤ leviForm q y v / Real.pi := by
      rw [hnatural]
      exact div_nonneg hpLevi Real.pi_pos.le
    have hmul := mul_nonneg hqDiv Real.pi_pos.le
    rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ Real.pi_ne_zero] at hmul
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨g, hg, heq⟩ :=
    FirstPass.exists_contDiff_eventuallyEq_of_contDiffOn hU hqSmooth hy
  have hmem : {x | q x = g x} ∩ U ∈ 𝓝 y :=
    inter_mem heq (hU.mem_nhds hy)
  obtain ⟨W, hWsub, hW, hyW⟩ := _root_.mem_nhds_iff.mp hmem
  have hWU : W ⊆ U := fun x hx => (hWsub hx).2
  have heqW : EqOn q g W := fun x hx => (hWsub hx).1
  have hgLevi : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ v : ComplexModel k, 0 ≤ leviForm g x v := by
    intro x hx v
    have hlocal : q =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g := by
      filter_upwards [hW.mem_nhds hx] with t ht
      exact heqW ht
    have hsecond : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ q) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) x :=
      hlocal.fderiv.fderiv_eq
    have hlevi : leviForm q x v = leviForm g x v := by
      simp only [leviForm, realHessian_eq_fderiv, hsecond]
    rw [← hlevi]
    exact hqLevi x (hWU hx) v
  have hgPsh : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun x => (g x : EReal)) W :=
    plurisubharmonicOn_of_levi_nonneg
      (hg.of_le (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)) hW hgLevi
  apply (hgPsh y hyW).congr
  filter_upwards [hW.mem_nhds hyW] with x hx
  change (g x : EReal) = (q x : EReal)
  exact congrArg (fun t : ℝ => (t : EReal)) (heqW hx).symm

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.plurisubharmonicOn_coe_comp_holomorphic_of_smooth
statement:
theorem plurisubharmonicOn_coe_comp_holomorphic_of_smooth
    {F : ComplexModel k → ComplexModel n} {p : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    {U : Set (ComplexModel k)} {V : Set (ComplexModel n)}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F U)
    (hpSmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p V) (hFV : MapsTo F U V)
    (hp : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun y => (p y : EReal)) V) :
    PlurisubharmonicOn (fun y => (p (F y) : EReal)) U
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun y => p (F y)) U :=
    hpSmooth.continuousOn.comp hF.continuousOn hFV
  have hdisc : DiscPshOn (fun y => (p (F y) : EReal)) U := by
    refine ⟨fun _ _ => EReal.coe_ne_top _,
      (continuous_coe_real_ereal.comp_continuousOn hcont).upperSemicontinuousOn,
      ?_⟩
    intro x v r hr hD C hC
    let line : ℂ → ComplexModel k := fun z => x + z • v
    let D : Set ℂ := line ⁻¹' U
    have hline : Differentiable ℂ line := by
      dsimp only [line]
      fun_prop
    have hDopen : IsOpen D := hU.preimage hline.continuous
    let g : ℂ → ComplexModel n := fun z => F (line z)
    have hgDiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ g D := by
      have hmap : MapsTo line D U := fun _ hz => hz
      exact hF.fun_comp hline.differentiableOn hmap
    have hgSmooth : ContDiffOn ℂ ∞ g D := hgDiff.contDiffOn hDopen
    let e : ComplexModel 1 ≃L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      PiLp.equivOfUnique 2 ℂ (fun _ : Fin 1 => ℂ)
    let A : Set (ComplexModel 1) := e ⁻¹' D
    have hAopen : IsOpen A := hDopen.preimage e.continuous
    let G : ComplexModel 1 → ComplexModel n := fun a => g (e a)
    have hGSmooth : ContDiffOn ℂ ∞ G A := by
      exact hgSmooth.comp e.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun _ ha => ha)
    have hGAV : MapsTo G A V := by
      intro a ha
      exact hFV ha
    have hGPsh : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun a => (p (G a) : EReal)) A :=
      plurisubharmonicOn_coe_comp_of_smooth
        hAopen hV hGSmooth hpSmooth hGAV hp
    have hGdisc : DiscPshOn (fun a => (p (G a) : EReal)) A :=
      hGPsh.discPshOn
    let d : ComplexModel 1 := e.symm 1
    have hedge (z : ℂ) : e (z • d) = z := by
      simp [d]
    have hGparam (z : ℂ) : G (0 + z • d) = F (x + z • v) := by
      simp only [G, g, line, zero_add, hedge]
    have hdiscA : affineClosedDisc (0 : ComplexModel 1) d r ⊆ A := by
      intro a ha
      obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := ha
      change line (e (0 + z • d)) ∈ U
      rw [show e (0 + z • d) = z by simp [hedge]]
      exact hD ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    have hboundA : ∀ a ∈ affineClosedDisc (0 : ComplexModel 1) d r,
        (p (G a) : EReal) ≤ (C : EReal) := by
      intro a ha
      obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := ha
      rw [hGparam]
      exact hC _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    have hsub := hGdisc.submean (0 : ComplexModel 1) d r hr hdiscA C hboundA
    unfold circleDeficit at hsub ⊢
    simp only [hGparam] at hsub
    simpa [G, g, line] using hsub
  exact hdisc.plurisubharmonicOn hU

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.plurisubharmonicAt_comp_holomorphic
statement:
theorem plurisubharmonicAt_comp_holomorphic
    {F : ComplexModel k → ComplexModel n} {u : ComplexModel n → EReal}
    {U : Set (ComplexModel k)} (hU : IsOpen U) (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F U)
    {z : ComplexModel k} (hz : z ∈ U) (hu : PlurisubharmonicAt u (F z)) :
    PlurisubharmonicAt (fun y => u (F y)) z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hFzV, huV⟩ := hu
  let Ω : Opens (ComplexModel n) := ⟨V, hV⟩
  have huΩ : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω := huV.plurisubharmonicOn hV
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV (F z) hFzV
  let A : Opens (ComplexModel n) := ⟨ball (F z) (r / 2), isOpen_ball⟩
  have hFzA : F z ∈ A := mem_ball_self (by positivity)
  let _ : ProperSpace (ComplexModel n) := FiniteDimensional.proper ℝ _
  have hAcompact : IsCompact (closure (A : Set (ComplexModel n))) := by
    change IsCompact (closure (ball (F z) (r / 2)))
    rw [closure_ball _ (by positivity : r / 2 ≠ 0)]
    exact isCompact_closedBall _ _
  have hAclΩ : closure (A : Set (ComplexModel n)) ⊆ Ω := by
    change closure (ball (F z) (r / 2)) ⊆ V
    rw [closure_ball _ (by positivity : r / 2 ≠ 0)]
    exact (closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
  have hAΩ : (A : Set (ComplexModel n)) ⊆ Ω := subset_closure.trans hAclΩ
  have hArel : RelativelyCompactIn A Ω := ⟨hAcompact, hAclΩ⟩
  have hex (q : ℕ) : ∃ f : ℕ → ComplexModel n → ℝ,
      IsDecreasingApproximation A (truncationReal u q) f :=
    exists_decreasingMollifierApproximation
      (truncationReal_isLocallyBoundedPshOn huΩ q) hArel
  choose f hf using hex
  let B : Opens (ComplexModel k) :=
    ⟨U ∩ F ⁻¹' (A : Set (ComplexModel n)),
      hF.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hU A.isOpen⟩
  have hzB : z ∈ B := ⟨hz, hFzA⟩
  have hFB : DifferentiableOn ℂ F B := hF.mono inter_subset_left
  have hFBA : MapsTo F B A := fun _ hy ↦ hy.2
  have hpull (q j : ℕ) :
      PlurisubharmonicOn (fun y ↦ (f q j (F y) : EReal)) B :=
    plurisubharmonicOn_coe_comp_holomorphic_of_smooth
      B.isOpen A.isOpen hFB ((hf q).1 j).1 hFBA ((hf q).1 j).2.1
  have htruncDisc (q : ℕ) :
      DiscPshOn (fun y ↦ (truncationReal u q (F y) : EReal)) B := by
    have hfj (j : ℕ) : DiscPshOn (fun y ↦ (f q j (F y) : EReal)) B :=
      (hpull q j).discPshOn
    have hanti (y : ComplexModel k) (hy : y ∈ B) :
        Antitone (fun j ↦ (f q j (F y) : EReal)) := by
      intro a b hab
      exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr ((hf q).2.1 (F y) hy.2 hab)
    apply (DiscPshOn.iInf_of_antitone hfj hanti).congr
    intro y hy
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (tendsto_atTop_iInf (hanti y hy))
      (EReal.tendsto_coe.mpr ((hf q).2.2 (F y) hy.2))
  have htruncAnti (y : ComplexModel k) (hy : y ∈ B) :
      Antitone (fun q ↦ (truncationReal u q (F y) : EReal)) := by
    intro a b hab
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr
      (truncationReal_antitone huΩ (hAΩ hy.2) hab)
  apply (DiscPshOn.iInf_of_antitone htruncDisc htruncAnti).plurisubharmonicOn
    B.isOpen z hzB |>.congr
  filter_upwards [B.isOpen.mem_nhds hzB] with y hy
  have hnegReal : Tendsto (fun q : ℕ ↦ -(q : ℝ)) atTop atBot :=
    tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hnegEReal : Tendsto (fun q : ℕ ↦ ((-(q : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal)) atTop (𝓝 ⊥) :=
    EReal.tendsto_coe_atBot.comp hnegReal
  have ht : Tendsto (fun q ↦ truncation u q (F y)) atTop (𝓝 (u (F y))) := by
    simpa only [truncation, max_eq_left bot_le] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.max hnegEReal :
        Tendsto (fun q : ℕ ↦ max (u (F y)) ((-(q : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal))
          atTop (𝓝 (max (u (F y)) ⊥)))
  have htReal : Tendsto (fun q ↦ (truncationReal u q (F y) : EReal))
      atTop (𝓝 (u (F y))) := by
    have heq : (fun q ↦ (truncationReal u q (F y) : EReal)) =
        fun q ↦ truncation u q (F y) := by
      funext q
      exact coe_truncationReal huΩ q (hAΩ hy.2)
    rw [heq]
    exact ht
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (tendsto_atTop_iInf (htruncAnti y hy)) htReal

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.plurisubharmonicOn_comp_holomorphic

:= by

name: PshLines.Regularization.HolomorphicPullback.quasiPlurisubharmonicAt_comp_holomorphic
statement:
theorem quasiPlurisubharmonicAt_comp_holomorphic
    {F : ComplexModel k → ComplexModel n} {u : ComplexModel n → EReal}
    {U : Set (ComplexModel k)} (hU : IsOpen U) (hF : ContDiffOn ℂ ∞ F U)
    {z : ComplexModel k} (hz : z ∈ U) (hu : QuasiPlurisubharmonicAt u (F z)) :
    QuasiPlurisubharmonicAt (fun y => u (F y)) z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, h, hp, hh, heq⟩ := hu
  have hcont : ContinuousAt F z := hF.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
  refine ⟨fun y => p (F y), fun y => h (F y),
    plurisubharmonicAt_comp_holomorphic hU (hF.differentiableOn (by simp)) hz hp,
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [hcont.eventually hh, hU.mem_nhds hz] with y hhy hy
    exact hhy.comp y (((hF.restrict_scalars ℝ) y hy).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy))
  exact heq.comp_tendsto hcont

theorem radialPoissonSlope_continuousOn_Ioi
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) :

proof:
