name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonPrimitive.radialPoissonPrimitive_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem radialPoissonPrimitive_hasDerivAt
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g)
    {A s : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hs : 0 < s) :
    HasDerivAt (radialPoissonPrimitive n g A)
      (radialPoissonSlope n g s) s
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : uIcc A s ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
    simp [uIcc, Icc_subset_Ioi_iff, hA, hs]
  have hcont := radialPoissonSlope_continuousOn_Ioi hn hg
  have hint : IntervalIntegrable (radialPoissonSlope n g) volume A s :=
    (hcont.mono hsub).intervalIntegrable
  have hmeas : StronglyMeasurableAtFilter (radialPoissonSlope n g) (𝓝 s) :=
    hcont.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter isOpen_Ioi s hs
  have hconts : ContinuousAt (radialPoissonSlope n g) s :=
    isOpen_Ioi.continuousOn_iff.mp hcont hs
  unfold radialPoissonPrimitive
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right hint hmeas hconts

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonPrimitive.radialPoissonPrimitive_deriv_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem radialPoissonPrimitive_deriv_hasDerivAt
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g)
    {A s : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hs : 0 < s) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (radialPoissonPrimitive n g A))
      (g s / (4 * s) -
        (n : ℝ) * radialPoissonSlope n g s / s) s
proof:
:= by
  apply (radialPoissonSlope_hasDerivAt hn hg hs).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hs] with t ht
  exact (radialPoissonPrimitive_hasDerivAt hn hg hA ht).deriv

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonPrimitive.radialPoissonPrimitive_ode
statement:
theorem radialPoissonPrimitive_ode
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g)
    {A s : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hs : 0 < s) :
    4 * (s * deriv (deriv (radialPoissonPrimitive n g A)) s +
      (n : ℝ) * deriv (radialPoissonPrimitive n g A) s) = g s
proof:
:= by
  rw [(radialPoissonPrimitive_deriv_hasDerivAt hn hg hA hs).deriv,
    (radialPoissonPrimitive_hasDerivAt hn hg hA hs).deriv]
  field_simp
  ring

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonPrimitive.radialPoissonPrimitive_nonneg
statement:
theorem radialPoissonPrimitive_nonneg
    {n : ℕ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {A s : ℝ} (hsA : s ≤ A)
    (hslope : ∀ t ∈ Icc s A, radialPoissonSlope n g t ≤ 0) :
    0 ≤ radialPoissonPrimitive n g A s
proof:
:= by
  calc
    radialPoissonPrimitive n g A s =
        ∫ t in s..A, -radialPoissonSlope n g t := by
      rw [radialPoissonPrimitive, intervalIntegral.integral_symm,
        intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
    _ ≥ 0 := intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hsA fun t ht =>
      neg_nonneg.mpr (hslope t ht)

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonPrimitive.radialPoissonPrimitive_eq_zero_of_slope_eq_zero
statement:
theorem radialPoissonPrimitive_eq_zero_of_slope_eq_zero
    {n : ℕ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {A s : ℝ} (hAs : A ≤ s)
    (hzero : ∀ t, A ≤ t → radialPoissonSlope n g t = 0) :
    radialPoissonPrimitive n g A s = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold radialPoissonPrimitive
  calc
    (∫ t in A..s, radialPoissonSlope n g t) = ∫ _t in A..s, (0 : ℝ) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro t ht
      have ht' : t ∈ Icc A s := (uIcc_of_le hAs).symm ▸ ht
      exact hzero t ht'.1
    _ = 0 := by simp

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonPrimitive.radialWeightedCumulative_eq_zero_of_total_and_outer_zero
statement:
theorem radialWeightedCumulative_eq_zero_of_total_and_outer_zero
    {n : ℕ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {A s : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hAs : A ≤ s)
    (hint : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (n - 1) * g t) (Ioi 0))
    (htotal : ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), t ^ (n - 1) * g t = 0)
    (hzero : ∀ t, A < t → g t = 0) :
    radialWeightedCumulative n g s = 0
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => t ^ (n - 1) * g t
  have hs : 0 ≤ s := hA.le.trans hAs
  have hintS : IntegrableOn f (Ioi s) :=
    hint.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hs)
  have htail : ∫ t in Ioi s, f t = 0 := by
    apply setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
    intro t ht
    dsimp [f]
    rw [hzero t (hAs.trans_lt ht), mul_zero]
  have hadd := intervalIntegral.integral_interval_add_Ioi
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := s) hint hintS
  rw [htail, add_zero, htotal] at hadd
  rw [radialWeightedCumulative]
  exact hadd

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonPrimitive.radialPoissonSlope_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_nonpos
statement:
theorem radialPoissonSlope_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_nonpos
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    radialPoissonSlope n
      (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b) s ≤ 0
proof:
:=
  radialPoissonSlope_nonpos hs
    (radialWeightedCumulative_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_nonpos
      hn R hR hab hs.le)

statement:

    (hs : 0 < s) (hsA : s ≤ A) :
    0 ≤ radialPoissonPrimitive n
      (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b) A s
proof:
:= by
  apply radialPoissonPrimitive_nonneg hsA
  intro t ht
  exact radialPoissonSlope_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_nonpos
    hn R hR hab (hs.trans_le ht.1)

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonPrimitive.radialWeightedCumulative_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_zero_of_outer
statement:
theorem radialWeightedCumulative_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_zero_of_outer
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : (R / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ s) :
    radialWeightedCumulative n
      (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b) s = 0
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℝ := (R / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2
  let g : ℝ → ℝ :=
    explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => t ^ (n - 1) * g t
  have hA : 0 < A := by
    dsimp [A]
    positivity
  have hfcont : Continuous f :=
    (continuous_id.pow _).mul
      (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_contDiff R hR a b).continuous
  have hleft : IntegrableOn f (Ioc 0 A) :=
    (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hA.le).mp
      (hfcont.intervalIntegrable 0 A)
  have hright : IntegrableOn f (Ioi A) := by
    apply integrableOn_zero.congr_fun
    · intro t ht
      dsimp [f, g]
      rw [explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_zero_of_sq_rOut_le
        R hR hab ht.le, mul_zero]
    · exact measurableSet_Ioi
  have hint : IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0) := by
    rw [← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hA.le]
    exact hleft.union hright
  apply radialWeightedCumulative_eq_zero_of_total_and_outer_zero
    hA hs hint
  · exact integral_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_weighted_eq_zero
      hn R hR a b
  · intro t ht
    exact explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_zero_of_sq_rOut_le
      R hR hab ht.le

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonPrimitive.radialPoissonSlope_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_zero_of_outer
statement:
theorem radialPoissonSlope_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_zero_of_outer
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : (R / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ s) :
    radialPoissonSlope n
      (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b) s = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [radialPoissonSlope,
    radialWeightedCumulative_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_zero_of_outer
      hn R hR hab hs,
    zero_div]

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonPrimitive.radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_zero_of_outer
statement:
theorem radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_zero_of_outer
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) {s : ℝ}

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.iteratedFDeriv_testFunctionRadialConvolution
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.iteratedFDeriv_testFunctionRadialConvolution
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (j : ℕ)
    (φ : 𝓓(D.inner, ℝ)) (r : ℕ) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (D.testFunctionRadialConvolution j φ) =
      D.kernel j ⋆[(ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ :

proof:

      (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ).flip =
        ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ := by

    (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ)

name: PshLines.Regularization.TestFunction.uniformContinuous_iteratedFDeriv
statement:
theorem TestFunction.uniformContinuous_iteratedFDeriv
    {U : Opens E} (φ : 𝓓(U, ℝ)) (r : ℕ) :
    UniformContinuous (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (fun y : E ↦ φ y))
proof:
:= by
  let g : E → (E [×r]→L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (fun y : E ↦ φ y)
  have hnextCont : Continuous
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (r + 1) (fun y : E ↦ φ y)) :=
    φ.contDiff.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by
      exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr
        (le_top : ((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞)))
  have hnextCompact : HasCompactSupport
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (r + 1) (fun y : E ↦ φ y)) :=
    φ.hasCompactSupport.iteratedFDeriv (r + 1)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    hnextCont.bounded_above_of_compact_support hnextCompact
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C :=
    (norm_nonneg (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (r + 1)
      (fun y : E ↦ φ y) 0)).trans (hC 0)
  rw [Metric.uniformContinuous_iff]
  intro ε hε
  let δ : ℝ := ε / (C + 1)
  have hC1 : 0 < C + 1 := by linarith
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos hε hC1
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro a b hab
  have hgdiff : ∀ y ∈ (univ : Set E), DifferentiableAt ℝ g y := by
    intro y hy
    exact (φ.contDiff.differentiable_iteratedFDeriv (by
      exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr
        (ENat.natCast_lt_top r))).differentiableAt
  have hDbound : ∀ y ∈ (univ : Set E), ‖fderiv ℝ g y‖ ≤ C := by
    intro y hy
    simpa only [g, norm_fderiv_iteratedFDeriv] using hC y
  have hmean := convex_univ.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
    hgdiff hDbound (mem_univ b) (mem_univ a)
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  calc
    ‖g a - g b‖ = ‖g b - g a‖ := norm_sub_rev _ _
    _ ≤ C * ‖a - b‖ := by simpa [norm_sub_rev] using hmean
    _ ≤ (C + 1) * ‖a - b‖ := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ < (C + 1) * δ := by
      apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left _ hC1
      simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hab
    _ = ε := by
      dsimp only [δ]
      exact mul_div_cancel₀ ε hC1.ne'

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.iteratedFDeriv_testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.iteratedFDeriv_testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (j : ℕ)
    (φ : 𝓓(D.inner, ℝ)) (r : ℕ) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ r
        (fun y : E ↦ D.testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn j φ y) =
      D.kernel j ⋆[(ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ :
          ℝ →L[ℝ] (E [×r]→L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] (E [×r]→L[ℝ] ℝ)), μ]
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (fun y : E ↦ φ y)

:= by

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.eventually_structureMapCLM_dist_lt
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.eventually_structureMapCLM_dist_lt
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (φ : 𝓓(D.inner, ℝ))
    (r : ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
      ‖ContDiffMapSupportedIn.structureMapCLM ℝ ⊤ r
          (D.testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn j φ) -
        ContDiffMapSupportedIn.structureMapCLM ℝ ⊤ r
          (D.includedTestFunctionSupportedIn φ)‖ < ε
proof:
:= by
  let g : E → (E [×r]→L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (fun y : E ↦ φ y)
  have hguc : UniformContinuous g :=
    PshLines.Regularization.TestFunction.uniformContinuous_iteratedFDeriv φ r
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hgδ⟩ :=
    (Metric.uniformContinuous_iff.mp hguc) (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
  filter_upwards [D.eventually_kernel_support_subset_ball hδ] with j hj
  have hnorm :
      ‖ContDiffMapSupportedIn.structureMapCLM ℝ ⊤ r
          (D.testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn j φ) -
        ContDiffMapSupportedIn.structureMapCLM ℝ ⊤ r
          (D.includedTestFunctionSupportedIn φ)‖ ≤ ε / 2 := by
    rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le (half_pos hε).le]
    intro y
    change ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ r
          (fun q : E ↦ D.testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn j φ q) y -
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ r
          (fun q : E ↦ D.includedTestFunctionSupportedIn φ q) y‖ ≤ ε / 2
    rw [D.iteratedFDeriv_testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn j φ r,
      D.iteratedFDeriv_includedTestFunctionSupportedIn φ r]
    rw [← dist_eq_norm]
    apply MeasureTheory.dist_convolution_le (half_pos hε).le hj
      (D.kernel_nonneg j) (D.kernel_integral_one j)
      hguc.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    intro q hq
    exact (hgδ (by simpa only [mem_ball] using hq)).le
  exact hnorm.trans_lt (half_lt_self hε)

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.tendsto_testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.tendsto_testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (φ : 𝓓(D.inner, ℝ)) :
    Tendsto
      (fun j : ℕ ↦ D.testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn j φ)
      atTop (𝓝 (D.includedTestFunctionSupportedIn φ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [(ContDiffMapSupportedIn.isUniformEmbedding_pi_structureMapCLM
    (𝕜 := ℝ)).isInducing.tendsto_nhds_iff, tendsto_pi_nhds]
  intro r
  change Tendsto
    (fun j : ℕ ↦ ContDiffMapSupportedIn.structureMapCLM ℝ ⊤ r
      (D.testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn j φ))
    atTop
    (𝓝 (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.structureMapCLM ℝ ⊤ r
      (D.includedTestFunctionSupportedIn φ)))
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ :=
    (eventually_atTop.mp (D.eventually_structureMapCLM_dist_lt φ r hε))
  refine ⟨N, fun j hj ↦ ?_⟩
  exact (dist_eq_norm
    (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.structureMapCLM ℝ ⊤ r
      (D.testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn j φ))
    (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.structureMapCLM ℝ ⊤ r
      (D.includedTestFunctionSupportedIn φ))).symm ▸ hN j hj

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.tendsto_ofSupportedIn_testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.tendsto_ofSupportedIn_testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (φ : 𝓓(D.inner, ℝ)) :
    Tendsto
      (fun j : ℕ ↦ TestFunction.ofSupportedIn D.compact_subset
        (D.testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn j φ))
      atTop
      (𝓝 (TestFunction.monoCLM ℝ φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have htarget :
      TestFunction.ofSupportedIn D.compact_subset
          (D.includedTestFunctionSupportedIn φ) =
        (TestFunction.monoCLM ℝ φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) := by
    ext y
    exact congrFun (D.includedTestFunctionSupportedIn_eq_monoCLM φ) y
  rw [← htarget]
  exact (TestFunction.continuous_ofSupportedIn D.compact_subset).continuousAt.tendsto.comp
    (D.tendsto_testFunctionRadialConvolutionSupportedIn φ)

name: PshLines.Regularization.exists_open_closure_closedBall_neighborhood
statement:
theorem exists_open_closure_closedBall_neighborhood
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {Ω : Opens E} {x : E} (hx : x ∈ Ω) :
    ∃ R > 0, ∃ U : Opens E, ∃ K : Compacts E,
      x ∈ U ∧ U ≤ Ω ∧ (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω ∧
        ∀ z ∈ closure (U : Set E), closedBall z R ⊆ K
proof:
:= by
  let _ : ProperSpace E := FiniteDimensional.proper ℝ E
  obtain ⟨R, hR, V, K, hVo, hxV, hVK, hKc, hKΩ, hball⟩ :=
    exists_open_compact_closedBall_neighborhood
      (S := ({x} : Set E)) isCompact_singleton Ω.isOpen (by simpa using hx)
  obtain ⟨U, hUo, hxU, hUV⟩ :=
    normal_exists_closure_subset isClosed_singleton hVo hxV
  let Uo : Opens E := ⟨U, hUo⟩
  let Kc : Compacts E := ⟨K, hKc⟩
  refine ⟨R, hR, Uo, Kc, ?_, ?_, hKΩ, ?_⟩
  · exact hxU (mem_singleton x)
  · exact subset_closure.trans (hUV.trans (hVK.trans hKΩ))
  · intro z hz
    exact hball z (hUV hz)

name: PshLines.Regularization.exists_open_closure_coordinateBall_neighborhood
statement:
theorem exists_open_closure_coordinateBall_neighborhood
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (A : E ≃L[ℝ] F) {Ω : Opens E} {x : E} (hx : x ∈ Ω) :
    ∃ R > 0, ∃ U : Opens E, ∃ K : Compacts E,
      x ∈ U ∧ U ≤ Ω ∧ (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω ∧
        ∀ z ∈ closure (U : Set E), ∀ y : E,
          ‖A (y - z)‖ ≤ R → y ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, U, K, hxU, hUΩ, hKΩ, hball⟩ :=
    exists_open_closure_closedBall_neighborhood hx
  let M : ℝ := max ‖A.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ 1
  have hM : 0 < M := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right _ _)
  let R : ℝ := r / M
  have hR : 0 < R := div_pos hr hM
  refine ⟨R, hR, U, K, hxU, hUΩ, hKΩ, ?_⟩
  intro z hz y hy
  apply hball z hz
  rw [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
  calc
    ‖y - z‖ = ‖A.symm (A (y - z))‖ := by rw [A.symm_apply_apply]
    _ ≤ ‖A.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * ‖A (y - z)‖ :=
      A.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _
    _ ≤ M * R := mul_le_mul (le_max_left _ _) hy (norm_nonneg _) hM.le
    _ = r := by
      dsimp [R]
      exact mul_div_cancel₀ r hM.ne'

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonOrigin.radialWeightedCumulative_eq_const_mul_pow
statement:
theorem radialWeightedCumulative_eq_const_mul_pow
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {g : ℝ → ℝ} {c δ s : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hs : s < δ) (hg : ∀ t, t < δ → g t = c) :
    radialWeightedCumulative n g s = c * s ^ n / (n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : max 0 s < δ := max_lt hδ hs
  unfold radialWeightedCumulative
  calc
    (∫ t in 0..s, t ^ (n - 1) * g t) =
        ∫ t in 0..s, c * t ^ (n - 1) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro t ht
      have htδ : t < δ :=
        ht.2.trans_lt hmax
      change t ^ (n - 1) * g t = c * t ^ (n - 1)
      rw [hg t htδ]
      ring
    _ = c * ∫ t in 0..s, t ^ (n - 1) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    _ = c * s ^ n / (n : ℝ) := by
      rw [integral_pow]
      have hn' : n - 1 + 1 = n := by omega
      rw [hn']
      have hncast : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = n := by
        exact_mod_cast hn'
      rw [hncast, zero_pow hn.ne']
      ring

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonOrigin.radialPoissonSlope_eq_const_div
statement:
theorem radialPoissonSlope_eq_const_div
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {g : ℝ → ℝ} {c δ s : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hs : s < δ) (hs0 : s ≠ 0)
    (hg : ∀ t, t < δ → g t = c) :
    radialPoissonSlope n g s = c / (4 * (n : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [radialPoissonSlope,
    radialWeightedCumulative_eq_const_mul_pow hn hδ hs hg]
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn.ne'
  have hsn : s ^ n ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero n hs0
  field_simp

statement:

    {n : ℕ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {c s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0) :

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonOrigin.radialPoissonSlopeExtension_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem radialPoissonSlopeExtension_zero
    (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    radialPoissonSlopeExtension n g c 0 = c / (4 * (n : ℝ))

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonOrigin.radialPoissonSlopeExtension_eq_const_div
statement:
theorem radialPoissonSlopeExtension_eq_const_div
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {g : ℝ → ℝ} {c δ s : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hs : s < δ)
    (hg : ∀ t, t < δ → g t = c) :
    radialPoissonSlopeExtension n g c s = c / (4 * (n : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs0 : s = 0
  · subst s
    simp
  · rw [radialPoissonSlopeExtension_eq_of_ne hs0,
      radialPoissonSlope_eq_const_div hn hδ hs hs0 hg]

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonOrigin.radialWeightedCumulative_contDiff
statement:
theorem radialWeightedCumulative_contDiff
    {n : ℕ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (radialWeightedCumulative n g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_infty_iff_deriv]
  constructor
  · intro s
    exact (radialWeightedCumulative_hasDerivAt hg.continuous s).differentiableAt
  · have hderiv : deriv (radialWeightedCumulative n g) =
        fun s => s ^ (n - 1) * g s := by
      funext s
      exact (radialWeightedCumulative_hasDerivAt hg.continuous s).deriv
    rw [hderiv]
    exact (contDiff_id.pow _).mul hg

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonOrigin.radialPoissonSlopeExtension_contDiff
statement:
theorem radialPoissonSlopeExtension_contDiff
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g) {c δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hconst : ∀ s, s < δ → g s = c) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (radialPoissonSlopeExtension n g c)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
      (radialPoissonSlopeExtension n g c) (Iio δ) := by
    apply contDiff_const.contDiffOn.congr
    intro s hs
    exact (radialPoissonSlopeExtension_eq_const_div
      hn hδ hs hconst)
  have hright : ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
      (radialPoissonSlopeExtension n g c) (Ioi 0) := by
    have hnum : ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
        (radialWeightedCumulative n g) (Ioi 0) :=
      (radialWeightedCumulative_contDiff (n := n) hg).contDiffOn
    have hden : ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
        (fun s : ℝ => 4 * s ^ n) (Ioi 0) :=
      (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_id.pow n)).contDiffOn
    have hquot : ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
        (fun s : ℝ => radialWeightedCumulative n g s / (4 * s ^ n))
        (Ioi 0) :=
      hnum.div hden fun s hs =>
        mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero n hs.ne')
    apply hquot.congr
    intro s hs
    have hspos : 0 < s := hs
    have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := hspos.ne'
    simp [radialPoissonSlopeExtension, radialPoissonSlope, hs0]
  apply contDiff_of_contDiffOn_union_of_isOpen hleft hright
  · apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro s
    by_cases hs : s < δ
    · exact Or.inl hs
    · exact Or.inr (hδ.trans_le (le_of_not_gt hs))
  · exact isOpen_Iio
  · exact isOpen_Ioi

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonOrigin.integral_radialPoissonSlope_eq_extension
statement:
theorem integral_radialPoissonSlope_eq_extension
    (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (c A s : ℝ) :
    (∫ t in A..s, radialPoissonSlope n g t) =
      ∫ t in A..s, radialPoissonSlopeExtension n g c t
proof:
:= by
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [volume.ae_ne (0 : ℝ)] with t ht0
  intro _ht
  exact (radialPoissonSlopeExtension_eq_of_ne ht0).symm

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonOrigin.radialPoissonPrimitive_eq_affine_of_lt
statement:
theorem radialPoissonPrimitive_eq_affine_of_lt
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g) {c δ A s : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hs : s < δ) (hconst : ∀ t, t < δ → g t = c) :
    radialPoissonPrimitive n g A s =
      radialPoissonPrimitive n g A 0 + c / (4 * (n : ℝ)) * s
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := radialPoissonSlopeExtension n g c
  have hqcont : Continuous q :=
    (radialPoissonSlopeExtension_contDiff hn hg hδ hconst).continuous
  have hA0 : IntervalIntegrable q volume A 0 :=
    hqcont.intervalIntegrable A 0
  have h0s : IntervalIntegrable q volume 0 s :=
    hqcont.intervalIntegrable 0 s
  have hsplit := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hA0 h0s
  calc
    radialPoissonPrimitive n g A s = ∫ t in A..s, q t := by
      rw [radialPoissonPrimitive]
      exact integral_radialPoissonSlope_eq_extension n g c A s
    _ = (∫ t in A..0, q t) + ∫ t in 0..s, q t := hsplit.symm
    _ = radialPoissonPrimitive n g A 0 +
        ∫ _t in 0..s, c / (4 * (n : ℝ)) := by
      congr 1
      · rw [radialPoissonPrimitive]
        exact (integral_radialPoissonSlope_eq_extension n g c A 0).symm
      · apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro t ht
        have htδ : t < δ :=
          ht.2.trans_lt (max_lt hδ hs)
        exact radialPoissonSlopeExtension_eq_const_div hn hδ htδ hconst
    _ = radialPoissonPrimitive n g A 0 +
        c / (4 * (n : ℝ)) * s := by
      simp [intervalIntegral.integral_const]
      ring

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonOrigin.radialPoissonPrimitive_contDiff_of_eq_const_below
statement:
theorem radialPoissonPrimitive_contDiff_of_eq_const_below
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g) {c δ A : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hconst : ∀ s, s < δ → g s = c) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (radialPoissonPrimitive n g A)
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := radialPoissonSlopeExtension n g c
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ∫ t in A..s, q t
  have hq : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) q :=
    radialPoissonSlopeExtension_contDiff hn hg hδ hconst
  have hFderiv : ∀ s, HasDerivAt F (q s) s := by
    intro s
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
      (hq.continuous.intervalIntegrable A s)
      hq.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter
      hq.continuous.continuousAt
  have hFsmooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) F := by
    rw [contDiff_infty_iff_deriv]
    constructor
    · exact fun s => (hFderiv s).differentiableAt
    · have hderiv : deriv F = q := by
        funext s
        exact (hFderiv s).deriv
      rw [hderiv]
      exact hq
  have heq : radialPoissonPrimitive n g A = F := by
    funext s
    rw [radialPoissonPrimitive]
    exact integral_radialPoissonSlope_eq_extension n g c A s
  rw [heq]
  exact hFsmooth

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonOrigin.explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_origin_of_lt_min_rIn_sq
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_origin_of_lt_min_rIn_sq
    {n : ℕ} (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : s < min
      ((shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR a).rIn ^ 2)
      ((shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR b).rIn ^ 2)) :
    explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b s =
      explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsa : s < (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR a).rIn ^ 2 :=
    hs.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hsb : s < (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR b).rIn ^ 2 :=
    hs.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have h0a : (0 : ℝ) <
      (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR a).rIn ^ 2 := by
    exact sq_pos_of_pos
      (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR a).rIn_pos
  have h0b : (0 : ℝ) <
      (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR b).rIn ^ 2 := by
    exact sq_pos_of_pos
      (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR b).rIn_pos
  rw [explicitRadialKernelSqDifference,
    explicitRadialKernelSqDifference,
    explicitRadialKernelSqProfile,
    explicitRadialKernelSqProfile,
    explicitRadialKernelSqProfile,
    explicitRadialKernelSqProfile,
    explicitRadialRawSqProfile_eq_one_of_lt_sq_rIn R hR a hsa,
    explicitRadialRawSqProfile_eq_one_of_lt_sq_rIn R hR b hsb,
    explicitRadialRawSqProfile_eq_one_of_lt_sq_rIn R hR a h0a,
    explicitRadialRawSqProfile_eq_one_of_lt_sq_rIn R hR b h0b]

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonOrigin.radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_affine
statement:
theorem radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_affine
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (a b : ℕ) (A : ℝ) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : s < min
      ((shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR a).rIn ^ 2)
      ((shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR b).rIn ^ 2)) :
    radialPoissonPrimitive n
        (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b) A s =
      radialPoissonPrimitive n
          (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b) A 0 +
        explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b 0 /
          (4 * (n : ℝ)) * s
proof:
:= by
  apply radialPoissonPrimitive_eq_affine_of_lt
    (c := explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b 0)
    hn (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_contDiff R hR a b)
  · exact lt_min
      (sq_pos_of_pos
        (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR a).rIn_pos)
      (sq_pos_of_pos
        (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR b).rIn_pos)
  · exact hs
  · intro t ht
    exact explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_origin_of_lt_min_rIn_sq
      R hR a b ht

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonOrigin.radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_contDiff
statement:
theorem radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_contDiff
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (a b : ℕ) (A : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
      (radialPoissonPrimitive n
        (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b) A)
proof:
:= by
  let δ : ℝ := min
    ((shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR a).rIn ^ 2)
    ((shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR b).rIn ^ 2)
  let g : ℝ → ℝ :=
    explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by
    dsimp [δ]
    exact lt_min
      (sq_pos_of_pos
        (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR a).rIn_pos)
      (sq_pos_of_pos
        (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR b).rIn_pos)
  apply radialPoissonPrimitive_contDiff_of_eq_const_below
    hn (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_contDiff R hR a b) hδ
  intro s hs
  exact explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_origin_of_lt_min_rIn_sq
    R hR a b hs

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonOrigin.radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_contDiffAt_zero
statement:
theorem radialPoissonPrimitive_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_contDiffAt_zero

name: PshLines.Regularization.distributionCutoffTranslatedPairingFDeriv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem distributionCutoffTranslatedPairingFDeriv_apply
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω) (z v : E) :
    distributionCutoffTranslatedPairingFDeriv
        T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ z v =
      distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ
        (translationDirectionalKernel κ v)
        (translationDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ v) K hχK hKΩ z
proof:
:= by
  change distributionOnSupportedInCLM T K hKΩ
      (cutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetLM χ κ hκ K hχK z v) =
    distributionOnSupportedInCLM T K hKΩ
      (cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ
        (translationDirectionalKernel κ v)
        (translationDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ v) K hχK z)
  congr 1
  ext y
  simp only [cutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetLM_apply,
    cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn_apply,
    cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn_apply, translationDirectionalKernel,
    iteratedFDeriv_one_apply]

    HasFDerivAt

      (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairingFDeriv

name: PshLines.Regularization.distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_contDiff_nat
statement:
private theorem distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_contDiff_nat
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (κ : E → ℝ) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ),
      ContDiff ℝ n
        (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro κ hκ
      change ContDiff ℝ 0
        (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ)
      rw [contDiff_zero]
      exact (show Differentiable ℝ
          (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ) from
        fun z ↦ (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_hasFDerivAt
          T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ z).differentiableAt).continuous
  | succ n ih =>
      intro κ hκ
      change ContDiff ℝ ((n : ℕ∞ω) + 1)
        (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ)
      rw [contDiff_succ_iff_hasFDerivAt]
      refine ⟨distributionCutoffTranslatedPairingFDeriv
        T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ, ?_, fun z ↦
          distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_hasFDerivAt
            T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ z⟩
      apply contDiff_clm_apply_iff.mpr
      intro v
      have hv := ih (translationDirectionalKernel κ v)
        (translationDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ v)
      have heq :
          (fun z ↦ distributionCutoffTranslatedPairingFDeriv
              T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ z v) =
            distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ
              (translationDirectionalKernel κ v)
              (translationDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ v)
              K hχK hKΩ := by
        funext z
        exact distributionCutoffTranslatedPairingFDeriv_apply
          T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ z v
      rw [heq]
      exact hv

theorem distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_contDiff

    {Ω : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)

name: PshLines.Regularization.fderiv_distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_apply
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω) (z v : E) :
    fderiv ℝ
        (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ) z v =
      distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ
        (translationDirectionalKernel κ v)
        (translationDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ v) K hχK hKΩ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [(distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_hasFDerivAt
    T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ z).fderiv]
  exact distributionCutoffTranslatedPairingFDeriv_apply
    T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ z v

name: PshLines.Regularization.realHessianDirectionalKernel_contDiff
statement:
theorem realHessianDirectionalKernel_contDiff
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (κ : E → ℝ) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (v : E) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (realHessianDirectionalKernel κ v)
proof:
:= by
  have hiter : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 κ) :=
    hκ.iteratedFDeriv_right (by
      change ((↑((⊤ : ℕ∞) + 2) : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ↑(⊤ : ℕ∞))
      exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (by simp))
  exact (continuousMultilinearApplyCLM ![v, v]).contDiff.comp hiter

name: PshLines.Regularization.translationDirectionalKernel_twice_self
statement:
theorem translationDirectionalKernel_twice_self
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (κ : E → ℝ) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (v x : E) :
    translationDirectionalKernel (translationDirectionalKernel κ v) v x =
      realHessianDirectionalKernel κ v x
proof:
:= by
  change fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ κ y (-v)) x (-v) =
    realHessian κ x v v
  have hneg : (fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ κ y (-v)) =
      -(fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ κ y v) := by
    funext y
    simp
  rw [hneg, fderiv_neg]
  rw [map_neg]
  rw [realHessian_eq_fderiv]
  have hDcont : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ κ) :=
    hκ.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by
      change ((↑((1 : ℕ∞) + 1) : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ↑(⊤ : ℕ∞))
      exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (by simp))
  have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ κ) x :=
    (hDcont.differentiable one_ne_zero).differentiableAt
  rw [fderiv_clm_apply hD (differentiableAt_const v)]
  simp

name: PshLines.Regularization.realHessian_distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_self
statement:
theorem realHessian_distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_self
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω) (z v : E) :
    realHessian
        (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ) z v v =
      distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ
        (realHessianDirectionalKernel κ v)
        (realHessianDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ v)
        K hχK hKΩ z
proof:
:= by
  let F : E → ℝ :=
    distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ
  let DF : E → E →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    distributionCutoffTranslatedPairingFDeriv T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ
  have hFderiv : fderiv ℝ F = DF := by
    funext q
    exact (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_hasFDerivAt
      T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ q).fderiv
  have hDFsmooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) DF := by
    rw [← hFderiv]
    exact (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_contDiff
      T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ).fderiv_right (by simp)
  have happly :
      fderiv ℝ (fun q ↦ DF q v) z v =
        distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ
          (realHessianDirectionalKernel κ v)
          (realHessianDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ v)
          K hχK hKΩ z := by
    have heq : (fun q ↦ DF q v) =
        distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ
          (translationDirectionalKernel κ v)
          (translationDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ v)
          K hχK hKΩ := by
      funext q
      exact distributionCutoffTranslatedPairingFDeriv_apply
        T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ q v
    rw [heq, fderiv_distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_apply]
    have hkernel :
        translationDirectionalKernel (translationDirectionalKernel κ v) v =
          realHessianDirectionalKernel κ v := by
      funext q
      exact translationDirectionalKernel_twice_self κ hκ v q
    exact congrFun (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_congr_kernel
      T χ
      (translationDirectionalKernel_contDiff (translationDirectionalKernel κ v)
        (translationDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ v) v)
      (realHessianDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ v)
      K hχK hKΩ hkernel) z
  have hclmapply :
      fderiv ℝ (fun q ↦ DF q v) z v = fderiv ℝ DF z v v := by
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hDFsmooth.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
      (differentiableAt_const v)]
    simp
  rw [realHessian_eq_fderiv, hFderiv, ← hclmapply]
  exact happly

name: PshLines.Regularization.leviForm_distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing
statement:
theorem leviForm_distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedSpace ℂ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω) (z v : E) :
    leviForm
        (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ) z v =
      (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ
          (realHessianDirectionalKernel κ v)
          (realHessianDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ v)
          K hχK hKΩ z +
        distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ
          (realHessianDirectionalKernel κ (Complex.I • v))
          (realHessianDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ (Complex.I • v))
          K hχK hKΩ z) / 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [leviForm,
    realHessian_distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_self,
    realHessian_distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_self]

name: PshLines.Regularization.distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_realHessian_eq_lineDeriv
statement:
theorem distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_realHessian_eq_lineDeriv
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω)
    (z w : E)
    (hcut : ∀ y ∈ tsupport (fun q : E ↦ κ (q - z)), χ y = 1) :
    distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ
        (realHessianDirectionalKernel κ w)
        (realHessianDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ w)
        K hχK hKΩ z =
      T (TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ w
        (TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ w
          (TestFunction.ofSupportedIn hKΩ
            (cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z))))
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun q : E ↦ χ q * κ (q - z)) =
      fun q : E ↦ κ (q - z) := by
    funext q
    by_cases hq : q ∈ tsupport (fun y : E ↦ κ (y - z))
    · rw [hcut q hq, one_mul]
    · rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hq, mul_zero]
  change T (TestFunction.ofSupportedIn hKΩ
      (cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ
        (realHessianDirectionalKernel κ w)
        (realHessianDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ w) K hχK z)) = _
  congr 1
  ext y
  rw [testFunction_lineDerivCLM_lineDerivCLM_apply]
  change χ y * realHessian κ (y - z) w w =
    realHessian (fun q : E ↦ χ q * κ (q - z)) y w w
  rw [hfun, realHessian_comp_sub]
  by_cases hh : realHessian κ (y - z) w w = 0
  · rw [hh, mul_zero]
  · have hy : y ∈ tsupport (fun q : E ↦ κ (q - z)) := by
      apply tsupport_realHessian_subset (fun q : E ↦ κ (q - z)) w w
      apply subset_tsupport
      change realHessian (fun q : E ↦ κ (q - z)) y w w ≠ 0
      rw [realHessian_comp_sub]
      exact hh
    rw [hcut y hy, one_mul]

name: PshLines.Regularization.leviForm_distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_eq_distributionalLevi
statement:
theorem leviForm_distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_eq_distributionalLevi
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedSpace ℂ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω)
    (z v : E)
    (hcut : ∀ y ∈ tsupport (fun q : E ↦ κ (q - z)), χ y = 1) :
    leviForm
        (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ) z v =
      distributionalLeviCLM v T
        (TestFunction.ofSupportedIn hKΩ
          (cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [leviForm_distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing,
    distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_realHessian_eq_lineDeriv
      T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ z v hcut,
    distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_realHessian_eq_lineDeriv
      T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ z (Complex.I • v) hcut,
    distributionalLeviCLM_apply]
  ring

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.distributionRegularizedValue_contDiff
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.distributionRegularizedValue_contDiff
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (j : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (D.distributionRegularizedValue T j)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : D.distributionRegularizedValue T j =
      distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T D.cutoff (D.kernel j)
        (D.kernel_contDiff j) D.cutoffCompact (by rfl)
        D.cutoffCompact_subset := by
    funext z
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_contDiff T D.cutoff (D.kernel j)
    (D.kernel_contDiff j) D.cutoffCompact (by rfl)
    D.cutoffCompact_subset

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.translatedKernel_tsupport_subset_compact_for_smoothing
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.translatedKernel_tsupport_subset_compact_for_smoothing
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (j : ℕ) {z : E}
    (hz : z ∈ closure (D.inner : Set E)) :
    tsupport (fun y : E ↦ D.kernel j (y - z)) ⊆ D.compact
proof:
:= by
  apply closure_minimal
  · intro y hy
    have hyKernel : y - z ∈ tsupport (D.kernel j) :=
      subset_tsupport (D.kernel j) hy
    have hcoord := D.kernel_tsupport_subset j hyKernel
    have hscale : D.radius / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≤ D.radius := by
      have hj : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) + 1 := by norm_num
      exact div_le_self D.radius_pos.le hj
    exact D.coordinate_buffer z hz y (hcoord.trans hscale)
  · exact D.compact.isCompact.isClosed

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.leviForm_distributionRegularizedValue_eq
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.leviForm_distributionRegularizedValue_eq
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (j : ℕ)
    {z : E} (hz : z ∈ closure (D.inner : Set E)) (v : E) :
    leviForm (D.distributionRegularizedValue T j) z v =
      distributionalLeviCLM v T
        (TestFunction.ofSupportedIn D.cutoffCompact_subset
          (D.localizedKernelSupportedIn j z))
proof:
:= by
  have hcut : ∀ y ∈ tsupport (fun q : E ↦ D.kernel j (q - z)),
      D.cutoff y = 1 := by
    intro y hy
    exact D.cutoff_one_on_compact y
      (D.translatedKernel_tsupport_subset_compact_for_smoothing j hz hy)
  have heq : D.distributionRegularizedValue T j =
      distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T D.cutoff (D.kernel j)
        (D.kernel_contDiff j) D.cutoffCompact (by rfl)
        D.cutoffCompact_subset := by
    funext q
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  simpa only [AdaptedRadialKernelData.localizedKernelSupportedIn] using
    leviForm_distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing_eq_distributionalLevi T
      D.cutoff (D.kernel j) (D.kernel_contDiff j) D.cutoffCompact
      (by rfl) D.cutoffCompact_subset z v hcut

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.leviForm_distributionRegularizedValue_nonneg
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.leviForm_distributionRegularizedValue_nonneg
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ))
    (hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi T) (j : ℕ)
    {z : E} (hz : z ∈ closure (D.inner : Set E)) (v : E) :
    0 ≤ leviForm (D.distributionRegularizedValue T j) z v
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.leviForm_distributionRegularizedValue_eq T j hz v]
  apply hT v
  intro y
  change 0 ≤ D.cutoff y * D.kernel j (y - z)
  exact mul_nonneg (D.cutoff_mem_Icc y).1 (D.kernel_nonneg j (y - z))

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.discPshOn_distributionRegularizedValue
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.discPshOn_distributionRegularizedValue
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ))
    (hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi T) (j : ℕ) :
    DiscPshOn (fun z : E ↦ (D.distributionRegularizedValue T j z : EReal))
      (D.inner : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  apply discPshOn_of_levi_nonneg
    ((D.distributionRegularizedValue_contDiff T j).of_le (by
      exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (by simp)))
  intro z hz v
  exact D.leviForm_distributionRegularizedValue_nonneg T hT j
    (subset_closure hz) v

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonCertificate.finrank_real_complexModel
statement:
theorem finrank_real_complexModel (n : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (ComplexModel n) = 2 * n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℝ ℂ (ComplexModel n),
    Complex.finrank_real_complex, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonCertificate.explicitRadialRaw_eq_sqProfile_norm_sq
statement:
theorem explicitRadialRaw_eq_sqProfile_norm_sq
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) (x : ComplexModel n) :
    explicitRadialRaw R hR j x =
      explicitRadialRawSqProfile (n := n) R hR j (‖x‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [explicitRadialRaw, explicitRadialRawSqProfile,
    ContDiffBumpBase.ofInnerProductSpace, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn_pos,
    Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg x), div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonCertificate.explicitRadialKernel_eq_sqProfile_norm_sq
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernel_eq_sqProfile_norm_sq
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) (x : ComplexModel n) :
    explicitRadialKernel R hR j x =
      explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR j (‖x‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [explicitRadialKernel, explicitRadialKernelSqProfile,
    explicitRadialRaw_eq_sqProfile_norm_sq]

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonCertificate.explicitRadialRawSqProfile_eq_one_of_lt_sq_rIn
statement:
theorem explicitRadialRawSqProfile_eq_one_of_lt_sq_rIn
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : s <
      (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn ^ 2) :
    explicitRadialRawSqProfile (n := n) R hR j s = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [explicitRadialRawSqProfile]
  apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
  norm_num
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt s <
      (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn :=
    (Real.sqrt_lt'
      (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn_pos).2 hs
  have hdiv : Real.sqrt s /
      (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn ≤ 1 :=
    ((div_lt_one
      (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn_pos).2 hsqrt).le
  linarith

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonCertificate.explicitRadialRawSqProfile_contDiff
statement:
theorem explicitRadialRawSqProfile_contDiff
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
      (explicitRadialRawSqProfile (n := n) R hR j)
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℝ := (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn
  have hr : 0 < r :=
    (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn_pos
  have hleft : ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
      (explicitRadialRawSqProfile (n := n) R hR j) (Iio (r ^ 2)) := by
    apply contDiff_const.contDiffOn.congr
    intro s hs
    exact explicitRadialRawSqProfile_eq_one_of_lt_sq_rIn R hR j hs
  have hsqrt : ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Real.sqrt (Ioi 0) :=
    contDiff_id.contDiffOn.sqrt (fun s hs => ne_of_gt hs)
  have hright : ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
      (explicitRadialRawSqProfile (n := n) R hR j) (Ioi 0) := by
    rw [show explicitRadialRawSqProfile (n := n) R hR j =
        fun s => Real.smoothTransition
          ((2 - Real.sqrt s / r) / (2 - 1)) by
      funext s
      rfl]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn
      ((contDiff_const.contDiffOn.sub (hsqrt.div_const r)).div_const (2 - 1))
  apply contDiff_of_contDiffOn_union_of_isOpen hleft hright
  · apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro s
    by_cases hs : s < r ^ 2
    · exact Or.inl hs
    · exact Or.inr (lt_of_lt_of_le (sq_pos_of_pos hr) (le_of_not_gt hs))
  · exact isOpen_Iio
  · exact isOpen_Ioi

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonCertificate.explicitRadialKernelSqProfile_contDiff
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernelSqProfile_contDiff
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
      (explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR j)
proof:
:=
  (explicitRadialRawSqProfile_contDiff R hR j).div_const _

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonCertificate.explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_contDiff
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_contDiff
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ) :

      (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b)

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonCertificate.explicitRadialKernel_sub_eq_sqDifference_norm_sq
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernel_sub_eq_sqDifference_norm_sq
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ) (x : ComplexModel n) :
    explicitRadialKernel R hR a x - explicitRadialKernel R hR b x =
      explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b (‖x‖ ^ 2)

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonCertificate.explicitRadialRawSqProfile_eq_zero_of_sq_rOut_le
statement:
theorem explicitRadialRawSqProfile_eq_zero_of_sq_rOut_le
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : (R / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ s) :
    explicitRadialRawSqProfile (n := n) R hR j s = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [explicitRadialRawSqProfile, Real.smoothTransition.zero_iff_nonpos]
  norm_num
  have hrOut : 0 < R / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  have hsqrt : R / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≤ Real.sqrt s :=
    (Real.le_sqrt' hrOut).2 hs
  have hratio := shrinkingBump_radius_ratio (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j
  have htwo : 2 * (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn ≤
      Real.sqrt s := by
    rw [← hratio]
    exact hsqrt
  have hdiv : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt s /
      (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn :=
    (le_div_iff₀
      (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j).rIn_pos).2 htwo
  linarith

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonCertificate.explicitRadialKernelSqProfile_eq_zero_of_sq_rOut_le
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernelSqProfile_eq_zero_of_sq_rOut_le
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : (R / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ s) :
    explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR j s = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [explicitRadialKernelSqProfile,
    explicitRadialRawSqProfile_eq_zero_of_sq_rOut_le R hR j hs,
    zero_div]

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonCertificate.explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_zero_of_sq_rOut_le
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_eq_zero_of_sq_rOut_le
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : (R / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ s) :
    explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b s = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hden : (a : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (b : ℝ) + 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right hab 1
  have hrad : R / ((b : ℝ) + 1) ≤ R / ((a : ℝ) + 1) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hR.le (by positivity) hden
  have hsq : (R / ((b : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 ≤
      (R / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).2 hrad
  rw [explicitRadialKernelSqDifference,
    explicitRadialKernelSqProfile_eq_zero_of_sq_rOut_le R hR a hs,
    explicitRadialKernelSqProfile_eq_zero_of_sq_rOut_le R hR b (hsq.trans hs),
    sub_self]

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonCertificate.radialWeightedCumulative_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem radialWeightedCumulative_hasDerivAt
    {n : ℕ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) (s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (radialWeightedCumulative n g)
      (s ^ (n - 1) * g s) s
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (n - 1) * g t) :=
    (continuous_id.pow _).mul hg
  unfold radialWeightedCumulative
  convert intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
      (hcont.intervalIntegrable 0 s)
      hcont.aestronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter
      hcont.continuousAt using 1

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonCertificate.radialWeightedCumulative_continuous
statement:
theorem radialWeightedCumulative_continuous
    {n : ℕ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) :
    Continuous (radialWeightedCumulative n g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro s
  exact (radialWeightedCumulative_hasDerivAt hg s).continuousAt

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialPoissonCertificate.radialWeightedCumulative_contDiff_one
statement:
theorem radialWeightedCumulative_contDiff_one
    {n : ℕ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (radialWeightedCumulative n g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_one_iff_deriv]
  constructor
  · exact fun s => (radialWeightedCumulative_hasDerivAt hg s).differentiableAt
  · have hderiv : deriv (radialWeightedCumulative n g) =
        fun s => s ^ (n - 1) * g s := by
      funext s
      exact (radialWeightedCumulative_hasDerivAt hg s).deriv
    rw [hderiv]
    exact (continuous_id.pow _).mul hg

  radialWeightedCumulative_contDiff_one hg.continuous

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.eventually_kernel_support_subset_ball
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.eventually_kernel_support_subset_ball
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, Function.support (D.kernel j) ⊆ ball 0 δ
proof:
:= by
  let A := adaptedComplexModelEquiv (E := E)
  have hradius : Tendsto
      (fun j : ℕ ↦ ‖A.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ *
        (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel (Module.finrank ℂ E))
          D.radius D.radius_pos j).rOut)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul
        (tendsto_shrinkingBump_rOut
          (E := ComplexModel (Module.finrank ℂ E)) D.radius D.radius_pos))
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
      ‖A.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ *
          (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel (Module.finrank ℂ E))
            D.radius D.radius_pos j).rOut < δ :=
    (tendsto_order.mp hradius).2 δ hδ
  filter_upwards [hevent] with j hj
  intro y hy
  rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
  have hcoord : ‖A y‖ ≤ D.radius / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by
    exact D.kernel_tsupport_subset j (subset_tsupport (D.kernel j) hy)
  calc
    ‖y‖ = ‖A.symm (A y)‖ := by rw [A.symm_apply_apply]
    _ ≤ ‖A.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * ‖A y‖ :=
      A.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _
    _ ≤ ‖A.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ *
        (D.radius / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcoord (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = ‖A.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ *
        (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel (Module.finrank ℂ E))
          D.radius D.radius_pos j).rOut := rfl
    _ < δ := hj

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.testFunctionRadialConvolution_support_subset
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.testFunctionRadialConvolution_support_subset
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (j : ℕ) (φ : 𝓓(D.inner, ℝ)) :
    Function.support (D.testFunctionRadialConvolution j φ) ⊆ D.compact
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hyadd : y ∈ Function.support (fun z : E ↦ φ z) +
      Function.support (D.kernel j) :=
    MeasureTheory.support_convolution_subset
      (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) hy
  rcases hyadd with ⟨z, hz, w, hw, rfl⟩
  have hzinner : z ∈ closure (D.inner : Set E) :=
    subset_closure (φ.tsupport_subset (subset_tsupport _ hz))
  have hcoord : ‖adaptedComplexModelEquiv w‖ ≤ D.radius := by
    refine (D.kernel_tsupport_subset j (subset_tsupport _ hw)).trans ?_
    have hj : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) + 1 := by norm_num
    exact div_le_self D.radius_pos.le hj
  exact D.coordinate_buffer z hzinner (z + w) (by simpa using hcoord)

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.testFunctionRadialConvolution_contDiff
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.testFunctionRadialConvolution_contDiff

proof:
:=
  (D.kernel_hasCompactSupport j).contDiff_convolution_right
