name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.translated_tsupport_subset_compact
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.translated_tsupport_subset_compact
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) {a : ℕ} {ψ : E → ℝ}
    (hψ : tsupport ψ ⊆ adaptedComplexModelEquiv ⁻¹'
      closedBall 0 (D.radius / ((a : ℝ) + 1)))
    {z : E} (hz : z ∈ closure (D.inner : Set E)) :
    tsupport (fun y : E ↦ ψ (y - z)) ⊆ D.compact
proof:
:= by
  apply closure_minimal
  · intro y hy
    have hyψ : y - z ∈ tsupport ψ :=
      subset_tsupport ψ hy
    have hcoord :
        ‖adaptedComplexModelEquiv (y - z)‖ ≤
          D.radius / ((a : ℝ) + 1) := by
      simpa only [mem_preimage, mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hψ hyψ
    have hscale : D.radius / ((a : ℝ) + 1) ≤ D.radius := by
      have ha : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (a : ℝ) + 1 := by norm_num
      exact div_le_self D.radius_pos.le ha
    exact D.coordinate_buffer z hz y (hcoord.trans hscale)
  · exact D.compact.isCompact.isClosed

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.exists_nonnegative_testFunction_value_sub_eq
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.exists_nonnegative_testFunction_value_sub_eq
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ))
    (hn : 0 < Module.finrank ℂ E) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    {z : E} (hz : z ∈ closure (D.inner : Set E)) :
    ∃ φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ), (∀ y, 0 ≤ φ y) ∧
      D.distributionRegularizedValue T a z -
          D.distributionRegularizedValue T b z =
        4 * ∑ j : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ E),
          distributionalLeviCLM
            (adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j) T φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ, _hψradial, hψsmooth, hψnonneg, hψcompact,
      hψsupport, hψtrace⟩ :=
    exists_adaptedRadialScaleDifferenceLeviPreimage
      μ hn D.radius D.radius_pos hab
  have hψK : tsupport (fun y : E ↦ ψ (y - z)) ⊆ D.compact :=
    D.translated_tsupport_subset_compact hψsupport hz
  have hψΩ : tsupport (fun y : E ↦ ψ (y - z)) ⊆ Ω :=
    hψK.trans D.compact_subset
  let φ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ) :=
    translatedTestFunction ψ hψcompact hψsmooth z hψΩ
  refine ⟨φ, fun y ↦ hψnonneg (y - z), ?_⟩
  let φa : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ) := TestFunction.ofSupportedIn
    D.cutoffCompact_subset (D.localizedKernelSupportedIn a z)
  let φb : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ) := TestFunction.ofSupportedIn
    D.cutoffCompact_subset (D.localizedKernelSupportedIn b z)
  have htest :
      φa - φb =
        ∑ j : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ E),
          (TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ
              (adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j)
              (TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ
                (adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j) φ) +
            TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ
              (Complex.I • adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j)
              (TestFunction.lineDerivCLM (n := ⊤) (k := ⊤) ℝ
                (Complex.I • adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j) φ)) := by
    ext y
    change D.localizedKernelSupportedIn a z y -
        D.localizedKernelSupportedIn b z y = _
    rw [D.localizedKernelSupportedIn_eq_kernel a hz,
      D.localizedKernelSupportedIn_eq_kernel b hz]
    simp only [sum_apply, add_apply,
      testFunction_lineDerivCLM_lineDerivCLM_apply]
    change D.kernel a (y - z) - D.kernel b (y - z) =
      ∑ j : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ E),
        (realHessian (fun q : E ↦ ψ (q - z)) y
            (adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j)
            (adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j) +
          realHessian (fun q : E ↦ ψ (q - z)) y
            (Complex.I • adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j)
            (Complex.I • adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j))
    simp_rw [realHessian_comp_sub]
    have htrace := hψtrace (y - z)
    simp only [leviForm] at htrace
    change adaptedRadialKernel μ D.radius D.radius_pos a (y - z) -
      adaptedRadialKernel μ D.radius D.radius_pos b (y - z) = _
    rw [← htrace, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    ring
  change T φa - T φb = _
  rw [← map_sub, htest, map_sum]
  simp_rw [map_add, distributionalLeviCLM_apply]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.distributionRegularizedValue_antitone
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.distributionRegularizedValue_antitone
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ))
    (hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi T)
    {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) {z : E}
    (hz : z ∈ closure (D.inner : Set E)) :
    D.distributionRegularizedValue T b z ≤
      D.distributionRegularizedValue T a z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : 0 < Module.finrank ℂ E
  · obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hdiff⟩ :=
      D.exists_nonnegative_testFunction_value_sub_eq T hn hab hz
    have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ j : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ E),
        distributionalLeviCLM
          (adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j) T φ := by
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ ↦ hT _ φ hφ
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ D.distributionRegularizedValue T a z -
        D.distributionRegularizedValue T b z := by
      rw [hdiff]
      exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hsum
    linarith
  · have hzero : Module.finrank ℂ E = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hn
    have hk : D.kernel a = D.kernel b :=
      D.kernel_eq_of_finrank_complex_eq_zero hzero a b
    have hlocalized : D.localizedKernelSupportedIn a z =
        D.localizedKernelSupportedIn b z := by
      ext y
      simp only [AdaptedRadialKernelData.localizedKernelSupportedIn_apply]
      rw [hk]
    unfold AdaptedRadialKernelData.distributionRegularizedValue
    rw [hlocalized]

name: PshLines.Regularization.distribution_eq_of_restrict_eq_on_openCover
statement:
private theorem distribution_eq_of_restrict_eq_on_openCover
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} {T S : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)} {ι : Type*}
    (U : ι → Opens E) (hUΩ : ∀ i, U i ≤ Ω)
    (hcover : ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (hlocal : ∀ i,
      restrictDistribution T (hUΩ i) = restrictDistribution S (hUΩ i)) :
    T = S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext φ
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := SmoothPartitionOfUnity.exists_isSubordinate
    (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E)) isClosed_closure (fun i ↦ (U i : Set E))
    (fun i ↦ (U i).isOpen) (by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcover x (φ.tsupport_subset hx)
      exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hi⟩)
  let active : Set ι := {i | (Function.support (ρ i) ∩ tsupport φ).Nonempty}
  have hactive : active.Finite :=
    by simpa only [active] using
      ρ.locallyFinite.finite_nonempty_inter_compact φ.hasCompactSupport
  let ψ (i : ι) : 𝓓(U i, ℝ) :=
    ⟨fun x ↦ ρ i x * φ x,
      (ρ i).contMDiff.contDiff.mul φ.contDiff,
      φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_left,
      (tsupport_mul_subset_left
        (f := fun x ↦ ρ i x) (g := fun x ↦ φ x)).trans (hρ i)⟩
  let Ψ (i : ι) : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ) := TestFunction.monoCLM ℝ (ψ i)
  have hφsum : φ = ∑ i ∈ hactive.toFinset, Ψ i := by
    apply TestFunction.ext
    intro x
    have hsum_apply :
        (∑ i ∈ hactive.toFinset, Ψ i) x =
          ∑ i ∈ hactive.toFinset, ρ i x * φ x := by
      have hsum_apply' : ∀ s : Finset ι,
          (∑ i ∈ s, Ψ i) x = ∑ i ∈ s, ρ i x * φ x := by
        intro s
        induction s using Finset.induction_on with
        | empty => rfl
        | @insert i s hi hs =>
            rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi]
            change (Ψ i) x + (∑ j ∈ s, Ψ j) x =
              ρ i x * φ x + ∑ j ∈ s, ρ j x * φ x
            rw [hs]
            exact congrArg₂ (· + ·)
              (congrFun (testFunction_inclusion_coe (hUΩ i) (ψ i)) x) rfl
      exact hsum_apply' hactive.toFinset
    by_cases hx : x ∈ tsupport φ
    · have hsupp : Function.support (fun i ↦ ρ i x) ⊆ active := by
        intro i hi
        exact ⟨x, hi, hx⟩
      rw [hsum_apply]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [← finsum_eq_finsetSum_of_support_subset (fun i ↦ ρ i x)
        (by simpa only [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset] using hsupp)]
      rw [ρ.sum_eq_one hx, one_mul]
    · have hφx : φ x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx
      rw [hsum_apply, hφx]
      simp
  calc
    T φ = T (∑ i ∈ hactive.toFinset, Ψ i) :=
      congrArg T hφsum
    _ = ∑ i ∈ hactive.toFinset, T (Ψ i) := by
      simp only [map_sum]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ hactive.toFinset, S (Ψ i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      exact congrArg (fun R : 𝓓'(U i, ℝ) ↦ R (ψ i)) (hlocal i)
    _ = S (∑ i ∈ hactive.toFinset, Ψ i) := by
      simp only [map_sum]
    _ = S φ := congrArg S hφsum.symm

name: PshLines.Regularization.regularDistribution_eq_of_eqOn
statement:
private theorem regularDistribution_eq_of_eqOn
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) {U : Opens E} {f g : E → ℝ}
    (hf : LocallyIntegrableOn f U μ) (hg : LocallyIntegrableOn g U μ)
    (hfg : EqOn f g U) :
    regularDistribution μ f hf = regularDistribution μ g hg
proof:
:= by
  ext φ
  rw [regularDistribution_apply, regularDistribution_apply]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ U
    · change φ x * f x = φ x * g x
      rw [hfg hx]
    · have hφx : φ x = 0 :=
        image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (φ.tsupport_subset h))
      simp only [hφx, zero_mul]

name: PshLines.Regularization.exists_pshRepresentative_of_locally
statement:
theorem exists_pshRepresentative_of_locally
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [IsScalarTower ℝ ℂ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {Ω : Opens E} {T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)}
    (hlocal : ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∃ (U : Opens E) (hUΩ : U ≤ Ω) (u : E → EReal),
      x ∈ U ∧ IsPshRepresentative μ (restrictDistribution T hUΩ) u) :
    ∃ u : E → EReal, IsPshRepresentative μ T u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose U hUΩ u hxU hu using fun x : Ω => hlocal x x.2
  have hcompat (x y : Ω) : EqOn (u x) (u y) (U x ⊓ U y) := by
    have hux := PshLines.IsPshRepresentative.restrict
      (U := U x ⊓ U y) μ (hu x) inf_le_left
    have huy := PshLines.IsPshRepresentative.restrict
      (U := U x ⊓ U y) μ (hu y) inf_le_right
    rw [restrictDistribution_trans] at hux huy
    exact hux.unique huy
  let g : E → EReal := fun y => if hy : y ∈ Ω then u ⟨y, hy⟩ y else 0
  have hg_eq (x : Ω) : EqOn g (u x) (U x) := by
    intro y hy
    have hyΩ : y ∈ Ω := hUΩ x hy
    simp only [g, dif_pos hyΩ]
    exact hcompat ⟨y, hyΩ⟩ x ⟨hxU ⟨y, hyΩ⟩, hy⟩
  have hgPsh : PlurisubharmonicOn g Ω := by
    intro y hyΩ
    let x : Ω := ⟨y, hyΩ⟩
    have hyU : y ∈ U x := hxU x
    apply ((hu x).1 y hyU).congr
    filter_upwards [(U x).isOpen.mem_nhds hyU] with z hz
    exact (hg_eq x hz).symm
  have hgLocal : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun y => (g y).toReal) Ω μ := by
    intro y hyΩ
    let x : Ω := ⟨y, hyΩ⟩
    have hyU : y ∈ U x := hxU x
    obtain ⟨_, _, huLocal, _⟩ := hu x
    have hae : (fun z => (u x z).toReal) =ᵐ[μ.restrict (U x)]
        fun z => (g z).toReal := by
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem (U x).isOpen.measurableSet] with z hz
      exact congrArg EReal.toReal (hg_eq x hz).symm
    have hgLocalU := huLocal.congr hae
    have hgAt := hgLocalU y hyU
    rw [(U x).isOpen.nhdsWithin_eq hyU] at hgAt
    rw [Ω.isOpen.nhdsWithin_eq hyΩ]
    exact hgAt
  have hUunion : (⋃ x : Ω, (U x : Set E)) = (Ω : Set E) := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨x, hyx⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hy
      exact hUΩ x hyx
    · intro y hy
      exact mem_iUnion_of_mem ⟨y, hy⟩ (hxU ⟨y, hy⟩)
  obtain ⟨A, hAcount, hAunion⟩ :=
    isOpen_iUnion_countable (fun x : Ω => (U x : Set E)) (fun x => (U x).isOpen)
  have hgFinite : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.restrict Ω, g y ≠ ⊤ ∧ g y ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [← hUunion, ← hAunion]
    rw [ae_restrict_biUnion_iff (fun x : Ω => (U x : Set E)) hAcount]
    intro x _
    filter_upwards [(hu x).2.1, ae_restrict_mem (U x).isOpen.measurableSet] with y hy hyU
    simpa only [hg_eq x hyU] using hy
  have hrestrict (x : Ω) :
      restrictDistribution T (hUΩ x) =
        restrictDistribution
          (regularDistribution μ (fun y => (g y).toReal) hgLocal) (hUΩ x) := by
    obtain ⟨_, _, huLocal, huT⟩ := hu x
    calc
      restrictDistribution T (hUΩ x) =
          regularDistribution μ (fun y => (u x y).toReal) huLocal := huT
      _ = regularDistribution μ (fun y => (g y).toReal)
          (hgLocal.mono_set (hUΩ x)) := by
        apply regularDistribution_eq_of_eqOn μ
        intro y hy
        exact congrArg EReal.toReal (hg_eq x hy).symm
      _ = restrictDistribution
          (regularDistribution μ (fun y => (g y).toReal) hgLocal) (hUΩ x) :=
        (PshLines.restrictDistribution_regularDistribution
          μ hgLocal (hUΩ x)).symm
  have hT : T = regularDistribution μ (fun y => (g y).toReal) hgLocal := by
    apply distribution_eq_of_restrict_eq_on_openCover U hUΩ
    · intro y hyΩ
      exact ⟨⟨y, hyΩ⟩, hxU ⟨y, hyΩ⟩⟩
    · exact hrestrict
  exact ⟨g, hgPsh, hgFinite, hgLocal, hT⟩

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.explicitRadialRaw_integrable
statement:
theorem explicitRadialRaw_integrable (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    Integrable (explicitRadialRaw (n := n) R hR j) ν
proof:
:=
  (explicitRadialRaw_contDiff R hR j).continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    (explicitRadialRaw_hasCompactSupport R hR j)

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.explicitRadialRaw_integral_pos
statement:
theorem explicitRadialRaw_integral_pos (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    0 < ∫ x : ComplexModel n, explicitRadialRaw R hR j x ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  refine (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg
    (explicitRadialRaw_nonneg R hR j)
    (explicitRadialRaw_integrable ν R hR j)).mpr ?_
  rw [explicitRadialRaw_support R hR j]
  exact measure_ball_pos ν 0 (by positivity)

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.coordinateRadialKernel_contDiff
statement:
theorem coordinateRadialKernel_contDiff (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (coordinateRadialKernel ν R hR j)
proof:
:=
  (explicitRadialRaw_contDiff R hR j).div_const _

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.coordinateRadialKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem coordinateRadialKernel_nonneg (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ)
    (x : ComplexModel n) : 0 ≤ coordinateRadialKernel ν R hR j x
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (explicitRadialRaw_nonneg R hR j x)
    (explicitRadialRaw_integral_pos ν R hR j).le

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.coordinateRadialKernel_integral_one
statement:
theorem coordinateRadialKernel_integral_one (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    ∫ x : ComplexModel n, coordinateRadialKernel ν R hR j x ∂ν = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [coordinateRadialKernel, div_eq_mul_inv,
    mul_comm (explicitRadialRaw R hR j _), ← smul_eq_mul, integral_smul]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (explicitRadialRaw_integral_pos ν R hR j).ne'

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.coordinateRadialKernel_support
statement:
theorem coordinateRadialKernel_support (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    Function.support (coordinateRadialKernel ν R hR j) =
      ball 0 (R / ((j : ℝ) + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := explicitRadialRaw_integral_pos (n := n) ν R hR j
  change Function.support (fun x : ComplexModel n ↦
    explicitRadialRaw R hR j x /
      ∫ y : ComplexModel n, explicitRadialRaw R hR j y ∂ν) = _
  rw [Function.support_div, Function.support_const hpos.ne', inter_univ,
    explicitRadialRaw_support R hR j]

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.coordinateRadialKernel_tsupport
statement:
theorem coordinateRadialKernel_tsupport (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    tsupport (coordinateRadialKernel ν R hR j) =
      closedBall 0 (R / ((j : ℝ) + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tsupport, coordinateRadialKernel_support ν R hR j,
    closure_ball _ (by positivity : R / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0)]

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.coordinateRadialKernel_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem coordinateRadialKernel_hasCompactSupport
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    HasCompactSupport (coordinateRadialKernel ν R hR j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HasCompactSupport, coordinateRadialKernel_tsupport ν R hR j]
  exact isCompact_closedBall _ _

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.coordinateRadialKernel_integrable
statement:
theorem coordinateRadialKernel_integrable (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    Integrable (coordinateRadialKernel ν R hR j) ν
proof:
:=
  (coordinateRadialKernel_contDiff ν R hR j).continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    (coordinateRadialKernel_hasCompactSupport ν R hR j)

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.explicitRadialRaw_unitary
statement:
theorem explicitRadialRaw_unitary (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ)
    (a : ℂ) (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (x : ComplexModel n) :
    explicitRadialRaw R hR j (a • x) = explicitRadialRaw R hR j x
proof:
:= by
  simp [explicitRadialRaw, ContDiffBumpBase.ofInnerProductSpace, norm_smul, ha]

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.coordinateRadialKernel_unitary
statement:
theorem coordinateRadialKernel_unitary (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ)
    (a : ℂ) (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (x : ComplexModel n) :
    coordinateRadialKernel ν R hR j (a • x) =
      coordinateRadialKernel ν R hR j x
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateRadialKernel, coordinateRadialKernel,
    explicitRadialRaw_unitary R hR j a ha x]

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.coordinateRadialKernel_scale
statement:
theorem coordinateRadialKernel_scale (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ)
    (x : ComplexModel n) :
    coordinateRadialKernel ν R hR b x =
      (((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^
          Module.finrank ℝ (ComplexModel n) *
        coordinateRadialKernel ν R hR a
          ((((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) • x)
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := ((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)
  have hq : 0 < q := by
    dsimp [q]
    positivity
  have hqpow : q ^ Module.finrank ℝ (ComplexModel n) ≠ 0 :=
    pow_ne_zero _ hq.ne'
  have hint :
      (∫ y : ComplexModel n, explicitRadialRaw R hR b y ∂ν) =
        (q ^ Module.finrank ℝ (ComplexModel n))⁻¹ *
          ∫ y : ComplexModel n, explicitRadialRaw R hR a y ∂ν := by
    rw [show (fun y : ComplexModel n ↦ explicitRadialRaw R hR b y) =
        fun y ↦ explicitRadialRaw R hR a (q • y) by
      funext y
      exact explicitRadialRaw_scale R hR a b y]
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using
      (Measure.integral_comp_smul_of_nonneg ν
        (explicitRadialRaw (n := n) R hR a) q (hR := hq.le))
  rw [coordinateRadialKernel, coordinateRadialKernel,
    explicitRadialRaw_scale R hR a b, hint]
  dsimp [q]
  field_simp [hqpow, (explicitRadialRaw_integral_pos (n := n) ν R hR a).ne']

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.adaptedRadialKernel_contDiff
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialKernel_contDiff (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR j)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ).IsAddHaarMeasure :=
    adaptedCoordinateMeasure_isAddHaarMeasure μ
  exact (coordinateRadialKernel_contDiff (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) R hR j).comp
    ((adaptedComplexModelEquiv (E := E)).toContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ).contDiff

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.adaptedRadialKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialKernel_nonneg (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) (x : E) :
    0 ≤ adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR j x
proof:
:= by
  let _ : (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ).IsAddHaarMeasure :=
    adaptedCoordinateMeasure_isAddHaarMeasure μ
  exact coordinateRadialKernel_nonneg (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) R hR j _

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.adaptedRadialKernel_integral_one
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialKernel_integral_one (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    ∫ x : E, adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR j x ∂μ = 1
proof:
:= by
  let _ : (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ).IsAddHaarMeasure :=
    adaptedCoordinateMeasure_isAddHaarMeasure μ
  simpa only [adaptedRadialKernel] using
    (integral_comp_adaptedComplexModelEquiv μ
      (coordinateRadialKernel (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) R hR j))
      |>.trans (coordinateRadialKernel_integral_one
        (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) R hR j)

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.adaptedRadialKernel_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialKernel_hasCompactSupport
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    HasCompactSupport (adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR j)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ).IsAddHaarMeasure :=
    adaptedCoordinateMeasure_isAddHaarMeasure μ
  change HasCompactSupport (fun x : E ↦ coordinateRadialKernel
    (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) R hR j (adaptedComplexModelEquiv x))
  exact (coordinateRadialKernel_hasCompactSupport
    (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) R hR j).comp_homeomorph
      (adaptedComplexModelEquiv (E := E)).toHomeomorph

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.adaptedRadialKernel_integrable
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialKernel_integrable (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    Integrable (adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR j) μ
proof:
:= by
  let _ : (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ).IsAddHaarMeasure :=
    adaptedCoordinateMeasure_isAddHaarMeasure μ
  change Integrable (fun x : E ↦ coordinateRadialKernel
    (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) R hR j (adaptedComplexModelEquiv x)) μ
  exact (adaptedComplexModelEquiv_measurePreserving μ).integrable_comp_of_integrable
    (coordinateRadialKernel_integrable
      (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) R hR j)

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.adaptedRadialKernel_tsupport_subset
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialKernel_tsupport_subset (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) :
    tsupport (adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR j) ⊆
      adaptedComplexModelEquiv ⁻¹'
        closedBall 0 (R / ((j : ℝ) + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let _ : (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ).IsAddHaarMeasure :=
    adaptedCoordinateMeasure_isAddHaarMeasure μ
  apply closure_minimal
  · intro x hx
    have hx' : adaptedComplexModelEquiv x ∈
        Function.support
          (coordinateRadialKernel (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) R hR j) := hx
    rw [coordinateRadialKernel_support (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) R hR j] at hx'
    change adaptedComplexModelEquiv x ∈
      closedBall 0 (R / ((j : ℝ) + 1))
    rw [← closure_ball _ (by positivity : R / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0)]
    exact subset_closure hx'
  · exact isClosed_closedBall.preimage adaptedComplexModelEquiv.continuous

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.adaptedRadialKernel_tsupport_subset_norm
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mp
    (adaptedRadialKernel_tsupport_subset μ R hR j hx)

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.adaptedRadialKernel_unitary
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialKernel_unitary (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ)
    (a : ℂ) (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (x : E) :
    adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR j
        (adaptedComplexModelEquiv.symm (a • adaptedComplexModelEquiv x)) =
      adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR j x
proof:
:= by
  let _ : (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ).IsAddHaarMeasure :=
    adaptedCoordinateMeasure_isAddHaarMeasure μ
  simp only [adaptedRadialKernel, ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact coordinateRadialKernel_unitary
    (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) R hR j a ha _

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernel.adaptedRadialKernel_scale
statement:
theorem adaptedRadialKernel_scale (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ) (x : E) :
    adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR b x =
      (((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^
          Module.finrank ℝ
            (ComplexModel (Module.finrank ℂ E)) *
        adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR a
          (adaptedComplexModelEquiv.symm
            (((((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) •
              adaptedComplexModelEquiv x))
proof:
:= by
  let _ : (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ).IsAddHaarMeasure :=
    adaptedCoordinateMeasure_isAddHaarMeasure μ
  simp only [adaptedRadialKernel, ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact coordinateRadialKernel_scale
    (adaptedCoordinateMeasure μ) R hR a b _

name: PshLines.Regularization.cutoffTranslatedKernelJet_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cutoffTranslatedKernelJet_zero
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (z y : E) (v : Fin 0 → E) :
    cutoffTranslatedKernelJet χ κ 0 z y v = χ y * κ (y - z)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cutoffTranslatedKernelJet]

name: PshLines.Regularization.cutoffTranslatedKernelJet_contDiff
statement:
theorem cutoffTranslatedKernelJet_contDiff
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (r : ℕ) (z : E) (v : Fin r → E) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun y ↦ cutoffTranslatedKernelJet χ κ r z y v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_infty]
  intro m
  have hχm : ContDiff ℝ m (χ : E → ℝ) :=
    χ.contDiff.of_le (by
      exact_mod_cast (show (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤ from le_top))
  apply hχm.mul
  have hderiv : ContDiff ℝ m (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r κ) :=
    hκ.iteratedFDeriv_right (by
      exact_mod_cast (show (m + r : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤ from le_top))
  have htranslated : ContDiff ℝ m
      (fun y ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ r κ (y - z)) :=
    hderiv.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  exact (continuousMultilinearApplyCLM (fun i ↦ -v i)).contDiff.comp htranslated

name: PshLines.Regularization.cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn_apply
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (r : ℕ) (z y : E) (v : Fin r → E) :
    cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK r z v y =
      χ y * iteratedFDeriv ℝ r κ (y - z) (fun i ↦ -v i)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: PshLines.Regularization.cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn_zero_eq
statement:
theorem cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn_zero_eq
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (z : E) (v : Fin 0 → E) :
    cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK 0 z v =
      cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp [cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn_apply,
    cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn_apply]

name: PshLines.Regularization.distributionOnSupportedInCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem distributionOnSupportedInCLM_apply
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (K : Compacts E)
    (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω)
    (φ : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E ℝ ⊤ K) :
    distributionOnSupportedInCLM T K hKΩ φ =
      T (TestFunction.ofSupportedIn hKΩ φ)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: PshLines.Regularization.distributionCutoffTranslatedKernelJet_zero_eq
statement:
theorem distributionCutoffTranslatedKernelJet_zero_eq

name: PshLines.Regularization.cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn_update_add
statement:
theorem cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn_update_add
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (r : ℕ) (z : E)
    (v : Fin r → E) (i : Fin r) (x y : E) :
    cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK r z
        (Function.update v i (x + y)) =
      cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK r z
          (Function.update v i x) +
        cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK r z
          (Function.update v i y)
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  change χ q * iteratedFDeriv ℝ r κ (q - z)
      (fun j => -Function.update v i (x + y) j) =
    χ q * iteratedFDeriv ℝ r κ (q - z)
        (fun j => -Function.update v i x j) +
      χ q * iteratedFDeriv ℝ r κ (q - z)
        (fun j => -Function.update v i y j)
  let w : Fin r → E := fun j => -v j
  have hadd : (fun j => -Function.update v i (x + y) j) =
      Function.update w i ((-x) + (-y)) := by
    funext j
    by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [w, hji, add_comm]
  have hx : (fun j => -Function.update v i x j) =
      Function.update w i (-x) := by
    funext j
    by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [w, hji]
  have hy : (fun j => -Function.update v i y j) =
      Function.update w i (-y) := by
    funext j
    by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [w, hji]
  rw [hadd, hx, hy,
    (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r κ (q - z)).map_update_add]
  ring

name: PshLines.Regularization.cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn_update_smul
statement:
theorem cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn_update_smul
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (r : ℕ) (z : E)
    (v : Fin r → E) (i : Fin r) (c : ℝ) (x : E) :
    cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK r z
        (Function.update v i (c • x)) =
      c • cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK r z
          (Function.update v i x)
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  change χ q * iteratedFDeriv ℝ r κ (q - z)
      (fun j => -Function.update v i (c • x) j) =
    c * (χ q * iteratedFDeriv ℝ r κ (q - z)
      (fun j => -Function.update v i x j))
  let w : Fin r → E := fun j => -v j
  have hsmul : (fun j => -Function.update v i (c • x) j) =
      Function.update w i (c • (-x)) := by
    funext j
    by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [w, hji]
  have hx : (fun j => -Function.update v i x j) =
      Function.update w i (-x) := by
    funext j
    by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [w, hji]
  rw [hsmul, hx,
    (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r κ (q - z)).map_update_smul]
  ring

name: PshLines.Regularization.iteratedFDeriv_fderiv_apply_cyclic
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_fderiv_apply_cyclic
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (f : E → F) (hf : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f)
    (x h : E) (r : ℕ) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ f y h) x =
      fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r f) x h
proof:
:= by
  induction r generalizing x with
  | zero =>
      ext v
      rw [fderiv_iteratedFDeriv]
      simp
  | succ r ihr =>
      ext m
      have hDf : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fderiv ℝ f) :=
        hf.fderiv_right (by simp)
      have hg : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ f y h) :=
        hDf.clm_apply contDiff_const
      have hDrg : DifferentiableAt ℝ
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ f y h)) x :=
        (hg.differentiable_iteratedFDeriv (by
          exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.natCast_lt_top r))).differentiableAt
      rw [hDrg.iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left']
      have heqLeft :
          (fun y ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (fun q ↦ fderiv ℝ f q h) y (Fin.tail m)) =
            (fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r f) y h (Fin.tail m)) := by
        funext y
        rw [ihr y]
      rw [heqLeft]
      have hDrsucc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (r + 1) f) x :=
        (hf.differentiable_iteratedFDeriv (by
          exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.natCast_lt_top (r + 1)))).differentiableAt
      rw [← fderiv_continuousMultilinear_apply_const_apply hDrsucc m h]
      have heqRight :
          (fun y ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ (r + 1) f y m) =
            (fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r f) y (m 0) (Fin.tail m)) := by
        funext y
        exact iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := f) (x := y) m
      rw [heqRight]
      let G : E → (E [×r]→L[ℝ] F) := iteratedFDeriv ℝ r f
      have hG2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 G :=
        hf.iteratedFDeriv_right (by
          change ((↑(2 + r) : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω)
          exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
      have hDG1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ G) :=
        hG2.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
      have hDGdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ G) x :=
        hDG1.differentiable one_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
      have hDGappliedH : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ G y h) x :=
        hDGdiff.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const h)
      have hDGappliedM : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ G y (m 0)) x :=
        hDGdiff.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const (m 0))
      change
        fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ G y h (Fin.tail m)) x (m 0) =
          fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ G y (m 0) (Fin.tail m)) x h
      rw [fderiv_continuousMultilinear_apply_const_apply
        hDGappliedH (Fin.tail m) (m 0)]
      rw [fderiv_continuousMultilinear_apply_const_apply
        hDGappliedM (Fin.tail m) h]
      have hleft :
          fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ G y h) x (m 0) =
            fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ G) x (m 0) h := by
        rw [fderiv_clm_apply hDGdiff (differentiableAt_const h)]
        simp
      have hright :
          fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ G y (m 0)) x h =
            fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ G) x h (m 0) := by
        rw [fderiv_clm_apply hDGdiff (differentiableAt_const (m 0))]
        simp
      rw [hleft, hright]
      exact congrArg (fun L : E [×r]→L[ℝ] F ↦ L (Fin.tail m))
        ((hG2.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by norm_num)) (m 0) h)

name: PshLines.Regularization.iteratedFDeriv_translationFirstJet
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_translationFirstJet
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (κ : E → ℝ) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ)
    (z h y : E) (r : ℕ) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (fun x ↦ fderiv ℝ κ (x - z) (-h)) y =
      fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r κ) (y - z) (-h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_comp_sub
    (f := fun q ↦ fderiv ℝ κ q (-h)) r z y]
  exact iteratedFDeriv_fderiv_apply_cyclic κ hκ (y - z) (-h) r

name: PshLines.Regularization.iteratedFDeriv_translationFirstRemainder
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_translationFirstRemainder
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (κ : E → ℝ) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ)
    (z h y : E) (r : ℕ) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (translationFirstRemainder κ z h) y =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ r κ (y - (z + h)) -
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ r κ (y - z) -
        fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r κ) (y - z) (-h)
proof:
:= by
  change iteratedFDeriv ℝ r
      ((fun q ↦ κ (q - (z + h))) - (fun q ↦ κ (q - z)) -
        (fun q ↦ fderiv ℝ κ (q - z) (-h))) y = _
  have hκzh : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun q ↦ κ (q - (z + h))) :=
    hκ.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  have hκz : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun q ↦ κ (q - z)) :=
    hκ.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  have hjet : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
      (fun q ↦ fderiv ℝ κ (q - z) (-h)) :=
    ((hκ.fderiv_right (by simp)).comp
      (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)).clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hrle : ((r : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω) :=
    WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_sub
      (f := (fun q ↦ κ (q - (z + h))) - (fun q ↦ κ (q - z)))
      (g := fun q ↦ fderiv ℝ κ (q - z) (-h))
      ((hκzh.sub hκz).of_le hrle) (hjet.of_le hrle),
    iteratedFDeriv_sub
      (f := fun q ↦ κ (q - (z + h))) (g := fun q ↦ κ (q - z))
      (hκzh.of_le hrle) (hκz.of_le hrle)]
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [
    iteratedFDeriv_comp_sub (f := κ) r (z + h) y,
    iteratedFDeriv_comp_sub (f := κ) r z y,
    iteratedFDeriv_translationFirstJet κ hκ z h y r]

name: PshLines.Regularization.compactNormSup_nonneg
statement:
theorem compactNormSup_nonneg
    {E F : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E] [SeminormedAddCommGroup F]
    (K : Compacts E) (f : E → F) :
    0 ≤ compactNormSup K f
proof:
:=
  le_max_left _ _

name: PshLines.Regularization.norm_le_compactNormSup
statement:
theorem norm_le_compactNormSup
    {E F : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E] [SeminormedAddCommGroup F]
    (K : Compacts E) (f : E → F) (hf : Continuous f)
    {y : E} (hy : y ∈ (K : Set E)) :
    ‖f y‖ ≤ compactNormSup K f
proof:
:= by
  have hbddImage : BddAbove ((fun q : E ↦ ‖f q‖) '' (K : Set E)) :=
    K.isCompact.bddAbove_image hf.norm.continuousOn
  have hbddRange : BddAbove
      (range (fun q : (K : Set E) ↦ ‖f q‖)) := by
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbddImage
    refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩
    exact hC ⟨q, q.property, rfl⟩
  exact (le_ciSup hbddRange ⟨y, hy⟩).trans (le_max_right _ _)

name: PshLines.Regularization.translationDerivativeRemainderSup_nonneg
statement:
theorem translationDerivativeRemainderSup_nonneg
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (κ : E → ℝ) (K : Compacts E) (z : E) (r : ℕ) (h : E) :
    0 ≤ translationDerivativeRemainderSup κ K z r h
proof:
:=
  compactNormSup_nonneg K _

name: PshLines.Regularization.translationDerivativeRemainderSup_isLittleO
statement:
theorem translationDerivativeRemainderSup_isLittleO
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (κ : E → ℝ) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ)
    (K : Compacts E) (z : E) (r : ℕ) :
    (translationDerivativeRemainderSup κ K z r) =o[𝓝 0]
      (fun h : E ↦ h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isLittleO_iff]
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_uniform_iteratedFDeriv_translation_remainder_bound
      κ hκ K z r c hc
  filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : E) hδ] with h hh
  have hhδ : ‖h‖ < δ := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hh
  have hsup :
      (⨆ y : (K : Set E),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (translationFirstRemainder κ z h) y‖) ≤
          c * ‖h‖ := by
    by_cases hK : (K : Set E).Nonempty
    · let _ : Nonempty (K : Set E) := Set.nonempty_coe_sort.mpr hK
      apply ciSup_le
      intro y
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_translationFirstRemainder κ hκ z h y r]
      exact hbound y y.property h hhδ
    · let _ : IsEmpty (K : Set E) :=
        ⟨fun y ↦ hK ⟨y, y.property⟩⟩
      simpa using mul_nonneg hc.le (norm_nonneg h)
  have hnon : 0 ≤ c * ‖h‖ := mul_nonneg hc.le (norm_nonneg h)
  have hle : translationDerivativeRemainderSup κ K z r h ≤ c * ‖h‖ := by
    exact max_le hnon hsup
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (translationDerivativeRemainderSup_nonneg κ K z r h)] using hle

name: PshLines.Regularization.cutoffTranslationFirstRemainder_seminorm_isLittleO_actual
statement:
theorem cutoffTranslationFirstRemainder_seminorm_isLittleO_actual
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (z : E) (r : ℕ) :
    (fun h : E ↦
      ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K r
        (cutoffTranslationFirstRemainderSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z h))
      =o[𝓝 0] (fun h : E ↦ h)
proof:
:= by
  apply cutoffTranslationFirstRemainder_seminorm_isLittleO
    χ κ hκ K hχK z r
    (cutoffDerivativeSup χ K)
    (translationDerivativeRemainderSup κ K z)
  · intro i _hi
    exact compactNormSup_nonneg K _
  · intro i _hi y hy
    have hiTop : ((i : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω) :=
      WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
    exact norm_le_compactNormSup K _
      ((χ.contDiff.of_le hiTop).continuous_iteratedFDeriv') hy
  · intro j _hj h
    exact translationDerivativeRemainderSup_nonneg κ K z j h
  · intro j _hj h y hy
    have hjTop : ((j : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω) :=
      WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
    have hcontinuous : Continuous
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (translationFirstRemainder κ z h)) :=
      ((translationFirstRemainder_contDiff κ hκ z h).of_le hjTop)
        |>.continuous_iteratedFDeriv'
    exact norm_le_compactNormSup K _ hcontinuous hy
  · intro j _hj
    exact translationDerivativeRemainderSup_isLittleO κ hκ K z j

name: PshLines.Regularization.cutoffTranslationFirstRemainder_finiteOrderSeminorm_isLittleO_actual
statement:
theorem cutoffTranslationFirstRemainder_finiteOrderSeminorm_isLittleO_actual
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (z : E) (m : ℕ) :
    (fun h : E ↦
      ((Finset.Iic m).sup
        (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K))
        (cutoffTranslationFirstRemainderSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z h))
      =o[𝓝 0] (fun h : E ↦ h)
proof:
:= by
  let R : E → ContDiffMapSupportedIn E ℝ ⊤ K :=
    fun h ↦ cutoffTranslationFirstRemainderSupportedIn
      χ κ hκ K hχK z h
  let S : E → ℝ := fun h ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Iic m,
    ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K i (R h)
  have hterms : ∀ i ∈ Finset.Iic m,
      (fun h : E ↦ ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K i (R h))
        =o[𝓝 0] (fun h : E ↦ h) := by
    intro i _hi
    exact cutoffTranslationFirstRemainder_seminorm_isLittleO_actual
      χ κ hκ K hχK z i
  have hSo : S =o[𝓝 0] (fun h : E ↦ h) := by
    dsimp only [S]
    refine (IsLittleO.sum hterms).congr ?_ (fun _ ↦ rfl)
    intro h
    simp
  have hdom :
      (fun h : E ↦
        ((Finset.Iic m).sup
          (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K)) (R h))
        =O[𝓝 0] S := by
    apply (IsBigOWith.of_bound (c := (1 : ℝ)) ?_).isBigO
    filter_upwards with h
    have hle :
        ((Finset.Iic m).sup
          (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K)) (R h) ≤ S h := by
      simpa [S] using (Seminorm.finset_sup_le_sum
        (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K)
        (Finset.Iic m)) (R h)
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ S h := by
      dsimp only [S]
      positivity
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (apply_nonneg
        ((Finset.Iic m).sup
          (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K)) (R h)),
      abs_of_nonneg hS0, one_mul] using hle
  exact hdom.trans_isLittleO hSo

name: PshLines.Regularization.distributionPairing_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem distributionPairing_hasFDerivAt
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω) (z : E) :
    HasFDerivAt
      (fun w ↦ distributionOnSupportedInCLM T K hKΩ
        (cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK w))
      ⟨(distributionOnSupportedInCLM T K hKΩ).toLinearMap.comp
          (cutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetLM χ κ hκ K hχK z),
        ((distributionOnSupportedInCLM T K hKΩ).toLinearMap.comp
          (cutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetLM χ κ hκ K hχK z)).continuous_of_finiteDimensional⟩ z
proof:
:= by
  apply distributionPairing_hasFDerivAt_of_supSeminorm_remainder
    T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ z
  intro m
  simpa only [cutoffTranslationFirstRemainderSupportedIn] using
    cutoffTranslationFirstRemainder_finiteOrderSeminorm_isLittleO_actual
      χ κ hκ K hχK z m

name: PshLines.Regularization.compact_limit_deficit
statement:
private theorem compact_limit_deficit
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {Ω : Opens E}
    {T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)} {f : ℕ → E → ℝ}
    (hf : IsDecreasingSmoothPshApproximation μ T f)
    {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω) :
    ∃ C : ℝ,
      (∀ x ∈ K, (⨅ n, (f n x : EReal)) ≤ (C : EReal)) ∧
      ∫⁻ x in K, ((C : EReal) - (⨅ n, (f n x : EReal))).toENNReal ∂μ < ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨χ, hχnonneg, hχK⟩ :=
    PshLines.exists_nonneg_testFunction_one_le_on_compact hK hKΩ
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := χ.hasCompactSupport.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (hf.1 0).continuous.continuousOn
  let g : ℕ → E → ℝ := fun n x => χ x * (C - f n x)
  have hg_cont (n : ℕ) : Continuous (g n) :=
    χ.continuous.mul (continuous_const.sub (hf.1 n).continuous)
  have hg_supp (n : ℕ) : HasCompactSupport (g n) :=
    χ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right
  have hg_int (n : ℕ) : Integrable (g n) μ :=
    (hg_cont n).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hg_supp n)
  have hC0 : ∀ x ∈ tsupport χ, f 0 x ≤ C := by
    intro x hx
    exact (le_abs_self (f 0 x)).trans (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC x hx)
  have hg_nonneg (n : ℕ) (x : E) : 0 ≤ g n x := by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ tsupport χ
    · exact mul_nonneg (hχnonneg x)
        (sub_nonneg.mpr ((hf.2.2.1 x (χ.tsupport_subset hx) (Nat.zero_le n)).trans (hC0 x hx)))
    · simp [g, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx]
  have hg_mono : Monotone g := by
    intro m n hmn x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ tsupport χ
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (sub_le_sub_left (hf.2.2.1 x (χ.tsupport_subset hx) hmn) C)
        (hχnonneg x)
    · simp [g, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx]
  have hχ_int : Integrable (fun x : E => χ x) μ :=
    χ.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport χ.hasCompactSupport
  have hχf_int (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x : E => χ x * f n x) μ :=
    (χ.continuous.mul (hf.1 n).continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      χ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right
  have hg_integral (n : ℕ) :
      ∫ x, g n x ∂μ = C * ∫ x, χ x ∂μ - ∫ x, χ x * f n x ∂μ := by
    rw [show g n = fun x => C * χ x - χ x * f n x by
      funext x
      simp only [g]
      ring]
    rw [integral_sub (hχ_int.const_mul C) (hχf_int n), integral_const_mul]
  have hg_tendsto : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, g n x ∂μ) atTop
      (𝓝 (C * ∫ x, χ x ∂μ - T χ)) := by
    convert tendsto_const_nhds.sub (hf.2.2.2 χ) using 1
    ext n
    exact hg_integral n
  have hg_integral_mono : Monotone (fun n => ∫ x, g n x ∂μ) := by
    intro m n hmn
    exact integral_mono (hg_int m) (hg_int n) (hg_mono hmn)
  have hg_integral_le (n : ℕ) :
      ∫ x, g n x ∂μ ≤ C * ∫ x, χ x ∂μ - T χ :=
    hg_integral_mono.ge_of_tendsto hg_tendsto n
  let G : ℕ → E → ℝ≥0∞ := fun n x => ENNReal.ofReal (g n x)
  have hG_meas (n : ℕ) : Measurable (G n) :=
    (hg_cont n).measurable.ennreal_ofReal
  have hG_mono : Monotone G := by
    intro m n hmn x
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hg_mono hmn x)
  have hG_integral (n : ℕ) :
      ∫⁻ x, G n x ∂μ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, g n x ∂μ) := by
    symm
    exact MeasureTheory.ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hg_int n)
      (Eventually.of_forall (hg_nonneg n))
  have hG_sup_lt : ∫⁻ x, ⨆ n, G n x ∂μ < ⊤ := by
    rw [lintegral_iSup hG_meas hG_mono]
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (iSup_le fun n => ?_)
      (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top :
        ENNReal.ofReal (C * ∫ x, χ x ∂μ - T χ) < ⊤)
    rw [hG_integral n]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hg_integral_le n)
  refine ⟨C, ?_, (setLIntegral_mono' hK.measurableSet ?_).trans_lt
    ((setLIntegral_le_lintegral K _).trans_lt hG_sup_lt)⟩
  · intro x hx
    refine (iInf_le (fun n => (f n x : EReal)) 0).trans ?_
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (hC0 x
      (subset_tsupport χ (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans_le (hχK x hx)))))
  intro x hx
  rw [PshLines.finiteDeficit_iInf]
  gcongr with n
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have hdef : 0 ≤ C - f n x := sub_nonneg.mpr
    ((hf.2.2.1 x (hKΩ hx) (Nat.zero_le n)).trans (hC0 x ?_))
  · exact le_mul_of_one_le_left hdef (hχK x hx)
  · exact subset_tsupport χ (ne_of_gt ((zero_lt_one.trans_le (hχK x hx))))

name: PshLines.Regularization.exists_pshRepresentative_of_decreasing_approximation
proof:
:= by
  let u : E → EReal := fun x => ⨅ n, (f n x : EReal)
  have huD : DiscPshOn u Ω :=
    DiscPshOn.iInf_of_antitone (fun n => hf.2.1 n) (fun x hx => by
      intro m n hmn
      exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (hf.2.2.1 x hx hmn))
  have huP : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω := huD.plurisubharmonicOn Ω.isOpen
  have hcompact (K : Set E) (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω) (hK : IsCompact K) :
      (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict K, u x ≠ ⊤ ∧ u x ≠ ⊥) ∧
        IntegrableOn (fun x => (u x).toReal) K μ ∧
        ((fun x => ((u x).toReal : EReal)) =ᶠ[ae (μ.restrict K)] u) := by
    obtain ⟨C, hCu, hCI⟩ := compact_limit_deficit μ hf hK hKΩ
    exact ae_finite_and_integrableOn_of_lintegral_deficit_lt_top hK.measure_lt_top
      (by filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hK.measurableSet] with x hx using hCu x hx)
      (huD.aemeasurable_deficit_restrict hK.measurableSet hKΩ C μ) hCI
  have huL : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => (u x).toReal) Ω μ := by
    rw [locallyIntegrableOn_iff Ω.isOpen.isLocallyClosed]
    intro K hKΩ hK
    exact (hcompact K hKΩ hK).2.1
  let _ : LocallyCompactSpace Ω := Ω.isOpen.locallyCompactSpace
  obtain ⟨K, hKcompact, hKcover⟩ := SigmaCompactSpace.exists_compact_covering (X := Ω)
  let L : ℕ → Set E := fun n => Subtype.val '' K n
  have hLcompact (n : ℕ) : IsCompact (L n) :=
    (hKcompact n).image continuous_subtype_val
  have hLΩ (n : ℕ) : L n ⊆ Ω := by
    rintro x ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
    exact y.property
  have hLcover : ⋃ n, L n = (Ω : Set E) := by
    apply Subset.antisymm
    · rw [iUnion_subset_iff]
      exact hLΩ
    · intro x hx
      have hy : (⟨x, hx⟩ : Ω) ∈ ⋃ n, K n := by
        rw [hKcover]
        exact mem_univ _
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hy
      exact mem_iUnion_of_mem n ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hn, rfl⟩
  have huFinite : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict Ω, u x ≠ ⊤ ∧ u x ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [← hLcover, ae_restrict_iUnion_iff]
    intro n
    exact (hcompact (L n) (hLΩ n) (hLcompact n)).1
  refine ⟨u, huP, huFinite, huL, ?_⟩
  ext φ
  rw [regularDistribution_apply]
  have hfnL (n : ℕ) : LocallyIntegrableOn (f n) Ω μ :=
    (hf.1 n).continuous.locallyIntegrable.locallyIntegrableOn Ω
  have hφfn (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x => φ x * f n x) μ := by
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply'] using
      TestFunction.integrable_bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) (hfnL n) φ
  have hφu : Integrable (fun x => φ x * (u x).toReal) μ := by
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply'] using
      TestFunction.integrable_bilin (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) huL φ
  let bound : E → ℝ := fun x => |φ x * f 0 x| + |φ x * (u x).toReal|
  have hbound_int : Integrable bound μ := by
    exact (hφfn 0).abs.add hφu.abs
  have hbound_inside : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict Ω,
      ∀ n, ‖φ x * f n x‖ ≤ bound x := by
    filter_upwards [huFinite, ae_restrict_mem Ω.isOpen.measurableSet] with x hx hxΩ
    intro n
    have hu_le : (u x).toReal ≤ f n x :=
      EReal.toReal_le_toReal (iInf_le (fun m => (f m x : EReal)) n)
        hx.2 (EReal.coe_ne_top (f n x))
    have hfn_le : f n x ≤ f 0 x := hf.2.2.1 x hxΩ (Nat.zero_le n)
    have habs : |f n x| ≤ |f 0 x| + |(u x).toReal| := by
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor
      · calc
          -(|f 0 x| + |(u x).toReal|) ≤ -|(u x).toReal| := by
            linarith [abs_nonneg (f 0 x)]
          _ ≤ (u x).toReal := by
            simpa only [abs_neg, neg_neg] using
              neg_le_neg (le_abs_self (-(u x).toReal))
          _ ≤ f n x := hu_le
      · calc
          f n x ≤ f 0 x := hfn_le
          _ ≤ |f 0 x| := le_abs_self _
          _ ≤ |f 0 x| + |(u x).toReal| := le_add_of_nonneg_right (abs_nonneg _)
    simpa only [bound, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, mul_add] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habs (abs_nonneg (φ x))
  have hφzero (x : E) (hx : x ∉ (Ω : Set E)) : φ x = 0 :=
    image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport fun h => hx (φ.tsupport_subset h)
  have hbound_outside : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict (Ω : Set E)ᶜ,
      ∀ n, ‖φ x * f n x‖ ≤ bound x := by
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem Ω.isOpen.measurableSet.compl fun x hx n => ?_
    simp [hφzero x hx, bound]
  have hbound : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖φ x * f n x‖ ≤ bound x := by
    have hall := ae_of_ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_compl (Ω : Set E)
      hbound_inside hbound_outside
    exact fun n => hall.mono fun x hx => hx n
  have hlim_inside : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict Ω,
      Tendsto (fun n => φ x * f n x) atTop (𝓝 (φ x * (u x).toReal)) := by
    filter_upwards [huFinite, ae_restrict_mem Ω.isOpen.measurableSet] with x hx hxΩ
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.mul
    have he : Tendsto (fun n => (f n x : EReal)) atTop (𝓝 (u x)) := by
      exact tendsto_atTop_iInf (fun m n hmn =>
        EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (hf.2.2.1 x hxΩ hmn))
    change Tendsto (fun n => ((f n x : EReal)).toReal) atTop (𝓝 (u x).toReal)
    exact (EReal.tendsto_toReal hx.1 hx.2).comp he
  have hlim_outside : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict (Ω : Set E)ᶜ,
      Tendsto (fun n => φ x * f n x) atTop (𝓝 (φ x * (u x).toReal)) := by
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem Ω.isOpen.measurableSet.compl fun x hx => ?_
    simp [hφzero x hx]
  have hlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ,
      Tendsto (fun n => φ x * f n x) atTop (𝓝 (φ x * (u x).toReal)) :=
    ae_of_ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_compl (Ω : Set E) hlim_inside hlim_outside
  have hintegral : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, φ x * f n x ∂μ) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ x, φ x * (u x).toReal ∂μ)) :=
    tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence bound
      (fun n => (hφfn n).aestronglyMeasurable) hbound_int hbound hlim
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hf.2.2.2 φ) hintegral

name: PshLines.Regularization.convolutionRightIteratedCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem convolutionRightIteratedCLM_apply
    (L : E →L[𝕜] E' →L[𝕜] F) (n : ℕ) (u : E)
    (A : G [×n]→L[𝕜] E') (m : Fin n → G) :
    convolutionRightIteratedCLM (G := G) L n u A m = L u (A m)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: PshLines.Regularization.hasCompactSupport_iteratedFDeriv_apply
statement:
theorem hasCompactSupport_iteratedFDeriv_apply
    {g : G → E'} (hcg : HasCompactSupport g) (n : ℕ)
    (m : Fin n → G) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x ↦ iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n g x m)
proof:
:= by
  apply HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact
    (hcg.iteratedFDeriv (𝕜 := 𝕜) n)
  intro x hx
  apply subset_tsupport
  intro hzero
  exact hx (by simp only [hzero, zero_apply])

name: PshLines.Regularization.iteratedFDeriv_convolution_right_apply
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_convolution_right_apply
    (L : E →L[𝕜] E' →L[𝕜] F) {f : G → E} {g : G → E'}
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ) (hcg : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hg : ContDiff 𝕜 (⊤ : ℕ∞) g) (n : ℕ) (x : G)
    (m : Fin n → G) :
    iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n (f ⋆[L, μ] g) x m =
      ∫ t, L (f t) (iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n g (x - t) m) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero =>
      simp only [iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply, convolution_def]
  | succ n ih =>
      let q : Fin n → G := Fin.tail m
      let h : G → E' := fun y ↦ iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n g y q
      have hhcompact : HasCompactSupport h :=
        hasCompactSupport_iteratedFDeriv_apply (𝕜 := 𝕜) hcg n q
      have hhsmooth : ContDiff 𝕜 (⊤ : ℕ∞) h := by
        have hiter : ContDiff 𝕜 (⊤ : ℕ∞)
            (iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n g) := hg.iteratedFDeriv_right
          (m := ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω)) (i := n) (by
            change (((⊤ : ℕ∞) + (n : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω) ≤
              ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω)
            exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
        let ev : (G [×n]→L[𝕜] E') →L[𝕜] E' :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply 𝕜 (fun _ : Fin n ↦ G) E' q
        exact ev.contDiff.comp hiter
      have hhsmooth1 : ContDiff 𝕜 1 h := hhsmooth.of_le (by norm_num)
      have hconvSmooth : ContDiff 𝕜 (⊤ : ℕ∞) (f ⋆[L, μ] g) :=
        hcg.contDiff_convolution_right L hf hg
      have hdiffIterated : DifferentiableAt 𝕜
          (iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n (f ⋆[L, μ] g)) x :=
        (hconvSmooth.differentiable_iteratedFDeriv (by
          exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr
            (ENat.natCast_lt_top n))).differentiableAt
      rw [hdiffIterated.iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left']
      have heq :
          (fun y ↦ iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n (f ⋆[L, μ] g) y q) =
            f ⋆[L, μ] h := by
        funext y
        rw [ih y q]
        rfl
      rw [heq]
      have hderiv := hhcompact.hasFDerivAt_convolution_right
        L hf hhsmooth1 x
      rw [hderiv.fderiv]
      rw [convolution_precompR_apply L hf (hhcompact.fderiv 𝕜)
        (hhsmooth1.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero) x (m 0)]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with t
      congr 1
      have hgdiff : DifferentiableAt 𝕜
          (iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n g) (x - t) :=
        (hg.differentiable_iteratedFDeriv (by
          exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr
            (ENat.natCast_lt_top n))).differentiableAt
      exact (hgdiff.iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left' (m := m)).symm

name: PshLines.Regularization.iteratedFDeriv_convolution_right
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_convolution_right
    (L : E →L[𝕜] E' →L[𝕜] F) {f : G → E} {g : G → E'}
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ) (hcg : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hg : ContDiff 𝕜 (⊤ : ℕ∞) g) (n : ℕ) (x : G) :
    iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n (f ⋆[L, μ] g) x =
      (f ⋆[convolutionRightIteratedCLM (G := G) L n, μ]
        iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n g) x
proof:
:= by
  have hgcont : Continuous (iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n g) :=
    hg.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by
      exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr
        (le_top : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞)))
  have hint : Integrable (fun t ↦
      convolutionRightIteratedCLM (G := G) L n (f t)
        (iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n g (x - t))) μ :=
    (hcg.iteratedFDeriv (𝕜 := 𝕜) n).convolutionExists_right
      (convolutionRightIteratedCLM (G := G) L n) hf hgcont x
  ext m
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_convolution_right_apply L hf hcg hg n x m,
    convolution_def, ContinuousMultilinearMap.integral_apply hint]
  rfl

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialCumulativeSign.explicitRadialKernelSqProfile_nonneg
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernelSqProfile_nonneg
    {n : ℕ} (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR j s
proof:
:= by
  exact div_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _)
    (explicitRadialRaw_integral_pos (n := n) R hR j).le

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialCumulativeSign.explicitRadialKernelSqProfile_scale
statement:
theorem explicitRadialKernelSqProfile_scale
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR b s =
      (((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ (2 * n) *
        explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR a
          (((((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2) * s)
proof:
:= by
  let i : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
  let x : ComplexModel n :=
    EuclideanSpace.single i (Real.sqrt s : ℂ)
  let q : ℝ := ((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)
  have hq : 0 < q := by
    dsimp [q]
    positivity
  have hx : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = s := by
    simp [x, Real.sq_sqrt hs]
  have hqx : ‖q • x‖ ^ 2 = q ^ 2 * s := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hq, mul_pow, hx]
  have hscale := explicitRadialKernel_scale (n := n) R hR a b x
  rw [explicitRadialKernel_eq_sqProfile_norm_sq,
    explicitRadialKernel_eq_sqProfile_norm_sq,
    finrank_real_complexModel, hx, hqx] at hscale
  exact hscale

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialCumulativeSign.radialKernelWeightedCumulative_scale
statement:
theorem radialKernelWeightedCumulative_scale
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (a b : ℕ)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    radialKernelWeightedCumulative n R hR b s =
      radialKernelWeightedCumulative n R hR a
        (((((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2) * s)
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := ((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)
  let c : ℝ := q ^ 2
  have hq : 0 < q := by
    dsimp [q]
    positivity
  have hc : 0 < c := by
    dsimp [c]
    positivity
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => t ^ (n - 1) *
    explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR a t
  calc
    radialKernelWeightedCumulative n R hR b s =
        ∫ t in 0..s, c * f (c * t) := by
      rw [radialKernelWeightedCumulative]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro t ht
      have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := (uIcc_of_le hs).symm ▸ ht |>.1
      change t ^ (n - 1) *
          explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR b t =
        c * ((c * t) ^ (n - 1) *
          explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR a (c * t))
      rw [explicitRadialKernelSqProfile_scale hn R hR a b ht0]
      dsimp [f, c, q]
      have hn' : n = n - 1 + 1 := by omega
      have hpow : (((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ (2 * n) =
          ((((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2) ^ n :=
        pow_mul _ 2 n
      rw [hpow]
      rw [congrArg (fun k : ℕ =>
        ((((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2) ^ k) hn']
      rw [pow_succ, mul_pow]
      ring
    _ = c * ∫ t in 0..s, f (c * t) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    _ = ∫ t in 0..c * s, f t := by
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_zero] using
        (intervalIntegral.smul_integral_comp_mul_left
          (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := s) f c)
    _ = radialKernelWeightedCumulative n R hR a (c * s) := by
      rfl

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialCumulativeSign.radialKernelWeightedCumulative_mono
statement:
theorem radialKernelWeightedCumulative_mono
    {n : ℕ} (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (j : ℕ)
    {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    radialKernelWeightedCumulative n R hR j s ≤
      radialKernelWeightedCumulative n R hR j t
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => u ^ (n - 1) *
    explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR j u
  have hfcont : Continuous f :=
    (continuous_id.pow _).mul
      (explicitRadialKernelSqProfile_contDiff R hR j).continuous
  have hf_nonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioc 0 t)] f := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioc] with u hu
    simpa [f] using mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hu.1.le _)
      (explicitRadialKernelSqProfile_nonneg R hR j u)
  unfold radialKernelWeightedCumulative
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_mono_interval le_rfl hs hst
    hf_nonneg
    (hfcont.intervalIntegrable 0 t)

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialCumulativeSign.radialWeightedCumulative_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_nonpos
statement:
theorem radialWeightedCumulative_explicitRadialKernelSqDifference_nonpos
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    radialWeightedCumulative n
      (explicitRadialKernelSqDifference (n := n) R hR a b) s ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := ((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)
  have hq : 1 ≤ q := by
    dsimp [q]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (a : ℝ) + 1)]
    have hab' : (a : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hab
    linarith
  have hqs : s ≤ q ^ 2 * s := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (q - 1)]
  have hmono := radialKernelWeightedCumulative_mono
    (n := n) R hR a hs hqs
  rw [← radialKernelWeightedCumulative_scale hn R hR a b hs] at hmono
  have hka : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (n - 1) *
        explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR a t)
      volume 0 s :=
    ((continuous_id.pow _).mul
      (explicitRadialKernelSqProfile_contDiff R hR a).continuous).intervalIntegrable 0 s
  have hkb : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (n - 1) *
        explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR b t)
      volume 0 s :=
    ((continuous_id.pow _).mul
      (explicitRadialKernelSqProfile_contDiff R hR b).continuous).intervalIntegrable 0 s
  change (∫ t in 0..s, t ^ (n - 1) *
    (explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR a t -
      explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR b t)) ≤ 0
  rw [show (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (n - 1) *
      (explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR a t -
        explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR b t)) =
      fun t => t ^ (n - 1) *
          explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR a t -
        t ^ (n - 1) *
          explicitRadialKernelSqProfile (n := n) R hR b t by
    funext t
    ring]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hka hkb]
  change radialKernelWeightedCumulative n R hR a s -
    radialKernelWeightedCumulative n R hR b s ≤ 0
  linarith

theorem finiteOrderSeminorm_le_norm_finiteJetCLM
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

        (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K)) f ≤
      ‖finiteJetCLM K m f‖

    (x := f) (norm_nonneg (finiteJetCLM K m f))
  intro i hi

proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (norm_finiteJetSpace_le_iff _ (apply_nonneg _ _)).2 fun i ↦ ?_
    have hi : (i : ℕ) ∈ Finset.Iic m :=
      i.property
    simpa [ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm_apply] using
      (Seminorm.le_finset_sup_apply
        (p := ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K)
        (x := f) hi)
  · exact finiteOrderSeminorm_le_norm_finiteJetCLM K m f

name: PshLines.Regularization.exists_finiteJet_extension
statement:
theorem exists_finiteJet_extension
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (K : Compacts E) (m : ℕ)
    (L : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E ℝ ⊤ K →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hL : ∀ f : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E ℝ ⊤ K,
      |L f| ≤ C *
        ((Finset.Iic m).sup
          (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K)) f) :
    ∃ G : FiniteJetSpace E m →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      ∀ f : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E ℝ ⊤ K,
        G (finiteJetCLM K m f) = L f
proof:
:= by
  let J := finiteJetCLM K m
  have hJ : Function.Injective J := finiteJetCLM_injective K m
  let e : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E ℝ ⊤ K ≃ₗ[ℝ]
      LinearMap.range J.toLinearMap :=
    LinearEquiv.ofInjective J.toLinearMap hJ
  let F : FiniteJetSpace E m →ₗ.[ℝ] ℝ :=
    { domain := LinearMap.range J.toLinearMap
      toFun := L.comp e.symm.toLinearMap }
  have hF : ∀ x : F.domain, F x ≤ C * ‖(x : FiniteJetSpace E m)‖ := by
    intro x
    have hxval : J (e.symm x) = (x : FiniteJetSpace E m) :=
      LinearEquiv.ofInjective_symm_apply J.toLinearMap x
    calc
      F x = L (e.symm x) := rfl
      _ ≤ |L (e.symm x)| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ C *
          ((Finset.Iic m).sup
            (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K)) (e.symm x) :=
        hL (e.symm x)
      _ ≤ C * ‖J (e.symm x)‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (finiteOrderSeminorm_le_norm_finiteJetCLM K m (e.symm x)) hC
      _ = C * ‖(x : FiniteJetSpace E m)‖ := by
        rw [hxval]
  obtain ⟨g, hgF, hgN⟩ := exists_extension_of_le_sublinear F
    (fun x ↦ C * ‖x‖)
    (fun c hc x ↦ by
      simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hc.le]
      ring)
    (fun x y ↦ by
      nlinarith [norm_add_le x y])
    hF
  have hg : ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ := by
    intro x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
    refine ⟨?_, hgN x⟩
    have h := hgN (-x)
    simp only [map_neg, norm_neg] at h
    linarith
  refine ⟨g.mkContinuous C hg, fun f ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := hgF (e f)
  simpa [F, e, J] using h

name: PshLines.Regularization.exists_finiteJet_distribution_extension
statement:
theorem exists_finiteJet_distribution_extension
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (T : Distribution Ω ℝ ⊤) (K : Compacts E)
    (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (G : FiniteJetSpace E m →L[ℝ] ℝ),
      ∀ f : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E ℝ ⊤ K,
        G (finiteJetCLM K m f) =
          T (TestFunction.ofSupportedIn hKΩ f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, C, _hC, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_finite_order_seminorm_bound_on_compact T K hKΩ
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := exists_finiteJet_extension K m
    (T.comp (TestFunction.ofSupportedInCLM ℝ hKΩ)).toLinearMap
    (C : ℝ) C.coe_nonneg (fun f ↦ by
      change |T (TestFunction.ofSupportedIn hKΩ f)| ≤
        (C : ℝ) *
          ((Finset.Iic m).sup
            (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K)) f
      exact hbound f)
  exact ⟨m, G, fun f ↦ by
    exact hG f⟩

name: PshLines.Regularization.translationFirstRemainder_contDiff
statement:
theorem translationFirstRemainder_contDiff
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (κ : E → ℝ) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (z h : E) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
      (translationFirstRemainder κ z h)
proof:
:= by
  have hκz : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun y ↦ κ (y - z)) :=
    hκ.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  have hκzh : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun y ↦ κ (y - (z + h))) :=
    hκ.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  have hfd : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fderiv ℝ κ) :=
    hκ.fderiv_right (by simp)
  have hjet : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)
      (fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ κ (y - z) (-h)) :=
    (hfd.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)).clm_apply contDiff_const
  exact (hκzh.sub hκz).sub hjet

statement:
@[simp]
theorem cutoffTranslationFirstRemainderSupportedIn_apply
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)

    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (z h y : E) :
    cutoffTranslationFirstRemainderSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z h y =
      χ y * translationFirstRemainder κ z h y
proof:
:= by
  simp [cutoffTranslationFirstRemainderSupportedIn,
    cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn_apply,
    cutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetLM_apply,
    cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn_apply,
    translationFirstRemainder, iteratedFDeriv_one_apply]
  ring

name: PshLines.Regularization.cutoffTranslationFirstRemainder_seminorm_le
statement:
theorem cutoffTranslationFirstRemainder_seminorm_le
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (z h : E) (r : ℕ)
    (A B : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA0 : ∀ i ≤ r, 0 ≤ A i) (hB0 : ∀ j ≤ r, 0 ≤ B j)
    (hA : ∀ i ≤ r, ∀ y ∈ (K : Set E),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (χ : E → ℝ) y‖ ≤ A i)
    (hB : ∀ j ≤ r, ∀ y ∈ (K : Set E),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (translationFirstRemainder κ z h) y‖ ≤ B j) :
    ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K r
        (cutoffTranslationFirstRemainderSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z h) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
        (r.choose i : ℝ) * A i * B (r - i)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
      (r.choose i : ℝ) * A i * B (r - i) := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i hi
    have hir : i ≤ r := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    have hri : r - i ≤ r := Nat.sub_le r i
    exact mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hA0 i hir)) (hB0 (r - i) hri)
  rw [ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm_top_le_iff ℝ hsum0]
  intro y hy
  have hfun :
      (cutoffTranslationFirstRemainderSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z h : E → ℝ) =
        fun q ↦ χ q * translationFirstRemainder κ z h q := by
    funext q
    exact cutoffTranslationFirstRemainderSupportedIn_apply
      χ κ hκ K hχK z h q
  rw [hfun]
  refine (norm_iteratedFDeriv_mul_le χ.contDiff
    (translationFirstRemainder_contDiff κ hκ z h) y (by
      change ((↑r : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω)
      exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)).trans ?_
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i hi
  have hir : i ≤ r := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  have hri : r - i ≤ r := Nat.sub_le r i
  calc
    (r.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (χ : E → ℝ) y‖ *
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (r - i) (translationFirstRemainder κ z h) y‖ ≤
      (r.choose i : ℝ) * A i *
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (r - i) (translationFirstRemainder κ z h) y‖ := by
      gcongr
      exact hA i hir y hy
    _ ≤ (r.choose i : ℝ) * A i * B (r - i) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hB (r - i) hri y hy)
        (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hA0 i hir))

name: PshLines.Regularization.cutoffTranslationFirstRemainder_seminorm_isLittleO
statement:
theorem cutoffTranslationFirstRemainder_seminorm_isLittleO
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (z : E) (r : ℕ)
    (A : ℕ → ℝ) (B : ℕ → E → ℝ)
    (hA0 : ∀ i ≤ r, 0 ≤ A i)
    (hA : ∀ i ≤ r, ∀ y ∈ (K : Set E),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (χ : E → ℝ) y‖ ≤ A i)
    (hB0 : ∀ j ≤ r, ∀ h, 0 ≤ B j h)
    (hB : ∀ j ≤ r, ∀ h, ∀ y ∈ (K : Set E),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (translationFirstRemainder κ z h) y‖ ≤ B j h)
    (hBo : ∀ j ≤ r, (B j) =o[𝓝 0] (fun h : E ↦ h)) :
    (fun h : E ↦
      ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K r
        (cutoffTranslationFirstRemainderSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z h))
      =o[𝓝 0] (fun h : E ↦ h)
proof:
:= by
  let Q : E → ℝ := fun h ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
    (r.choose i : ℝ) * A i * B (r - i) h
  have hQo : Q =o[𝓝 0] (fun h : E ↦ h) := by
    dsimp only [Q]
    have hterms : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
        (fun h ↦ (r.choose i : ℝ) * A i * B (r - i) h)
          =o[𝓝 0] (fun h : E ↦ h) := by
      intro i hi
      have hir : i ≤ r := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      have hri : r - i ≤ r := Nat.sub_le r i
      exact (hBo (r - i) hri).const_mul_left ((r.choose i : ℝ) * A i)
    refine (IsLittleO.sum hterms).congr ?_ (fun _ ↦ rfl)
    intro h
    simp
  have hdom :
      (fun h : E ↦
        ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K r
          (cutoffTranslationFirstRemainderSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z h))
        =O[𝓝 0] Q := by
    apply (IsBigOWith.of_bound (c := (1 : ℝ)) ?_).isBigO
    filter_upwards with h
    have hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q h := by
      dsimp only [Q]
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro i hi
      have hir : i ≤ r := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      have hri : r - i ≤ r := Nat.sub_le r i
      exact mul_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hA0 i hir))
        (hB0 (r - i) hri h)
    have hle := cutoffTranslationFirstRemainder_seminorm_le
      χ κ hκ K hχK z h r A (fun j ↦ B j h) hA0
      (fun j hj ↦ hB0 j hj h) hA (fun j hj ↦ hB j hj h)
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (apply_nonneg
        (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K r) _),
      abs_of_nonneg hQ0, one_mul, Q] using hle
  exact hdom.trans_isLittleO hQo

name: PshLines.Regularization.finiteJet_cutoffTranslatedKernel_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem finiteJet_cutoffTranslatedKernel_hasFDerivAt
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (m : ℕ) (z : E) :
    HasFDerivAt
      (fun w ↦ finiteJetCLM K m
        (cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK w))
      (finiteJetCutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetCLM
        χ κ hκ K hχK m z) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero, isLittleO_iff]
  have hrem := cutoffTranslationFirstRemainder_finiteOrderSeminorm_isLittleO_actual
    χ κ hκ K hχK z m
  rw [isLittleO_iff] at hrem
  intro c hc
  filter_upwards [hrem hc] with h hh
  calc
    ‖finiteJetCLM K m
          (cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK (z + h)) -
        finiteJetCLM K m
          (cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z) -
        finiteJetCutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetCLM
          χ κ hκ K hχK m z h‖ =
        ((Finset.Iic m).sup
          (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K))
          (cutoffTranslationFirstRemainderSupportedIn
            χ κ hκ K hχK z h) := by
      change ‖finiteJetCLM K m
          (cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK (z + h)) -
        finiteJetCLM K m
          (cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z) -
        finiteJetCLM K m
          (cutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetLM χ κ hκ K hχK z h)‖ = _
      rw [← map_sub, ← map_sub,
        norm_finiteJetCLM_eq_finiteOrderSeminorm]
      rfl
    _ ≤ c * ‖h‖ := (Real.le_norm_self _).trans hh

name: PshLines.Regularization.continuous_finiteJet_cutoffTranslatedKernel
statement:
theorem continuous_finiteJet_cutoffTranslatedKernel
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (m : ℕ) :
    Continuous (fun z ↦ finiteJetCLM K m
      (cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z))
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun z ↦
    (finiteJet_cutoffTranslatedKernel_hasFDerivAt
      χ κ hκ K hχK m z).continuousAt

@[simp]
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.convolutionTestFunctionSupportedIn_apply

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.integrable_smul_finiteJet_localizedKernel
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.integrable_smul_finiteJet_localizedKernel
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (j : ℕ)
    (φ : 𝓓(D.inner, ℝ)) (m : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun z ↦ φ z • finiteJetCLM D.cutoffCompact m
      (D.localizedKernelSupportedIn j z)) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
  · exact φ.continuous.smul
      (continuous_finiteJet_cutoffTranslatedKernel D.cutoff (D.kernel j)
        (D.kernel_contDiff j) D.cutoffCompact (by rfl) m)
  · exact φ.hasCompactSupport.smul_right

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.smul_finiteJet_localizedKernel_apply
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.smul_finiteJet_localizedKernel_apply
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (j : ℕ)
    (φ : 𝓓(D.inner, ℝ)) (m : ℕ) (z y : E)
    (i : ↑(Finset.Iic m)) (v : Fin (i : ℕ) → E) :
    (φ z • finiteJetCLM D.cutoffCompact m
        (D.localizedKernelSupportedIn j z)) i y v =
      φ z * iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i : ℕ) (D.kernel j) (y - z) v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : φ z = 0
  · simp [hz]
  · have hzinner : z ∈ closure (D.inner : Set E) :=
      subset_closure (φ.tsupport_subset (subset_tsupport φ hz))
    have hfun : (D.localizedKernelSupportedIn j z : E → ℝ) =
        fun q ↦ D.kernel j (q - z) := by
      funext q
      exact D.localizedKernelSupportedIn_eq_kernel j hzinner
    rw [finiteJetSpace_smul_apply, finiteJetCLM_apply,
      BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply,
      ContDiffMapSupportedIn.structureMapCLM_top_apply]
    rw [congrArg (fun f : E → ℝ ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i : ℕ) f y) hfun,
      iteratedFDeriv_comp_sub]
    simp only [smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.finiteJet_convolutionTestFunctionSupportedIn_eq_integral
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.finiteJet_convolutionTestFunctionSupportedIn_eq_integral
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (j : ℕ)
    (φ : 𝓓(D.inner, ℝ)) (m : ℕ) :
    finiteJetCLM D.cutoffCompact m
        (D.convolutionTestFunctionSupportedIn j φ) =
      ∫ z, φ z • finiteJetCLM D.cutoffCompact m
        (D.localizedKernelSupportedIn j z) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let I : E → FiniteJetSpace E m := fun z ↦
    φ z • finiteJetCLM D.cutoffCompact m
      (D.localizedKernelSupportedIn j z)
  have hI : Integrable I μ :=
    D.integrable_smul_finiteJet_localizedKernel j φ m
  ext i y v
  change iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i : ℕ)
      (φ ⋆[ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ, μ] D.kernel j) y v =
    finiteJetEvalCLM m i y v (∫ z, I z ∂μ)
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_convolution_right_apply
    (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ)
    φ.continuous.locallyIntegrable (D.kernel_hasCompactSupport j)
    (D.kernel_contDiff j) (i : ℕ) y v,
    ← (finiteJetEvalCLM m i y v).integral_comp_comm hI]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with z
  simpa only [I, ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul, finiteJetEvalCLM_apply] using
    (D.smul_finiteJet_localizedKernel_apply j φ m z y i v).symm

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.distribution_convolution_transpose
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.distribution_convolution_transpose
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ))
    (j : ℕ) (φ : 𝓓(D.inner, ℝ)) :
    ∫ z, φ z * D.distributionRegularizedValue T j z ∂μ =
      T (TestFunction.ofSupportedIn D.cutoffCompact_subset
        (D.convolutionTestFunctionSupportedIn j φ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, G, hG⟩ := exists_finiteJet_distribution_extension
    T D.cutoffCompact D.cutoffCompact_subset
  let I : E → FiniteJetSpace E m := fun z ↦
    φ z • finiteJetCLM D.cutoffCompact m
      (D.localizedKernelSupportedIn j z)
  have hI : Integrable I μ :=
    D.integrable_smul_finiteJet_localizedKernel j φ m
  calc
    ∫ z, φ z * D.distributionRegularizedValue T j z ∂μ =
        ∫ z, G (I z) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with z
      simp only [I, AdaptedRadialKernelData.distributionRegularizedValue,
        map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hG]
    _ = G (∫ z, I z ∂μ) := G.integral_comp_comm hI
    _ = G (finiteJetCLM D.cutoffCompact m
        (D.convolutionTestFunctionSupportedIn j φ)) := by
      rw [D.finiteJet_convolutionTestFunctionSupportedIn_eq_integral j φ m]
    _ = T (TestFunction.ofSupportedIn D.cutoffCompact_subset
        (D.convolutionTestFunctionSupportedIn j φ)) := hG _

name: PshLines.Regularization.exists_testFunction_eq_one_nhds_compact
statement:
theorem exists_testFunction_eq_one_nhds_compact
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {Ω : Opens E} {K : Set E}
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω) :
    ∃ χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ),
      (∀ᶠ x in 𝓝ˢ K, χ x = 1) ∧ ∀ x, χ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hVo, hKV, hVΩ, hVc⟩ :=
    exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hK Ω.isOpen hKΩ
  have hKintV : K ⊆ interior V := by simpa [hVo.interior_eq] using hKV
  obtain ⟨f, hfK, hfV, hfrange⟩ :=
    exists_contMDiffMap_one_nhds_of_subset_interior
      (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) (𝓘(ℝ, E)) hK.isClosed hKintV
  have hsupp : Function.support f ⊆ V := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hxV
    exact hx (hfV x hxV)
  let χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ) :=
    ⟨f, f.contMDiff.contDiff,
      HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact hVc
        (hsupp.trans subset_closure),
      (closure_mono hsupp).trans hVΩ⟩
  exact ⟨χ, hfK, hfrange⟩
