name: PshLines.Regularization.exists_adaptedRadialKernelData
proof:
:= by
  let AReal : E ≃L[ℝ] ComplexModel (Module.finrank ℂ E) :=
    ((adaptedComplexModelEquiv (E := E)).toLinearEquiv.restrictScalars ℝ).toContinuousLinearEquiv
  obtain ⟨R, hR, U, K, hxU, hUΩ, hKΩ, hbuffer⟩ :=
    exists_open_closure_coordinateBall_neighborhood AReal hx
  obtain ⟨χ, hχK, hχrange⟩ :=
    exists_testFunction_eq_one_nhds_compact K.isCompact hKΩ
  refine ⟨{
    radius := R

    center_mem := hxU
    inner_le := hUΩ
    compact_subset := hKΩ

    cutoff := χ
    cutoff_one_on_compact := ?_
    cutoff_mem_Icc := hχrange }⟩
  intro y hy
  exact hχK.self_of_nhdsSet y hy

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.kernel_eq_of_finrank_complex_eq_zero
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.kernel_eq_of_finrank_complex_eq_zero
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (hE : Module.finrank ℂ E = 0)
    (a b : ℕ) : D.kernel a = D.kernel b
proof:
:= by
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℂ E := finiteDimensional_complex_of_real
  let _ : Subsingleton E := Module.finrank_zero_iff.mp hE
  funext y
  have hs := D.kernel_scale a b y
  have hdim :
      Module.finrank ℝ (ComplexModel (Module.finrank ℂ E)) = 0 := by
    rw [hE]
    exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
  have hpoint :
      adaptedComplexModelEquiv.symm
          (((((b : ℝ) + 1) / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) •
            adaptedComplexModelEquiv y) = y :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hdim, pow_zero, one_mul, hpoint] at hs
  exact hs.symm

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialKernelData.cutoffTranslatedTestFunction_eq_kernel
statement:
theorem AdaptedRadialKernelData.cutoffTranslatedTestFunction_eq_kernel
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [IsScalarTower ℝ ℂ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {μ : Measure E} [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {Ω : Opens E} {x : E}
    (D : AdaptedRadialKernelData μ Ω x) (j : ℕ) {z y : E}
    (hz : z ∈ closure (D.inner : Set E)) :
    cutoffTranslatedTestFunction D.cutoff (D.kernel j) (D.kernel_contDiff j) z y =
      D.kernel j (y - z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cutoffTranslatedTestFunction_apply]
  by_cases hkernel : D.kernel j (y - z) = 0
  · simp [hkernel]
  have hsupport : y - z ∈ tsupport (D.kernel j) :=
    subset_tsupport (D.kernel j) hkernel
  have hcoordinate := D.kernel_tsupport_subset j hsupport
  have hscale : D.radius / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≤ D.radius := by
    have hj : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) + 1 := by norm_num
    exact div_le_self D.radius_pos.le hj
  have hcutoff : D.cutoff y = 1 :=
    D.cutoff_eq_one_of_coordinate_displacement hz (hcoordinate.trans hscale)
  rw [hcutoff, one_mul]

name: PshLines.Regularization.exists_finite_seminorm_bound_on_compact
statement:
theorem exists_finite_seminorm_bound_on_compact
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (K : Compacts E)
    (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω) :
    ∃ (s : Finset ℕ) (C : ℝ≥0), C ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ φ : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E ℝ ⊤ K,
        |T (TestFunction.ofSupportedIn hKΩ φ)| ≤
          (C : ℝ) *
            (s.sup (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K)) φ
proof:
:= by
  let TK := T.comp (TestFunction.ofSupportedInCLM ℝ hKΩ)
  let q : Seminorm ℝ (ContDiffMapSupportedIn E ℝ ⊤ K) :=
    (normSeminorm ℝ ℝ).comp TK.toLinearMap
  have hq : Continuous q := continuous_norm.comp TK.continuous
  obtain ⟨s, C, hC, hbound⟩ := Seminorm.bound_of_continuous
    (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.withSeminorms ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K) q hq
  refine ⟨s, C, hC, fun φ ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := hbound φ
  change |T ((TestFunction.ofSupportedInCLM ℝ hKΩ) φ)| ≤
    (C : ℝ) * (s.sup (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K)) φ
  change |T ((TestFunction.ofSupportedInCLM ℝ hKΩ) φ)| ≤
    (C : ℝ) * (s.sup (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K)) φ at h
  exact h

name: PshLines.Regularization.exists_finite_order_seminorm_bound_on_compact
statement:
theorem exists_finite_order_seminorm_bound_on_compact
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (K : Compacts E)
    (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (C : ℝ≥0), C ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ φ : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E ℝ ⊤ K,
        |T (TestFunction.ofSupportedIn hKΩ φ)| ≤
          (C : ℝ) *
            ((Finset.Iic m).sup
              (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K)) φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, C, hC, hbound⟩ := exists_finite_seminorm_bound_on_compact T K hKΩ
  refine ⟨s.sup id, C, hC, fun φ ↦ (hbound φ).trans ?_⟩
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ C.coe_nonneg
  have hseminorm :
      s.sup (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K) ≤
        (Finset.Iic (s.sup id)).sup
          (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K) :=
    Finset.sup_mono s.subset_Iic_sup_id
  exact hseminorm φ

name: PshLines.Regularization.exists_uniform_taylor_remainder_bound_on_compact
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_taylor_remainder_bound_on_compact
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (f : E → F) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) {C : Set E} (hC : IsCompact C) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x ∈ C, ∀ h : E, ‖h‖ < δ →
      ‖f (x + h) - f x - fderiv ℝ f x h‖ ≤ ε * ‖h‖
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  have hcompact : IsCompact (Metric.cthickening 1 C) := hC.cthickening
  have hdf : Continuous (fderiv ℝ f) :=
    (hf.fderiv_right (m := 0) (by norm_num)).continuous
  have huc : UniformContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ f) (Metric.cthickening 1 C) :=
    hcompact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hdf.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hδ₀bound⟩ :=
    (Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp huc) ε hε
  refine ⟨min 1 δ₀, lt_min one_pos hδ₀, ?_⟩
  intro x hx h hh
  have hδ₁ : ‖h‖ < 1 := hh.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδ : ‖h‖ < δ₀ := hh.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hxthick : x ∈ Metric.cthickening 1 C :=
    Metric.self_subset_cthickening C hx
  have hsegment : ∀ y ∈ segment ℝ x (x + h),
      y ∈ Metric.cthickening 1 C := by
    intro y hy
    apply Metric.mem_cthickening_of_dist_le y x 1 C hx
    have hyball : y ∈ Metric.closedBall x (dist x (x + h)) :=
      segment_subset_closedBall_left x (x + h) hy
    exact hyball.trans (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hδ₁.le)
  have hderivBound : ∀ y ∈ segment ℝ x (x + h),
      ‖fderiv ℝ f y - fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ ε := by
    intro y hy
    have hydist : dist y x < δ₀ := by
      have hyball : y ∈ Metric.closedBall x (dist x (x + h)) :=
        segment_subset_closedBall_left x (x + h) hy
      exact hyball.trans_lt (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hδ)
    have := hδ₀bound y (hsegment y hy) x hxthick hydist
    simpa [dist_eq_norm] using this.le
  have hmv := (convex_segment x (x + h)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le'
    (f := f) (φ := fderiv ℝ f x) (C := ε)
    (fun _y _hy => (hf.differentiable (by norm_num)).differentiableAt) hderivBound
    (left_mem_segment ℝ x (x + h)) (right_mem_segment ℝ x (x + h))
  simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using hmv

name: PshLines.Regularization.exists_uniform_iteratedFDeriv_translation_remainder_bound
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_iteratedFDeriv_translation_remainder_bound
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (κ : E → ℝ) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ)
    (K : Compacts E) (z : E) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ y ∈ (K : Set E), ∀ h : E, ‖h‖ < δ →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m κ (y - (z + h)) -
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ m κ (y - z) -
          fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m κ) (y - z) (-h)‖ ≤
        ε * ‖h‖
proof:
:= by
  have hFm : ContDiff ℝ 2 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m κ) :=
    hκ.iteratedFDeriv_right
      (by
        change ((↑(2 + m) : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω)
        exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
  have hcompact : IsCompact ((fun y : E => y - z) '' (K : Set E)) :=
    K.isCompact.image (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_uniform_taylor_remainder_bound_on_compact
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m κ) hFm hcompact ε hε
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro y hy h hh
  have hb := hbound (y - z) ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ (-h) (by simpa using hh)
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hb

name: PshLines.Regularization.cutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetLM_apply
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (z v : E) :
    cutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetLM χ κ hκ K hχK z v =
      cutoffTranslatedKernelJetSupportedIn
        χ κ hκ K hχK 1 z (fun _ => v)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: PshLines.Regularization.hasFDerivAt_linear_of_seminorm_remainder
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_linear_of_seminorm_remainder
    {E A : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [AddCommGroup A] [Module ℝ A]
    (p : Seminorm ℝ A) (L : A →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hL : ∀ a : A, |L a| ≤ C * p a)
    (Φ : E → A) (Ψ : E →ₗ[ℝ] A) (z : E)
    (hrem : (fun h : E => p (Φ (z + h) - Φ z - Ψ h)) =o[𝓝 0]
      (fun h : E => h)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun w => L (Φ w))
      ⟨L.comp Ψ, (L.comp Ψ).continuous_of_finiteDimensional⟩ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero]
  have hb :
      (fun h : E => L (Φ (z + h)) - L (Φ z) - (L.comp Ψ) h) =O[𝓝 0]
        (fun h : E => C * p (Φ (z + h) - Φ z - Ψ h)) := by
    apply (IsBigOWith.of_bound (c := (1 : ℝ)) ?_).isBigO
    filter_upwards with h
    simpa [map_sub, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hC,
      abs_of_nonneg (apply_nonneg p _)]
      using hL (Φ (z + h) - Φ z - Ψ h)
  exact hb.trans_isLittleO (hrem.const_mul_left C)

name: PshLines.Regularization.distributionPairing_hasFDerivAt_of_supSeminorm_remainder
statement:
theorem distributionPairing_hasFDerivAt_of_supSeminorm_remainder
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω) (z : E)
    (hrem : ∀ m : ℕ,
      (fun h : E =>
        ((Finset.Iic m).sup
          (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K))
          (cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK (z + h) -
            cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z -
            cutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetLM χ κ hκ K hχK z h))
        =o[𝓝 0] (fun h : E => h)) :
    HasFDerivAt
      (fun w => distributionOnSupportedInCLM T K hKΩ
        (cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK w))
      ⟨(distributionOnSupportedInCLM T K hKΩ).toLinearMap.comp
          (cutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetLM χ κ hκ K hχK z),
        ((distributionOnSupportedInCLM T K hKΩ).toLinearMap.comp
          (cutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetLM χ κ hκ K hχK z)).continuous_of_finiteDimensional⟩
      z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, C, _hC, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_finite_order_seminorm_bound_on_compact T K hKΩ
  apply hasFDerivAt_linear_of_seminorm_remainder
    ((Finset.Iic m).sup (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K))
    (distributionOnSupportedInCLM T K hKΩ).toLinearMap (C : ℝ) C.coe_nonneg
  · intro φ
    simpa [distributionOnSupportedInCLM_apply] using hbound φ
  · exact hrem m

name: PshLines.Regularization.exists_pshRepresentative
statement:
theorem exists_pshRepresentative
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [IsScalarTower ℝ ℂ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {Ω : Opens E} {T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)}
    (hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi T) :
    ∃ u : E → EReal, IsPshRepresentative μ T u
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_pshRepresentative_of_locally μ
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨U, hUΩ, f, hxU, hf⟩ := exists_local_decreasing_psh_regularization μ hT x hx
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_pshRepresentative_of_decreasing_approximation μ hf
  exact ⟨U, hUΩ, u, hxU, hu⟩

name: PshLines.Regularization.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_iff_exists_pshRepresentative
statement:
theorem hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_iff_exists_pshRepresentative
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [IsScalarTower ℝ ℂ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {Ω : Opens E}
    (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) :
    HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi T ↔ ∃ u : E → EReal, IsPshRepresentative μ T u
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact exists_pshRepresentative μ
  · rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
    exact hu.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.tendsto_everywhere_ereal_of_ae_of_antitone_psh
statement:
theorem tendsto_everywhere_ereal_of_ae_of_antitone_psh
    {U : Opens (ComplexModel n)} {u : ComplexModel n → EReal}
    {f : ℕ → ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u U)
    (hf : ∀ j, PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z ↦ (f j z : EReal)) U)
    (hanti : ∀ z ∈ U, Antitone (fun j ↦ f j z))
    (hae : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume.restrict (U : Set (ComplexModel n)),
      Tendsto (fun j ↦ (f j z : EReal)) atTop (𝓝 (u z))) :
    ∀ z ∈ U, Tendsto (fun j ↦ (f j z : EReal)) atTop (𝓝 (u z))
proof:
:= by
  let g : ComplexModel n → EReal := fun z ↦ ⨅ j, (f j z : EReal)
  have hantiE (z : ComplexModel n) (hz : z ∈ U) :
      Antitone (fun j ↦ (f j z : EReal)) := by
    intro a b hab
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (hanti z hz hab)
  have hgpsh : PlurisubharmonicOn g U := by
    apply DiscPshOn.plurisubharmonicOn_iInf_of_antitone U.isOpen
    · intro j
      exact (hf j).discPshOn
    · exact hantiE
  have hgae : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume.restrict (U : Set (ComplexModel n)),
      g z = u z := by
    filter_upwards [hae, ae_restrict_mem U.isOpen.measurableSet] with z hzlim hzU
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (tendsto_atTop_iInf (hantiE z hzU)) hzlim
  have hgu : EqOn g u U :=
    hgpsh.eqOn_of_ae_eq hu U.isOpen volume hgae
  intro z hz
  rw [← hgu hz]
  exact tendsto_atTop_iInf (hantiE z hz)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.tendsto_everywhere_of_ae_of_antitone_psh
statement:
theorem tendsto_everywhere_of_ae_of_antitone_psh
    {U : Opens (ComplexModel n)} {u : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    {f : ℕ → ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z ↦ (u z : EReal)) U)
    (hf : ∀ j, PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z ↦ (f j z : EReal)) U)
    (hanti : ∀ z ∈ U, Antitone (fun j ↦ f j z))
    (hae : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume.restrict (U : Set (ComplexModel n)),
      Tendsto (fun j ↦ f j z) atTop (𝓝 (u z))) :
    ∀ z ∈ U, Tendsto (fun j ↦ f j z) atTop (𝓝 (u z))
proof:
:= by
  have haeE : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume.restrict (U : Set (ComplexModel n)),
      Tendsto (fun j ↦ (f j z : EReal)) atTop (𝓝 (u z : EReal)) := by
    filter_upwards [hae] with z hzlim
    exact EReal.tendsto_coe.mpr hzlim
  intro z hz
  apply EReal.tendsto_coe.mp
  exact tendsto_everywhere_ereal_of_ae_of_antitone_psh hu hf hanti haeE z hz

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PlurisubharmonicOn.le_circleAverage_of_continuous_majorant
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.le_circleAverage_of_continuous_majorant
    {u : ℂ → EReal} {Ω : Set ℂ} (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω)
    {c : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hD : closedBall c R ⊆ Ω) {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g)
    (hgu : ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, u z ≤ (g z : EReal))
    (happrox : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ h : ℂ → ℝ, HarmonicOnNhd h univ ∧
        ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, |h z - g z| < ε) :
    u c ≤ ((Real.circleAverage g c R : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  have hcΩ : c ∈ Ω := hD (mem_closedBall_self hR.le)
  have hctop : u c ≠ ⊤ := (hu c hcΩ).ne_top
  by_cases hcbot : u c = ⊥
  · simp [hcbot]
  rw [← EReal.coe_toReal hctop hcbot, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
  apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro δ hδ
  let ε : ℝ := δ / 2
  have hε : 0 < ε := div_pos hδ (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨h, hh, happ⟩ := happrox ε hε
  have hhΩ : HarmonicOnNhd h Ω := hh.mono (subset_univ Ω)
  have hsub : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z => u z - (h z : EReal)) Ω :=
    hu.sub_harmonic hhΩ
  have hsphere : ∀ z ∈ sphere c R,
      u z - (h z : EReal) ≤ (ε : EReal) := by
    intro z hz
    have hreal : g z - h z ≤ ε := by
      have := (abs_lt.mp (happ z hz)).1
      linarith
    calc
      u z - (h z : EReal) ≤ (g z : EReal) - (h z : EReal) :=
        EReal.sub_le_sub (hgu z hz) le_rfl
      _ = ((g z - h z : ℝ) : EReal) := by rw [EReal.coe_sub]
      _ ≤ (ε : EReal) := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr hreal
  have hcenter_sub : u c - (h c : EReal) ≤ (ε : EReal) :=
    hsub.le_const_on_closedBall_of_le_on_sphere hR hD hsphere c
      (mem_closedBall_self hR.le)
  have hcenter : u c ≤ ((h c + ε : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    have hle := (EReal.sub_le_iff_le_add
      (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_bot (h c))) (Or.inl (EReal.coe_ne_top (h c)))).mp
      hcenter_sub
    simpa [← EReal.coe_add, add_comm] using hle
  have hhclosed : HarmonicOnNhd h (closedBall c |R|) :=
    hh.mono (subset_univ _)
  have hcircle_h : CircleIntegrable h c R :=
    (hhclosed.continuousOn.mono sphere_subset_closedBall).circleIntegrable'
  have hcircle_g : CircleIntegrable g c R :=
    hg.continuousOn.circleIntegrable'
  have hcircle_const : CircleIntegrable (fun _ : ℂ => ε) c R :=
    circleIntegrable_const ε c R
  have havg : h c ≤ Real.circleAverage g c R + ε := by
    have hmono : Real.circleAverage h c R ≤
        Real.circleAverage (fun z => g z + ε) c R := by
      apply Real.circleAverage_mono hcircle_h (hcircle_g.add hcircle_const)
      intro z hz
      have := (abs_lt.mp (happ z (by simpa [abs_of_pos hR] using hz))).2
      change h z ≤ g z + ε
      linarith
    rw [hhclosed.circleAverage_eq,
      Real.circleAverage_fun_add hcircle_g hcircle_const,
      Real.circleAverage_const] at hmono
    exact hmono
  have hreal_center : (u c).toReal ≤ Real.circleAverage g c R + δ := by
    apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp
    rw [EReal.coe_toReal hctop hcbot]
    refine hcenter.trans ?_
    apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr
    dsimp [ε] at havg ⊢
    linarith
  exact hreal_center

name: PshLines.FirstPass.circleDeficit_coe_eq_mul_finiteDeficit_circleAverage
statement:
theorem circleDeficit_coe_eq_mul_finiteDeficit_circleAverage
    {g : ℂ → ℝ} (c : ℂ) {R C : ℝ}
    (hg : Continuous g)
    (hC : ∀ z ∈ sphere c |R|, g z ≤ C) :
    circleDeficit (fun z => (g z : EReal)) c 1 R C =
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) *
        ((C : EReal) - ((Real.circleAverage g c R : ℝ) : EReal)).toENNReal
proof:
:= by
  have hparam : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => g (c + circleMap 0 R t • (1 : ℂ))) := by
    fun_prop
  have hC' : ∀ t : ℝ, g (c + circleMap 0 R t • (1 : ℂ)) ≤ C := by
    intro t
    simpa [circleMap] using hC (circleMap c R t) (circleMap_mem_sphere' c R t)
  rw [circleDeficit_coe_eq c 1 R C (hparam.intervalIntegrable _ _) hC']
  have hmap : (fun t : ℝ => g (c + circleMap 0 R t • (1 : ℂ))) =
      fun t : ℝ => g (circleMap c R t) := by
    funext t
    congr 1
    simp only [circleMap, zero_add, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [← EReal.coe_sub, EReal.real_coe_toENNReal,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.pi)]
  congr 1
  rw [hmap]
  rw [Real.circleAverage]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.circleDeficit_coe_le_of_le_circleAverage
statement:
theorem circleDeficit_coe_le_of_le_circleAverage
    {g : ℂ → ℝ} (c : ℂ) {R C : ℝ} (w : EReal)
    (hg : Continuous g)
    (hC : ∀ z ∈ sphere c |R|, g z ≤ C)
    (hw : w ≤ ((Real.circleAverage g c R : ℝ) : EReal)) :
    circleDeficit (fun z => (g z : EReal)) c 1 R C ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * ((C : EReal) - w).toENNReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleDeficit_coe_eq_mul_finiteDeficit_circleAverage c hg hC]
  gcongr
  exact EReal.toENNReal_le_toENNReal (EReal.sub_le_sub le_rfl hw)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.circleSubmean_of_continuous_antitone_majorants
statement:
theorem circleSubmean_of_continuous_antitone_majorants
    {w : ℂ → EReal} (c : ℂ) {R C : ℝ} (g : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ n, Continuous (g n))
    (hC : ∀ n, ∀ z ∈ sphere c |R|, g n z ≤ C)
    (hanti : ∀ t : ℝ, Antitone fun n =>
      (g n (c + circleMap 0 R t) : EReal))
    (hinf : ∀ t : ℝ, (⨅ n, (g n (c + circleMap 0 R t) : EReal)) =
      w (c + circleMap 0 R t))
    (hcenter : ∀ n, w c ≤ ((Real.circleAverage (g n) c R : ℝ) : EReal)) :
    circleDeficit w c 1 R C ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * ((C : EReal) - w c).toENNReal
proof:
:= by
  let u : ℕ → ℂ → EReal := fun n z => (g n z : EReal)
  have hm : ∀ n, Measurable fun t : ℝ =>
      ((C : EReal) - u n (c + circleMap 0 R t • (1 : ℂ))).toENNReal := by
    intro n
    exact (continuous_finiteDeficit C).measurable.comp
      (continuous_coe_real_ereal.comp (by fun_prop)).measurable
  have hanti' : ∀ t : ℝ, Antitone fun n =>
      u n (c + circleMap 0 R t • (1 : ℂ)) := by
    simpa [u] using hanti
  have hdef : circleDeficit w c 1 R C =
      ⨆ n, circleDeficit (u n) c 1 R C := by
    rw [← circleDeficit_iInf_of_antitone_of_measurable c 1 C hm hanti']
    unfold circleDeficit
    apply lintegral_congr
    intro t
    simp only [u, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [hinf t]
  rw [hdef]
  apply iSup_le
  intro n
  exact circleDeficit_coe_le_of_le_circleAverage c (w c) (hg n) (hC n)
    (hcenter n)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.associatedMetric_self_pos
proof: := ha u hu

name: PshLines.FirstPass.flatFundamentalForm_isOneOne
statement:
theorem flatFundamentalForm_isOneOne (n : ℕ) :
    IsOneOne (Kahler.fundamentalFormAlt : (ComplexModel n) [⋀^Fin 2]→L[ℝ] ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v
  simpa only [Kahler.fundamentalFormAlt_apply, Kahler.complexStructure, Matrix.cons_val_zero,

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PlurisubharmonicOn.circleSubmean_of_closedBall_subset_of_harmonicApproximation
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.circleSubmean_of_closedBall_subset_of_harmonicApproximation
    (hHA : HasGlobalHarmonicCircleApproximation)
    {u : ℂ → EReal} {Ω : Set ℂ} (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω)
    {c : ℂ} {R C : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hD : closedBall c R ⊆ Ω)
    (hC : ∀ z ∈ closedBall c R, u z ≤ (C : EReal)) :
    circleDeficit u c 1 R C ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * ((C : EReal) - u c).toENNReal
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set ℂ := sphere c R
  have hK : IsCompact K := isCompact_sphere c R
  have hKne : K.Nonempty := by
    let z : ℂ := c + (R : ℂ)
    exact ⟨z, by simp [K, z, abs_of_pos hR]⟩
  have hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω := by
    intro z hz
    exact hD (sphere_subset_closedBall hz)
  have husc : UpperSemicontinuousOn u K :=
    hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.mono hKΩ
  have htop : ∀ z ∈ K, u z ≠ ⊤ := fun z hz => (hu z (hKΩ hz)).ne_top
  have hCK : ∀ z ∈ K, u z ≤ (C : EReal) :=
    fun z hz => hC z (sphere_subset_closedBall hz)
  let g : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ := fun n => uscSupConvolution K u C n
  have hg : ∀ n, Continuous (g n) := fun n =>
    continuous_uscSupConvolution hKne htop hCK n
  have hgu : ∀ n z, z ∈ K → u z ≤ (g n z : EReal) := fun n z hz =>
    le_coe_uscSupConvolution hKne htop hCK n hz
  have hgC : ∀ n z, g n z ≤ C := fun n z =>
    uscSupConvolution_le hKne htop hCK n z
  have hganti : ∀ z, Antitone fun n => g n z := fun z =>
    uscSupConvolution_antitone hKne htop hCK z
  have hginf : ∀ z, z ∈ K → (⨅ n : ℕ, (g n z : EReal)) = u z :=
    fun z hz => iInf_coe_uscSupConvolution hKne husc htop hCK hz
  have hcenter : ∀ n, u c ≤ ((Real.circleAverage (g n) c R : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    intro n
    apply PshLines.FirstPass.PlurisubharmonicOn.le_circleAverage_of_continuous_majorant
      hu hR hD (hg n)
    · intro z hz
      exact hgu n z hz
    · intro ε hε
      simpa [abs_of_pos hR] using hHA c hR.ne' (g n) (hg n) ε hε
  apply circleSubmean_of_continuous_antitone_majorants c g hg
  · intro n z _
    exact hgC n z
  · intro t m n hmn
    apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr
    exact hganti (c + circleMap 0 R t) hmn
  · intro t
    have hz : c + circleMap 0 R t ∈ K := by
      simpa [K, circleMap] using circleMap_mem_sphere c hR.le t
    exact hginf _ hz
  · exact hcenter

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PlurisubharmonicOn.discPshOn_of_harmonicApproximation
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.discPshOn_of_harmonicApproximation
    (hHA : HasGlobalHarmonicCircleApproximation)
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    {u : E → EReal} {U : Set E} (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u U) :
    DiscPshOn u U
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x hx => (hu x hx).ne_top, hu.upperSemicontinuousOn, ?_⟩
  intro x v r hr hD C hC
  let L : ℂ →L[ℂ] E := (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ).smulRight v
  let Ω : Set ℂ := (fun z => x + L z) ⁻¹' U
  let w : ℂ → EReal := fun z => u (x + L z)
  have hw : PlurisubharmonicOn w Ω := hu.comp_affine L x
  have hclosed : closedBall 0 r ⊆ Ω := by
    intro z hz
    apply hD
    exact ⟨z, hz, by simp [L]⟩
  have hwC : ∀ z ∈ closedBall 0 r, w z ≤ (C : EReal) := by
    intro z hz
    apply hC
    exact ⟨z, hz, by simp [L]⟩
  have hsub :=
    PshLines.FirstPass.PlurisubharmonicOn.circleSubmean_of_closedBall_subset_of_harmonicApproximation
      hHA hw hr hclosed hwC
  change circleDeficit (fun z => u (x + L z)) 0 1 r C ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) *
      ((C : EReal) - u (x + L 0)).toENNReal at hsub
  rw [circleDeficit_comp_affine u L x] at hsub
  simpa [L] using hsub

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.complexTopCoefficient_eq
statement:
theorem complexTopCoefficient_eq (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    complexTopCoefficient H = ((n.factorial : ℝ) / Real.pi ^ n : ℝ) * H.det
proof:
:= by
  have hpi : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
  have hc : Complex.I / (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) * (-2 * Complex.I) =
      (Real.pi : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
    simp [Complex.I_sq]
  unfold complexTopCoefficient
  calc
    _ = (n.factorial : ℂ) *
        (Complex.I / (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) * (-2 * Complex.I)) ^ n * H.det := by
          rw [mul_pow (Complex.I / (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) (-2 * Complex.I)]
          ac_rfl
    _ = _ := by rw [hc]; simp [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.complexHessian_isHermitian
statement:
theorem complexHessian_isHermitian {u : ComplexModel n → ℝ} {z : ComplexModel n}
    (hu : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 u z) : (complexHessian u z).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  have hs (a b : ComplexModel n) : realHessian u z a b = realHessian u z b a := by
    simpa only [realHessian_eq_fderiv] using hu.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by norm_num) a b
  ext j k
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, complexHessian,
      hs (coordinateVector k) (coordinateVector j),
      hs (Complex.I • coordinateVector k) (Complex.I • coordinateVector j),
      hs (coordinateVector k) (Complex.I • coordinateVector j),
      hs (Complex.I • coordinateVector k) (coordinateVector j)]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.complexHessian_norm_sq
statement:
@[simp] theorem complexHessian_norm_sq (z : ComplexModel n) :
    complexHessian (fun w : ComplexModel n => ‖w‖ ^ 2) z = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext j k
  by_cases h : j = k
  · subst k
    norm_num [complexHessian, realHessian_norm_sq, coordinateVector, PiLp.inner_apply,
      apply_ite, norm_smul, Complex.norm_I]
  · simp [complexHessian, realHessian_norm_sq, coordinateVector, PiLp.inner_apply,
      apply_ite, h, Ne.symm h]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.IsSmoothPshOn.constantApproximation
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ => hu, fun _ _ _ _ _ => le_rfl, fun _ _ => tendsto_const_nhds⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.coefficientSemipositive_zero
statement:
theorem coefficientSemipositive_zero :
    CoefficientSemipositive (0 : (ComplexModel n) [⋀^Fin 2]→L[ℝ] ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  exact le_refl 0

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.coefficientSemipositive_add
statement:
theorem coefficientSemipositive_add
    {a b : (ComplexModel n) [⋀^Fin 2]→L[ℝ] ℝ}
    (ha : CoefficientSemipositive a) (hb : CoefficientSemipositive b) :
    CoefficientSemipositive (a + b)
proof: := fun v => add_nonneg (ha v) (hb v)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.coefficientSemipositive_smul
proof: := fun v => mul_nonneg hc (ha v)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.KahlerBackground.isSemipositive
statement:
theorem KahlerBackground.isSemipositive (omega : KahlerBackground n M) :
    omega.form.val.IsSemipositive
proof:
:= by
  intro e z hz v
  by_cases hv : v = 0
  · subst v
    rw [(omega.form.val.coeff e z).map_coord_zero (0 : Fin 2) rfl]
  · exact (omega.isKahler.1 e z hz).2 v hv |>.le

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.smoothDDC_sub
statement:
theorem smoothDDC_sub {h f : ComplexModel n → ℝ} {U : Set (ComplexModel n)}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h U) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U)
    {z : ComplexModel n} (hz : z ∈ U) :
    smoothDDC (fun y => h y - f y) z = smoothDDC h z - smoothDDC f z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [smoothDDC_add hU hh hf.neg hz, smoothDDC_neg hU hf hz]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.sub_coe_add_coe
statement:
theorem sub_coe_add_coe (a : EReal) (r s : ℝ) :
    a - (r : EReal) + ((s + r : ℝ) : EReal) = a + (s : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← EReal.coe_neg, add_assoc, ← EReal.coe_add]
  congr 2
  ring

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.thetaPshPotential_sub_smooth
statement:
theorem thetaPshPotential_sub_smooth {θ η : SmoothRealForm n M 2}
    {f : M → ℝ} (hf : ChartSmooth (n := n) f)
    (hθη : ∀ (e : ComplexChart n M) (z : ComplexModel n), z ∈ e.val.target →
      η.coeff e z = θ.coeff e z + smoothDDC (fun y => f (e.val.symm y)) z)
    {u : M → EReal} (hu : IsThetaPshPotential θ u) :
    IsThetaPshPotential η (fun x => u x - (f x : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro e z hz
    obtain ⟨W, ρ, hzW, hρ, hp⟩ := hu.1 e z hz
    refine ⟨W, fun y => ρ y + f (e.val.symm y), hzW, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨hρ.1, hρ.2.1, hρ.2.2.1.add ((hf e).mono hρ.2.1), ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      rw [smoothDDC_add hρ.1 hρ.2.2.1 ((hf e).mono hρ.2.1) hy,
        hρ.2.2.2 hy, hθη e y (hρ.2.1 hy)]
    · have heq : (fun y => chartFunction (fun x => u x - (f x : EReal)) e y +
          ((ρ y + f (e.val.symm y) : ℝ) : EReal)) =
          (fun y => chartFunction u e y + (ρ y : EReal)) := by
        funext y
        exact sub_coe_add_coe _ _ _
      rw [heq]
      exact hp
  · intro x U hU hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hfin⟩ := hu.2 x U hU hx
    refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
    change u y - (f y : EReal) ≠ ⊥
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← EReal.coe_neg]
    exact EReal.add_ne_bot_iff.mpr ⟨hfin, EReal.coe_ne_bot _⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.nefWithRespectTo_of_bottChernRel
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, heq⟩ := hθη
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hpos⟩ := hθ ε hε
  refine ⟨fun x => h x - f x, fun e => (hh e).sub (hf e), ?_⟩
  intro e z hz
  rw [heq e z hz, smoothDDC_sub e.val.open_target (hh e) (hf e) hz]
  convert hpos e z hz using 1
  congr 1
  abel

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.nefWithRespectTo_bottChernRel_iff
proof:
:=
  ⟨nefWithRespectTo_of_bottChernRel omega hθη,
    nefWithRespectTo_of_bottChernRel omega hθη.symm⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.pseudoeffectiveViaPotentials_of_bottChernRel
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, heq⟩ := hθη
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hθ
  exact ⟨fun x => u x - (f x : EReal), thetaPshPotential_sub_smooth hf heq hu⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.pseudoeffectiveViaPotentials_bottChernRel_iff
proof:
:=
  ⟨pseudoeffectiveViaPotentials_of_bottChernRel hθη,
    pseudoeffectiveViaPotentials_of_bottChernRel hθη.symm⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.bigWithRespectToViaPotentials_of_bottChernRel
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hu⟩ := hθ
  have hrel : BottChernRel (θ - ε • omega.form) (η - ε • omega.form) := by
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using hθη.add (BottChernRel.refl (-(ε • omega.form)))
  exact ⟨ε, hε, pseudoeffectiveViaPotentials_of_bottChernRel hrel hu⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.bigWithRespectToViaPotentials_bottChernRel_iff
proof:
:=
  ⟨bigWithRespectToViaPotentials_of_bottChernRel omega hθη,
    bigWithRespectToViaPotentials_of_bottChernRel omega hθη.symm⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.classNefWithRespectTo_ofRepresentative
statement:
@[simp] theorem classNefWithRespectTo_ofRepresentative (omega : KahlerBackground n M)
    (θ : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M) :
    ClassNefWithRespectTo omega (RealBottChern.ofRepresentative θ) ↔ NefWithRespectTo omega θ
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.classPseudoeffectiveViaPotentials_ofRepresentative
statement:
@[simp] theorem classPseudoeffectiveViaPotentials_ofRepresentative
    (θ : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M) :
    ClassPseudoeffectiveViaPotentials (RealBottChern.ofRepresentative θ) ↔
      PseudoeffectiveViaPotentials θ
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.classBigWithRespectToViaPotentials_ofRepresentative
statement:
@[simp] theorem classBigWithRespectToViaPotentials_ofRepresentative (omega : KahlerBackground n M)
    (θ : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M) :
    ClassBigWithRespectToViaPotentials omega (RealBottChern.ofRepresentative θ) ↔
      BigWithRespectToViaPotentials omega θ
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.nefWithRespectTo_of_semipositive
statement:
theorem nefWithRespectTo_of_semipositive (omega : KahlerBackground n M)
    {θ : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M} (hθ : θ.val.IsSemipositive) :
    NefWithRespectTo omega θ
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  refine ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => contDiffOn_const, ?_⟩
  intro e z hz
  rw [smoothDDC_zero, add_zero]
  exact coefficientSemipositive_add (hθ e z hz)
    (coefficientSemipositive_smul hε.le (omega.isSemipositive e z hz))

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.nefWithRespectTo_zero
statement:
theorem nefWithRespectTo_zero (omega : KahlerBackground n M) :
    NefWithRespectTo omega 0
proof:
:=
  nefWithRespectTo_of_semipositive omega (fun _ _ _ => coefficientSemipositive_zero)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.nefWithRespectTo_add
statement:
theorem nefWithRespectTo_add (omega : KahlerBackground n M)
    {θ η : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M}
    (hθ : NefWithRespectTo omega θ) (hη : NefWithRespectTo omega η) :
    NefWithRespectTo omega (θ + η)
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hpos⟩ := hθ (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
  obtain ⟨k, hk, kpos⟩ := hη (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
  refine ⟨fun x => h x + k x, fun e => (hh e).add (hk e), ?_⟩
  intro e z hz v
  rw [coeff_add, smoothDDC_add e.val.open_target (hh e) (hk e) hz]
  have hsum := add_nonneg (hpos e z hz v) (kpos e z hz v)
  simp only [ContinuousAlternatingMap.add_apply, ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul] at hsum ⊢
  linarith

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.nefWithRespectTo_smul
statement:
theorem nefWithRespectTo_smul (omega : KahlerBackground n M)
    {θ : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M} {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hθ : NefWithRespectTo omega θ) :
    NefWithRespectTo omega (c • θ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc with hc0 | hcpos
  · rw [← hc0, zero_smul]
    exact nefWithRespectTo_zero omega
  · intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨h, hh, hpos⟩ := hθ (ε / c) (div_pos hε hcpos)
    refine ⟨fun x => c • h x, fun e => (hh e).const_smul c, ?_⟩
    intro e z hz
    rw [coeff_smul, smoothDDC_smul e.val.open_target (hh e) c hz]
    have heps : c * (ε / c) = ε := by field_simp
    have hscaled := coefficientSemipositive_smul hc (hpos e z hz)
    simpa only [smul_add, smul_smul, heps] using hscaled

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.classNefWithRespectTo_of_semipositive
statement:
theorem classNefWithRespectTo_of_semipositive (omega : KahlerBackground n M)
    {θ : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M} (hθ : θ.val.IsSemipositive) :
    ClassNefWithRespectTo omega (RealBottChern.ofRepresentative θ)
proof:
:=
  nefWithRespectTo_of_semipositive omega hθ

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.classNefWithRespectTo_zero
statement:
theorem classNefWithRespectTo_zero (omega : KahlerBackground n M) :
    ClassNefWithRespectTo omega (0 : RealBottChern n M)
proof: := nefWithRespectTo_zero omega

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.classNefWithRespectTo_add
statement:
theorem classNefWithRespectTo_add (omega : KahlerBackground n M)
    {α β : RealBottChern n M}
    (hα : ClassNefWithRespectTo omega α) (hβ : ClassNefWithRespectTo omega β) :
    ClassNefWithRespectTo omega (α + β)
proof:
:= by
  revert hα hβ
  refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ α β ?_
  intro θ η hθ hη
  exact nefWithRespectTo_add omega hθ hη

name: PshLines.FirstPass.PositiveClasses.classNefWithRespectTo_smul
statement:
theorem classNefWithRespectTo_smul (omega : KahlerBackground n M)
    {α : RealBottChern n M} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hα : ClassNefWithRespectTo omega α) : ClassNefWithRespectTo omega (c • α)
proof:
:= by
  revert hα
  refine Quotient.inductionOn α ?_
  intro θ hθ
  exact nefWithRespectTo_smul omega hc hθ

name: PshLines.FirstPass.mem_complexChartAt_source
statement:
theorem mem_complexChartAt_source (x : M) :
    x ∈ (complexChartAt (n := n) x).val.source
proof:
:=
  mem_chart_source (ComplexModel n) x

name: PshLines.FirstPass.chartTransition_mem_groupoid
statement:
theorem chartTransition_mem_groupoid [IsComplexManifold n M]
    (e f : ComplexChart n M) :
    chartTransition e f ∈ contDiffGroupoid ∞ (𝓘(ℂ, ComplexModel n))
proof:
:=
  StructureGroupoid.compatible _ e.property f.property

name: PshLines.FirstPass.I_smul_conjugateCoordinateCombination
statement:
private theorem I_smul_conjugateCoordinateCombination (x : Fin n → ℂ) :
    Complex.I • conjugateCoordinateCombination x =
      ∑ j, ((x j).im • coordinateVector j +
        (x j).re • (Complex.I • coordinateVector j))
proof:
:= by
  unfold conjugateCoordinateCombination
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  simp only [smul_sub, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := ℂ), smul_smul]
  rw [← sub_smul, ← add_smul]
  congr 1
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp

name: PshLines.FirstPass.complexHessian_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_leviForm
statement:
theorem complexHessian_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_leviForm
    {u : ComplexModel n → ℝ} {z : ComplexModel n}
    (hu : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 u z) (x : Fin n → ℂ) :
    star x ⬝ᵥ ((complexHessian u z).mulVec x) =
      (leviForm u z (conjugateCoordinateCombination x) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [leviForm, Complex.ofReal_re]
    rw [show Complex.I • conjugateCoordinateCombination x = _ from
      I_smul_conjugateCoordinateCombination x]
    simp [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, complexHessian,
      conjugateCoordinateCombination, realHessian_eq_fderiv,
      Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib, smul_eq_mul]
    ring_nf
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    simp only [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    simp only [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  · simpa using (complexHessian_isHermitian hu).im_star_dotProduct_mulVec_self x

name: PshLines.FirstPass.leviForm_nonneg_of_contDiffOn_plurisubharmonicOn
statement:
theorem leviForm_nonneg_of_contDiffOn_plurisubharmonicOn
    {U : Opens (ComplexModel n)} {u : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U)
    (hp : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z ↦ (u z : EReal)) U)
    {z : ComplexModel n} (hz : z ∈ U) (v : ComplexModel n) :
    0 ≤ leviForm u z v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, heq⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_eventuallyEq_of_contDiffOn U.isOpen hs hz
  have hnhd : {y | u y = g y} ∩ (U : Set (ComplexModel n)) ∈ 𝓝 z :=
    inter_mem heq (U.isOpen.mem_nhds hz)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnhd
  have hballEq : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z ε, u y = g y :=
    fun y hy ↦ (hball hy).1
  have hballU : Metric.ball z ε ⊆ U :=
    fun y hy ↦ (hball hy).2
  obtain ⟨R, hR, L, hL, hLball, _, hdiscs⟩ :=
    exists_compact_affineClosedDisc_family isCompact_singleton Metric.isOpen_ball
      (singleton_subset_iff.mpr (Metric.mem_ball_self hε)) v
  have hpdisc : DiscPshOn (fun y ↦ (u y : EReal)) U :=
    PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.discPshOn hp
  have hmean : ∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 R,
      g z ≤ Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ ↦ g (z + ζ • v)) 0 r := by
    intro r hr
    have hDball : affineClosedDisc z v r ⊆ Metric.ball z ε :=
      (hdiscs z (mem_singleton z) r hr.2.le).trans hLball
    have hDU : affineClosedDisc z v r ⊆ U := hDball.trans hballU
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hpdisc.exists_disc_upper_bound z v hr.1.le hDU
    have hpoint (t : ℝ) :
        u (z + circleMap 0 r t • v) = g (z + circleMap 0 r t • v) :=
      hballEq _ (hDball (circle_mem_affineClosedDisc z v hr.1.le t))
    have hcircg : Continuous (fun t : ℝ ↦ g (z + circleMap 0 r t • v)) := by
      fun_prop
    have hint : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun t : ℝ ↦ u (z + circleMap 0 r t • v)) volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
      have hfun : (fun t : ℝ ↦ u (z + circleMap 0 r t • v)) =
          fun t : ℝ ↦ g (z + circleMap 0 r t • v) := funext hpoint
      rw [hfun]
      exact hcircg.intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hsub := hpdisc.submean z v r hr.1 hDU C hC
    have hmeanU : u z ≤ Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ ↦ u (z + ζ • v)) 0 r :=
      (circleDeficit_coe_le_iff z v r C hint
        (fun t ↦ EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp
          (hC _ (circle_mem_affineClosedDisc z v hr.1.le t)))
        (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp
          (hC z (center_mem_affineClosedDisc z v hr.1.le)))).mp hsub
    have havg : Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ ↦ u (z + ζ • v)) 0 r =
        Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ ↦ g (z + ζ • v)) 0 r := by
      unfold Real.circleAverage
      congr 1
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro t _
      exact hpoint t
    rw [hballEq z (Metric.mem_ball_self hε), havg] at hmeanU
    exact hmeanU
  have hg2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 g :=
    hg.of_le (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)
  have hline : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun ζ : ℂ ↦ g (z + ζ • v)) :=
    hg2.comp (contDiff_const.add (complexLineLinear v).contDiff)
  have hlap : 0 ≤ Δ (fun ζ : ℂ ↦ g (z + ζ • v)) 0 :=
    laplacian_nonneg_of_circleAverage_submean hline 0 hR (by simpa using hmean)
  have hlevig : 0 ≤ leviForm g z v := by
    simpa using (laplacian_complexLine_nonneg_iff hg2 z v 0).mp hlap
  have hsecond : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) z = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) z :=
    heq.fderiv.fderiv_eq
  have hlevi : leviForm u z v = leviForm g z v := by
    simp only [leviForm, realHessian_eq_fderiv, hsecond]
  rwa [hlevi]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.isSmoothPshOn_of_psh
statement:
theorem isSmoothPshOn_of_psh {U : Opens (ComplexModel n)}
    {u : ComplexModel n → ℝ} (hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U)
    (hp : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z ↦ (u z : EReal)) U) :
    IsSmoothPshOn U u
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hs, hp, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hs2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 u z :=
    ((hs z hz).contDiffAt (U.isOpen.mem_nhds hz)).of_le
      (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
  · exact complexHessian_isHermitian hs2
  · intro x
    rw [complexHessian_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_leviForm hs2 x]
    exact Complex.nonneg_iff.mpr
      ⟨leviForm_nonneg_of_contDiffOn_plurisubharmonicOn hs hp hz _, rfl⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.truncation_lower_bound
statement:
theorem truncation_lower_bound (u : ComplexModel n → EReal) (k : ℕ)
    (z : ComplexModel n) : ((-(k : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ truncation u k z
proof:
:=
  le_max_right _ _

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.truncation_ne_bot
statement:
theorem truncation_ne_bot (u : ComplexModel n → EReal) (k : ℕ)
    (z : ComplexModel n) : truncation u k z ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  ne_of_gt ((EReal.bot_lt_coe _).trans_le (truncation_lower_bound u k z))

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.truncation_ne_top
statement:
theorem truncation_ne_top (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω) (k : ℕ)
    {z : ComplexModel n} (hz : z ∈ Ω) : truncation u k z ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  exact ne_of_lt (max_lt (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr (hu z hz).ne_top)
    (EReal.coe_lt_top _))

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.coe_truncationReal
statement:
theorem coe_truncationReal (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω) (k : ℕ)
    {z : ComplexModel n} (hz : z ∈ Ω) :
    (truncationReal u k z : EReal) = truncation u k z
proof:
:=
  EReal.coe_toReal (truncation_ne_top hu k hz) (truncation_ne_bot u k z)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.truncation_plurisubharmonicOn
statement:
theorem truncation_plurisubharmonicOn (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω) (k : ℕ) :
    PlurisubharmonicOn (truncation u k) Ω
proof:
:=
  hu.max (fun z _ => plurisubharmonicAt_const _ (EReal.coe_ne_top _) z)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.truncationReal_plurisubharmonicOn
statement:
theorem truncationReal_plurisubharmonicOn (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω) (k : ℕ) :
    PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z => (truncationReal u k z : EReal)) Ω
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  apply (truncation_plurisubharmonicOn hu k z hz).congr
  filter_upwards [Ω.isOpen.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
  exact (coe_truncationReal hu k hw).symm

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.truncation_at_pole
statement:
@[simp] theorem truncation_at_pole (k : ℕ) {z : ComplexModel n} (hz : u z = ⊥) :
    truncation u k z = ((-(k : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  simp [truncation, hz]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.truncationReal_at_pole
statement:
theorem truncationReal_at_pole (k : ℕ) {z : ComplexModel n} (hz : u z = ⊥) :
    truncationReal u k z = -(k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncationReal
  rw [truncation_at_pole k hz]
  exact EReal.toReal_coe _

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.truncation_eq_on_strictLocus
statement:
theorem truncation_eq_on_strictLocus (k : ℕ) :
    EqOn (truncation u k) u (strictTruncationLocus Ω u k)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hz => max_eq_left hz.2.le

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.truncationReal_eq_on_strictLocus
statement:
theorem truncationReal_eq_on_strictLocus (k : ℕ) :
    EqOn (truncationReal u k) (fun z => (u z).toReal)
      (strictTruncationLocus Ω u k)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hz => congrArg EReal.toReal (truncation_eq_on_strictLocus k hz)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.pole_not_mem_strictLocus
statement:
theorem pole_not_mem_strictLocus (k : ℕ) {z : ComplexModel n} (hz : u z = ⊥) :
    z ∉ strictTruncationLocus Ω u k
proof:
:= by
  simp [strictTruncationLocus, hz]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.truncation_antitone
statement:
theorem truncation_antitone (u : ComplexModel n → EReal) (z : ComplexModel n) :
    Antitone (fun k => truncation u k z)
proof:
:= by
  intro k l hkl
  apply max_le_max le_rfl
  exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (neg_le_neg (Nat.cast_le.mpr hkl))

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.truncationReal_antitone
statement:
theorem truncationReal_antitone (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω)
    {z : ComplexModel n} (hz : z ∈ Ω) : Antitone (fun k => truncationReal u k z)
proof:
:= by
  intro k l hkl
  apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp
  rw [coe_truncationReal hu l hz, coe_truncationReal hu k hz]
  exact truncation_antitone u z hkl

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.strictTruncationLocus_mono
statement:
theorem strictTruncationLocus_mono (Ω : Opens (ComplexModel n))
    (u : ComplexModel n → EReal) : Monotone (strictTruncationLocus Ω u)
proof:
:= by
  intro k l hkl z hz
  refine ⟨hz.1, lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hz.2⟩
  exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (neg_le_neg (Nat.cast_le.mpr hkl))

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.truncation_truncation
statement:
theorem truncation_truncation (u : ComplexModel n → EReal) {k l : ℕ}
    (hkl : k ≤ l) : truncation (truncation u l) k = truncation u k
proof:
:= by
  funext z
  have h : ((-(l : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ ((-(k : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) :=
    EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (neg_le_neg (Nat.cast_le.mpr hkl))
  simp only [truncation, max_assoc, max_eq_right h]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.truncationReal_nested
proof:
:= by
  apply EReal.coe_injective
  have hmax (a b : ℝ) : ((max a b : ℝ) : EReal) = max (a : EReal) (b : EReal) := by
    rcases le_total a b with h | h
    · rw [max_eq_right h, max_eq_right (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr h)]
    · rw [max_eq_left h, max_eq_left (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr h)]
  rw [hmax, coe_truncationReal hu l hz, coe_truncationReal hu k hz]
  exact congrFun (truncation_truncation u hkl) z

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.strictLocus_eq_truncationReal_superlevel
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  by_cases hz : z ∈ Ω
  · have h : ((-(l : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ ((-(k : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) :=
      EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (neg_le_neg (Nat.cast_le.mpr hkl))
    simp only [strictTruncationLocus, mem_ofPred_eq, hz, true_and]
    rw [← EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff, coe_truncationReal hu l hz]
    simp only [truncation, lt_max_iff, not_lt.mpr h, or_false]
  · simp [strictTruncationLocus, hz]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.measurableSet_strictTruncationLocus
statement:
theorem measurableSet_strictTruncationLocus (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω) (k : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet (strictTruncationLocus Ω u k)
proof:
:= by
  have hsc : UpperSemicontinuousOn (fun z : Ω => u z) univ :=
    hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.comp continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn
      (fun z _ => z.property)
  have hm : Measurable (fun z : Ω => u z) :=
    (upperSemicontinuousOn_univ_iff.mp hsc).measurable
  have hs := Ω.isOpen.measurableSet.subtype_image
    (hm measurableSet_Ioi : MeasurableSet {z : Ω | ((-(k : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) < u z})
  convert hs using 1
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    exact ⟨⟨z, hz.1⟩, hz.2, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨w.property, hw⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.truncationReal_isLocallyBoundedPshOn
statement:
theorem truncationReal_isLocallyBoundedPshOn (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω) (k : ℕ) :
    IsLocallyBoundedPshOn Ω (truncationReal u k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨truncationReal_plurisubharmonicOn hu k, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (Ω.isOpen.mem_nhds hz)
  have hclosed : closedBall z (r / 2) ⊆ Ω :=
    (closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := hu.exists_nonnegative_compact_upper_bound
    (isCompact_closedBall z (r / 2)) hclosed
  refine ⟨⟨ball z (r / 2), isOpen_ball⟩, mem_ball_self (by linarith),
    ball_subset_closedBall.trans hclosed, C + (k : ℝ), ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  have hwΩ := hclosed (ball_subset_closedBall hw)
  have hlo : -(k : ℝ) ≤ truncationReal u k w := by
    apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp
    rw [coe_truncationReal hu k hwΩ]
    exact truncation_lower_bound u k w
  have hhi : truncationReal u k w ≤ C := by
    apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp
    rw [coe_truncationReal hu k hwΩ]
    exact max_le (hC w (ball_subset_closedBall hw))
      (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k]))
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k]⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.iUnion_strictTruncationLocus
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
    exact ⟨hk.1, ne_of_gt ((EReal.bot_lt_coe (-(k : ℝ))).trans hk.2)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hz, hu⟩
    obtain ⟨r, _, hr⟩ := EReal.exists_between_coe_real (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr hu)
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_nat_gt (-r)
    refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨k, hz, ?_⟩
    exact (EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr (show -(k : ℝ) < r by linarith)).trans hr

name: PshLines.FirstPass.coe_uscFloor
statement:
theorem coe_uscFloor {C : ℝ} {n : ℕ} {a : EReal} (ha : a ≠ ⊤) :
    ((uscFloor C n a : ℝ) : EReal) =
      max a (((C - (n : ℝ)) : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  apply EReal.coe_toReal
  · exact ne_of_lt <| max_lt (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr ha) (EReal.coe_lt_top _)
  · exact ne_of_gt <|
      (EReal.bot_lt_coe (C - (n : ℝ))).trans_le (le_max_right _ _)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.le_coe_uscFloor
statement:
theorem le_coe_uscFloor {C : ℝ} {n : ℕ} {a : EReal} (ha : a ≠ ⊤) :
    a ≤ (uscFloor C n a : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_uscFloor ha]
  exact le_max_left _ _

name: PshLines.FirstPass.uscFloor_le
statement:
theorem uscFloor_le {C : ℝ} {n : ℕ} {a : EReal} (ha : a ≠ ⊤)
    (haC : a ≤ (C : EReal)) : uscFloor C n a ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp
  rw [coe_uscFloor ha]
  exact max_le haC <| EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr <| by
    exact sub_le_self C (Nat.cast_nonneg n)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.uscFloor_antitone
statement:
theorem uscFloor_antitone {C : ℝ} {a : EReal} (ha : a ≠ ⊤) :
    Antitone (fun n : ℕ => uscFloor C n a)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m hnm
  apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp
  rw [coe_uscFloor ha, coe_uscFloor ha]
  apply max_le_max le_rfl
  exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr <| sub_le_sub_left (Nat.cast_le.mpr hnm) C

name: PshLines.FirstPass.uscSupConvolution_range_bddAbove
statement:
private theorem uscSupConvolution_range_bddAbove {K : Set X} {u : X → EReal}
    {C : ℝ} (htop : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≠ ⊤) (hC : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≤ (C : EReal))
    (n : ℕ) (x : X) :
    BddAbove (Set.range fun y : K =>
      uscFloor C n (u y) - (n : ℝ) * dist x y)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  have hfloor := uscFloor_le (n := n) (htop y y.property) (hC y y.property)
  have hpenalty : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * dist x y :=
    mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) dist_nonneg
  linarith

name: PshLines.FirstPass.uscSupConvolution_range_nonempty
statement:
private theorem uscSupConvolution_range_nonempty {K : Set X} {u : X → EReal}
    {C : ℝ} (hne : K.Nonempty) (n : ℕ) (x : X) :
    (Set.range fun y : K =>
      uscFloor C n (u y) - (n : ℝ) * dist x y).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hne
  exact ⟨uscFloor C n (u y) - (n : ℝ) * dist x y, ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, rfl⟩⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.uscSupConvolution_le
statement:
theorem uscSupConvolution_le {K : Set X} {u : X → EReal} {C : ℝ}
    (hne : K.Nonempty) (htop : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≠ ⊤)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≤ (C : EReal)) (n : ℕ) (x : X) :
    uscSupConvolution K u C n x ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  apply csSup_le (uscSupConvolution_range_nonempty hne n x)
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  have hfloor := uscFloor_le (n := n) (htop y y.property) (hC y y.property)
  have hpenalty : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * dist x y :=
    mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) dist_nonneg
  linarith

name: PshLines.FirstPass.uscSupConvolution_lipschitz
statement:
theorem uscSupConvolution_lipschitz {K : Set X} {u : X → EReal} {C : ℝ}
    (hne : K.Nonempty) (htop : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≠ ⊤)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≤ (C : EReal))
    (n : ℕ) :
    LipschitzWith (n : ℝ≥0) (uscSupConvolution K u C n)
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x x'
  have hbdd (z : X) := uscSupConvolution_range_bddAbove htop hC n z
  have hforward : uscSupConvolution K u C n x ≤
      uscSupConvolution K u C n x' + (n : ℝ) * dist x x' := by
    apply csSup_le (uscSupConvolution_range_nonempty hne n x)
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have hterm : uscFloor C n (u y) - (n : ℝ) * dist x' y ≤
        uscSupConvolution K u C n x' :=
      le_csSup (hbdd x') (Set.mem_range_self y)
    have htriangle : dist x' y ≤ dist x x' + dist x y := by
      simpa [dist_comm x' x] using dist_triangle x' x y
    have hn : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    nlinarith
  have hbackward : uscSupConvolution K u C n x' ≤
      uscSupConvolution K u C n x + (n : ℝ) * dist x x' := by
    apply csSup_le (uscSupConvolution_range_nonempty hne n x')
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have hterm : uscFloor C n (u y) - (n : ℝ) * dist x y ≤
        uscSupConvolution K u C n x :=
      le_csSup (hbdd x) (Set.mem_range_self y)
    have htriangle : dist x y ≤ dist x x' + dist x' y :=
      dist_triangle x x' y
    have hn : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    nlinarith
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  simp only [NNReal.coe_natCast]
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.continuous_uscSupConvolution
statement:
theorem continuous_uscSupConvolution {K : Set X} {u : X → EReal} {C : ℝ}
    (hne : K.Nonempty) (htop : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≠ ⊤)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≤ (C : EReal))
    (n : ℕ) : Continuous (uscSupConvolution K u C n)
proof:
:=
  (uscSupConvolution_lipschitz hne htop hC n).continuous

name: PshLines.FirstPass.le_coe_uscSupConvolution
statement:
theorem le_coe_uscSupConvolution {K : Set X} {u : X → EReal} {C : ℝ}
    (_hne : K.Nonempty) (htop : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≠ ⊤)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≤ (C : EReal)) (n : ℕ) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ K) :
    u x ≤ (uscSupConvolution K u C n x : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  let y : K := ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hterm : uscFloor C n (u x) ≤ uscSupConvolution K u C n x := by
    have := le_csSup (uscSupConvolution_range_bddAbove htop hC n x)
      (Set.mem_range_self y)
    simpa [uscSupConvolution, y] using this
  exact (le_coe_uscFloor (htop x hx)).trans <|
    EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr hterm

name: PshLines.FirstPass.uscSupConvolution_antitone
statement:
theorem uscSupConvolution_antitone {K : Set X} {u : X → EReal} {C : ℝ}
    (hne : K.Nonempty) (htop : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≠ ⊤)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≤ (C : EReal)) (x : X) :
    Antitone (fun n : ℕ => uscSupConvolution K u C n x)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m hnm
  apply csSup_le (uscSupConvolution_range_nonempty hne m x)
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  have hterm : uscFloor C n (u y) - (n : ℝ) * dist x y ≤
      uscSupConvolution K u C n x :=
    le_csSup (uscSupConvolution_range_bddAbove htop hC n x)
      (Set.mem_range_self y)
  have hfloor := (uscFloor_antitone (C := C) (htop y y.property)) hnm
  have hcast : (n : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hnm
  have hdist : 0 ≤ dist x y := dist_nonneg
  change uscFloor C m (u y) - (m : ℝ) * dist x y ≤
    uscSupConvolution K u C n x
  nlinarith

name: PshLines.FirstPass.exists_uscSupConvolution_le
statement:
private theorem exists_uscSupConvolution_le {K : Set X} {u : X → EReal} {C A : ℝ}
    (hne : K.Nonempty) (hu : UpperSemicontinuousOn u K)
    (htop : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≠ ⊤) (hC : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≤ (C : EReal))
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ K) (huxA : u x < (A : EReal)) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, uscSupConvolution K u C n x ≤ A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hnear⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp (hu x hx (A : EReal) huxA)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max (C - A) ((C - A) / δ))
  have hn₁ : C - (n : ℝ) < A := by
    have := (le_max_left (C - A) ((C - A) / δ)).trans_lt hn
    linarith
  have hn₂ : C - A < (n : ℝ) * δ := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ hδ).mp
    exact (le_max_right (C - A) ((C - A) / δ)).trans_lt hn
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  apply csSup_le (uscSupConvolution_range_nonempty hne n x)
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  by_cases hy : dist x y < δ
  · have hyball : (y : X) ∈ ball x δ := by
      simpa [mem_ball, dist_comm] using hy
    have huyA : u y < (A : EReal) := hnear ⟨hyball, y.property⟩
    have hfloor : uscFloor C n (u y) < A := by
      rw [← EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff, coe_uscFloor (htop y y.property)]
      exact max_lt huyA (EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr hn₁)
    have hpenalty : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * dist x y :=
      mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) dist_nonneg
    linarith
  · have hfloor := uscFloor_le (n := n) (htop y y.property) (hC y y.property)
    have hfar : δ ≤ dist x y := le_of_not_gt hy
    have hnnonneg : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    have hmul : (n : ℝ) * δ ≤ (n : ℝ) * dist x y :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfar hnnonneg
    linarith

name: PshLines.FirstPass.iInf_coe_uscSupConvolution
statement:
theorem iInf_coe_uscSupConvolution {K : Set X} {u : X → EReal} {C : ℝ}
    (hne : K.Nonempty) (hu : UpperSemicontinuousOn u K)
    (htop : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≠ ⊤) (hC : ∀ y ∈ K, u y ≤ (C : EReal))
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ K) :
    (⨅ n : ℕ, (uscSupConvolution K u C n x : EReal)) = u x
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_of_forall_gt
    intro b hub
    obtain ⟨A, huA, hAb⟩ := EReal.exists_between_coe_real hub
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_uscSupConvolution_le hne hu htop hC hx huA
    exact (iInf_le (fun k : ℕ => (uscSupConvolution K u C k x : EReal)) n).trans_lt <|
      (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr hn).trans_lt hAb
  · exact le_iInf fun n => le_coe_uscSupConvolution hne htop hC n hx

name: PshLines.FirstPass.exists_continuous_antitone_majorants_on_compact
statement:
theorem exists_continuous_antitone_majorants_on_compact {K : Set X}
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hne : K.Nonempty) {u : X → EReal}
    (hu : UpperSemicontinuousOn u K) (htop : ∀ x ∈ K, u x ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (g : ℕ → X → ℝ),
      (∀ n, Continuous (g n)) ∧
      (∀ n x, x ∈ K → u x ≤ (g n x : EReal)) ∧
      (∀ n x, g n x ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ x, Antitone fun n => g n x) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∈ K → (⨅ n : ℕ, (g n x : EReal)) = u x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hmax⟩ := hu.exists_isMaxOn hne hK
  obtain ⟨C, hyC, _⟩ := EReal.exists_rat_btwn_of_lt
    (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr (htop y hy))
  have hC : ∀ x ∈ K, u x ≤ (((C : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) :=
    fun x hx => (hmax hx).trans hyC.le
  refine ⟨(C : ℝ), uscSupConvolution K u (C : ℝ), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fun n => continuous_uscSupConvolution hne htop hC n
  · exact fun n x hx => le_coe_uscSupConvolution hne htop hC n hx
  · exact fun n x => uscSupConvolution_le hne htop hC n x
  · exact fun x => uscSupConvolution_antitone hne htop hC x
  · exact fun x hx => iInf_coe_uscSupConvolution hne hu htop hC hx

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.le_const_on_closedBall_of_le_on_sphere
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.le_const_on_closedBall_of_le_on_sphere
    {u : ℂ → EReal} {Ω : Set ℂ} (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn u Ω)
    {c : ℂ} {R C : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hD : closedBall c R ⊆ Ω)
    (hs : ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, u z ≤ (C : EReal)) :
    ∀ z ∈ closedBall c R, u z ≤ (C : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  by_contra hqC
  have hCq : (C : EReal) < u q := lt_of_not_ge hqC
  obtain ⟨y, hyD, hmax⟩ :=
    (hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.mono hD).exists_isMaxOn
      ⟨q, hq⟩ (isCompact_closedBall c R)
  have hy_top : u y ≠ ⊤ := (hu y (hD hyD)).ne_top
  have hy_bot : u y ≠ ⊥ := by
    have hy_gt : (C : EReal) < u y := hCq.trans_le (hmax hq)
    intro hy
    rw [hy] at hy_gt
    exact (not_lt_of_ge bot_le) hy_gt
  let B : ℝ := (u y).toReal
  have hyB : u y = (B : EReal) := (EReal.coe_toReal hy_top hy_bot).symm
  have hCB : C < B := by
    rw [← EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff, ← hyB]
    exact hCq.trans_le (hmax hq)
  have hy_ball : y ∈ ball c R := by
    have hyr : dist y c ≤ R := mem_closedBall.mp hyD
    apply mem_ball.mpr
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne hyr
    intro hyr_eq
    have hys : y ∈ sphere c R := mem_sphere.mpr hyr_eq
    have := hs y hys
    rw [hyB, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] at this
    exact (not_lt_of_ge this) hCB
  let O : Set ℂ := {z | z ∈ ball c R ∧ u z = (B : EReal)}
  have hO : IsOpen O := by
    rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hzW, hdisc⟩ := hu z (hD (ball_subset_closedBall hz.1))
    have hopen : IsOpen (W ∩ ball c R) := hW.inter isOpen_ball
    have hzopen : z ∈ W ∩ ball c R := ⟨hzW, hz.1⟩
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen z hzopen
    have hBW : ball z δ ⊆ W := fun w hw => (hball hw).1
    have hBbound : ∀ w ∈ ball z δ, u w ≤ (B : EReal) := by
      intro w hw
      exact (hmax (ball_subset_closedBall (hball hw).2)).trans_eq hyB
    have heq := hdisc.eqOn_ball_of_le_of_eq z hBW hBbound hz.2
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
    intro w hw
    exact ⟨(hball hw).2, heq hw⟩
  have hK : IsCompact (closedBall c R ∩ u ⁻¹' Ici (B : EReal)) :=
    (hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.mono hD).isCompact_inter_preimage_Ici
      (isCompact_closedBall c R) (B : EReal)
  have hOK : O ⊆ closedBall c R ∩ u ⁻¹' Ici (B : EReal) := by
    intro z hz
    exact ⟨ball_subset_closedBall hz.1, by simp [hz.2]⟩
  have hclosure : closure O ∩ closedBall c R ⊆ O := by
    intro z hz
    have hzK := closure_minimal hOK hK.isClosed hz.1
    have hzeq : u z = (B : EReal) := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · exact (hmax hz.2).trans_eq hyB
      · exact hzK.2
    have hzball : z ∈ ball c R := by
      have hzr : dist z c ≤ R := mem_closedBall.mp hz.2
      apply mem_ball.mpr
      apply lt_of_le_of_ne hzr
      intro hzr_eq
      have hzs : z ∈ sphere c R := mem_sphere.mpr hzr_eq
      have hzC := hs z hzs
      rw [hzeq, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] at hzC
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hzC) hCB
    exact ⟨hzball, hzeq⟩
  have hnonempty : (closedBall c R ∩ O).Nonempty :=
    ⟨y, ball_subset_closedBall hy_ball, hy_ball, hyB⟩
  have hall : closedBall c R ⊆ O :=
    isPreconnected_closedBall.subset_of_closure_inter_subset hO hnonempty hclosure
  let z : ℂ := c + (R : ℂ)
  have hzs : z ∈ sphere c R := by
    simp [z, abs_of_pos hR]
  have hzO := hall (sphere_subset_closedBall hzs)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (by
    have hzC := hs z hzs
    rw [hzO.2, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] at hzC
    exact hzC)) hCB

name: PshLines.leviForm_affine_re
statement:
theorem leviForm_affine_re (p q : ℝ) (z w : ℂ) :
    leviForm (fun ζ : ℂ => p * ζ.re + q) z w = 0
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ := p • Complex.reCLM
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun ζ : ℂ => p * ζ.re + q) = fun _ => A := by
    funext ζ
    exact (by
      simpa [A, Complex.reCLM_apply, smul_eq_mul] using
        ((Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.const_smul p).add_const q).fderiv)
  rw [leviForm, realHessian_eq_fderiv, realHessian_eq_fderiv, hfd]
  simp

name: PshLines.plurisubharmonicOn_coe_affine_re
statement:
theorem plurisubharmonicOn_coe_affine_re (p q : ℝ) (U : Set ℂ) :
    PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z : ℂ => ((p * z.re + q : ℝ) : EReal)) U
proof:
:= by
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : ℂ => p * z.re + q) := by
    have hlin : ContDiff ℝ 2 (p • Complex.reCLM : ℂ → ℝ) :=
      (p • Complex.reCLM).contDiff
    simpa [Complex.reCLM_apply, smul_eq_mul] using
      hlin.add (contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun _ : ℂ => q))
  have hglobal : PlurisubharmonicOn
      (fun z : ℂ => ((p * z.re + q : ℝ) : EReal)) univ :=
    plurisubharmonicOn_of_levi_nonneg hsmooth isOpen_univ
      (fun z _ w => by rw [leviForm_affine_re])
  exact hglobal.mono (Set.subset_univ U)

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.eqOn_ball_of_le_of_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hle := hu.ball_deficit_le volume a R C hBU hC
  have hzero : ∫⁻ x in ball a R, ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal = 0 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · simpa [ha] using hle
    · exact bot_le
  have hae0 : (fun x => ((C : EReal) - u x).toENNReal) =ᵐ[
      volume.restrict (ball a R)] 0 :=
    (MeasureTheory.lintegral_eq_zero_iff'
      (hu.aemeasurable_deficit_restrict measurableSet_ball hBU C volume)).mp hzero
  have hae : u =ᵐ[volume.restrict (ball a R)] fun _ => (C : EReal) := by
    filter_upwards [hae0, ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball] with x hx hmem
    exact le_antisymm (hC x hmem)
      (EReal.sub_nonpos.mp (EReal.toENNReal_eq_zero_iff.mp hx))
  have hpsh : PlurisubharmonicOn u (ball a R) :=
    (hu.mono hBU).plurisubharmonicOn isOpen_ball
  have hconst : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun _ : ℂ => (C : EReal)) (ball a R) :=
    fun x _ => plurisubharmonicAt_const (C : EReal) (by simp) x
  exact hpsh.eqOn_of_ae_eq hconst isOpen_ball volume hae

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.comp_re_no_finite_strict_interior_max
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.comp_re_no_finite_strict_interior_max
    {v : ℝ → EReal} {I : Set ℝ}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z : ℂ => v z.re) (Complex.re ⁻¹' I))
    {a b x C : ℝ} (habI : Icc a b ⊆ I) (hx : x ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hmax : ∀ y ∈ Icc a b, v y ≤ (C : EReal)) (heq : v x = (C : EReal))
    (ha : v a < (C : EReal)) (hb : v b < (C : EReal)) : False
proof:
:= by
  let O : Set ℝ := {y | y ∈ Ioo a b ∧ v y = (C : EReal)}
  have hO : IsOpen O := by
    rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
    intro y hy
    have hyI : y ∈ I := habI (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hy.1)
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hyU, hdisc⟩ := hu (y : ℂ) (by simpa using hyI)
    have hopen : IsOpen (U ∩ Complex.re ⁻¹' Ioo a b) :=
      hU.inter (isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.continuous_re)
    have hyopen : (y : ℂ) ∈ U ∩ Complex.re ⁻¹' Ioo a b := by
      exact ⟨hyU, by simpa using hy.1⟩
    obtain ⟨R, hR, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen (y : ℂ) hyopen
    have hBU : ball (y : ℂ) R ⊆ U := fun z hz => (hball hz).1
    have hCball : ∀ z ∈ ball (y : ℂ) R, v z.re ≤ (C : EReal) := by
      intro z hz
      exact hmax z.re (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hball hz).2)
    have heqball := hdisc.eqOn_ball_of_le_of_eq (y : ℂ) hBU hCball (by simpa using hy.2)
    refine ⟨R, hR, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    have hqc : (q : ℂ) ∈ ball (y : ℂ) R := by
      rw [mem_ball, Complex.dist_of_im_eq (by simp)]
      simpa using hq
    exact ⟨(hball hqc).2, by simpa using heqball hqc⟩
  have husc : UpperSemicontinuousOn v (Icc a b) := by
    have hmap : MapsTo (fun y : ℝ => (y : ℂ)) (Icc a b) (Complex.re ⁻¹' I) := by
      intro y hy
      simpa using habI hy
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
      hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.comp Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn hmap
  have hK : IsCompact (Icc a b ∩ v ⁻¹' Ici (C : EReal)) :=
    husc.isCompact_inter_preimage_Ici isCompact_Icc (C : EReal)
  have hOK : O ⊆ Icc a b ∩ v ⁻¹' Ici (C : EReal) := by
    intro y hy
    exact ⟨Ioo_subset_Icc_self hy.1, by simp [hy.2]⟩
  have hclosure : closure O ∩ Icc a b ⊆ O := by
    intro y hy
    have hyK := closure_minimal hOK hK.isClosed hy.1
    have hyeq : v y = (C : EReal) := le_antisymm (hmax y hy.2) hyK.2
    have hya : y ≠ a := by
      intro h
      subst y
      exact (ne_of_lt ha) hyeq
    have hyb : y ≠ b := by
      intro h
      subst y
      exact (ne_of_lt hb) hyeq
    exact ⟨⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hy.2.1 (Ne.symm hya), lt_of_le_of_ne hy.2.2 hyb⟩, hyeq⟩
  have hnonempty : (Icc a b ∩ O).Nonempty :=
    ⟨x, Ioo_subset_Icc_self hx, hx, heq⟩
  have hall : Icc a b ⊆ O :=
    isPreconnected_Icc.subset_of_closure_inter_subset hO hnonempty hclosure
  have haO := hall (left_mem_Icc.mpr (hx.1.trans hx.2).le)
  exact (ne_of_lt ha) haO.2

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.comp_re_toReal_le_affine_chord
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.comp_re_toReal_le_affine_chord
    {v : ℝ → EReal} {I : Set ℝ}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z : ℂ => v z.re) (Complex.re ⁻¹' I))
    {a t b : ℝ} (hat : a < t) (htb : t < b) (habI : Icc a b ⊆ I)
    (ha_top : v a ≠ ⊤) (ha_bot : v a ≠ ⊥)
    (ht_top : v t ≠ ⊤) (ht_bot : v t ≠ ⊥)
    (hb_top : v b ≠ ⊤) (hb_bot : v b ≠ ⊥) :
    (v t).toReal ≤ (v a).toReal +
      (t - a) * ((v b).toReal - (v a).toReal) / (b - a)
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℝ := (v a).toReal
  let B : ℝ := (v b).toReal
  let p : ℝ := (B - A) / (b - a)
  let q : ℝ := A - p * a
  let w : ℝ → EReal := fun x => v x + (((-p) * x + (-q) : ℝ) : EReal)
  have hab : a < b := hat.trans htb
  have hba : b - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hab)
  have hwpsh : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z : ℂ => w z.re) (Complex.re ⁻¹' I) := by
    simpa [w] using hu.add
      (plurisubharmonicOn_coe_affine_re (-p) (-q) (Complex.re ⁻¹' I))
  have hwa : w a = 0 := by
    rw [show w a = v a + (((-p) * a + (-q) : ℝ) : EReal) by rfl,
      ← EReal.coe_toReal ha_top ha_bot, ← EReal.coe_add]
    apply EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mpr
    dsimp [q, A]
    ring
  have hwb : w b = 0 := by
    rw [show w b = v b + (((-p) * b + (-q) : ℝ) : EReal) by rfl,
      ← EReal.coe_toReal hb_top hb_bot, ← EReal.coe_add]
    apply EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mpr
    dsimp [q, p, A, B]
    field_simp [hba]
    ring
  have hwt : w t = (((v t).toReal + ((-p) * t + (-q)) : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    calc
      w t = v t + (((-p) * t + (-q) : ℝ) : EReal) := rfl
      _ = ((v t).toReal : EReal) + (((-p) * t + (-q) : ℝ) : EReal) := by
        rw [EReal.coe_toReal ht_top ht_bot]
      _ = (((v t).toReal + ((-p) * t + (-q)) : ℝ) : EReal) :=
        (EReal.coe_add _ _).symm
  rw [show (v a).toReal + (t - a) * ((v b).toReal - (v a).toReal) / (b - a) =
      A + (t - a) * p by dsimp [A, B, p]; ring]
  by_contra hle
  have hlt : A + (t - a) * p < (v t).toReal := lt_of_not_ge hle
  have hline : p * t + q = A + (t - a) * p := by
    dsimp [q]
    ring
  have hposR : 0 < (v t).toReal + ((-p) * t + (-q)) := by linarith
  have hwtpos : (0 : EReal) < w t := by
    rw [hwt]
    exact EReal.coe_pos.mpr hposR
  have hwusc : UpperSemicontinuousOn w (Icc a b) := by
    have hmap : MapsTo (fun y : ℝ => (y : ℂ)) (Icc a b) (Complex.re ⁻¹' I) := by
      intro y hy
      simpa using habI hy
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
      hwpsh.upperSemicontinuousOn.comp Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn hmap
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxmax⟩ := hwusc.exists_isMaxOn
    (show (Icc a b).Nonempty from ⟨t, hat.le, htb.le⟩) isCompact_Icc
  have htx : w t ≤ w x := hxmax ⟨hat.le, htb.le⟩
  have hxbot : w x ≠ ⊥ := ne_bot_of_gt (hwtpos.trans_le htx)
  have hxtop : w x ≠ ⊤ :=
    (hwpsh (x : ℂ) (by simpa using habI hx)).ne_top
  let C : ℝ := (w x).toReal
  have hxcoe : w x = (C : EReal) := (EReal.coe_toReal hxtop hxbot).symm
  have hCpos : (0 : EReal) < (C : EReal) := by
    rw [← hxcoe]
    exact hwtpos.trans_le htx
  have hxa : x ≠ a := by
    intro h
    subst x
    rw [hwa] at hxcoe
    exact (ne_of_lt hCpos) hxcoe
  have hxb : x ≠ b := by
    intro h
    subst x
    rw [hwb] at hxcoe
    exact (ne_of_lt hCpos) hxcoe
  have hxIoo : x ∈ Ioo a b :=
    ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hx.1 (Ne.symm hxa), lt_of_le_of_ne hx.2 hxb⟩
  exact hwpsh.comp_re_no_finite_strict_interior_max habI hxIoo
    (fun y hy => by simpa [hxcoe] using hxmax hy) hxcoe
    (by simpa [hwa] using hCpos) (by simpa [hwb] using hCpos)

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.comp_re_le_chord
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicOn.comp_re_le_chord
    {v : ℝ → EReal} {I : Set ℝ}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z : ℂ => v z.re) (Complex.re ⁻¹' I))
    {a t b : ℝ} (hat : a < t) (htb : t < b) (habI : Icc a b ⊆ I)
    (ha_top : v a ≠ ⊤) (ha_bot : v a ≠ ⊥)
    (ht_top : v t ≠ ⊤) (ht_bot : v t ≠ ⊥)
    (hb_top : v b ≠ ⊤) (hb_bot : v b ≠ ⊥) :
    v t ≤ (((b - t) / (b - a) : ℝ) : EReal) * v a +
      (((t - a) / (b - a) : ℝ) : EReal) * v b
proof:
:= by
  have hab : a < b := hat.trans htb
  have hba : b - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hab)
  have hreal := hu.comp_re_toReal_le_affine_chord hat htb habI
    ha_top ha_bot ht_top ht_bot hb_top hb_bot
  have hweight :
      (v a).toReal + (t - a) * ((v b).toReal - (v a).toReal) / (b - a) =
        (b - t) / (b - a) * (v a).toReal +
          (t - a) / (b - a) * (v b).toReal := by
    field_simp [hba]
    ring
  rw [hweight] at hreal
  calc
    v t = ((v t).toReal : EReal) := (EReal.coe_toReal ht_top ht_bot).symm
    _ ≤ (((b - t) / (b - a) * (v a).toReal +
        (t - a) / (b - a) * (v b).toReal : ℝ) : EReal) :=
      EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr hreal
    _ = (((b - t) / (b - a) : ℝ) : EReal) * ((v a).toReal : EReal) +
        (((t - a) / (b - a) : ℝ) : EReal) * ((v b).toReal : EReal) := by
      rw [← EReal.coe_mul, ← EReal.coe_mul, ← EReal.coe_add]
    _ = (((b - t) / (b - a) : ℝ) : EReal) * v a +
        (((t - a) / (b - a) : ℝ) : EReal) * v b := by
      rw [EReal.coe_toReal ha_top ha_bot, EReal.coe_toReal hb_top hb_bot]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.LocallyUniformlyBoundedAbove.mono_family
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨U, hU, C, hC⟩ := hF x hx
  exact ⟨U, hU, C, fun f hf => hC f (hGF hf)⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.LocallyUniformlyBoundedAbove.mono_domain
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨U, hU, C, hC⟩ := hF x (hVΩ hx)
  refine ⟨U, ?_, C, ?_⟩
  · exact (nhdsWithin_mono x hVΩ) hU
  · intro f hf y hy
    exact hC f hf y ⟨hy.1, hVΩ hy.2⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.LocallyUniformlyBoundedAbove.exists_uniform_upper_bound_on_compact
statement:
theorem LocallyUniformlyBoundedAbove.exists_uniform_upper_bound_on_compact
    {F : Set (X → EReal)} {Ω K : Set X}
    (hF : LocallyUniformlyBoundedAbove F Ω) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ f ∈ F, ∀ x ∈ K, f x ≤ (C : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hKempty : K = ∅
  · exact ⟨0, by simp [hKempty]⟩
  choose U hU C hC using fun x : K => hF x (hKΩ x.property)
  have hUK : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ K), U ⟨x, hx⟩ ∈ 𝓝[K] x := by
    intro x hx
    exact (nhdsWithin_mono x hKΩ) (hU ⟨x, hx⟩)
  obtain ⟨t, hcover⟩ := hK.elim_nhdsWithin_subcover'
    (fun x hx => U ⟨x, hx⟩) hUK
  have ht : t.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : K.Nonempty := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hKempty
    obtain ⟨i, hi, -⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hcover hx)
    exact ⟨i, hi⟩
  refine ⟨t.sup' ht C, ?_⟩
  intro f hf x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hcover hx)
  have hlocal : f x ≤ (C i : EReal) :=
    hC i f hf x ⟨hxi, hKΩ hx⟩
  exact hlocal.trans <| EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (Finset.le_sup' C hi)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.LocallyUniformlyBoundedAbove.exists_uniform_upper_bound_on_compact_image
statement:
theorem LocallyUniformlyBoundedAbove.exists_uniform_upper_bound_on_compact_image
    {F : Set (X → EReal)} {Ω : Set X} {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (hF : LocallyUniformlyBoundedAbove F Ω) {L : Set Y} (hL : IsCompact L)
    {φ : Y → X} (hφ : ContinuousOn φ L) (hφΩ : MapsTo φ L Ω) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ f ∈ F, ∀ y ∈ L, f (φ y) ≤ (C : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hF.exists_uniform_upper_bound_on_compact
    (hL.image_of_continuousOn hφ)
    (fun _ hz => by obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hz; exact hφΩ hy)
  exact ⟨C, fun f hf y hy => hC f hf (φ y) ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩⟩

name: PshLines.HarmonicAt.comp_complexAffine
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => x + w * v
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ :=
    isOpen_iff.1 (isOpen_setOfPred_harmonicAt (f := h)) (A z) hh
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFre⟩ :=
    InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd.exists_analyticOnNhd_ball_re_eq
      (fun y hy => hball hy)
  have hAz_ball : A z ∈ ball (A z) ε := mem_ball_self hε
  have hA : AnalyticAt ℂ A z := by
    dsimp [A]
    fun_prop
  have hFA : AnalyticAt ℂ (F ∘ A) z := (hF (A z) hAz_ball).comp hA
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, A w ∈ ball (A z) ε :=
    hA.continuousAt.eventually (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hAz_ball)
  have heq : (fun w : ℂ => ((F ∘ A) w).re) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
      (fun w : ℂ => h (x + w * v)) := by
    filter_upwards [hnear] with w hw
    exact hFre hw
  exact (harmonicAt_congr_nhds heq).mp (AnalyticAt.harmonicAt_re hFA)

name: PshLines.HarmonicOnNhd.comp_complexAffine
statement:
theorem HarmonicOnNhd.comp_complexAffine {h : ℂ → ℝ} {S T : Set ℂ} (x v : ℂ)
    (hh : HarmonicOnNhd h S)
    (hmap : ∀ z ∈ T, x + z * v ∈ S) :
    HarmonicOnNhd (fun z : ℂ => h (x + z * v)) T
proof:
:=
  fun z hz => HarmonicAt.comp_complexAffine (hh _ (hmap z hz))

name: PshLines.HarmonicOnNhd.discPshOn
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ => EReal.coe_ne_top _,
    (continuous_coe_real_ereal.comp_continuousOn hh.continuousOn).upperSemicontinuousOn,
    ?_⟩
  intro x v r hr hD C hC
  have hpull : HarmonicOnNhd (fun z : ℂ => h (x + z * v)) (closedBall 0 |r|) := by
    apply HarmonicOnNhd.comp_complexAffine x v hh
    intro z hz
    apply hD
    refine ⟨z, ?_, rfl⟩
    simpa [abs_of_pos hr] using hz
  have hmean : h x = Real.circleAverage (fun z : ℂ => h (x + z * v)) 0 r := by
    rw [InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd.circleAverage_eq hpull]
    simp
  have hcirc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => h (x + circleMap 0 r t * v)) := by
    have hpath : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => x + circleMap 0 r t * v) := by fun_prop
    apply hh.continuousOn.comp_continuous hpath
    intro t
    apply hD
    exact circle_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr.le t
  apply (circleDeficit_coe_le_iff x v r C (hcirc.intervalIntegrable _ _)
    (fun t => EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp
      (hC _ (circle_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr.le t)))
    (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp
      (hC x (center_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr.le)))).mpr
  exact hmean.le

name: PshLines.HarmonicOnNhd.discPshOn_of_univ
proof:
:= by
  apply discPshOn_of_circleAverage (continuousOn_univ.mp hh.continuousOn)
  intro x v r hr _hD
  have hpull : HarmonicOnNhd (fun z : ℂ => h (x + z * v)) (closedBall 0 |r|) := by
    apply HarmonicOnNhd.comp_complexAffine x v hh
    simp
  have hmean := InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd.circleAverage_eq hpull
  simpa using hmean.ge

name: PshLines.HarmonicAt.plurisubharmonicAt
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨{y | HarmonicAt h y}, isOpen_setOfPred_harmonicAt h, hh, ?_⟩
  exact HarmonicOnNhd.discPshOn (fun _ hy => hy)

name: PshLines.HarmonicOnNhd.plurisubharmonicOn
proof:
:=
  fun x hx => HarmonicAt.plurisubharmonicAt (hh x hx)

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.add_harmonic

:=
  hu.add (HarmonicOnNhd.discPshOn hh)

name: PshLines.DiscPshOn.sub_harmonic

:= by
