name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.add_harmonic
proof:
:=
  hu.add (HarmonicOnNhd.plurisubharmonicOn hh)

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.sub_harmonic
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, Pi.neg_apply, EReal.coe_neg] using
    hu.add (HarmonicOnNhd.plurisubharmonicOn hh.neg)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.smoothDc_contDiffOn
proof:
:= by
  apply (ContinuousAlternatingMap.ofSubsingletonLIE (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := ComplexModel n) (F := ℝ)
    (0 : Fin 1)).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn
  exact ((hh.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).clm_comp
    contDiffOn_const).const_smul (-1 / (4 * Real.pi) : ℝ)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.smoothDc_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem smoothDc_zero (z : ComplexModel n) :
    smoothDc (fun _ : ComplexModel n => (0 : ℝ)) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [smoothDc_apply]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.smoothDc_add
proof:
:= by
  change smoothDc (h + g) z = _
  ext v
  simp [smoothDc_apply, fderiv_add hh hg, mul_add]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.smoothDc_smul
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [smoothDc_apply, fderiv_fun_const_smul hh c]
  simp only [smul_apply, ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply,
    smoothDc_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: PshLines.FirstPass.smoothDc_neg
proof:
:= by
  have heq := smoothDc_smul hh (-1)
  have hfun : (fun y => (-1 : ℝ) • h y) = (fun y => -h y) := by
    funext y
    exact neg_one_mul _
  rw [hfun] at heq
  apply heq.trans
  ext v
  exact neg_one_mul _

name: PshLines.FirstPass.smoothDDC_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem smoothDDC_zero (z : ComplexModel n) :
    smoothDDC (fun _ : ComplexModel n => (0 : ℝ)) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : smoothDc (fun _ : ComplexModel n => (0 : ℝ)) = 0 := by
    funext y
    exact smoothDc_zero y
  simp only [smoothDDC, hzero, extDeriv, fderiv_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
  exact map_zero (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFinCLM ℝ (ComplexModel n) ℝ)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.smoothDDC_add
statement:
theorem smoothDDC_add {h g : ComplexModel n → ℝ} {U : Set (ComplexModel n)}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h U) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U)
    {z : ComplexModel n} (hz : z ∈ U) :
    smoothDDC (fun y => h y + g y) z = smoothDDC h z + smoothDDC g z
proof:
:= by
  have heq : smoothDc (fun y => h y + g y) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] smoothDc h + smoothDc g := by
    filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hz] with y hy
    exact smoothDc_add ((hh y hy).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy) |>.differentiableAt (by simp))
      ((hg y hy).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy) |>.differentiableAt (by simp))
  exact heq.extDeriv_eq.trans (extDeriv_add
    (((smoothDc_contDiffOn hU hh) z hz).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
      |>.differentiableAt (by simp))
    (((smoothDc_contDiffOn hU hg) z hz).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
      |>.differentiableAt (by simp)))

name: PshLines.FirstPass.smoothDDC_smul
statement:
theorem smoothDDC_smul {h : ComplexModel n → ℝ} {U : Set (ComplexModel n)}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h U) (c : ℝ)
    {z : ComplexModel n} (hz : z ∈ U) :
    smoothDDC (fun y => c • h y) z = c • smoothDDC h z
proof:
:= by
  have heq : smoothDc (fun y => c • h y) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] c • smoothDc h := by
    filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hz] with y hy
    exact smoothDc_smul
      ((hh y hy).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy) |>.differentiableAt (by simp)) c
  exact heq.extDeriv_eq.trans (extDeriv_smul c (smoothDc h))

name: PshLines.FirstPass.smoothDDC_neg
proof:
:= by
  have heq := smoothDDC_smul hU hh (-1) hz
  have hfun : (fun y => (-1 : ℝ) • h y) = (fun y => -h y) := by
    funext y
    exact neg_one_mul _
  rw [hfun] at heq
  apply heq.trans
  ext v
  exact neg_one_mul _

name: PshLines.FirstPass.ClosedRealOneOneForm.ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem ext {a b : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M}
    (h : ∀ e z, a.val.coeff e z = b.val.coeff e z) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨⟨ac, as, ap⟩, ha⟩
  rcases b with ⟨⟨bc, bs, bp⟩, hb⟩
  have hc : ac = bc := funext fun e => funext fun z => h e z
  cases hc
  rfl

name: PshLines.FirstPass.ClosedRealOneOneForm.coeff_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_zero (e : ComplexChart n M) (z : ComplexModel n) :
    (0 : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M).val.coeff e z = 0
proof: := rfl

name: PshLines.FirstPass.ClosedRealOneOneForm.coeff_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_add (a b : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M) (e : ComplexChart n M)
    (z : ComplexModel n) : (a + b).val.coeff e z = a.val.coeff e z + b.val.coeff e z
proof: := rfl

name: PshLines.FirstPass.ClosedRealOneOneForm.coeff_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_smul (c : ℝ) (a : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M) (e : ComplexChart n M)
    (z : ComplexModel n) : (c • a).val.coeff e z = c • a.val.coeff e z
proof: := rfl

name: PshLines.FirstPass.ClosedRealOneOneForm.coeff_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_neg (a : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M) (e : ComplexChart n M)
    (z : ComplexModel n) : (-a).val.coeff e z = -a.val.coeff e z
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  exact neg_one_mul _

name: PshLines.FirstPass.ClosedRealOneOneForm.BottChernRel.refl
statement: theorem BottChernRel.refl (a : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M) : BottChernRel a a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => contDiffOn_const, ?_⟩
  intro e z hz
  rw [smoothDDC_zero, add_zero]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.ClosedRealOneOneForm.BottChernRel.symm
statement:
theorem BottChernRel.symm {a b : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M}
    (hab : BottChernRel a b) : BottChernRel b a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := hab
  refine ⟨fun x => -h x, fun e => (hh e).neg, ?_⟩
  intro e z hz
  rw [smoothDDC_neg e.val.open_target (hh e) hz, heq e z hz, add_neg_cancel_right]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.ClosedRealOneOneForm.BottChernRel.trans
statement:
theorem BottChernRel.trans {a b c : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M}
    (hab : BottChernRel a b) (hbc : BottChernRel b c) : BottChernRel a c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := hab
  obtain ⟨g, hg, geq⟩ := hbc
  refine ⟨fun x => h x + g x, fun e => (hh e).add (hg e), ?_⟩
  intro e z hz
  rw [smoothDDC_add e.val.open_target (hh e) (hg e) hz, geq e z hz, heq e z hz,
    add_assoc]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.ClosedRealOneOneForm.bottChernRel_of_geometricallyEq
statement:
theorem bottChernRel_of_geometricallyEq {a b : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M}
    (hab : a.val.GeometricallyEq b.val) : BottChernRel a b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => contDiffOn_const, ?_⟩
  intro e z hz
  rw [smoothDDC_zero, add_zero]
  exact (hab e hz).symm

name: PshLines.FirstPass.ClosedRealOneOneForm.bottChernRel_geometricallyEq_iff
proof:
:= by
  have ha := bottChernRel_of_geometricallyEq haa
  have hb := bottChernRel_of_geometricallyEq hbb
  exact ⟨fun h => ha.symm.trans (h.trans hb), fun h => ha.trans (h.trans hb.symm)⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.ClosedRealOneOneForm.BottChernRel.add
statement:
theorem BottChernRel.add {a b c d : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M}
    (hab : BottChernRel a b) (hcd : BottChernRel c d) : BottChernRel (a + c) (b + d)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := hab
  obtain ⟨g, hg, geq⟩ := hcd
  refine ⟨fun x => h x + g x, fun e => (hh e).add (hg e), ?_⟩
  intro e z hz
  rw [coeff_add, coeff_add, smoothDDC_add e.val.open_target (hh e) (hg e) hz,
    heq e z hz, geq e z hz]
  abel

name: PshLines.FirstPass.ClosedRealOneOneForm.BottChernRel.smul
statement:
theorem BottChernRel.smul {a b : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M}
    (hab : BottChernRel a b) (c : ℝ) : BottChernRel (c • a) (c • b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := hab
  refine ⟨fun x => c • h x, fun e => (hh e).const_smul c, ?_⟩
  intro e z hz
  rw [coeff_smul, coeff_smul, smoothDDC_smul e.val.open_target (hh e) c hz,
    heq e z hz, smul_add]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.ClosedRealOneOneForm.BottChernRel.neg
statement:
theorem BottChernRel.neg {a b : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M}
    (hab : BottChernRel a b) : BottChernRel (-a) (-b)
proof: := hab.smul (-1)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.RealBottChern.ofRepresentative_eq_iff
statement:
theorem ofRepresentative_eq_iff (a b : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M) :
    ofRepresentative a = ofRepresentative b ↔ ClosedRealOneOneForm.BottChernRel a b
proof:
:=
  Quotient.eq

name: PshLines.FirstPass.RealBottChern.ofRepresentative_eq_of_geometricallyEq
statement:
theorem ofRepresentative_eq_of_geometricallyEq {a b : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M}
    (hab : a.val.GeometricallyEq b.val) : ofRepresentative a = ofRepresentative b
proof:
:=
  (ofRepresentative_eq_iff a b).mpr
    (ClosedRealOneOneForm.bottChernRel_of_geometricallyEq hab)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.RealBottChern.ofRepresentative_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofRepresentative_zero :
    ofRepresentative (0 : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: PshLines.FirstPass.RealBottChern.ofRepresentative_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofRepresentative_add (a b : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M) :
    ofRepresentative (a + b) = ofRepresentative a + ofRepresentative b
proof: := rfl

name: PshLines.FirstPass.RealBottChern.ofRepresentative_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofRepresentative_smul (c : ℝ) (a : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M) :
    ofRepresentative (c • a) = c • ofRepresentative a
proof: := rfl

name: PshLines.FirstPass.RealBottChern.ofRepresentative_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofRepresentative_neg (a : ClosedRealOneOneForm n M) :
    ofRepresentative (-a) = -ofRepresentative a
proof: := rfl

name: PshLines.PlurisubharmonicAt.quasiPlurisubharmonicAt
statement:
theorem PlurisubharmonicAt.quasiPlurisubharmonicAt {u : E → EReal} {x : E}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicAt u x) : QuasiPlurisubharmonicAt u x
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨u, fun _ => 0, hu, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => contDiffAt_const), by simp⟩

name: PshLines.QuasiPlurisubharmonicAt.congr
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, h, hp, hh, heq⟩ := hu
  exact ⟨p, h, hp, hh, huv.symm.trans heq⟩

name: PshLines.QuasiPlurisubharmonicAt.ne_top
statement:
theorem QuasiPlurisubharmonicAt.ne_top {u : E → EReal} {x : E}
    (hu : QuasiPlurisubharmonicAt u x) : u x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, h, hp, _, heq⟩ := hu
  rw [heq.eq_of_nhds]
  exact EReal.add_ne_top hp.ne_top (EReal.coe_ne_top _)

name: PshLines.QuasiPlurisubharmonicAt.add_smooth
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, g, hp, hg, heq⟩ := hu
  refine ⟨p, fun y => g y + h y, hp, ?_, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [hg, hh] with y hgy hhy
    exact hgy.add hhy
  filter_upwards [heq] with y hy
  rw [hy, EReal.coe_add, add_assoc]

name: PshLines.QuasiPlurisubharmonicOn.mono
proof: := fun x hx => hu x (hVU hx)

name: PshLines.QuasiPlurisubharmonicOn.add_smooth
statement:
theorem QuasiPlurisubharmonicOn.add_smooth {u : E → EReal} {h : E → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hu : QuasiPlurisubharmonicOn u U)
    (hh : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ h y) :
    QuasiPlurisubharmonicOn (fun y => u y + (h y : EReal)) U
proof:
:=
  fun x hx => (hu x hx).add_smooth (hh x hx)

name: PshLines.LocalQuasiPshPotentialOn.mono
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hV, hu.2.1.mono hVU, ?_⟩
  intro x hx W hW hxW
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hfin⟩ := hu.2.2 x (hVU hx) (V ∩ W) (hV.inter hW) ⟨hx, hxW⟩
  exact ⟨y, hy.2, hfin⟩

name: PshLines.localQuasiPshPotentialOn_const
statement:
theorem localQuasiPshPotentialOn_const (c : ℝ) {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) :
    LocalQuasiPshPotentialOn (fun _ : E => (c : EReal)) U
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hU, fun x _ => (plurisubharmonicAt_const c (EReal.coe_ne_top c) x).quasiPlurisubharmonicAt, ?_⟩
  exact fun x hx V _ hxV => ⟨x, ⟨hx, hxV⟩, EReal.coe_ne_bot c⟩

name: PshLines.MoreSingularOn.of_le
statement:
theorem MoreSingularOn.of_le {u v : X → EReal} {U : Set X}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ U, u x ≤ v x) : MoreSingularOn u v U
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, by simpa using h⟩

name: PshLines.MoreSingularOn.refl
statement: theorem MoreSingularOn.refl (u : X → EReal) (U : Set X) : MoreSingularOn u u U
proof:
:=
  .of_le (fun _ _ => le_rfl)

name: PshLines.MoreSingularOn.trans
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := huv
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hvw
  refine ⟨D + C, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  calc
    u x ≤ v x + (C : EReal) := hC x hx
    _ ≤ (w x + (D : EReal)) + (C : EReal) := add_le_add (hD x hx) le_rfl
    _ = w x + ((D + C : ℝ) : EReal) := by rw [EReal.coe_add, add_assoc]

name: PshLines.MoreSingularOn.mono
statement:
theorem MoreSingularOn.mono {u v : X → EReal} {U V : Set X}
    (h : MoreSingularOn u v U) (hVU : V ⊆ U) : MoreSingularOn u v V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h
  exact ⟨C, fun x hx => hC x (hVU hx)⟩

name: PshLines.MoreSingularOn.eq_bot_of_eq_bot
statement:
theorem MoreSingularOn.eq_bot_of_eq_bot {u v : X → EReal} {U : Set X}
    (h : MoreSingularOn u v U) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (hv : v x = ⊥) : u x = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h
  have h := hC x hx
  simpa [hv] using h

name: PshLines.SameSingularityTypeOn.refl
statement:
theorem SameSingularityTypeOn.refl (u : X → EReal) (U : Set X) :
    SameSingularityTypeOn u u U
proof: := ⟨.refl u U, .refl u U⟩

name: PshLines.SameSingularityTypeOn.symm
statement:
theorem SameSingularityTypeOn.symm {u v : X → EReal} {U : Set X}
    (h : SameSingularityTypeOn u v U) : SameSingularityTypeOn v u U

name: PshLines.SameSingularityTypeOn.trans
proof: := ⟨huv.1.trans hvw.1, hvw.2.trans huv.2⟩

name: PshLines.sameSingularityTypeOn_add_const
statement:
theorem sameSingularityTypeOn_add_const (u : X → EReal) (U : Set X) (c : ℝ) :
    SameSingularityTypeOn (fun x => u x + (c : EReal)) u U
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨c, fun _ _ => le_rfl⟩, ⟨-c, fun x _ => ?_⟩⟩
  rw [add_assoc, ← EReal.coe_add, add_neg_cancel, EReal.coe_zero, add_zero]

name: PshLines.MoreSingularAt.refl
statement: theorem MoreSingularAt.refl (u : X → EReal) (x : X) : MoreSingularAt u u x
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => by simp)⟩

name: PshLines.MoreSingularAt.trans
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := huv
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hvw
  refine ⟨D + C, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hC, hD] with y hyC hyD
  simpa [EReal.coe_add, add_assoc] using hyC.trans (add_le_add hyD (le_rfl : (C : EReal) ≤ C))

name: PshLines.MoreSingularOn.moreSingularAt
statement:
theorem MoreSingularOn.moreSingularAt {u v : X → EReal} {U : Set X}
    (h : MoreSingularOn u v U) {x : X} (hU : U ∈ 𝓝 x) : MoreSingularAt u v x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h
  exact ⟨C, Filter.eventually_of_mem hU (fun y hy => hC y hy)⟩

name: PshLines.moreSingularOn_gluedMax
statement:
theorem moreSingularOn_gluedMax (U V : Set X) (u v : X → EReal) :
    MoreSingularOn v (gluedMax U u v) V
proof:
:= by
  apply MoreSingularOn.of_le
  intro x _
  classical
  by_cases hx : x ∈ U
  · rw [gluedMax_eq_max hx]
    exact le_max_right _ _
  · simp [gluedMax, hx]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.SmoothRealForm.GeometricallyEq.refl
statement: theorem GeometricallyEq.refl (a : SmoothRealForm n M k) : a.GeometricallyEq a
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ => rfl

name: PshLines.FirstPass.SmoothRealForm.GeometricallyEq.symm
statement:
theorem GeometricallyEq.symm {a b : SmoothRealForm n M k}
    (h : a.GeometricallyEq b) : b.GeometricallyEq a
proof:
:=
  fun e => (h e).symm

name: PshLines.FirstPass.SmoothRealForm.GeometricallyEq.trans
statement:
theorem GeometricallyEq.trans {a b c : SmoothRealForm n M k}
    (hab : a.GeometricallyEq b) (hbc : b.GeometricallyEq c) : a.GeometricallyEq c
proof:
:=
  fun e => (hab e).trans (hbc e)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.SmoothRealForm.geometricallyEq_equivalence
statement:
theorem geometricallyEq_equivalence :
    Equivalence (GeometricallyEq (n := n) (M := M) (k := k))
proof:
:=
  ⟨GeometricallyEq.refl, GeometricallyEq.symm, GeometricallyEq.trans⟩

name: PshLines.FirstPass.SmoothRealForm.geometricallyEq_iff
statement:
theorem geometricallyEq_iff {a b : SmoothRealForm n M k} :
    a.GeometricallyEq b ↔
      ∀ e z, z ∈ e.val.target → ∀ v, a.coeff e z v = b.coeff e z v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h e z hz v
    rw [h e hz]
  · intro h e z hz
    ext v
    exact h e z hz v

name: PshLines.FirstPass.SmoothRealForm.GeometricallyEq.coeff_eventuallyEq
proof:
:=
  eventually_of_mem (e.val.open_target.mem_nhds hz) (fun _ hw => h e hw)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.SmoothRealForm.GeometricallyEq.extDeriv_eqOn
proof:
:=
  fun _ hz => (h.coeff_eventuallyEq e hz).extDeriv_eq

name: PshLines.FirstPass.SmoothRealForm.GeometricallyEq.isClosed_iff
statement:
theorem GeometricallyEq.isClosed_iff {a b : SmoothRealForm n M k}
    (h : a.GeometricallyEq b) : a.IsClosed ↔ b.IsClosed
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha e z hz
    rw [← h.extDeriv_eqOn e hz]
    exact ha e z hz
  · intro hb e z hz
    rw [h.extDeriv_eqOn e hz]
    exact hb e z hz

name: PshLines.FirstPass.SmoothRealForm.GeometricallyEq.isTypeOneOne_iff
statement:
theorem GeometricallyEq.isTypeOneOne_iff {a b : SmoothRealForm n M 2}
    (h : a.GeometricallyEq b) : a.IsTypeOneOne ↔ b.IsTypeOneOne
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsTypeOneOne
  exact forall_congr' fun e => forall_congr' fun z =>
    forall_congr' fun hz => by rw [h e hz]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.SmoothRealForm.GeometricallyEq.isSemipositive_iff
statement:
theorem GeometricallyEq.isSemipositive_iff {a b : SmoothRealForm n M 2}
    (h : a.GeometricallyEq b) : a.IsSemipositive ↔ b.IsSemipositive
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsSemipositive
  exact forall_congr' fun e => forall_congr' fun z =>
    forall_congr' fun hz => by rw [h e hz]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.SmoothRealForm.GeometricallyEq.isHermitian_iff
statement:
theorem GeometricallyEq.isHermitian_iff {a b : SmoothRealForm n M 2}
    (h : a.GeometricallyEq b) : a.IsHermitian ↔ b.IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsHermitian
  exact forall_congr' fun e => forall_congr' fun z =>
    forall_congr' fun hz => by rw [h e hz]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.SmoothRealForm.GeometricallyEq.isKahler_iff
statement:
theorem GeometricallyEq.isKahler_iff {a b : SmoothRealForm n M 2}
    (h : a.GeometricallyEq b) : a.IsKahler ↔ b.IsKahler
proof:
:=
  and_congr h.isHermitian_iff h.isClosed_iff

name: PshLines.FirstPass.GeometricRealForm.ofRepresentative_eq_iff
statement:
theorem ofRepresentative_eq_iff (a b : SmoothRealForm n M k) :
    ofRepresentative a = ofRepresentative b ↔ a.GeometricallyEq b
proof:
:=
  Quotient.eq

name: PshLines.FirstPass.GeometricRealForm.isClosed_ofRepresentative
statement:
@[simp] theorem isClosed_ofRepresentative (a : SmoothRealForm n M k) :
    (ofRepresentative a).IsClosed ↔ a.IsClosed
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: PshLines.FirstPass.GeometricRealForm.isHermitian_ofRepresentative
statement:
@[simp] theorem isHermitian_ofRepresentative (a : SmoothRealForm n M 2) :
    (ofRepresentative a).IsHermitian ↔ a.IsHermitian
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: PshLines.FirstPass.GeometricRealForm.isKahler_ofRepresentative
statement:
@[simp] theorem isKahler_ofRepresentative (a : SmoothRealForm n M 2) :
    (ofRepresentative a).IsKahler ↔ a.IsKahler
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: PshLines.FirstPass.HolomorphicDDC.smoothDc_comp
proof:
:= by
  change smoothDc (ρ ∘ F) z = _
  ext v
  rw [smoothDc_apply, fderiv_comp z hρ (hF.restrictScalars ℝ)]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, smoothDc_apply]
  rw [hF.fderiv_restrictScalars ℝ]
  exact congrArg (fun w => (-1 / (4 * Real.pi)) * fderiv ℝ ρ (F z) w)
    ((fderiv ℂ F z).map_smul Complex.I (v 0))

name: PshLines.FirstPass.HolomorphicDDC.smoothDDC_comp
statement:
theorem smoothDDC_comp {F : ComplexModel k → ComplexModel n}
    {ρ : ComplexModel n → ℝ} {U : Set (ComplexModel k)}
    {V : Set (ComplexModel n)} (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℂ ∞ F U) (hρ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ρ V)
    (hFV : MapsTo F U V) {z : ComplexModel k} (hz : z ∈ U) :
    smoothDDC (fun y => ρ (F y)) z =
      (smoothDDC ρ (F z)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F z)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : smoothDc (fun y => ρ (F y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
      (fun y => (smoothDc ρ (F y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F y)) := by
    filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hz] with y hy
    exact smoothDc_comp
      (((hF y hy).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp))
      (((hρ (F y) (hFV hy)).contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds (hFV hy))).differentiableAt
        (by simp))
  apply heq.extDeriv_eq.trans
  exact extDeriv_pullback
    ((((smoothDc_contDiffOn hV hρ) (F z) (hFV hz)).contDiffAt
      (hV.mem_nhds (hFV hz))).differentiableAt (by simp))
    (((hF.restrict_scalars ℝ) z hz).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz))
    (by simpa using ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.smoothDDC_apply_eq_realHessian
statement:
theorem smoothDDC_apply_eq_realHessian {u : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    {z : ComplexModel n} (hu : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 u z) (v w : ComplexModel n) :
    smoothDDC u z ![v, w] =
      (realHessian u z w (Complex.I • v) -
        realHessian u z v (Complex.I • w)) / (4 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  unfold smoothDDC
  rw [extDeriv_apply]
  · rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp only [Fin.isValue, Fin.removeNth_zero, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, smoothDc_apply]
    have htail : Fin.tail ![v, w] 0 = w := by rfl
    have hremove : Fin.removeNth 1 ![v, w] 0 = v := by rfl
    rw [htail, hremove]
    norm_num
    have hv : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y (Complex.I • v)) z := by
      fun_prop
    have hw : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y (Complex.I • w)) z := by
      fun_prop
    have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) z :=
      (hu.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    rw [fderiv_const_mul hw (-1 / (4 * Real.pi)),
      fderiv_const_mul hv (-1 / (4 * Real.pi))]
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply hfd (differentiableAt_const (c := Complex.I • w)),
      fderiv_clm_apply hfd (differentiableAt_const (c := Complex.I • v))]
    have hcw : fderiv ℝ (fun _ : ComplexModel n ↦ Complex.I • w) z = 0 :=
      fderiv_const_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (x := z) (Complex.I • w)
    have hcv : fderiv ℝ (fun _ : ComplexModel n ↦ Complex.I • v) z = 0 :=
      fderiv_const_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (x := z) (Complex.I • v)
    rw [hcw, hcv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_zero, zero_add, smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, realHessian_eq_fderiv]
    ring
  · unfold smoothDc
    have houter : ContDiff ℝ 1
        (ContinuousAlternatingMap.ofSubsingletonLIE
          (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := ComplexModel n) (F := ℝ) (0 : Fin 1)) :=
      (ContinuousAlternatingMap.ofSubsingletonLIE
        (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := ComplexModel n) (F := ℝ) (0 : Fin 1)).contDiff
    have hinner : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y =>
        (-1 / (4 * Real.pi) : ℝ) •
          (fderiv ℝ u y).comp (modelComplexStructure n)) z :=
      ((hu.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).clm_comp contDiffAt_const)
        |>.const_smul (-1 / (4 * Real.pi) : ℝ)
    exact (houter.comp_contDiffAt z hinner).differentiableAt (by norm_num)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.exists_contDiff_eventuallyEq_of_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem exists_contDiff_eventuallyEq_of_contDiffOn
    {W : Set (ComplexModel n)} {h : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hW : IsOpen W) (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h W) {x : ComplexModel n} (hx : x ∈ W) :
    ∃ g : ComplexModel n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g ∧ h =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεW⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW x hx
  let b : ContDiffBump x :=
    { rIn := ε / 4
      rOut := ε / 2
      rIn_pos := by positivity
      rIn_lt_rOut := by linarith }
  let g : ComplexModel n → ℝ := W.piecewise (fun y ↦ b y * h y) 0
  have hbts : tsupport (b : ComplexModel n → ℝ) ⊆ W := by
    rw [b.tsupport_eq]
    exact (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hε)).trans hεW
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ W
    · apply (b.contDiffAt.mul ((hh y hy).contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hy))).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      filter_upwards [hW.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      simp [g, hz]
    · have hyt : y ∉ tsupport (b : ComplexModel n → ℝ) := fun hyt ↦ hy (hbts hyt)
      apply (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      filter_upwards [(isClosed_tsupport (b : ComplexModel n → ℝ)).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hyt]
        with z hz
      have hbz : b z = 0 := by
        apply not_ne_iff.mp
        intro hbzne
        exact hz (subset_tsupport (b : ComplexModel n → ℝ) hbzne)
      by_cases hzW : z ∈ W <;> simp [g, hzW, hbz]
  refine ⟨g, hg, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds x b.rIn_pos] with y hy
  have hyW : y ∈ W := hεW (by
    change dist y x < ε
    change dist y x < ε / 4 at hy
    linarith)
  have hby : b y = 1 := b.one_of_mem_closedBall (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy)
  simp [g, hyW, hby]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.smoothDDC_complexDiagonal_eq_leviForm
proof:
:= by
  rw [smoothDDC_apply_eq_realHessian hu]
  simp only [smul_smul, Complex.I_mul_I, neg_one_smul]
  simp [leviForm, realHessian_eq_fderiv]
  ring

name: PshLines.FirstPass.plurisubharmonicOn_coe_of_smoothDDC_eq_zero
statement:
theorem plurisubharmonicOn_coe_of_smoothDDC_eq_zero
    {W : Set (ComplexModel n)} {h : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hW : IsOpen W) (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h W)
    (hzero : ∀ z ∈ W, smoothDDC h z = 0) :
    PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z ↦ (h z : EReal)) W
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨g, hg, heq⟩ := exists_contDiff_eventuallyEq_of_contDiffOn hW hh hx
  have hmem : {y | h y = g y} ∩ W ∈ 𝓝 x := inter_mem heq (hW.mem_nhds hx)
  obtain ⟨V, hVsub, hV, hxV⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hmem
  have hVW : V ⊆ W := fun y hy ↦ (hVsub hy).2
  have heqV : EqOn h g V := fun y hy ↦ (hVsub hy).1
  have hddcg : ∀ y ∈ V, smoothDDC g y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hloc : h =ᶠ[𝓝 y] g := by
      filter_upwards [hV.mem_nhds hy] with t ht
      exact heqV ht
    rw [← smoothDDC_congr hloc]
    exact hzero y (hVW hy)
  have hlevi : ∀ y ∈ V, ∀ v : ComplexModel n, leviForm g y v = 0 := by
    intro y hy v
    have hdiag := smoothDDC_complexDiagonal_eq_leviForm (z := y)
      ((hg.of_le (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)).contDiffAt) v
    rw [hddcg y hy] at hdiag
    have hz : leviForm g y v / Real.pi = 0 := hdiag.symm
    exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hz).resolve_right Real.pi_ne_zero
  have hpshg : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun y ↦ (g y : EReal)) V :=
    plurisubharmonicOn_of_levi_nonneg
      (hg.of_le (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)) hV
      (fun y hy v ↦ (hlevi y hy v).ge)
  apply (hpshg x hxV).congr
  filter_upwards [hV.mem_nhds hxV] with y hy
  rw [heqV hy]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.corrected_add_sub
statement:
theorem corrected_add_sub (a : EReal) (r s : ℝ) :
    (a + (r : EReal)) + ((s - r : ℝ) : EReal) = a + (s : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_assoc, ← EReal.coe_add]
  congr 2
  ring

name: PshLines.FirstPass.smoothLocalPotential_psh_iff
statement:
theorem smoothLocalPotential_psh_iff
    {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace (ComplexModel n) M]
    [IsComplexManifold n M] (θ : SmoothRealForm n M 2) (e : ComplexChart n M)
    (W : Set (ComplexModel n)) (ρ σ : ComplexModel n → ℝ)
    (hρ : IsSmoothLocalPotential θ e W ρ) (hσ : IsSmoothLocalPotential θ e W σ)
    (u : ComplexModel n → EReal) :
    PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z => u z + (ρ z : EReal)) W ↔
      PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z => u z + (σ z : EReal)) W
proof:
:= by
  have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y ↦ σ y - ρ y) W :=
    hσ.2.2.1.sub hρ.2.2.1
  have hddc : ∀ z ∈ W, smoothDDC (fun y ↦ σ y - ρ y) z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [PositiveClasses.smoothDDC_sub hρ.1 hσ.2.2.1 hρ.2.2.1 hz,
      hσ.2.2.2 hz, hρ.2.2.2 hz, sub_self]
  have hpsh := plurisubharmonicOn_coe_of_smoothDDC_eq_zero hρ.1 hsmooth hddc
  constructor
  · intro hu
    have hadd := PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.add hu hpsh
    intro x hx
    apply (hadd x hx).congr
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun y ↦ corrected_add_sub (u y) (ρ y) (σ y)
  · intro hu
    have hsmooth' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y ↦ ρ y - σ y) W :=
      hρ.2.2.1.sub hσ.2.2.1
    have hddc' : ∀ z ∈ W, smoothDDC (fun y ↦ ρ y - σ y) z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      rw [PositiveClasses.smoothDDC_sub hρ.1 hρ.2.2.1 hσ.2.2.1 hz,
        hρ.2.2.2 hz, hσ.2.2.2 hz, sub_self]
    have hpsh' := plurisubharmonicOn_coe_of_smoothDDC_eq_zero hρ.1 hsmooth' hddc'
    have hadd := PshLines.PlurisubharmonicOn.add hu hpsh'
    intro x hx
    apply (hadd x hx).congr
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun y ↦ corrected_add_sub (u y) (σ y) (ρ y)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.IsLocallyBoundedPshOn.exists_compact_abs_bound
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal : FirstPass.LocallyUniformlyBoundedAbove
      {fun x : ComplexModel n => ((|u x| : ℝ) : EReal)}
      (Ω : Set (ComplexModel n)) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨V, hxV, hVΩ, C, hC⟩ := hu.2 x hx
    refine ⟨(V : Set (ComplexModel n)),
      mem_nhdsWithin_iff_exists_mem_nhds_inter.mpr
        ⟨V, V.isOpen.mem_nhds hxV, by simp⟩, max C 0, ?_⟩
    intro f hf y hy
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hf]
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr
      ((hC y hy.1).trans (le_max_left C 0))
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    hlocal.exists_uniform_upper_bound_on_compact hK hKΩ
  refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right C 0, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hxC := hC (fun y : ComplexModel n => ((|u y| : ℝ) : EReal))
    (Set.mem_singleton _) x hx
  exact (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp hxC).trans (le_max_left C 0)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.locallyIntegrableOn_of_plurisubharmonicOn_real
statement:
theorem locallyIntegrableOn_of_plurisubharmonicOn_real
    {Ω : Opens (ComplexModel n)} {u : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z ↦ (u z : EReal)) Ω) :
    LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω volume
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp Ω.isOpen z hz
  have hzball : z ∈ ball z r := mem_ball_self hr
  have hpshBall : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun x ↦ (u x : EReal)) (ball z r) :=
    hu.mono hball
  have hlocal := hpshBall.locallyIntegrableOn_toReal volume
    (convex_ball z r).isPreconnected ⟨z, hzball, by simp⟩ z hzball
  simpa only [EReal.toReal_coe,
    nhdsWithin_eq_nhds.mpr (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hzball),
    nhdsWithin_eq_nhds.mpr (Ω.isOpen.mem_nhds hz)] using hlocal

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_plurisubharmonicOn_real
statement:
theorem hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_plurisubharmonicOn_real
    {Ω : Opens (ComplexModel n)} {u : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hu : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun z ↦ (u z : EReal)) Ω) :
    HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
      (regularDistribution volume u
        (locallyIntegrableOn_of_plurisubharmonicOn_real hu))
proof:
:= by
  apply hu.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_locallyIntegrable
    (locallyIntegrableOn_of_plurisubharmonicOn_real hu)
  filter_upwards with z
  simp

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.exists_smoothPsh_aeApproximation
statement:
theorem exists_smoothPsh_aeApproximation
    {Ω U : Opens (ComplexModel n)} {u : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hu : IsLocallyBoundedPshOn Ω u) (hU : RelativelyCompactIn U Ω) :
    ∃ f : ℕ → ComplexModel n → ℝ,
      (∀ j, IsSmoothPshOn U (f j)) ∧
        ∀ᵐ z ∂volume.restrict (U : Set (ComplexModel n)),
          Tendsto (fun j ↦ f j z) atTop (𝓝 (u z))
proof:
:= by
  let huL : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω volume :=
    locallyIntegrableOn_of_plurisubharmonicOn_real hu.1
  have hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi (regularDistribution volume u huL) := by
    apply hu.1.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_locallyIntegrable huL
    filter_upwards with z
    simp
  obtain ⟨V, f, hV, hclUV, hVΩ, hsmooth, _hdisc, hpsh, hlim⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_psh_ae_approximation huL hT hU.1 hU.2
  have hUV : (U : Set (ComplexModel n)) ⊆ V := subset_closure.trans hclUV
  refine ⟨f, fun j ↦ isSmoothPshOn_of_psh (hsmooth j).contDiffOn
    ((hpsh j).mono hUV), ?_⟩
  exact ae_mono (Measure.restrict_mono hUV le_rfl) hlim

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.exists_uniformlyBounded_smoothPsh_aeApproximation_on_compact
statement:
theorem exists_uniformlyBounded_smoothPsh_aeApproximation_on_compact
    {Ω : Opens (ComplexModel n)} {u : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hu : IsLocallyBoundedPshOn Ω u) {S : Set (ComplexModel n)}
    (hS : IsCompact S) (hSΩ : S ⊆ Ω) :
    ∃ (U K : Set (ComplexModel n)) (f : ℕ → ComplexModel n → ℝ) (C : ℝ),
      IsOpen U ∧ S ⊆ U ∧ U ⊆ K ∧ IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ Ω ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (f j)) ∧
      (∀ j, DiscPshOn (fun x ↦ (f j x : EReal)) U) ∧
      (∀ j, PlurisubharmonicOn (fun x ↦ (f j x : EReal)) U) ∧
      (∀ j x, |f j x| ≤ C) ∧
      ∀ᵐ x ∂volume,
        Tendsto (fun j ↦ f j x) atTop (𝓝 (K.indicator u x))
proof:
:= by
  let huL : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω volume :=
    locallyIntegrableOn_of_plurisubharmonicOn_real hu.1
  have hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
      (regularDistribution volume u huL) :=
    hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_plurisubharmonicOn_real hu.1
  let : ProperSpace (ComplexModel n) := FiniteDimensional.proper ℝ _
  obtain ⟨R, hR, U, K, hU, hSU, hUK, hK, hKΩ, hball⟩ :=
    exists_open_compact_closedBall_neighborhood hS Ω.isOpen hSΩ
  obtain ⟨C, hC, huC⟩ := hu.exists_compact_abs_bound hK hKΩ
  let g : ComplexModel n → ℝ := K.indicator u
  have hgint : Integrable g volume :=
    integrable_indicator_of_locallyIntegrableOn_isCompact huL hK hKΩ
  have hgC : ∀ x, |g x| ≤ C := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ K
    · simpa only [g, indicator_of_mem hx] using huC x hx
    · simp only [g, indicator_of_notMem hx, abs_zero, hC]
  let f : ℕ → ComplexModel n → ℝ := fun j ↦
    mollify volume g (shrinkingBump R hR j)
  have hs (j : ℕ) (z : ComplexModel n) (hz : z ∈ U) :
      tsupport (fun x ↦
        (shrinkingBump R hR j).normed volume (x - z)) ⊆ K :=
    (tsupport_mollifier_translate_subset volume (shrinkingBump R hR j) z).trans
      ((closedBall_subset_closedBall
        (shrinkingBump_rOut_le (E := ComplexModel n) R hR j)).trans
          (hball z hz))
  have hfdisc (j : ℕ) : DiscPshOn (fun x ↦ (f j x : EReal)) U :=
    discPshOn_translationPairing_indicator huL hT
      (shrinkingBump R hR j).hasCompactSupport_normed
      (shrinkingBump R hR j).contDiff_normed
      (shrinkingBump R hR j).nonneg_normed hK hKΩ (hs j)
  refine ⟨U, K, f, C, hU, hSU, hUK, hK, hKΩ, hC, ?_, hfdisc, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    exact contDiff_mollify volume hgint.locallyIntegrable (shrinkingBump R hR j)
  · intro j
    exact (hfdisc j).plurisubharmonicOn hU
  · intro j x
    exact abs_mollify_le_of_ae_abs_le volume hgint.locallyIntegrable hC
      (ae_of_all volume hgC) (shrinkingBump R hR j) x
  · simpa only [f] using ae_tendsto_mollify volume hgint.locallyIntegrable R hR

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.isDecreasingApproximation_geometricCorrection
statement:
theorem isDecreasingApproximation_geometricCorrection
    {U : Opens (ComplexModel n)} {u : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    {g : ℕ → ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hg : ∀ j, IsSmoothPshOn U (g j))
    (herr : ∀ j z, z ∈ U →
      dist (g j z) (u z) ≤ ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j) / 8) :
    IsDecreasingApproximation U u
      (fun j z ↦ g j z + (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    apply isSmoothPshOn_of_psh
    · exact (hg j).1.add contDiffOn_const
    · have hc : PlurisubharmonicOn
          (fun _ : ComplexModel n ↦ (((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j : ℝ) : EReal)) U :=
        fun z _ ↦ plurisubharmonicAt_const _ (EReal.coe_ne_top _) z
      simpa only [EReal.coe_add] using (hg j).2.1.add hc
  · intro z hz
    apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le
    intro j
    have hj := herr j z hz
    have hjs := herr (j + 1) z hz
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hj hjs
    have hj' := (abs_le.mp hj).1
    have hjs' := (abs_le.mp hjs).2
    have hpow : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j := pow_nonneg (by positivity) _
    change g (j + 1) z + (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (j + 1) ≤
      g j z + (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j
    rw [pow_succ] at hjs' ⊢
    norm_num at hjs' ⊢
    nlinarith
  · intro z hz
    apply tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.mpr
    have hpow : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ ↦ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
      tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by positivity) (by norm_num)
    have hboundlim : Tendsto
        (fun j : ℕ ↦ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j + ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j) / 8)
        atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using hpow.add (hpow.div_const 8)
    apply squeeze_zero (fun _ ↦ dist_nonneg) (fun j ↦ ?_) hboundlim
    calc
      dist (g j z + (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j) (u z) ≤
          dist (g j z + (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j) (g j z) + dist (g j z) (u z) :=
        dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j + ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j) / 8 :=
        add_le_add (by
          rw [Real.dist_eq, add_sub_cancel_left,
            abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by positivity) j)]) (herr j z hz)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.MongeAmpere.exists_decreasingApproximation_of_continuousOn
statement:
theorem exists_decreasingApproximation_of_continuousOn
    {Ω U : Opens (ComplexModel n)} {u : ComplexModel n → ℝ}
    (hu : IsLocallyBoundedPshOn Ω u) (hcont : ContinuousOn u Ω)
    (hU : RelativelyCompactIn U Ω) :
    ∃ f : ℕ → ComplexModel n → ℝ, IsDecreasingApproximation U u f
proof:
:= by
  let huL : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω volume :=
    locallyIntegrableOn_of_plurisubharmonicOn_real hu.1
  have hT : HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi (regularDistribution volume u huL) := by
    apply hu.1.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_locallyIntegrable huL
    filter_upwards with z
    simp
  let : ProperSpace (ComplexModel n) := FiniteDimensional.proper ℝ _
  obtain ⟨R, hR, V, K, hV, hclUV, hVK, hK, hKΩ, hball⟩ :=
    exists_open_compact_closedBall_neighborhood hU.1 Ω.isOpen hU.2
  have hgint : Integrable (K.indicator u) volume :=
    integrable_indicator_of_locallyIntegrableOn_isCompact huL hK hKΩ
  have huc : UniformContinuousOn u K :=
    hK.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous (hcont.mono hKΩ)
  have hchoice : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ m : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ V,
      dist (mollify volume (K.indicator u) (shrinkingBump R hR m) z) (u z) ≤
        ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j) / 8 := by
    intro j
    have he : 0 < ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j) / 8 := by positivity
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hmod⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp huc _ he
    have hevent : ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop,
        (shrinkingBump (E := ComplexModel n) R hR m).rOut < δ :=
      (tendsto_shrinkingBump_rOut (E := ComplexModel n) R hR).eventually
        (Iio_mem_nhds hδ)
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Filter.Eventually.exists hevent
    refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    have hzK : z ∈ K := hVK hz
    rw [mollify_eq_convolution, ← indicator_of_mem hzK u]
    apply ContDiffBump.dist_normed_convolution_le hgint.aestronglyMeasurable
    intro x hx
    have hxK : x ∈ K := hball z hz (by
      exact mem_closedBall.mpr (((mem_ball.mp hx).trans_le
        (shrinkingBump_rOut_le (E := ComplexModel n) R hR m)).le))
    have hdist : dist (u x) (u z) ≤ ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j) / 8 :=
      (hmod x hxK z hzK ((mem_ball.mp hx).trans hm)).le
    simpa only [indicator_of_mem hxK, indicator_of_mem hzK] using hdist
  choose m hm using hchoice
  let g : ℕ → ComplexModel n → ℝ := fun j ↦
    mollify volume (K.indicator u) (shrinkingBump R hR (m j))
  have hsupp (j : ℕ) (z : ComplexModel n) (hz : z ∈ V) :
      tsupport (fun x ↦
        (shrinkingBump R hR (m j)).normed volume (x - z)) ⊆ K :=
    (tsupport_mollifier_translate_subset volume (shrinkingBump R hR (m j)) z).trans
      ((closedBall_subset_closedBall
        (shrinkingBump_rOut_le (E := ComplexModel n) R hR (m j))).trans
          (hball z hz))
  have hdisc (j : ℕ) : DiscPshOn (fun z ↦ (g j z : EReal)) V :=
    discPshOn_translationPairing_indicator huL hT
      (shrinkingBump R hR (m j)).hasCompactSupport_normed
      (shrinkingBump R hR (m j)).contDiff_normed
      (shrinkingBump R hR (m j)).nonneg_normed hK hKΩ (hsupp j)
  have hUV : (U : Set (ComplexModel n)) ⊆ V := subset_closure.trans hclUV
  have hg (j : ℕ) : IsSmoothPshOn U (g j) :=
    isSmoothPshOn_of_psh
      (contDiff_mollify volume hgint.locallyIntegrable
        (shrinkingBump R hR (m j))).contDiffOn
      ((hdisc j).plurisubharmonicOn hV |>.mono hUV)
  refine ⟨_, isDecreasingApproximation_geometricCorrection hg ?_⟩
  intro j z hz
  exact hm j z (hUV hz)

name: PshLines.FirstPass.continuous_harmonicCircleParam
statement:
theorem continuous_harmonicCircleParam (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ) :
    Continuous (harmonicCircleParam c R)
proof:
:= by
  unfold harmonicCircleParam
  fun_prop

name: PshLines.FirstPass.harmonicCircleParam_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem harmonicCircleParam_coe (c : ℂ) (R t : ℝ) :
    harmonicCircleParam c R (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) = circleMap c R t
proof:
:= by
  simp [harmonicCircleParam, circleMap, AddCircle.homeomorphCircle'_apply_mk]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.globalHarmonicFourierMode_harmonicOnNhd
statement:
theorem globalHarmonicFourierMode_harmonicOnNhd (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (n : ℤ) :
    InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd (globalHarmonicFourierMode c R n) univ
proof:
:= by
  intro z _
  unfold globalHarmonicFourierMode
  split_ifs with hn
  · exact (by fun_prop : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => ((w - c) / (R : ℂ)) ^ n.toNat) z).harmonicAt
  · exact (by fun_prop : AnalyticAt ℂ
        (fun w : ℂ => ((w - c) / (R : ℂ)) ^ (-n).toNat) z).harmonicAt_conj

name: PshLines.FirstPass.globalHarmonicFourierMode_param
statement:
theorem globalHarmonicFourierMode_param (c : ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : R ≠ 0)
    (n : ℤ) (q : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :
    globalHarmonicFourierMode c R n (harmonicCircleParam c R q) =
      fourier n q
proof:
:= by
  induction q using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on
  rename_i t
  rw [harmonicCircleParam_coe, fourier_coe_apply]
  have hfourierExponent :
      (2 : ℂ) * Real.pi * Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (t : ℂ) /
          ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        (n : ℂ) * ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
    push_cast
    ring
  unfold globalHarmonicFourierMode
  split_ifs with hn
  · have hcoord : (circleMap c R t - c) / (R : ℂ) = Complex.exp (t * Complex.I) := by
      rw [circleMap_sub_center]
      simp [circleMap_zero, hR]
    rw [hcoord, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul, hfourierExponent]
    have hcast : (n.toNat : ℂ) = (n : ℂ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn
    rw [hcast]
  · have hcoord : (circleMap c R t - c) / (R : ℂ) = Complex.exp (t * Complex.I) := by
      rw [circleMap_sub_center]
      simp [circleMap_zero, hR]
    rw [hcoord, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul, ← Complex.exp_conj]
    rw [map_mul, map_natCast, map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I]
    rw [hfourierExponent]
    congr 1
    have hneg : 0 ≤ -n := by omega
    have hcast : ((-n).toNat : ℂ) = ((-n : ℤ) : ℂ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_of_nonneg hneg
    rw [hcast]
    push_cast
    ring

name: PshLines.FirstPass.exists_global_harmonic_extension_of_mem_span_fourier
statement:
theorem exists_global_harmonic_extension_of_mem_span_fourier
    (c : ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : R ≠ 0)
    (p : C(AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), ℂ))
    (hp : p ∈ span ℂ (range (@fourier (2 * Real.pi)))) :
    ∃ H : ℂ → ℂ,
      InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd H univ ∧
      ∀ q, H (harmonicCircleParam c R q) = p q
proof:
:= by
  induction hp using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem p hp =>
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hp
      exact ⟨globalHarmonicFourierMode c R n,
        globalHarmonicFourierMode_harmonicOnNhd c R n,
        globalHarmonicFourierMode_param c hR n⟩
  | zero =>
      exact ⟨fun _ ↦ 0, InnerProductSpace.harmonicOnNhd_const 0, by simp⟩
  | add p₁ p₂ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      obtain ⟨H₁, hH₁, hbdy₁⟩ := ih₁
      obtain ⟨H₂, hH₂, hbdy₂⟩ := ih₂
      refine ⟨H₁ + H₂, hH₁.add hH₂, ?_⟩
      intro q
      simp [hbdy₁ q, hbdy₂ q]
  | smul a p _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨H, hH, hbdy⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨fun z ↦ a * H z, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [Function.comp_def] using
          hH.comp_CLM (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℂ a)
      · intro q
        simp [hbdy q]

name: PshLines.FirstPass.exists_global_harmonic_uniformApprox_circleParam
statement:
theorem exists_global_harmonic_uniformApprox_circleParam
    (c : ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : R ≠ 0)
    (g : C(AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), ℝ)) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ h : ℂ → ℝ,
      InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd h univ ∧
      ∀ q, |h (harmonicCircleParam c R q) - g q| < ε
proof:
:= by
  let G : C(AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), ℂ) :=
    ⟨fun q ↦ (g q : ℂ), by fun_prop⟩
  have hG : G ∈ (span ℂ (range (@fourier (2 * Real.pi)))).topologicalClosure := by
    rw [span_fourier_closure_eq_top]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hdist⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hG ε hε
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hbdy⟩ :=
    exists_global_harmonic_extension_of_mem_span_fourier c hR p hp
  refine ⟨fun z ↦ (H z).re, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [Function.comp_def] using hH.comp_CLM Complex.reCLM
  · intro q
    have hre :
        |(H (harmonicCircleParam c R q)).re - g q| ≤
          ‖H (harmonicCircleParam c R q) - (g q : ℂ)‖ := by
      calc
        |(H (harmonicCircleParam c R q)).re - g q| =
            ‖Complex.reCLM
              (H (harmonicCircleParam c R q) - (g q : ℂ))‖ := by simp
        _ ≤ ‖Complex.reCLM‖ *
            ‖H (harmonicCircleParam c R q) - (g q : ℂ)‖ :=
          Complex.reCLM.le_opNorm _
        _ = ‖H (harmonicCircleParam c R q) - (g q : ℂ)‖ := by
          rw [Complex.reCLM_norm, one_mul]
    refine hre.trans_lt ?_
    rw [hbdy q]
    calc
      ‖p q - (g q : ℂ)‖ = ‖(p - G) q‖ := by rfl
      _ ≤ ‖p - G‖ := ContinuousMap.norm_coe_le_norm (p - G) q
      _ = dist p G := by rw [dist_eq_norm]
      _ = dist G p := dist_comm _ _
      _ < ε := hdist

name: PshLines.FirstPass.exists_global_harmonic_uniformApproxOn_sphere
statement:
theorem exists_global_harmonic_uniformApproxOn_sphere
    (c : ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    {f : ℂ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (sphere c R))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ h : ℂ → ℝ,
      InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd h univ ∧
      ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, |h z - f z| < ε
proof:
:= by
  have hparam : ∀ q, harmonicCircleParam c R q ∈ sphere c R := by
    intro q
    induction q using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on
    rename_i t
    rw [harmonicCircleParam_coe]
    exact circleMap_mem_sphere c hR.le t
  let g : C(AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), ℝ) :=
    ⟨fun q ↦ f (harmonicCircleParam c R q),
      hf.comp_continuous (continuous_harmonicCircleParam c R) hparam⟩
  obtain ⟨h, hharm, happ⟩ :=
    exists_global_harmonic_uniformApprox_circleParam c hR.ne' g hε
  refine ⟨h, hharm, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hz' : z ∈ range (circleMap c R) := by
    rw [range_circleMap, abs_of_pos hR]
    exact hz
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hz'
  simpa [g] using happ (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.comp_submodule_add
proof:
:= by
  intro c v hv s hs
  have key : ∀ s : ℂ, ((c + s • v : K) : E) + a = ((c : E) + a) + s • (v : E) := fun s => by
    simp only [Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul]
    abel
  have hset : (fun s : ℂ => c + s • v) ⁻¹' {w : K | (w : E) + a ∈ D} =
      (fun s : ℂ => ((c : E) + a) + s • (v : E)) ⁻¹' D := by
    ext s
    simp only [mem_preimage, mem_ofPred_eq, key]
  have hv' : (v : E) ≠ 0 := by simpa using hv
  have h := hl ((c : E) + a) (v : E) hv' s (by rw [← hset]; exact hs)
  simp only [hset, key]
  exact h

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.upperSemicontinuousOn_of_finrank_le_one
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.upperSemicontinuousOn_of_finrank_le_one [FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
    (hn : Module.finrank ℂ E ≤ 1) {u : E → ℝ} {D : Set E} (hD : IsOpen D)
    (hl : LineSubharmonicOn u D) : UpperSemicontinuousOn u D
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  suffices h : UpperSemicontinuousAt u z from h.upperSemicontinuousWithinAt D
  intro b hb
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial E with hE | hE
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun x => (Subsingleton.elim z x) ▸ hb
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_ne (0 : E)
  have hspan : ∀ w : E, ∃ c : ℂ, c • v = w :=
    (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' v hv).mp (le_antisymm hn Module.finrank_pos)
  have hline := hl.upperSemicontinuousAt_line hD hz v b (by simpa using hb)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hline
  have hvpos : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv
  filter_upwards [ball_mem_nhds z (mul_pos hε hvpos)] with y hy
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hspan (y - z)
  have hcε : dist c 0 < ε := by
    rw [dist_zero_right]
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, ← hc, norm_smul] at hy
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right hy hvpos.le
  simpa [hc] using hball hcε

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.measurable_indicator
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.measurable_indicator [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] {u : E → ℝ} {D : Set E} (hD : IsOpen D)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ D, 0 ≤ u x) (hl : LineSubharmonicOn u D) {e : E} (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    (hslice : ∀ t : ℂ, UpperSemicontinuousOn (fun w : (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ => u (w + t • e))
      {w | (w : E) + t • e ∈ D}) :
    Measurable (D.indicator u)
proof:
:= by
  set W := (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ
  have he0 : e ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    simp [h] at he
  let G : Set (W × ℂ) := {p | (p.1 : E) + p.2 • e ∈ D}
  have hG : IsOpen G := hD.preimage (by fun_prop)
  let F : W × ℂ → ℝ := fun p => u ((p.1 : E) + p.2 • e)
  have hborel : Measurable (fun p : G => F p.1) :=
    borel_measurable_of_sections (X := W) hG (f := fun w t => u ((w : E) + t • e))
      (fun t => hslice t) (fun _ _ h => hpos _ h) (fun w _ h => hl w e he0 _ h)
  have hFG : Measurable (G.indicator F) := by
    refine measurable_of_restrict_of_restrict_compl hG.measurableSet ?_ ?_
    · convert hborel using 1
      funext p
      simp [Set.domRestrict, p.property]
    · convert (measurable_const : Measurable fun _ : (Gᶜ : Set (W × ℂ)) => (0 : ℝ)) using 1
      funext p
      exact indicator_of_notMem p.property _
  have hmem : ∀ y : E, y - ⟪e, y⟫_ℂ • e ∈ W := fun y => by
    rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right]
    simp [inner_sub_right, inner_smul_right, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, he]
  let Ψ : E → W × ℂ := fun y => (⟨y - ⟪e, y⟫_ℂ • e, hmem y⟩, ⟪e, y⟫_ℂ)
  have hΦΨ : ∀ y, ((Ψ y).1 : E) + (Ψ y).2 • e = y := fun y => by simp [Ψ]
  have hΨ : Measurable Ψ := by
    refine Continuous.measurable (Continuous.prodMk ?_ ?_)
    · exact Continuous.subtype_mk (by fun_prop) _
    · fun_prop
  have heq : D.indicator u = G.indicator F ∘ Ψ := by
    funext y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ D
    · have hyG : Ψ y ∈ G := by
        change ((Ψ y).1 : E) + (Ψ y).2 • e ∈ D
        rw [hΦΨ]
        exact hy
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, indicator_of_mem hy, indicator_of_mem hyG, F, hΦΨ]
    · have hyG : Ψ y ∉ G := by
        change ((Ψ y).1 : E) + (Ψ y).2 • e ∉ D
        rw [hΦΨ]
        exact hy
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, indicator_of_notMem hy, indicator_of_notMem hyG]
  rw [heq]
  exact hFG.comp hΨ

name: PshLines.PSHD.boundedLineSubharmonicUSC_of_ballAverage
statement: theorem boundedLineSubharmonicUSC_of_ballAverage : BoundedLineSubharmonicUSC.{u}
proof:
:=
  fun hD hl hu hpos hbdd => hl.upperSemicontinuousOn hD hu hpos hbdd

name: PshLines.PSHD.upperSemicontinuousOn_of_boundedLineSubharmonicUSC
statement:
theorem upperSemicontinuousOn_of_boundedLineSubharmonicUSC
    (hstep : BoundedLineSubharmonicUSC.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [FiniteDimensional ℂ E],
      Module.finrank ℂ E = n → ∀ {u : E → ℝ} {D : Set E}, IsOpen D →
        (∀ x ∈ D, 0 ≤ u x) → LineSubharmonicOn u D → UpperSemicontinuousOn u D
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro E _ _ _ hn u D hD hpos hl
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 2 with h | h
  · exact hl.upperSemicontinuousOn_of_finrank_le_one (by omega) hD
  have : Nontrivial E := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := ℂ) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_norm_eq E zero_le_one
  have he0 : e ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    simp [h] at he
  have : Fact (Module.finrank ℂ E = (n - 1) + 1) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hW : Module.finrank ℂ (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ = n - 1 := Submodule.finrank_orthogonal_span_singleton he0
  have hslice : ∀ t : ℂ, UpperSemicontinuousOn (fun w : (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ => u (w + t • e))
      {w | (w : E) + t • e ∈ D} := fun t =>
    ih (n - 1) (by omega) hW (hD.preimage (by fun_prop)) (fun w hw => hpos _ hw)
      (hl.comp_submodule_add _ _)
  borelize E
  have hmeas := hl.measurable_indicator hD hpos he hslice
  have heqOn : EqOn u (D.indicator u) D := fun x hx => (indicator_of_mem hx u).symm
  have hl' := hl.congr heqOn
  have husc := hstep hD hl' hmeas
    (fun x hx => by rw [← heqOn hx]; exact hpos x hx)
    (fun p hp => hl'.exists_bddAbove (by omega) hmeas hD hp)
  intro x hx
  exact (husc x hx).congr_of_eventuallyEq hx
    (eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall fun y hy c => by rw [heqOn hy])

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.discPshOn_of_nonneg
proof:
:=
  hl.discPshOn (upperSemicontinuousOn_of_boundedLineSubharmonicUSC
    boundedLineSubharmonicUSC_of_ballAverage _ rfl hD hpos hl)

name: PshLines.PSHD.measurable_on_open_of_discPsh_sections
statement:
theorem measurable_on_open_of_discPsh_sections
    {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {G : Set (X × ℂ)} (hG : IsOpen G) {f : X → ℂ → ℝ}
    (husc : ∀ y, UpperSemicontinuousOn (fun x => f x y) {x | (x, y) ∈ G})
    (hpos : ∀ x y, (x, y) ∈ G → 0 ≤ f x y)
    (hpsh : ∀ x, DiscPshOn (fun y => (f x y : EReal)) {y | (x, y) ∈ G}) :
    Measurable (fun p : G => f p.1.1 p.1.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_of_open_neighborhoods
  intro p
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hG.mem_nhds p.property)
  have hprod : ball p.1.1 r ×ˢ ball p.1.2 r ⊆ G := by
    simpa only [ball_prod_same] using hball
  let V : Set G := Subtype.val ⁻¹' (ball p.1.1 r ×ˢ ball p.1.2 r)
  refine ⟨V, (isOpen_ball.prod isOpen_ball).preimage continuous_subtype_val,
    ⟨mem_ball_self hr, mem_ball_self hr⟩, ?_⟩
  let : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (ball p.1.2 r)) :=
    ⟨by simpa using (measure_ball_lt_top (μ := (volume : Measure ℂ)) (x := p.1.2) (r := r))⟩
  have hm := measurable_on_product_of_discPsh (X := ball p.1.1 r) isOpen_ball
    (f := fun x y => f x y)
    (fun y hy => upperSemicontinuousOn_iff_restrict.mpr
      ((husc y).mono (fun x hx => hprod ⟨hx, hy⟩)))
    (fun x y hy => hpos x y (hprod ⟨x.property, hy⟩))
    (fun x => (hpsh x).mono (fun y hy => hprod ⟨x.property, hy⟩))
  let q : V → ball p.1.1 r × ball p.1.2 r := fun z =>
    (⟨z.1.1.1, z.property.1⟩, ⟨z.1.1.2, z.property.2⟩)
  have hq : Measurable q := by
    exact ((measurable_fst.comp (measurable_subtype_coe.comp
      measurable_subtype_coe)).subtype_mk).prodMk
      ((measurable_snd.comp (measurable_subtype_coe.comp
        measurable_subtype_coe)).subtype_mk)
  exact hm.comp hq

name: PshLines.PSHD.isClosed_hopf_relation
proof:
:= by
  let C := {p : sphere (0 : ℂ) 1 × (sphere (0 : E) 1 × sphere (0 : E) 1) |
    (p.1 : ℂ) • (p.2.2 : E) = (p.2.1 : E)}
  have hC : IsClosed C := isClosed_eq
    ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).smul
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd.snd))
    (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd.fst)
  have heq : {p : sphere (0 : E) 1 × sphere (0 : E) 1 | hopf p.1 = hopf p.2} =
      Prod.snd '' C := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · intro hp
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hval⟩ := (hopf_eq_iff p.1 p.2).mp hp
      exact ⟨(⟨a, by simpa using ha⟩, p), hval, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨a, q⟩, hval, rfl⟩
      exact (hopf_eq_iff q.1 q.2).mpr ⟨a, by simp, hval⟩
  rw [heq]
  exact isClosedMap_snd_of_compactSpace C hC

name: PshLines.PSHD.measurableSet_highValue_hopf_relation
statement:
theorem measurableSet_highValue_hopf_relation
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {u : E → ℝ} (hu : Measurable u) (x : E) (R A : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet {p : (ℝ × sphere (0 : E) 1) × sphere (0 : E) 1 |
      p.1.1 ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ hopf p.2 = hopf p.1.2 ∧
        A ≤ u (x + (p.1.1 : ℂ) • (p.2 : E))}
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Continuous (fun p : (ℝ × sphere (0 : E) 1) × sphere (0 : E) 1 =>
      p.1.1) := continuous_fst.fst
  have hdir : IsClosed {p : (ℝ × sphere (0 : E) 1) × sphere (0 : E) 1 |
      hopf p.2 = hopf p.1.2} :=
    isClosed_hopf_relation.preimage (continuous_snd.prodMk continuous_fst.snd)
  have hpoint : Continuous (fun p : (ℝ × sphere (0 : E) 1) × sphere (0 : E) 1 =>
      x + (p.1.1 : ℂ) • (p.2 : E)) :=
    continuous_const.add ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hr).smul
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd))
  exact (measurableSet_Icc.preimage hr.measurable).inter
    (hdir.measurableSet.inter
      (measurableSet_le measurable_const (hu.comp hpoint.measurable)))

name: PshLines.PSHD.measurableSet_projective_highValue_relation
statement:
theorem measurableSet_projective_highValue_relation
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {u : E → ℝ} (hu : Measurable u) (x : E) (R A : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet {p : (ℝ × Projectivization ℂ E) × sphere (0 : E) 1 |
      p.1.1 ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ hopf p.2 = p.1.2 ∧
        A ≤ u (x + (p.1.1 : ℂ) • (p.2 : E))}
proof:
:=
  measurableSet_highValue_relation continuous_hopf hu x R A

name: PshLines.PSHD.nonempty_isCompact_projective_highValue_section
statement:
theorem nonempty_isCompact_projective_highValue_section
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    {u : E → ℝ} {D : Set E} (hD : IsOpen D) {x : E}
    (hu : ∀ v : E, v ≠ 0 →
      DiscPshOn (fun z => (u (x + z • v) : EReal))
        ((fun z : ℂ => x + z • v) ⁻¹' D))
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hball : closedBall x r ⊆ D)
    (ξ : Projectivization ℂ E) :
    {f : sphere (0 : E) 1 | hopf f = ξ ∧
      u x ≤ u (x + (r : ℂ) • (f : E))}.Nonempty ∧
    IsCompact {f : sphere (0 : E) 1 | hopf f = ξ ∧
      u x ≤ u (x + (r : ℂ) • (f : E))}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := hopf_surjective ξ
  have hv : (r : ℂ) • (e : E) ≠ 0 := by
    apply norm_ne_zero_iff.mp
    simpa [norm_smul, abs_of_pos hr] using hr.ne'
  apply nonempty_isCompact_highValue_hopf_fiber e (hu _ hv)
  · exact hD.preimage (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
  · intro z hz
    apply hball
    have hz' : ‖z‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa using hz
    have hmul : ‖z‖ * r ≤ r := by nlinarith
    simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, norm_smul, abs_of_pos hr] using hmul

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_highValue_sphere
statement:
theorem exists_highValue_sphere {u : ℂ → ℝ} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hu : DiscPshOn (fun z => (u z : EReal)) U) (hU : IsOpen U)
    {c : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hD : closedBall c r ⊆ U) :
    ∃ z ∈ sphere c r, u c ≤ u z
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (sphere c r).Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨c + (r : ℂ), ?_⟩
    simp [abs_of_pos hr]
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hmax⟩ :=
    (hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.mono (sphere_subset_closedBall.trans hD)).exists_isMaxOn
      hs (isCompact_sphere c r)
  refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
  exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp
    ((hu.plurisubharmonicOn hU).le_const_on_closedBall_of_le_on_sphere hr hD
      (fun w hw => hmax hw) c (mem_closedBall_self hr.le))

name: PshLines.PSHD.isCompact_highValue_sphere
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF, heq⟩ := upperSemicontinuousOn_iff_preimage_Ici.mp
    (hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.mono hD) (A : EReal)
  have hset : {z ∈ sphere c r | A ≤ u z} = sphere c r ∩ F := by
    simpa only [Set.preimage, Set.mem_Ici, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff,
      Set.inter_ofPred_eq_sep] using heq
  rw [hset]
  exact (isCompact_sphere c r).inter_right hF

name: PshLines.PSHD.nonempty_isCompact_highValue_sphere
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hval⟩ := exists_highValue_sphere hu hU hr hD
  exact ⟨⟨z, hz, hval⟩,
    isCompact_highValue_sphere hu (sphere_subset_closedBall.trans hD)⟩

name: PshLines.PSHD.nonempty_isCompact_highValue_affineCircle
statement:
theorem nonempty_isCompact_highValue_affineCircle
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    {u : E → ℝ} {U : Set ℂ} {x v : E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn (fun z => (u (x + z • v) : EReal)) U) (hU : IsOpen U)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hD : closedBall (0 : ℂ) r ⊆ U) :
    {y | ∃ z ∈ sphere (0 : ℂ) r, y = x + z • v ∧ u x ≤ u y}.Nonempty ∧
      IsCompact {y | ∃ z ∈ sphere (0 : ℂ) r, y = x + z • v ∧ u x ≤ u y}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne, hcomp⟩ := nonempty_isCompact_highValue_sphere hu hU hr hD
  simp only [zero_smul, add_zero] at hne hcomp
  have heq : {y | ∃ z ∈ sphere (0 : ℂ) r, y = x + z • v ∧ u x ≤ u y} =
      (fun z : ℂ => x + z • v) '' {z ∈ sphere (0 : ℂ) r | u x ≤ u (x + z • v)} := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl, hval⟩
      exact ⟨z, ⟨hz, hval⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, ⟨hz, hval⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨z, hz, rfl, hval⟩
  rw [heq]
  exact ⟨hne.image _, hcomp.image (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))⟩

name: PshLines.PSHD.measurable_of_eventually_tendsto
statement:
theorem measurable_of_eventually_tendsto
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {f : ℕ → ℕ → X → ℝ} {u : X → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ N k, Measurable (f N k))
    (hu : ∀ x, ∀ᶠ N in atTop, Tendsto (fun k => f N k x) atTop (𝓝 (u x))) :
    Measurable u
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun x =>
      limsup (fun N => limsup (fun k => f N k x) atTop) atTop) :=
    Measurable.limsup (fun N => Measurable.limsup (hf N))
  convert hm using 1
  funext x
  symm
  apply Filter.Tendsto.limsup_eq
  apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
  filter_upwards [hu x] with N hN
  exact hN.limsup_eq.symm

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_nat_tendsto_truncated_real_ball_average_restrict
statement:
theorem exists_nat_tendsto_truncated_real_ball_average_restrict
    {u : E → ℝ} {U s : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn (fun x => (u x : EReal)) U)
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (a : E) (hUa : U ∈ 𝓝 a) (hsa : s ∈ 𝓝 a) :
    ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N ≥ N₀,
      Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (∫ x in ball a r, min (u x) (N : ℝ) ∂(μ.restrict s)) /
        (μ (ball a r)).toReal) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (u a))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := exists_nat_tendsto_truncated_real_ball_average hu μ a hUa
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hRs⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hsa
  refine ⟨N₀, fun N hN => (hN₀ N hN).congr' ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds hR)] with r hr
  have hbs : ball a r ⊆ s := (ball_subset_ball hr.le).trans hRs
  rw [Measure.restrict_restrict measurableSet_ball, inter_eq_left.mpr hbs]

name: PshLines.PSHD.highValue_hopf_fiber_eq_image
statement:
theorem highValue_hopf_fiber_eq_image
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    (u : E → ℝ) (x : E) (r : ℝ) (e : sphere (0 : E) 1) :
    {f : sphere (0 : E) 1 | hopf f = hopf e ∧
      u x ≤ u (x + (r : ℂ) • (f : E))} =
    phaseOrbit e '' {a : sphere (0 : ℂ) 1 |
      u x ≤ u (x + (a : ℂ) • ((r : ℂ) • (e : E)))}
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hf, hval⟩
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (hopf_fiber_eq_range e ▸ hf : f ∈ range (phaseOrbit e))
    refine ⟨a, ?_, rfl⟩
    simpa only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, phaseOrbit, smul_smul, mul_comm] using hval
  · rintro ⟨a, hval, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (hopf_eq_iff _ _).mpr ⟨a, by simp, rfl⟩
    · simpa only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, phaseOrbit, smul_smul, mul_comm] using hval

name: PshLines.PSHD.nonempty_isCompact_highValue_hopf_fiber
statement:
theorem nonempty_isCompact_highValue_hopf_fiber
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    {u : E → ℝ} {x : E} {r : ℝ} (e : sphere (0 : E) 1) {U : Set ℂ}
    (hu : DiscPshOn
      (fun z => (u (x + z • ((r : ℂ) • (e : E))) : EReal)) U)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hD : closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 ⊆ U) :
    {f : sphere (0 : E) 1 | hopf f = hopf e ∧
      u x ≤ u (x + (r : ℂ) • (f : E))}.Nonempty ∧
    IsCompact {f : sphere (0 : E) 1 | hopf f = hopf e ∧
      u x ≤ u (x + (r : ℂ) • (f : E))}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne, hcomp⟩ :=
    nonempty_isCompact_highValue_sphere hu hU (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) hD
  simp only [zero_smul, add_zero] at hne hcomp
  have hpre : IsCompact {a : sphere (0 : ℂ) 1 |
      u x ≤ u (x + (a : ℂ) • ((r : ℂ) • (e : E)))} := by
    simpa only [preimage_ofPred_eq, Subtype.coe_prop, true_and] using
      hcomp.preimage_continuous
        (continuous_subtype_val : Continuous (Subtype.val : sphere (0 : ℂ) 1 → ℂ))
  have hne' : {a : sphere (0 : ℂ) 1 |
      u x ≤ u (x + (a : ℂ) • ((r : ℂ) • (e : E)))}.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hval⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, hval⟩
  rw [highValue_hopf_fiber_eq_image]
  exact ⟨hne'.image _, hpre.image (continuous_phaseOrbit e)⟩

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.ball_deficit_le
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.ball_deficit_le {u : E → ℝ} {D : Set E}
    (hl : LineSubharmonicOn u D) (hu : Measurable u) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (a : E) (R C : ℝ) (hBD : ball a R ⊆ D) (hC : ∀ y ∈ ball a R, u y ≤ C) :
    ∫⁻ x in ball a R, ENNReal.ofReal (C - u x) ∂μ ≤
      μ (ball 0 R) * ENNReal.ofReal (C - u a)
proof:
:= by
  let d : E → ℝ≥0∞ := fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (C - u x)
  let f : E → ℝ≥0∞ := (ball a R).indicator d
  have hm : Measurable f :=
    ((measurable_const.sub hu).ennreal_ofReal).indicator measurableSet_ball
  have hf : ∫⁻ x in ball a R, f x ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in ball a R, d x ∂μ :=
    setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_ball (fun x hx => by simp [f, hx])
  have hrot (t : ℝ) :
      ∫⁻ v in ball 0 R, f (a + circleMap 0 1 t • v) ∂μ =
        ∫⁻ x in ball a R, d x ∂μ :=
    (lintegral_ball_add_circleMap_smul μ f a t R).trans hf
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : E × ℝ => a + circleMap 0 1 p.2 • p.1) := by
    fun_prop
  have hswap := lintegral_lintegral_swap
    (μ := μ.restrict (ball 0 R)) (ν := volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi)))
    (f := fun v t => f (a + circleMap 0 1 t • v)) (hm.comp hc.measurable).aemeasurable
  have hangle (v : E) (hv : v ∈ ball 0 R) :
      ∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi), f (a + circleMap 0 1 t • v) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * d a := by
    have hD := affineClosedDisc_subset_ball a v (by simpa using hv)
    have heq :
        ∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi), f (a + circleMap 0 1 t • v) =
          circleDeficit (fun x => (u x : EReal)) a v 1 C := by
      apply lintegral_congr
      intro t
      have ht := hD (circle_mem_affineClosedDisc a v (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) t)
      simp [f, d, ht, ← EReal.coe_sub]
    rw [heq]
    have h := hl.hasDiscSubmeanOn a v 1 (by norm_num) (hD.trans hBD) C
      (fun y hy => EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (hC y (hD hy)))
    simpa [d, ← EReal.coe_sub, EReal.real_coe_toENNReal] using h
  have hmul : (∫⁻ x in ball a R, d x ∂μ) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) ≤
      (μ (ball 0 R) * d a) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) := by
    calc
      (∫⁻ x in ball a R, d x ∂μ) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) =
          ∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi),
            ∫⁻ v in ball 0 R, f (a + circleMap 0 1 t • v) ∂μ := by
              simp_rw [hrot]
              simp
      _ = ∫⁻ v in ball 0 R,
          (∫⁻ t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi), f (a + circleMap 0 1 t • v)) ∂μ := hswap.symm
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ _v in ball 0 R, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * d a ∂μ :=
        setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_ball hangle
      _ = (μ (ball 0 R) * d a) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) := by
        rw [setLIntegral_const]; ring
  exact (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_left
    (ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos)))
    ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mp hmul

name: PshLines.PSHD.lintegral_ball_eq_ofReal_mul_lintegral_unitBall
statement:
theorem lintegral_ball_eq_ofReal_mul_lintegral_unitBall [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (g : E → ℝ≥0∞) (z : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∫⁻ x in ball z r, g x ∂μ =
      ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) * ∫⁻ y in ball 0 1, g (z + r • y) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
  set h : E → ℝ≥0∞ := (ball (0 : E) r).indicator (fun x => g (z + x))
  have hpre : (ball (0 : E) 1).indicator (fun y => g (z + r • y)) = fun y => h (r • y) := by
    funext y
    have hiff : r • y ∈ ball (0 : E) r ↔ y ∈ ball (0 : E) 1 := by
      simp [mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, abs_of_pos hr, hr]
    by_cases hy : y ∈ ball (0 : E) 1
    · simp [h, hy, hiff.mpr hy]
    · simp [h, hy, mt hiff.mp hy]
  have hmap : ∫⁻ y, h (r • y) ∂μ =
      ENNReal.ofReal |(r ^ Module.finrank ℝ E)⁻¹| * ∫⁻ x, h x ∂μ := by
    rw [← smul_eq_mul, ← lintegral_smul_measure, ← Measure.map_addHaar_smul μ hr0]
    exact (lintegral_map_equiv h (Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero r hr0).toMeasurableEquiv).symm
  have hone : ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) *
      ENNReal.ofReal |(r ^ Module.finrank ℝ E)⁻¹| = 1 := by
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity), abs_of_pos (by positivity),
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity), ENNReal.ofReal_one]
  calc ∫⁻ x in ball z r, g x ∂μ = ∫⁻ x, h x ∂μ := by
        rw [lintegral_indicator measurableSet_ball, lintegral_ball_add]
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) * ∫⁻ y, h (r • y) ∂μ := by
        rw [hmap, ← mul_assoc, hone, one_mul]
    _ = _ := by rw [← hpre, lintegral_indicator measurableSet_ball]

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.exists_ball_deficit_gt
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.exists_ball_deficit_gt {u : E → ℝ} {D : Set E} (hD : IsOpen D)
    (hl : LineSubharmonicOn u D) (hu : Measurable u) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    {z : E} (hz : z ∈ D) (C : ℝ) {t : ℝ≥0∞} (ht : t < ENNReal.ofReal (C - u z))
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ∃ r ∈ Ioc 0 ρ, μ (ball 0 r) * t < ∫⁻ x in ball z r, ENNReal.ofReal (C - u x) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let s : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ρ / (k + 1)
  have hs : ∀ k, 0 < s k := fun k => by positivity
  have hsρ : ∀ k, s k ≤ ρ := fun k =>
    div_le_self hρ.le (by linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k)])
  have hs0 : Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa [s, div_eq_mul_inv] using tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.const_mul ρ
  have hray : ∀ y : E, ENNReal.ofReal (C - u z) ≤
      liminf (fun k => ENNReal.ofReal (C - u (z + s k • y))) atTop := by
    intro y
    refine le_of_forall_lt_imp_le_of_dense fun a ha => ?_
    have hatop : a ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_lt ha
    have ha' : a.toReal < C - u z := (ENNReal.lt_ofReal_iff_toReal_lt hatop).mp ha
    have hline := hl.upperSemicontinuousAt_line hD hz y (C - a.toReal) (by
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
      linarith)
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun k => ((s k : ℝ) : ℂ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp hs0
    refine le_liminf_of_le (by isBoundedDefault) ?_
    filter_upwards [hlim.eventually hline] with k hk
    simp only [Complex.coe_smul] at hk
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hatop]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by linarith)
  have hmeas : ∀ k, Measurable (fun y : E => ENNReal.ofReal (C - u (z + s k • y))) := fun k =>
    (measurable_const.sub (hu.comp
      (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.const_smul (s k))).measurable)).ennreal_ofReal
  have hlow : μ (ball 0 1) * ENNReal.ofReal (C - u z) ≤
      liminf (fun k => ∫⁻ y in ball 0 1, ENNReal.ofReal (C - u (z + s k • y)) ∂μ) atTop :=
    calc μ (ball 0 1) * ENNReal.ofReal (C - u z) =
        ∫⁻ _y in ball (0 : E) 1, ENNReal.ofReal (C - u z) ∂μ := by
          rw [setLIntegral_const, mul_comm]
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ y in ball (0 : E) 1,
          liminf (fun k => ENNReal.ofReal (C - u (z + s k • y))) atTop ∂μ :=
        lintegral_mono fun y => hray y
      _ ≤ _ := lintegral_liminf_le hmeas
  have hball0 : μ (ball (0 : E) 1) ≠ 0 := (measure_ball_pos μ 0 one_pos).ne'
  have hlt : μ (ball 0 1) * t < μ (ball 0 1) * ENNReal.ofReal (C - u z) :=
    (ENNReal.mul_lt_mul_iff_right hball0 measure_ball_lt_top.ne).mpr ht
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (eventually_lt_of_lt_liminf (hlt.trans_le hlow)).exists
  refine ⟨s k, ⟨hs k, hsρ k⟩, ?_⟩
  have hvol := Measure.addHaar_ball_mul_of_pos μ (0 : E) (hs k) 1
  rw [mul_one] at hvol
  rw [lintegral_ball_eq_ofReal_mul_lintegral_unitBall μ _ z (hs k), hvol, mul_assoc]
  exact (ENNReal.mul_lt_mul_iff_right (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by positivity)).ne'
    ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mpr hk

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.upperSemicontinuousOn
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.upperSemicontinuousOn {u : E → ℝ} {D : Set E} (hD : IsOpen D)
    (hl : LineSubharmonicOn u D) (hu : Measurable u) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ D, 0 ≤ u x)
    (hbdd : ∀ p ∈ D, ∃ r > 0, BddAbove (u '' ball p r)) : UpperSemicontinuousOn u D
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  suffices h : UpperSemicontinuousAt u z from h.upperSemicontinuousWithinAt D
  intro b hb
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial E with hE | hE
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun x => (Subsingleton.elim z x) ▸ hb
  let μ : Measure E := Measure.addHaar
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, C₀, hC₀⟩ := hbdd z hz
  obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, hr₂D⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hD z hz
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, h2ρ₁, h2ρ₂⟩ : ∃ ρ > 0, 2 * ρ ≤ r₁ ∧ 2 * ρ ≤ r₂ :=
    ⟨min r₁ r₂ / 2, by positivity, by linarith [min_le_left r₁ r₂],
      by linarith [min_le_right r₁ r₂]⟩
  have h2ρD : ball z (2 * ρ) ⊆ D := (ball_subset_ball h2ρ₂).trans hr₂D
  set b' := (u z + b) / 2 with hb'
  set C := max C₀ (b + 1) with hC
  have hCbound : ∀ x ∈ ball z (2 * ρ), u x ≤ C := fun x hx =>
    (hC₀ ⟨x, ball_subset_ball h2ρ₁ hx, rfl⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hbC : b + 1 ≤ C := le_max_right _ _
  have ht : ENNReal.ofReal (C - b') < ENNReal.ofReal (C - u z) :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by linarith)).mpr (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨r, ⟨hr, hrρ⟩, hlt⟩ := hl.exists_ball_deficit_gt hD hu μ hz C ht hρ
  let d' : E → ℝ≥0∞ := (ball z (2 * ρ)).indicator (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (C - u x))
  have hd' : Measurable d' :=
    ((measurable_const.sub hu).ennreal_ofReal).indicator measurableSet_ball
  have hfin : ∫⁻ x, d' x ∂μ ≠ ⊤ := by
    refine ne_top_of_le_ne_top ?_ (lintegral_mono (g := (ball z (2 * ρ)).indicator
      (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal C)) ?_)
    · rw [lintegral_indicator_const measurableSet_ball]
      exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top measure_ball_lt_top.ne
    · intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ ball z (2 * ρ)
      · simp only [d', indicator_of_mem hx]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by linarith [hpos x (h2ρD hx)])
      · simp [d', indicator_of_notMem hx]
  have hcont := continuousAt_lintegral_ball hd' hfin (Measure.addHaar_sphere μ z r)
  have hdeq : ∀ y, ball y r ⊆ ball z (2 * ρ) →
      ∫⁻ x in ball y r, d' x ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in ball y r, ENNReal.ofReal (C - u x) ∂μ :=
    fun y hy => setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_ball
      (fun x hx => indicator_of_mem (hy hx) _)
  have hzsub : ball z r ⊆ ball z (2 * ρ) := ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, μ (ball 0 r) * ENNReal.ofReal (C - b') <
      ∫⁻ x in ball y r, d' x ∂μ :=
    hcont.eventually (lt_mem_nhds (by simpa only [hdeq z hzsub] using hlt))
  filter_upwards [hev, ball_mem_nhds z hρ] with y hy hyz
  have hsub : ball y r ⊆ ball z (2 * ρ) :=
    ball_subset_ball' (by rw [mem_ball] at hyz; linarith)
  have hsm := hl.ball_deficit_le hu μ y r C (hsub.trans h2ρD) (fun x hx => hCbound x (hsub hx))
  rw [hdeq y hsub] at hy
  have htd := (ENNReal.mul_lt_mul_iff_right (measure_ball_pos μ 0 hr).ne'
    measure_ball_lt_top.ne).mp (hy.trans_le hsm)
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff'] at htd
  linarith [htd.1]

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.upperSemicontinuousOn_of_pshRepresentative
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.upperSemicontinuousOn_of_pshRepresentative {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {u : E → ℝ} {D : Set E} (hD : IsOpen D)
    (hl : LineSubharmonicOn u D) (hu : Measurable u) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ D, 0 ≤ u x)
    (hbdd : ∀ p ∈ D, ∃ r > 0, BddAbove (u '' ball p r)) : UpperSemicontinuousOn u D
proof:
:= by
  let μ : Measure E := Measure.addHaar
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hae⟩ := hl.exists_plurisubharmonicOn_ae_eq hD hu hpos hbdd μ
  have heq := hl.eqOn_of_ae_eq_of_lines hD hv μ hae
  intro x hx c hc
  have hvx : v x < (c : EReal) := by
    rw [← heq x hx]
    exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr hc
  filter_upwards [PlurisubharmonicOn.upperSemicontinuousOn hv x hx _ hvx,
    self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hy hyD
  rw [← heq y hyD] at hy
  exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp hy

name: PshLines.PSHD.isCompact_unitary
statement: theorem isCompact_unitary : IsCompact (unitary (E →L[ℂ] E) : Set (E →L[ℂ] E))
proof:
:= by
  have : ProperSpace (E →L[ℂ] E) := FiniteDimensional.proper ℂ _
  refine Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded isClosed_unitary ?_
  refine (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x := (0 : E →L[ℂ] E)) (r := 1)).subset ?_
  intro U hU
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial (E →L[ℂ] E) with h | h
  · simp [Subsingleton.elim U 0]
  · exact (CStarRing.norm_of_mem_unitary hU).le

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_uniform_highValue_star_of_unit
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_highValue_star_of_unit
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {e : E} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hd : s < Module.finrank ℝ (ℝ × (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ C : ℝ≥0∞, C < ⊤ ∧ ∀ (u : E → ℝ), Measurable u →
      ∀ (D : Set E) (x : E), closedBall x R ⊆ D →
      (∀ v : E, v ≠ 0 → DiscPshOn (fun z => (u (x + z • v) : EReal))
        ((fun z : ℂ => x + z • v) ⁻¹' D)) →
      ∃ μ : Measure E, IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧
        μ {y | ‖y - x‖ ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ u x ≤ u y} = 1 ∧
        rieszEnergy s μ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  let S := ℝ × (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ
  let c : S := (3 * R / 4, 0)
  let δ : ℝ := min (R / 4) 1
  let B : Set S := ball c δ
  let η : Measure S := Measure.addHaar
  let m : Measure S := (η B)⁻¹ • η.restrict B
  have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_min (by positivity) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨hm, _, henergy⟩ := normalized_restrict_ball_properties (μ := η) hs hd c hδ
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure m := hm
  let a : ℝ≥0∞ := ENNReal.ofReal (min 1 (R / 4))
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by dsimp [a]; positivity
  have hat : a ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hap : a ^ s ≠ 0 := by simp [ENNReal.rpow_eq_zero_iff, ha0, hat]
  refine ⟨(a ^ s)⁻¹ * rieszEnergy s m,
    ENNReal.mul_lt_top (ENNReal.inv_lt_top.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hap)) henergy, ?_⟩
  intro u hum D x hball hu
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ, hval⟩ := exists_highValue_chart_map hum x hR hball hu he
  have hmem : ∀ᵐ p ∂m, p ∈ B :=
    Measure.ae_smul_measure (self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_ball) _
  have hsep : ∀ᵐ p : S × S ∂m.prod m,
      a * edist p.1 p.2 ≤ edist (Ψ p.1) (Ψ p.2) := by
    filter_upwards [Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hmem,
      Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae hmem] with p hp hq
    dsimp [a]
    rw [edist_dist, edist_dist, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      (chart_map_dist_lower_bound he hR.le x (fun p => (hval p).2) hp hq)
  refine ⟨m.map Ψ, Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hΨ.aemeasurable, ?_,
    rieszEnergy_map_le_of_ae_edist_le hs.le m hΨ ha0 hat hsep⟩
  let K : Set E := {y | ‖y - x‖ ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ u x ≤ u y}
  have hK : MeasurableSet K :=
    (measurableSet_Icc.preimage (measurable_id.sub measurable_const).norm).inter
      (measurableSet_le measurable_const hum)
  have hpre : Ψ ⁻¹' K = univ := by
    apply eq_univ_of_forall
    intro p
    obtain ⟨hhigh, z, hz, hzp⟩ := hval p
    have hn : ‖NormedSpace.normalize (e + (p.2 : E))‖ = 1 :=
      NormedSpace.norm_normalize (affineLift_ne_zero he
        (Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right.mp p.2.property))
    refine ⟨?_, hhigh⟩
    simp only [hzp, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, hn, mul_one, hz, mem_Icc]
    exact ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le (by linarith) (min_le_left _ _)⟩
  change m.map Ψ K = 1
  rw [Measure.map_apply hΨ hK, hpre, measure_univ]

name: PshLines.PSHD.measurable_on_product_of_discPsh
statement:
theorem measurable_on_product_of_discPsh
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [SequentialSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X]
    {s : Set ℂ} (hs : IsOpen s) [IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict s)]
    {f : X → ℂ → ℝ}
    (husc : ∀ y ∈ s, UpperSemicontinuous (fun x => f x y))
    (hpos : ∀ x, ∀ y ∈ s, 0 ≤ f x y)
    (hpsh : ∀ x, DiscPshOn (fun y => (f x y : EReal)) s) :
    Measurable (fun p : X × s => f p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hmeas : ∀ x, Measurable (fun y : s => f x y) := by
    intro x
    have hm := (upperSemicontinuousOn_iff_restrict.mpr
      (hpsh x).upperSemicontinuousOn).measurable.ereal_toReal
    simpa using hm
  let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
  have hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) := by
    apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
    exact ⟨tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat,
      Eventually.of_forall (fun k => by
        change 0 < 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
        positivity)⟩
  let F : ℕ → ℕ → X × s → ℝ := fun N k p =>
    (∫ y in ball (p.2 : ℂ) (r k), min (f p.1 y) (N : ℝ)
      ∂(volume.restrict s)) / (volume (ball (0 : ℂ) (r k))).toReal
  apply measurable_of_eventually_tendsto (f := F)
  · intro N k
    have hm : Measurable (fun p : X × ℂ =>
        (∫ y in ball p.2 (r k), min (f p.1 y) (N : ℝ) ∂(volume.restrict s)) /
          (volume (ball (0 : ℂ) (r k))).toReal) :=
      measurable_normalized_integral_ball_min_restrict
      (μ := (volume : Measure ℂ)) (s := s) (f := f) (N := (N : ℝ)) (r := r k)
      hs.measurableSet
      hmeas husc hpos (Nat.cast_nonneg N)
      (fun y => (volume : Measure ℂ).addHaar_sphere y (r k))
      (volume (ball (0 : ℂ) (r k))).toReal
