    have hmap : Measurable (fun p : X × s => (p.1, (p.2 : ℂ))) :=
      measurable_fst.prodMk (measurable_subtype_coe.comp measurable_snd)
    exact hm.comp hmap
  · intro p
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := exists_nat_tendsto_truncated_real_ball_average_restrict
      (hpsh p.1) volume p.2 (hs.mem_nhds p.2.property) (hs.mem_nhds p.2.property)
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N₀] with N hN
    have ht := (hN₀ N hN).comp hr
    convert ht using 1
    funext k
    have hm : volume (ball (0 : ℂ) (r k)) = volume (ball (p.2 : ℂ) (r k)) := by
      simpa using lintegral_ball_add (volume : Measure ℂ)
        (fun _ => (1 : ℝ≥0∞)) (p.2 : ℂ) (r k)
    simp only [F, hm, Function.comp_def]

name: PshLines.PSHD.measurableSet_highValue_relation
statement:
theorem measurableSet_highValue_relation
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {P : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P] [T2Space P]
    [MeasurableSpace P] [BorelSpace P] [SecondCountableTopology P]
    {q : sphere (0 : E) 1 → P} (hq : Continuous q)
    {u : E → ℝ} (hu : Measurable u) (x : E) (R A : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet {p : (ℝ × P) × sphere (0 : E) 1 |
      p.1.1 ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ q p.2 = p.1.2 ∧
        A ≤ u (x + (p.1.1 : ℂ) • (p.2 : E))}
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Continuous (fun p : (ℝ × P) × sphere (0 : E) 1 => p.1.1) :=
    continuous_fst.fst
  have he : Continuous (fun p : (ℝ × P) × sphere (0 : E) 1 => (p.2 : E)) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd
  have hpoint : Continuous (fun p : (ℝ × P) × sphere (0 : E) 1 =>
      x + (p.1.1 : ℂ) • (p.2 : E)) :=
    continuous_const.add ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hr).smul he)
  exact (measurableSet_Icc.preimage hr.measurable).inter
    ((isClosed_eq (hq.comp continuous_snd) continuous_fst.snd).measurableSet.inter
      (measurableSet_le measurable_const (hu.comp hpoint.measurable)))

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.eqOn_of_ae_eq_of_lines
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.eqOn_of_ae_eq_of_lines {u : E → ℝ} {v : E → EReal} {D : Set E}
    (hD : IsOpen D) (hl : LineSubharmonicOn u D) (hv : PlurisubharmonicOn v D)
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hae : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.restrict D, (u y : EReal) = v y) :
    ∀ x ∈ D, (u x : EReal) = v x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  let S : Set E := {y | y ∈ D ∧ (u y : EReal) ≠ v y}
  have hS : μ S = 0 := by
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' hD.measurableSet] at hae
    rw [← compl_mem_ae_iff]
    filter_upwards [hae] with y hy hyS
    exact hyS.2 (hy hyS.1)
  by_cases hE : Nontrivial E
  · let _ : InnerProductSpace ℝ E := InnerProductSpace.complexToReal
    have hS' : (volume : Measure E) S = 0 :=
      Measure.absolutelyContinuous_isAddHaarMeasure volume μ hS
    obtain ⟨e, he, hnull⟩ := exists_unit_line_preimage_null hS' x
    have he0 : e ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      simp at he
    let O : Set ℂ := (fun t : ℂ ↦ x + t • e) ⁻¹' D
    have hO : IsOpen O := hD.preimage (by fun_prop)
    have h0 : (0 : ℂ) ∈ O := by simpa [O] using hx
    have h₁ : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun t : ℂ ↦ (u (x + t • e) : EReal)) O :=
      (discPshOn_of_connectedComponentIn hO fun t ht ↦ hl x e he0 t ht).plurisubharmonicOn hO
    have h₂ : PlurisubharmonicOn (fun t : ℂ ↦ v (x + t • e)) O :=
      hv.comp_affine ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ).smulRight e) x
    have hae' : (fun t : ℂ ↦ (u (x + t • e) : EReal)) =ᵐ[volume.restrict O]
        fun t ↦ v (x + t • e) := by
      rw [EventuallyEq, ae_restrict_iff' hO.measurableSet]
      filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hnull] with t ht htO
      by_contra hne
      exact ht ⟨htO, hne⟩
    simpa using h₁.eqOn_of_ae_eq h₂ hO volume hae' h0
  · have hsub : Subsingleton E := not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp hE
    by_contra hne
    have hSx : S = univ := by
      refine eq_univ_of_forall fun y ↦ ?_
      rw [Subsingleton.elim y x]
      exact ⟨hx, hne⟩
    rw [hSx] at hS
    exact (Measure.measure_univ_pos.mpr (NeZero.ne μ)).ne' hS

name: PshLines.PSHD.measureFourier_map_sub
statement:
theorem measureFourier_map_sub (μ : Measure E) [SFinite μ] (ξ : E) :
    measureFourier ((μ.prod μ).map (fun p : E × E ↦ p.1 - p.2)) ξ =
      ((‖measureFourier μ ξ‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : charFun ((μ.prod μ).map (fun p : E × E ↦ p.1 - p.2))
      ((-2 * Real.pi) • ξ) =
      charFun μ ((-2 * Real.pi) • ξ) * charFun μ (-((-2 * Real.pi) • ξ)) := by
    simp only [charFun_apply]
    rw [integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), ← integral_prod_mul]
    congr 1
    funext p
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_neg_right]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [charFun_neg, Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq] at h
  simpa only [measureFourier] using h

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_nat_tendsto_truncated_real_ball_average
statement:
theorem exists_nat_tendsto_truncated_real_ball_average {u : E → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn (fun x => (u x : EReal)) U)
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (a : E) (hUa : U ∈ 𝓝 a) :
    ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N ≥ N₀,
      Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (∫ x in ball a r, min (u x) (N : ℝ) ∂μ) /
        (μ (ball a r)).toReal) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (u a))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hRU⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hUa
  have hhalf : 0 < R / 2 := half_pos hR
  have hB : closedBall a (R / 2) ⊆ U := by
    intro x hx
    apply hRU
    exact mem_ball.mpr ((mem_closedBall.mp hx).trans_lt (by linarith))
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hu.exists_compact_upper_bound (isCompact_closedBall a (R / 2))
    ⟨a, mem_closedBall_self hhalf.le⟩ hB
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := exists_nat_ge C
  refine ⟨N₀, ?_⟩
  intro N hN
  have hclip (x : E) (hx : x ∈ closedBall a (R / 2)) :
      min (u x) (N : ℝ) = u x := by
    apply min_eq_left
    have hxC : u x ≤ C := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp (hC x hx)
    exact hxC.trans (hN₀.trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr hN))
  apply (tendsto_real_ball_average hu μ a hUa).congr'
  filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds hhalf)] with r hr
  congr 1
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball] with x hx
  exact (hclip x (mem_closedBall.mpr ((mem_ball.mp hx).trans hr).le)).symm

name: PshLines.PSHD.upperSemicontinuous_lintegral_of_dominated
statement:
theorem upperSemicontinuous_lintegral_of_dominated
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [SequentialSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] {μ : Measure Y} {f : X → Y → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hmeas : ∀ x, Measurable (f x))
    (husc : ∀ y, UpperSemicontinuous (fun x => f x y))
    (g : Y → ℝ≥0∞) (hbound : ∀ x, f x ≤ᵐ[μ] g)
    (hfinite : ∫⁻ y, g y ∂μ ≠ ⊤) :
    UpperSemicontinuous (fun x => ∫⁻ y, f x y ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  apply upperSemicontinuous_iff_isClosed_preimage.mpr
  intro a
  apply isSeqClosed_iff_isClosed.mp
  intro x p hx hp
  have hfatou := limsup_lintegral_le g (fun n => hmeas (x n))
    (fun n => hbound (x n)) hfinite
  have hpoint : ∀ y, limsup (fun n => f (x n) y) atTop ≤ f p y := by
    intro y
    exact (hp.limsup_comp_le_limsup (u := fun z => f z y)).trans
      (upperSemicontinuous_iff_limsup_le.mp (husc y) p)
  change a ≤ ∫⁻ y, f p y ∂μ
  refine le_trans ?_ (hfatou.trans (lintegral_mono hpoint))
  apply le_limsup_of_le (by isBoundedDefault)
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hb.exists
  exact (hx n).trans hn

name: PshLines.PSHD.upperSemicontinuous_lintegral_min
statement:
theorem upperSemicontinuous_lintegral_min
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [SequentialSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] {μ : Measure Y} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {f : X → Y → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hmeas : ∀ x, Measurable (f x))
    (husc : ∀ y, UpperSemicontinuous (fun x => f x y))
    {N : ℝ≥0∞} (hN : N ≠ ⊤) :
    UpperSemicontinuous (fun x => ∫⁻ y, min (f x y) N ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  apply upperSemicontinuous_lintegral_of_dominated
    (fun x => (hmeas x).min measurable_const)
    (fun y => (husc y).inf upperSemicontinuous_const) (fun _ => N)
  · intro x
    exact Eventually.of_forall (fun y => min_le_right (f x y) N)
  · simpa only [lintegral_const] using
      ENNReal.mul_ne_top hN (measure_ne_top μ univ)

name: PshLines.PSHD.continuousAt_lintegral_ball
statement:
theorem continuousAt_lintegral_ball
    {Y : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y] {μ : Measure Y} {f : Y → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hf : Measurable f) (hfinite : ∫⁻ y, f y ∂μ ≠ ⊤)
    {x : Y} {r : ℝ} (hμ : μ (Metric.sphere x r) = 0) :
    ContinuousAt (fun z => ∫⁻ y in Metric.ball z r, f y ∂μ) x
proof:
:= by
  have hi := integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_ne_top hf.aemeasurable hfinite
  have heq : (fun z => ∫⁻ y in Metric.ball z r, f y ∂μ) =
      (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in Metric.ball z r, (f y).toReal ∂μ)) := by
    funext z
    have hz : ∫⁻ y in Metric.ball z r, f y ∂μ ≠ ⊤ :=
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top hfinite (lintegral_mono' Measure.restrict_le_self le_rfl)
    rw [integral_toReal hf.aemeasurable (ae_lt_top hf hz),
      ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hz]
  rw [heq]
  exact ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.comp
    (continuousAt_integral_ball hi hμ)

name: PshLines.PSHD.measurable_lintegral_ball_min
statement:
theorem measurable_lintegral_ball_min
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [SequentialSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X]
    [MetricSpace Y] [SecondCountableTopology Y]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure Y} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f : X → Y → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hmeas : ∀ x, Measurable (f x))
    (husc : ∀ y, UpperSemicontinuous (fun x => f x y))
    {N : ℝ≥0∞} (hN : N ≠ ⊤) {r : ℝ}
    (hμ : ∀ y, μ (Metric.sphere y r) = 0) :
    Measurable (fun p : X × Y => ∫⁻ y in Metric.ball p.2 r, min (f p.1 y) N ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ x, Continuous (fun z => ∫⁻ y in Metric.ball z r, min (f x y) N ∂μ) := by
    intro x
    apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
    intro z
    apply continuousAt_lintegral_ball ((hmeas x).min measurable_const) _ (hμ z)
    apply ne_top_of_le_ne_top _ (lintegral_mono (fun y => min_le_right (f x y) N))
    simpa only [lintegral_const] using ENNReal.mul_ne_top hN (measure_ne_top μ univ)
  have hm : ∀ z, Measurable (fun x => ∫⁻ y in Metric.ball z r, min (f x y) N ∂μ) :=
    fun z => (upperSemicontinuous_lintegral_min (μ := μ.restrict (Metric.ball z r))
      hmeas husc hN).measurable
  exact (measurable_uncurry_of_continuous_of_measurable hc hm).comp measurable_swap

name: PshLines.PSHD.cuts_bddBelow
statement:
private theorem cuts_bddBelow {K : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ} (hK : K ⊆ Ici a) :
    BddBelow (positiveMeasureCuts K)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  rintro t ⟨r, rfl, hr⟩
  by_contra h
  have hempty : K ∩ Iio (r : ℝ) = ∅ := by
    apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    rintro x ⟨hx, hxr⟩
    exact (not_le_of_gt (lt_trans hxr (lt_of_not_ge h))) (hK hx)
  simp [hempty] at hr

name: PshLines.PSHD.cuts_nonempty
statement:
private theorem cuts_nonempty {K : Set ℝ} {b : ℝ} (hK : K ⊆ Iic b)
    (hpos : 0 < volume K) : (positiveMeasureCuts K).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_gt b
  refine ⟨r, r, rfl, ?_⟩
  have heq : K ∩ Iio (r : ℝ) = K := inter_eq_left.mpr fun x hx => lt_of_le_of_lt (hK hx) hr
  simpa [heq] using hpos

name: PshLines.PSHD.positiveMeasureEndpoint_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hbelow := cuts_bddBelow (fun x hx => (hK hx).1)
  have hnonempty := cuts_nonempty (fun x hx => (hK hx).2) hpos
  let q := positiveMeasureEndpoint K
  by_contra hq
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hclosed.isOpen_compl q hq
  obtain ⟨l, hl₁, hl₂⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (sub_lt_self q hε)
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htq⟩ := (csInf_lt_iff hbelow hnonempty).mp (show sInf (positiveMeasureCuts K) < q + ε by dsimp [q, positiveMeasureEndpoint]; linarith)
  obtain ⟨r, rfl, hr⟩ := ht
  have hlzero : volume (K ∩ Iio (l : ℝ)) = 0 := by
    by_contra hz
    have hm : (l : ℝ) ∈ positiveMeasureCuts K := ⟨l, rfl, lt_of_le_of_ne bot_le (Ne.symm hz)⟩
    have := csInf_le hbelow hm
    change q ≤ (l : ℝ) at this
    linarith
  have hsub : K ∩ Iio (r : ℝ) ⊆ K ∩ Iio (l : ℝ) := by
    rintro x ⟨hx, hxr⟩
    refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    by_contra hxl
    change ¬ x < (l : ℝ) at hxl
    change x < (r : ℝ) at hxr
    have hdist : dist x q < ε := by
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith
    exact hball hdist hx
  have hm : volume (K ∩ Iio (r : ℝ)) ≤ volume (K ∩ Iio (l : ℝ)) := measure_mono hsub
  rw [hlzero] at hm
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hm) hr

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_measurable_mem_of_closed_positive_sections
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_mem_of_closed_positive_sections
    {S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S] {K : Set (S × ℝ)} {a b : ℝ}
    (hK : MeasurableSet K)
    (hclosed : ∀ s, IsClosed (Prod.mk s ⁻¹' K))
    (hbound : ∀ s, Prod.mk s ⁻¹' K ⊆ Icc a b)
    (hpos : ∀ s, 0 < volume (Prod.mk s ⁻¹' K)) :
    ∃ q : S → ℝ, Measurable q ∧ ∀ s, (s, q s) ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun s => positiveMeasureEndpoint (Prod.mk s ⁻¹' K), ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply measurable_of_Iio
    intro t
    have heq : {s | positiveMeasureEndpoint (Prod.mk s ⁻¹' K) < t} =
        ⋃ r : ℚ, {s | (r : ℝ) < t ∧ 0 < volume ((Prod.mk s ⁻¹' K) ∩ Iio (r : ℝ))} := by
      ext s
      simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, mem_iUnion]
      rw [positiveMeasureEndpoint, csInf_lt_iff
        (cuts_bddBelow (fun x hx => (hbound s hx).1))
        (cuts_nonempty (fun x hx => (hbound s hx).2) (hpos s))]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, ⟨r, rfl, hr⟩, hrt⟩
        exact ⟨r, hrt, hr⟩
      · rintro ⟨r, hrt, hr⟩
        exact ⟨r, ⟨r, rfl, hr⟩, hrt⟩
    change MeasurableSet {s | positiveMeasureEndpoint (Prod.mk s ⁻¹' K) < t}
    rw [heq]
    apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
    intro r
    have hm : Measurable (fun s => volume ((Prod.mk s ⁻¹' K) ∩ Iio (r : ℝ))) := by
      exact measurable_measure_prodMk_left (hK.inter (measurable_snd measurableSet_Iio))
    exact (MeasurableSet.const _).inter (measurableSet_lt measurable_const hm)
  · intro s
    exact positiveMeasureEndpoint_mem (hclosed s) (hbound s) (hpos s)

name: PshLines.PSHD.continuous_normalized_affineLift
statement:
theorem continuous_normalized_affineLift {e : E} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) :
    Continuous (fun v : (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ => NormedSpace.normalize (e + (v : E)))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun v : (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ => e + (v : E)) := by fun_prop
  have hi : Continuous (fun v : (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ => ‖e + (v : E)‖⁻¹) :=
    hc.norm.inv₀ (fun v => norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (affineLift_ne_zero he
      (Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right.mp v.property)))
  exact hi.smul hc

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_highValue_chart_map
statement:
theorem exists_highValue_chart_map
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {u : E → ℝ} (hum : Measurable u) {D : Set E} (x : E)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hball : closedBall x R ⊆ D)
    (hu : ∀ v : E, v ≠ 0 → DiscPshOn (fun z => (u (x + z • v) : EReal))
      ((fun z : ℂ => x + z • v) ⁻¹' D))
    {e : E} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) :
    ∃ Ψ : ℝ × (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ → E, Measurable Ψ ∧ ∀ p,
      u x ≤ u (Ψ p) ∧ ∃ z : ℂ,
        ‖z‖ = max (R / 2) (min R p.1) ∧
        Ψ p = x + z • NormedSpace.normalize (e + (p.2 : E))
proof:
:= by
  let S := ℝ × (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ
  let r : S → ℝ := fun p => max (R / 2) (min R p.1)
  let v : S → E := fun p => NormedSpace.normalize (e + (p.2 : E))
  have hr : ∀ p, 0 < r p := fun p =>
    (half_pos hR).trans_le (le_max_left _ _)
  have hrR : ∀ p, r p ≤ R := fun p =>
    max_le (by linarith) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hn : ∀ p, ‖v p‖ = 1 := fun p =>
    NormedSpace.norm_normalize (affineLift_ne_zero he
      (Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right.mp p.2.property))
  have hvm : Measurable v :=
    (continuous_normalized_affineLift he).measurable.comp measurable_snd
  have hrm : Measurable r := by dsimp [r]; fun_prop
  apply exists_measurable_highValue_circlePoint hum x hvm hrm hr
    (fun p => hu _ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by rw [hn p]; exact one_ne_zero)))
  rintro p y ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  apply hball
  have hz' : ‖z‖ ≤ r p := by simpa using hz
  simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, norm_smul, hn p] using hz'.trans (hrR p)

name: PshLines.PSHD.isPreconnected_affineClosedDisc
statement:
theorem isPreconnected_affineClosedDisc (x v : E) (r : ℝ) :
    IsPreconnected (affineClosedDisc x v r)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isPreconnected_closedBall (x := (0 : ℂ)) (r := r)).image
  fun_prop

name: PshLines.PSHD.affineClosedDisc_subset_connectedComponentIn
proof:
:=
  (isPreconnected_affineClosedDisc x v r).subset_connectedComponentIn
    (center_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr) hD

name: PshLines.PSHD.discPshOn_of_connectedComponentIn
statement:
theorem discPshOn_of_connectedComponentIn [LocallyConnectedSpace E]
    {u : E → EReal} {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hu : ∀ x ∈ U, DiscPshOn u (connectedComponentIn U x)) : DiscPshOn u U
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact (hu x hx).ne_top x (mem_connectedComponentIn hx)
  · intro x hx
    have hux := (hu x hx).upperSemicontinuousOn x (mem_connectedComponentIn hx)
    have hat : UpperSemicontinuousAt u x := by
      simpa only [UpperSemicontinuousWithinAt, UpperSemicontinuousAt,
        SemicontinuousWithinAt, SemicontinuousAt,
        nhdsWithin_eq_nhds.mpr (hU.connectedComponentIn.mem_nhds
          (mem_connectedComponentIn hx))] using hux
    exact hat.upperSemicontinuousWithinAt U
  · intro x v r hr hD C hC
    exact (hu x (hD (center_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr.le))).submean x v r hr
      (affineClosedDisc_subset_connectedComponentIn hr.le hD) C hC

name: PshLines.PSHD.continuousAt_integral_ball
statement:
theorem continuousAt_integral_ball
    {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} {f : X → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f μ) {x : X} {r : ℝ} (hμ : μ (sphere x r) = 0) :
    ContinuousAt (fun z => ∫ y in ball z r, f y ∂μ) x
proof:
:= by
  have hnot : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, y ∉ sphere x r := by
    simpa only [ae_iff, not_not, ofPred_mem_eq] using hμ
  have hlim : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ContinuousAt (fun z => (ball z r).indicator f y) x := by
    filter_upwards [hnot] with y hy
    have hxy : x ∉ frontier (ball y r) := by
      intro h
      apply hy
      simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_comm] using frontier_ball_subset_sphere h
    have hc := continuousOn_const.continuousAt_indicator
      (f := fun _ : X => f y) hxy
    have heq : (fun z => (ball z r).indicator f y) =
        (ball y r).indicator (fun _ : X => f y) := by
      funext z
      simp only [Set.indicator, mem_ball, dist_comm]
    rw [heq]
    exact hc
  have h := tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
    (fun y => ‖f y‖)
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun z => hf.aestronglyMeasurable.indicator measurableSet_ball))
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun z => Eventually.of_forall
      (fun y => norm_indicator_le_norm_self (s := ball z r) (f := f) (a := y))))
    hf.norm hlim
  change Tendsto (fun z => ∫ y in ball z r, f y ∂μ) (𝓝 x)
    (𝓝 (∫ y in ball x r, f y ∂μ))
  simpa only [integral_indicator measurableSet_ball] using h

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.congr
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.congr {u w : E → ℝ} {D : Set E} (hu : LineSubharmonicOn u D)
    (heq : EqOn u w D) : LineSubharmonicOn w D
proof:
:= by
  intro c v hv z hz
  refine (hu c v hv z hz).congr ?_
  intro t ht
  have htD : t ∈ (fun t : ℂ => c + t • v) ⁻¹' D := connectedComponentIn_subset _ _ ht
  simp only [heq htD]

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.upperSemicontinuousAt_line
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hv : v = 0
  · subst hv
    simpa using (upperSemicontinuousAt_const (x := (0 : ℂ)) (z := u z))
  have hP : IsOpen ((fun t : ℂ => z + t • v) ⁻¹' D) := hD.preimage (by fun_prop)
  have h0 : (0 : ℂ) ∈ (fun t : ℂ => z + t • v) ⁻¹' D := by simpa using hz
  have hnhds : connectedComponentIn ((fun t : ℂ => z + t • v) ⁻¹' D) 0 ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℂ) :=
    hP.connectedComponentIn.mem_nhds (mem_connectedComponentIn h0)
  intro b hb
  have h := (hl z v hv 0 h0).upperSemicontinuousOn 0 (mem_connectedComponentIn h0)
    (b : EReal) (EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr hb)
  rw [nhdsWithin_eq_nhds.mpr hnhds] at h
  filter_upwards [h] with t ht
  exact_mod_cast ht

name: PshLines.PSHD.hasDiscSubmeanOn_of_line_sections
statement:
theorem hasDiscSubmeanOn_of_line_sections {φ : E → EReal} {D : Set E}
    (hl : ∀ c v : E, v ≠ 0 → ∀ z ∈ (fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' D,
      DiscPshOn (fun t ↦ φ (c + t • v)) (connectedComponentIn ((fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' D) z)) :
    HasDiscSubmeanOn φ D
proof:
:= by
  intro x v r hr hDisc C hC
  by_cases hv : v = 0
  · subst hv
    simp [circleDeficit, mul_comm]
  set P := (fun t : ℂ => x + t • v) ⁻¹' D
  have hball : closedBall (0 : ℂ) r ⊆ P := fun t ht => hDisc ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  have h0 : (0 : ℂ) ∈ P := hball (mem_closedBall_self hr.le)
  have hdisc : affineClosedDisc (0 : ℂ) 1 r = closedBall 0 r := by
    simp [affineClosedDisc]
  have hK : affineClosedDisc (0 : ℂ) 1 r ⊆ connectedComponentIn P 0 := by
    rw [hdisc]
    exact (convex_closedBall (0 : ℂ) r).isPreconnected.subset_connectedComponentIn
      (mem_closedBall_self hr.le) hball
  have h := (hl x v hv 0 h0).submean 0 1 r hr hK C (by
    rw [hdisc]
    intro t ht
    exact hC _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩)
  simpa [circleDeficit] using h

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.hasDiscSubmeanOn
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.hasDiscSubmeanOn {u : E → ℝ} {D : Set E}
    (hl : LineSubharmonicOn u D) : HasDiscSubmeanOn (fun x => (u x : EReal)) D
proof:
:=
  hasDiscSubmeanOn_of_line_sections hl

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.discPshOn
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ => EReal.coe_ne_top _,
    continuous_coe_real_ereal.comp_upperSemicontinuousOn husc EReal.coe_strictMono.monotone,
    hl.hasDiscSubmeanOn⟩

name: PshLines.PSHD.chartParameter_ball_bounds
statement:
theorem chartParameter_ball_bounds {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    {R : ℝ} {p : ℝ × F}
    (hp : p ∈ ball (3 * R / 4, (0 : F)) (min (R / 4) 1)) :
    R / 2 ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ R ∧ ‖p.2‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := max_lt_iff.mp (show
    max (dist p.1 (3 * R / 4)) (dist p.2 0) < min (R / 4) 1 from hp)
  have hr := abs_lt.mp (show |p.1 - 3 * R / 4| < R / 4 from
    (h.1.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)))
  refine ⟨by linarith [hr.1], by linarith [hr.2], ?_⟩
  simpa using (h.2.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)).le

name: PshLines.PSHD.chart_map_dist_lower_bound
statement:
theorem chart_map_dist_lower_bound
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    {e : E} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (x : E)
    {Ψ : ℝ × (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ → E}
    (hcircle : ∀ p, ∃ z : ℂ,
      ‖z‖ = max (R / 2) (min R p.1) ∧
      Ψ p = x + z • NormedSpace.normalize (e + (p.2 : E)))
    {p q : ℝ × (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ}
    (hp : p ∈ ball (3 * R / 4, 0) (min (R / 4) 1))
    (hq : q ∈ ball (3 * R / 4, 0) (min (R / 4) 1)) :
    min 1 (R / 4) * dist p q ≤ dist (Ψ p) (Ψ q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hp0, hpR, hp1⟩ := chartParameter_ball_bounds hp
  obtain ⟨hq0, hqR, hq1⟩ := chartParameter_ball_bounds hq
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzp⟩ := hcircle p
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htq⟩ := hcircle q
  simp only [min_eq_right hpR, max_eq_right hp0] at hz
  simp only [min_eq_right hqR, max_eq_right hq0] at ht
  have h := normalized_affineLift_max_lower_bound he
    (Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right.mp p.2.property)
    (Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right.mp q.2.property)
    hp1 hq1 hR (by rw [hz]; exact hp0) (by rw [ht]; exact hq0)
  simpa [hzp, htq, dist_eq_norm, Prod.norm_def, Real.norm_eq_abs, hz, ht] using h

name: PshLines.PSHD.integral_fourier_schwartz_eq
statement:
theorem integral_fourier_schwartz_eq (η : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure η] (g : 𝓢(E, ℂ)) :
    ∫ x, 𝓕 g x ∂η = ∫ ξ, g ξ * measureFourier η ξ
proof:
:= by
  have h := VectorFourier.integral_fourierIntegral_smul_eq_flip
    (μ := η) (ν := volume) (L := innerₗ E) (f := fun _ ↦ (1 : ℂ))
    (g := fun ξ : E ↦ g ξ)
    Real.continuous_fourierChar (by simpa using continuous_inner) (integrable_const 1)
    g.integrable
  simp only [← measureFourier_eq_vectorFourier, smul_eq_mul, one_mul] at h
  simp_rw [mul_comm (g _), h, flip_innerₗ]
  rfl

name: PshLines.PSHD.integral_schwartz_eq_fourierInv
statement:
theorem integral_schwartz_eq_fourierInv (η : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure η]
    (hF : MemLp (measureFourier η) 2) (g : 𝓢(E, ℂ)) :
    ∫ x, g x ∂η = ∫ x, g x * (𝓕⁻ (hF.toLp (measureFourier η)) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure E)) x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 𝓕 (η.toTemperedDistribution) =
      ((hF.toLp (measureFourier η) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure E)) : 𝓢'(E, ℂ)) := by
    ext g
    rw [TemperedDistribution.fourier_apply, Measure.toTemperedDistribution_apply η,
      Lp.toTemperedDistribution_apply, integral_fourier_schwartz_eq]
    refine integral_congr_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [hF.coeFn_toLp] with x hx
    simp [hx]
  have h2 : η.toTemperedDistribution =
      ((𝓕⁻ (hF.toLp (measureFourier η)) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure E)) : 𝓢'(E, ℂ)) := by
    rw [← Lp.fourierInv_toTemperedDistribution_eq, ← h1, FourierTransform.fourierInv_fourier_eq]
  have h3 := congrArg (fun T : 𝓢'(E, ℂ) ↦ T g) h2
  simpa using h3

name: PshLines.PSHD.borel_eq_generateFrom_isCompact
statement:
theorem borel_eq_generateFrom_isCompact :
    ‹MeasurableSpace X› = MeasurableSpace.generateFrom {K : Set X | IsCompact K}
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_le fun K hK ↦ hK.isClosed.measurableSet)
  rw [BorelSpace.measurable_eq (α := X), borel_eq_generateFrom_isClosed]
  refine MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_le fun C hC ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨x₀⟩ | hempty := isEmpty_or_nonempty X
  · simp [Set.eq_empty_of_isEmpty C]
  · rcases hempty with ⟨x₀⟩
    have hC' : C = ⋃ n : ℕ, C ∩ closedBall x₀ n := by
      ext x
      simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_inter_iff, mem_closedBall]
      constructor
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_ge (dist x x₀)
        exact ⟨n, hx, hn⟩
      · rintro ⟨_, hx, _⟩
        exact hx
    rw [hC']
    exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n ↦ MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom
      ((isCompact_closedBall x₀ n).inter_left hC)

name: PshLines.PSHD.Measure.ext_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem Measure.ext_of_isCompact {μ ν : Measure X} [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]
    (h : ∀ K, IsCompact K → μ K = ν K) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  obtain hX | ⟨⟨x₀⟩⟩ := isEmpty_or_nonempty X
  · ext s
    simp [Set.eq_empty_of_isEmpty s]
  refine Measure.ext_of_generateFrom_of_iUnion {K : Set X | IsCompact K}
    (fun n : ℕ ↦ closedBall x₀ n) ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun n ↦ isCompact_closedBall x₀ n)
    (fun n ↦ (isCompact_closedBall x₀ n).measure_lt_top.ne) h
  · exact borel_eq_generateFrom_isCompact
  · intro K hK L hL _
    exact hK.inter_right hL.isClosed
  · exact iUnion_closedBall_nat x₀

name: PshLines.PSHD.measureReal_isCompact_eq_setIntegral
statement:
theorem measureReal_isCompact_eq_setIntegral (η : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure η]
    {f : E → ℂ} (hf : LocallyIntegrable f)
    (h : ∀ g : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → HasCompactSupport g →
      ∫ x, (g x : ℂ) ∂η = ∫ x, (g x : ℂ) * f x)
    {s : Set E} (hs : IsCompact s) :
    ((η.real s : ℝ) : ℂ) = ∫ x in s, f x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, δpos, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ, 0 < δ ∧ IsCompact (cthickening δ s) :=
    hs.exists_isCompact_cthickening
  obtain ⟨u, -, u_pos, u_lim⟩ : ∃ u, StrictAnti u ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ), u n ∈ Ioo 0 δ)
    ∧ Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 0) := exists_seq_strictAnti_tendsto' δpos
  let v : ℕ → Set E := fun n ↦ thickening (u n) s
  obtain ⟨K, K_compact, vK⟩ : ∃ K, IsCompact K ∧ ∀ n, v n ⊆ K :=
    ⟨_, hδ, fun n ↦ thickening_subset_cthickening_of_le (u_pos n).2.le _⟩
  have : ∀ n, ∃ (g : E → ℝ), Function.support g = v n ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ g ∧ Set.range g ⊆ Set.Icc 0 1
          ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, g x = 1 := by
    intro n
    rcases exists_contMDiff_support_eq_eq_one_iff 𝓘(ℝ, E) isOpen_thickening hs.isClosed
      (self_subset_thickening (u_pos n).1 s) with ⟨g, g_smooth, g_range, g_supp, hg⟩
    exact ⟨g, g_supp, g_smooth.contDiff, g_range, fun x hx ↦ (hg x).1 hx⟩
  choose g g_supp g_diff g_range hg using this
  have g_le : ∀ n x, ‖(g n x : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro n x
    have := g_range n (mem_range_self (f := g n) x)
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg this.1]
    exact this.2
  have g_zero : ∀ n x, x ∉ K → g n x = 0 := by
    intro n x hxK
    rw [← Function.notMem_support, g_supp]
    contrapose hxK
    exact vK n hxK
  have g_lim : ∀ x, Tendsto (fun n ↦ (g n x : ℂ)) atTop (𝓝 (s.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℂ)) x)) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hxs : x ∈ s
    · simp [hg _ x hxs, indicator_of_mem hxs]
    · simp_rw [indicator_of_notMem hxs]
      apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
      obtain ⟨ε, εpos, hε⟩ : ∃ ε, 0 < ε ∧ x ∉ thickening ε s := by
        rw [← hs.isClosed.closure_eq, closure_eq_iInter_thickening s] at hxs
        simpa using hxs
      filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.1 u_lim).2 _ εpos] with n hn
      have : g n x = 0 := by
        rw [← Function.notMem_support, g_supp]
        contrapose hε
        exact thickening_mono hn.le s hε
      simp [this]
  have L₁ : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ x, (g n x : ℂ) ∂η) atTop (𝓝 ((η.real s : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    have := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (μ := η) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ))
      (fun n ↦ (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (g_diff n).continuous).aestronglyMeasurable)
      (integrable_const 1) (fun n ↦ Eventually.of_forall (g_le n))
      (Eventually.of_forall g_lim)
    rwa [integral_indicator_const _ hs.measurableSet, Complex.real_smul, mul_one] at this
  have L₂ : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ x, (g n x : ℂ) * f x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in s, f x)) := by
    rw [← integral_indicator hs.measurableSet]
    refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (K.indicator fun x ↦ ‖f x‖)
      (fun n ↦ (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (g_diff n).continuous).aestronglyMeasurable.mul
        hf.aestronglyMeasurable) ?_ (fun n ↦ Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ ?_)
      (Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ ?_)
    · rw [integrable_indicator_iff K_compact.measurableSet]
      exact (hf.integrableOn_isCompact K_compact).norm
    · rw [norm_mul]
      by_cases hxK : x ∈ K
      · rw [indicator_of_mem hxK]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (g_le n x)
      · simp [g_zero n x hxK, indicator_of_notMem hxK]
    · have := (g_lim x).mul_const (f x)
      convert this using 2
      by_cases hxs : x ∈ s <;> simp [hxs]
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique L₁ (by simpa only [h _ (g_diff _) (HasCompactSupport.intro
    K_compact (g_zero _))] using L₂)

name: PshLines.PSHD.lintegral_enorm_sq_eq_eLpNorm_sq
statement:
theorem lintegral_enorm_sq_eq_eLpNorm_sq {F' : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F']
    (μ : Measure E) (f : E → F') :
    ∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂μ = eLpNorm f 2 μ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := eLpNorm_nnreal_pow_eq_lintegral (μ := μ) (f := f) (p := 2) two_ne_zero
  simp only [NNReal.coe_ofNat, ENNReal.coe_ofNat, ENNReal.rpow_two] at h
  simpa using h.symm

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_density_of_memLp_measureFourier
statement:
theorem exists_density_of_memLp_measureFourier (η : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure η]
    (hF : MemLp (measureFourier η) 2) :
    ∃ g : E → ℝ, Measurable g ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) ∧ MemLp g 2 ∧
      η = volume.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (g x)) ∧
      ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (g x) ^ 2 = ∫⁻ ξ, ‖measureFourier η ξ‖ₑ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  set F : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure E) := hF.toLp (measureFourier η)
  set h : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure E) := 𝓕⁻ F
  have hmem : MemLp (h : E → ℂ) 2 := Lp.memLp h
  have hloc : LocallyIntegrable (h : E → ℂ) := hmem.locallyIntegrable (by norm_num)
  have htest : ∀ g : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → HasCompactSupport g →
      ∫ x, (g x : ℂ) ∂η = ∫ x, (g x : ℂ) * h x := by
    intro g hg hgs
    have hs : HasCompactSupport (fun x ↦ (g x : ℂ)) := hgs.comp_left Complex.ofReal_zero
    have hd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x ↦ (g x : ℂ)) := Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp hg
    simpa using integral_schwartz_eq_fourierInv η hF (hs.toSchwartzMap hd)
  have hK : ∀ K, IsCompact K → ((η.real K : ℝ) : ℂ) = ∫ x in K, h x :=
    fun K hK ↦ measureReal_isCompact_eq_setIntegral η hloc htest hK
  
  have him : (fun x ↦ (h x).im) =ᵐ[volume] 0 := by
    refine ae_eq_zero_of_forall_setIntegral_isCompact_eq_zero'
      (hmem.im.locallyIntegrable (by norm_num)) fun K hK' ↦ ?_
    · have := congrArg Complex.im (hK K hK')
      rw [Complex.ofReal_im] at this
      rw [this]
      exact integral_im (hloc.integrableOn_isCompact hK')
  
  have hre : MemLp (fun x ↦ (h x).re) 2 := hmem.re
  set u : E → ℝ := hre.aestronglyMeasurable.mk _ with hu_def
  have hu_meas : Measurable u := hre.aestronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurable_mk.measurable
  have hu_ae : (fun x ↦ (h x).re) =ᵐ[volume] u := hre.aestronglyMeasurable.ae_eq_mk
  have hu_mem : MemLp u 2 := hre.ae_eq hu_ae
  have hu_loc : LocallyIntegrable u := hu_mem.locallyIntegrable (by norm_num)
  have hKu : ∀ K, IsCompact K → η.real K = ∫ x in K, u x := by
    intro K hK'
    have := congrArg Complex.re (hK K hK')
    rw [Complex.ofReal_re] at this
    rw [this, ← setIntegral_congr_ae hK'.measurableSet (hu_ae.mono fun x hx _ ↦ hx)]
    exact (integral_re (hloc.integrableOn_isCompact hK')).symm
  set ρp := volume.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (u x)) with hρp
  set ρm := volume.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (-u x)) with hρm
  have hρm_fin : IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts ρm := by
    refine ⟨fun K hK' ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [hρm, withDensity_apply _ hK'.measurableSet]
    exact (hu_loc.integrableOn_isCompact hK').neg.lintegral_lt_top
  have hsum : ∀ K, IsCompact K → (η + ρm) K = ρp K := by
    intro K hK'
    have hint := hu_loc.integrableOn_isCompact hK'
    have h1 := hKu K hK'
    rw [integral_eq_lintegral_pos_part_sub_lintegral_neg_part hint] at h1
    rw [Measure.add_apply, hρm, hρp, withDensity_apply _ hK'.measurableSet,
      withDensity_apply _ hK'.measurableSet]
    have hp := hint.lintegral_lt_top
    have hm := hint.neg.lintegral_lt_top
    simp only [Pi.neg_apply] at hm
    rw [← ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr
      ⟨measure_ne_top η K, hm.ne⟩) hp.ne, ENNReal.toReal_add (measure_ne_top η K) hm.ne,
      ← measureReal_def, h1]
    ring
  have : IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts (η + ρm) := ⟨fun K hK' ↦ by
    rw [Measure.add_apply]
    exact ENNReal.add_lt_top.mpr ⟨measure_lt_top η K, hK'.measure_lt_top⟩⟩
  have heq : η + ρm = ρp := Measure.ext_of_isCompact hsum
  set N : Set E := {x | u x < 0}
  have hN : MeasurableSet N := measurableSet_lt hu_meas measurable_const
  have hρpN : ρp N = 0 := by
    rw [hρp, withDensity_apply _ hN]
    refine (setLIntegral_congr_fun hN fun x hx ↦ ?_).trans lintegral_zero
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr (le_of_lt hx)
  have hρmNc : ρm Nᶜ = 0 := by
    rw [hρm, withDensity_apply _ hN.compl]
    refine (setLIntegral_congr_fun hN.compl fun x hx ↦ ?_).trans lintegral_zero
    have hx' : 0 ≤ u x := by simpa [N] using hx
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr (by linarith)
  have hρm0 : ρm = 0 := by
    rw [← Measure.measure_univ_eq_zero, ← measure_add_measure_compl hN, hρmNc, add_zero]
    refine le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
    calc ρm N ≤ (η + ρm) N := by rw [Measure.add_apply]; exact le_add_self
      _ = 0 := by rw [heq, hρpN]
  have hu_nonneg : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, 0 ≤ u x := by
    have h0 : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (-u x) = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (fun m : Measure E ↦ m univ) hρm0
      simpa [hρm, withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ] using this
    rw [lintegral_eq_zero_iff (by fun_prop)] at h0
    filter_upwards [h0] with x hx
    simpa [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero] using hx
  refine ⟨fun x ↦ max (u x) 0, by fun_prop, fun x ↦ le_max_right _ _, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hae : (fun x ↦ ‖h x‖) =ᵐ[volume] fun x ↦ max (u x) 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hu_ae, him, hu_nonneg] with x hre hi hnn
      have hx : h x = ((u x : ℝ) : ℂ) := Complex.ext (by simpa using hre) (by simpa using hi)
      rw [hx, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hnn, max_eq_left hnn]
    exact hmem.norm.ae_eq hae
  · calc η = η + ρm := by rw [hρm0, add_zero]
      _ = ρp := heq
      _ = _ := by
        rw [hρp]
        congr 1
        funext x
        simp [ENNReal.ofReal_max]
  · have hae : (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (max (u x) 0) ^ 2) =ᵐ[volume] fun x ↦ ‖h x‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
      filter_upwards [hu_ae, him, hu_nonneg] with x hre hi hnn
      have hx : h x = ((u x : ℝ) : ℂ) := Complex.ext (by simpa using hre) (by simpa using hi)
      rw [hx, max_eq_left hnn, ← ofReal_norm, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg hnn]
    rw [lintegral_congr_ae hae, lintegral_enorm_sq_eq_eLpNorm_sq,
      lintegral_enorm_sq_eq_eLpNorm_sq, ← eLpNorm_congr_ae hF.coeFn_toLp]
    congr 1
    have hnorm : ‖h‖ = ‖F‖ := by
      rw [← Lp.norm_fourier_eq h]
      simp [h]
    rw [Lp.norm_def, Lp.norm_def] at hnorm
    exact (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (Lp.eLpNorm_ne_top h) (Lp.eLpNorm_ne_top F)).mp hnorm

name: PshLines.PSHD.measurable_integral_ball_min_restrict
statement:
theorem measurable_integral_ball_min_restrict
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [SequentialSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X]
    [MetricSpace Y] [SecondCountableTopology Y]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure Y} {s : Set Y} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    [IsFiniteMeasure (μ.restrict s)] {f : X → Y → ℝ}
    (hmeas : ∀ x, Measurable (fun y : s => f x y))
    (husc : ∀ y ∈ s, UpperSemicontinuous (fun x => f x y))
    (hpos : ∀ x, ∀ y ∈ s, 0 ≤ f x y)
    {N : ℝ} (hN : 0 ≤ N) {r : ℝ}
    (hμ : ∀ y, μ (sphere y r) = 0) :
    Measurable (fun p : X × Y =>
      ∫ y in ball p.2 r, min (f p.1 y) N ∂(μ.restrict s))
proof:
:= by
  have hm := measurable_lintegral_ball_min_restrict hs
    (fun x => ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp (hmeas x))
    (fun y hy => ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.comp_upperSemicontinuous
      (husc y hy) ENNReal.ofReal_mono) (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top : ENNReal.ofReal N ≠ ⊤) hμ
  have heq (p : X × Y) :
      (∫ y in ball p.2 r, min (f p.1 y) N ∂(μ.restrict s)) =
      (∫⁻ y in ball p.2 r, min (ENNReal.ofReal (f p.1 y)) (ENNReal.ofReal N)
        ∂(μ.restrict s)).toReal := by
    have hfm : AEMeasurable (f p.1) (μ.restrict s) :=
      (aemeasurable_restrict_iff_comap_subtype hs).2 (hmeas p.1).aemeasurable
    rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae]
    · simp only [ENNReal.ofReal_min]
    · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_restrict_mem hs)] with y hy
      exact le_min (hpos p.1 y hy) hN
    · exact (hfm.min aemeasurable_const).aestronglyMeasurable.restrict
  convert hm.ennreal_toReal using 1
  funext p
  exact heq p

name: PshLines.PSHD.measurable_normalized_integral_ball_min_restrict
statement:
theorem measurable_normalized_integral_ball_min_restrict
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [SequentialSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X]
    [MetricSpace Y] [SecondCountableTopology Y]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure Y} {s : Set Y} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    [IsFiniteMeasure (μ.restrict s)] {f : X → Y → ℝ}
    (hmeas : ∀ x, Measurable (fun y : s => f x y))
    (husc : ∀ y ∈ s, UpperSemicontinuous (fun x => f x y))
    (hpos : ∀ x, ∀ y ∈ s, 0 ≤ f x y)
    {N : ℝ} (hN : 0 ≤ N) {r : ℝ}
    (hμ : ∀ y, μ (sphere y r) = 0) (c : ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun p : X × Y =>
      (∫ y in ball p.2 r, min (f p.1 y) N ∂(μ.restrict s)) / c)
proof:
:=
  (measurable_integral_ball_min_restrict hs hmeas husc hpos hN hμ).div_const c

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_measurable_highValue_phase
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_highValue_phase
    {S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S]
    {u : S → ℂ → ℝ} {U : S → Set ℂ} {r : S → ℝ}
    (hu : ∀ s, DiscPshOn (fun z => (u s z : EReal)) (U s))
    (hr : ∀ s, 0 < r s) (hD : ∀ s, closedBall (0 : ℂ) (r s) ⊆ U s)
    (hc : Measurable (fun s => u s 0))
    (hf : Measurable (fun p : S × ℝ => u p.1 (circleMap 0 (r p.1) p.2))) :
    ∃ θ : S → ℝ, Measurable θ ∧ ∀ s,
      θ s ∈ Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ∧ u s 0 ≤ u s (circleMap 0 (r s) (θ s))
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set (S × ℝ) := {p | p.2 ∈ Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ∧
    u p.1 0 ≤ u p.1 (circleMap 0 (r p.1) p.2)}
  have hK : MeasurableSet K :=
    (measurableSet_Icc.preimage measurable_snd).inter
      (measurableSet_le (hc.comp measurable_fst) hf)
  have hclosed : ∀ s, IsClosed (Prod.mk s ⁻¹' K) := by
    intro s
    exact (isCompact_highValue_angles (hu s) (hr s).le (hD s) (u s 0)).isClosed
  have hbound : ∀ s, Prod.mk s ⁻¹' K ⊆ Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
    fun _ _ h => h.1
  have hpos : ∀ s, 0 < volume (Prod.mk s ⁻¹' K) := by
    intro s
    have hdisc : affineClosedDisc (0 : ℂ) 1 (r s) ⊆ U s := by
      simpa [affineClosedDisc] using hD s
    have hm := volume_highValue_angles_pos (hu s) 0 1 (hr s) hdisc
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, zero_add] at hm
    exact hm.trans_le (measure_mono (fun _ h => ⟨⟨h.1.1.le, h.1.2⟩, h.2⟩))
  exact exists_measurable_mem_of_closed_positive_sections hK hclosed hbound hpos

name: PshLines.PSHD.borel_measurable_of_sections
statement:
theorem borel_measurable_of_sections
    {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {G : Set (X × ℂ)} (hG : IsOpen G) {f : X → ℂ → ℝ}
    (husc : ∀ y, UpperSemicontinuousOn (fun x => f x y) {x | (x, y) ∈ G})
    (hpos : ∀ x y, (x, y) ∈ G → 0 ≤ f x y)
    (hsub : ∀ x y, (x, y) ∈ G → DiscPshOn (fun w => (f x w : EReal))
      (connectedComponentIn {w | (x, w) ∈ G} y)) :
    Measurable (fun p : G => f p.1.1 p.1.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_on_open_of_discPsh_sections hG husc hpos
  intro x
  apply discPshOn_of_connectedComponentIn
    (hG.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))
  exact hsub x

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_measurable_highValue_circlePoint
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_highValue_circlePoint
    {S E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {u : E → ℝ} (hum : Measurable u) (x : E) {D : Set E}
    {v : S → E} {r : S → ℝ} (hv : Measurable v) (hrm : Measurable r)
    (hr : ∀ s, 0 < r s)
    (hu : ∀ s, DiscPshOn (fun z => (u (x + z • v s) : EReal))
      ((fun z : ℂ => x + z • v s) ⁻¹' D))
    (hD : ∀ s, affineClosedDisc x (v s) (r s) ⊆ D) :
    ∃ Ψ : S → E, Measurable Ψ ∧ ∀ s,
      u x ≤ u (Ψ s) ∧
      ∃ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = r s ∧ Ψ s = x + z • v s
proof:
:= by
  have hcircle : Measurable (fun p : S × ℝ => circleMap 0 (r p.1) p.2) := by
    have hcont : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => circleMap 0 q.1 q.2) := by
      unfold circleMap
      fun_prop
    exact hcont.measurable.comp ((hrm.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
  have hf : Measurable (fun p : S × ℝ =>
      u (x + circleMap 0 (r p.1) p.2 • v p.1)) :=
    hum.comp (measurable_const.add (hcircle.smul (hv.comp measurable_fst)))
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ, hval⟩ := exists_measurable_highValue_phase hu hr
    (fun s z hz => hD s ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩)
    (by simp) hf
  refine ⟨fun s => x + circleMap 0 (r s) (θ s) • v s,
    measurable_const.add ((hcircle.comp (measurable_id.prodMk hθ)).smul hv), ?_⟩
  intro s
  refine ⟨by simpa using (hval s).2, circleMap 0 (r s) (θ s), ?_, rfl⟩
  rw [norm_circleMap_zero, abs_of_pos (hr s)]

name: PshLines.PSHD.hopf_eq_iff
statement:
theorem hopf_eq_iff (e f : sphere (0 : E) 1) :
    hopf e = hopf f ↔ ∃ a : ℂ, ‖a‖ = 1 ∧ a • (f : E) = (e : E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hopf, hopf, Projectivization.mk_eq_mk_iff']
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    refine ⟨a, ?_, ha⟩
    have he : ‖(e : E)‖ = 1 := by simp
    have hf : ‖(f : E)‖ = 1 := by simp
    have := congrArg norm ha
    simpa [norm_smul, he, hf] using this
  · rintro ⟨a, _, ha⟩
    exact ⟨a, ha⟩

name: PshLines.PSHD.continuous_phaseOrbit
statement:
theorem continuous_phaseOrbit (e : sphere (0 : E) 1) :
    Continuous (phaseOrbit e)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_subtype_val.smul continuous_const).subtype_mk _

name: PshLines.PSHD.hopf_fiber_eq_range
statement:
theorem hopf_fiber_eq_range (e : sphere (0 : E) 1) :
    {f | hopf f = hopf e} = range (phaseOrbit e)
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨a, ha, heq⟩ := (hopf_eq_iff f e).mp h
    exact ⟨⟨a, by simpa using ha⟩, Subtype.ext heq⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact (hopf_eq_iff _ _).mpr
      ⟨a, by simp, rfl⟩

name: PshLines.PSHD.isCompact_hopf_fiber
statement:
theorem isCompact_hopf_fiber (e : sphere (0 : E) 1) :
    IsCompact {f | hopf f = hopf e}
proof:
:= by
  rw [hopf_fiber_eq_range]
  exact isCompact_range (continuous_phaseOrbit e)

name: PshLines.PSHD.hopf_surjective
statement: theorem hopf_surjective : Function.Surjective (hopf (E := E))
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  let e : sphere (0 : E) 1 :=
    ⟨(‖p.rep‖⁻¹ : ℂ) • p.rep, by
      simp [norm_smul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr p.rep_nonzero]⟩
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  rw [← p.mk_rep]
  exact (Projectivization.mk_eq_mk_iff' ℂ _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨(‖p.rep‖⁻¹ : ℂ), rfl⟩

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.integral_line_mul_leviForm_nonneg
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.integral_line_mul_leviForm_nonneg {u : E → ℝ} {D : Set E}
    (hD : IsOpen D) (hl : LineSubharmonicOn u D) (hu : Measurable u)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ D, 0 ≤ u x) (hbdd : ∀ p ∈ D, ∃ r > 0, BddAbove (u '' ball p r))
    {χ : E → ℝ} (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ) (hχc : HasCompactSupport χ) (hχD : tsupport χ ⊆ D)
    (hχn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x) (w a : E) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    0 ≤ ∫ t : ℂ, u (w + t • a) * leviForm χ (w + t • a) a
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℂ → E := fun t ↦ w + t • a
  have hg : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding g :=
    (Homeomorph.addLeft w).isClosedEmbedding.comp (isClosedEmbedding_smul_left ha)
  let O : Opens ℂ := ⟨g ⁻¹' D, hD.preimage hg.continuous⟩
  have hO : IsOpen (O : Set ℂ) := O.isOpen
  
  have hdisc : DiscPshOn (fun t : ℂ ↦ (u (g t) : EReal)) O :=
    discPshOn_of_connectedComponentIn hO fun t ht ↦ hl w a ha t ht
  
  have hbddO : ∀ p ∈ (O : Set ℂ), ∃ r > 0, BddAbove ((u ∘ g) '' ball p r) := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨r, hr, C, hC⟩ := hbdd (g p) hp
    refine ⟨r / ‖a‖, div_pos hr (norm_pos_iff.mpr ha), C, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    refine hC ⟨g t, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at ht ⊢
    have : g t - g p = (t - p) • a := by simp [g, sub_smul]
    rw [this, norm_smul, ← lt_div_iff₀ (norm_pos_iff.mpr ha)]
    exact ht
  have hL : LocallyIntegrableOn (u ∘ g) O volume :=
    locallyIntegrableOn_of_bddAbove hO (hu.comp hg.continuous.measurable)
      (fun t ht ↦ hpos _ ht) hbddO volume
  have hL' : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun t : ℂ ↦ ((u (g t) : EReal)).toReal) O volume := by
    simpa only [EReal.toReal_coe, Function.comp_def] using hL
  
  let ψ : 𝓓(O, ℝ) :=
    { toFun := χ ∘ g
      contDiff' := hχ.comp (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.smul contDiff_const))
      hasCompactSupport' := hχc.comp_isClosedEmbedding hg
      tsupport_subset' := (tsupport_comp_subset_preimage χ hg.continuous).trans
        (preimage_mono hχD) }
  have hψn : ∀ t, 0 ≤ ψ t := fun t ↦ hχn (g t)
  have hpos' := hdisc.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_locallyIntegrable hL'
    (Eventually.of_forall fun t ↦ ⟨EReal.coe_ne_top _, EReal.coe_ne_bot _⟩) 1 ψ hψn
  rw [distributionalLeviCLM_regularDistribution_apply] at hpos'
  have hlevi : ∀ t : ℂ, leviForm ψ t 1 = leviForm χ (w + t • a) a := by
    intro t
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 χ := hχ.of_le (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)
    change (realHessian (fun t : ℂ ↦ χ (w + t • a)) t 1 1 +
      realHessian (fun t : ℂ ↦ χ (w + t • a)) t (Complex.I • (1 : ℂ))
        (Complex.I • (1 : ℂ))) / 4 = _
    rw [realHessian_complexLine h2, realHessian_complexLine h2]
    simp [leviForm]
  simpa [hlevi, g] using hpos'

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_slices
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_slices {Ω : Opens E} {u : E → ℝ}
    (hl : LineSubharmonicOn u Ω) (hu : Measurable u) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Ω, 0 ≤ u x)
    (hbdd : ∀ p ∈ Ω, ∃ r > 0, BddAbove (u '' ball p r))
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] (huL : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ) :
    HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi (regularDistribution μ u huL)
proof:
:= by
  intro a χ hχn
  rw [distributionalLeviCLM_regularDistribution_apply]
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · simp [ha]
  let W : Submodule ℂ E := (ℂ ∙ a)ᗮ
  have hc : IsCompl W (ℂ ∙ a) := (Submodule.isCompl_orthogonal (ℂ ∙ a)).symm
  let eₗ : (W × ℂ) ≃ₗ[ℂ] E :=
    ((LinearEquiv.refl ℂ W).prodCongr (LinearEquiv.toSpanNonzeroSingleton ℂ E a ha)).trans
      (Submodule.prodEquivOfIsCompl W (ℂ ∙ a) hc)
  let e : (W × ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] E := eₗ.toContinuousLinearEquiv
  have he : ∀ p : W × ℂ, e p = (p.1 : E) + p.2 • a := by
    intro p
    simp [e, eₗ]
  let ν : Measure (W × ℂ) := (Measure.addHaar : Measure W).prod volume
  let F : E → ℝ := fun x ↦ u x * leviForm χ x a
  have hF : Integrable F μ := integrable_mul_leviForm_testFunction huL χ a
  let eₘ : (W × ℂ) ≃ᵐ E := e.toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv
  have heₘ : ∀ p, eₘ p = e p := fun _ ↦ rfl
  have : (ν.map eₘ).IsAddHaarMeasure := e.isAddHaarMeasure_map ν
  set c := (ν.map eₘ).addHaarScalarFactor μ
  have hmap : ν.map eₘ = c • μ := Measure.isAddLeftInvariant_eq_smul _ _
  have hcpos : 0 < c := Measure.addHaarScalarFactor_pos_of_isAddHaarMeasure _ _
  have hFν : Integrable F (ν.map eₘ) := by
    rw [hmap]
    exact hF.smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top
  have hFe : Integrable (F ∘ eₘ) ν := (integrable_map_equiv eₘ F).mp hFν
  have hslice : 0 ≤ ∫ p, F (eₘ p) ∂ν := by
    rw [integral_prod (fun p ↦ F (eₘ p)) hFe]
    refine integral_nonneg fun w ↦ ?_
    simp only [heₘ, he, F]
    exact hl.integral_line_mul_leviForm_nonneg Ω.isOpen hu hpos hbdd χ.contDiff
      χ.hasCompactSupport χ.tsupport_subset hχn w a ha
  rw [← integral_map_equiv eₘ F, hmap, integral_smul_nnreal_measure] at hslice
  rw [NNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul] at hslice
  exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right hslice (by exact_mod_cast hcpos)

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_highValue_annulus_map
statement:
theorem exists_highValue_annulus_map
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {u : E → ℝ} (hum : Measurable u) {D : Set E} (x : E)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hball : closedBall x R ⊆ D)
    (hu : ∀ v : E, v ≠ 0 → DiscPshOn (fun z => (u (x + z • v) : EReal))
      ((fun z : ℂ => x + z • v) ⁻¹' D))
    (m : Measure (Icc (R / 2) R × sphere (0 : E) 1)) [IsProbabilityMeasure m] :
    ∃ Ψ : (Icc (R / 2) R × sphere (0 : E) 1) → E, Measurable Ψ ∧
      (∀ s, u x ≤ u (Ψ s) ∧ ∃ z : ℂ,
        ‖z‖ = (s.1 : ℝ) ∧ Ψ s = x + z • (s.2 : E)) ∧
      m.map Ψ {y | ‖y - x‖ ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ u x ≤ u y} = 1
proof:
:= by
  let S := Icc (R / 2) R × sphere (0 : E) 1
  have hv : Measurable (fun s : S => (s.2 : E)) :=
    measurable_subtype_coe.comp measurable_snd
  have hrm : Measurable (fun s : S => (s.1 : ℝ)) :=
    measurable_subtype_coe.comp measurable_fst
  have hr : ∀ s : S, 0 < (s.1 : ℝ) :=
    fun s => (half_pos hR).trans_le s.1.property.1
  have hn : ∀ s : S, ‖(s.2 : E)‖ = 1 := fun s => by simp
  have hdisc : ∀ s : S, affineClosedDisc x (s.2 : E) (s.1 : ℝ) ⊆ D := by
    rintro s y ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    apply hball
    have hz' : ‖z‖ ≤ (s.1 : ℝ) := by simpa using hz
    simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, norm_smul, hn s] using
      hz'.trans s.1.property.2
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ, hval⟩ := exists_measurable_highValue_circlePoint hum x hv hrm hr
    (fun s => hu _ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by rw [hn s]; exact one_ne_zero))) hdisc
  refine ⟨Ψ, hΨ, hval, ?_⟩
  let K : Set E := {y | ‖y - x‖ ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ u x ≤ u y}
  have hK : MeasurableSet K :=
    (measurableSet_Icc.preimage (measurable_id.sub measurable_const).norm).inter
      (measurableSet_le measurable_const hum)
  have hmem : ∀ s, Ψ s ∈ K := by
    intro s
    obtain ⟨hhigh, z, hz, heq⟩ := hval s
    refine ⟨?_, hhigh⟩
    simp [heq, norm_smul, hz, hn s]
  change m.map Ψ K = 1
  have hpre : Ψ ⁻¹' K = univ := by
    ext s
    exact iff_of_true (hmem s) (mem_univ s)
  rw [Measure.map_apply hΨ hK, hpre, measure_univ]

name: PshLines.PSHD.lintegral_norm_complex_eq_zero
statement:
theorem lintegral_norm_complex_eq_zero [Nontrivial E] {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f)
    (h : ∫⁻ ζ : E, f ‖ζ‖ = 0) : ∫⁻ t : ℂ, f ‖t‖ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hae : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)), f r = 0 := by
    rw [lintegral_fun_norm_addHaar volume hf] at h
    have hd : (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast Module.finrank_pos.ne'
    have hb : (volume : Measure E) (ball 0 1) ≠ 0 := (measure_ball_pos _ _ one_pos).ne'
    have h0 : ∫⁻ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1)) * f r = 0 := by
      simpa [hd, hb] using h
    rw [lintegral_eq_zero_iff (by fun_prop)] at h0
    filter_upwards [h0, ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with r hr hr0
    have hpos : ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1)) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa using pow_pos (mem_Ioi.mp hr0) _
    simpa [hpos] using hr
  rw [lintegral_fun_norm_addHaar volume hf]
  have : ∫⁻ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (Module.finrank ℝ ℂ - 1)) * f r = 0 := by
    rw [lintegral_eq_zero_iff (by fun_prop)]
    filter_upwards [hae] with r hr
    simp [hr]
  rw [this, mul_zero]

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_unit_line_preimage_null
proof:
:= by
  set M := toMeasurable (volume : Measure E) N
  have hM : MeasurableSet M := measurableSet_toMeasurable _ _
  have hM0 : (volume : Measure E) M = 0 := by rw [measure_toMeasurable]; exact hN
  let g : E → ℝ≥0∞ := fun ζ ↦ M.indicator 1 (z + ζ)
  have hg : Measurable g :=
    (measurable_one.indicator hM).comp (measurable_const.add measurable_id)
  have hg0 : ∫⁻ ζ, g ζ = 0 := by
    have : ∫⁻ ζ, g ζ = (volume : Measure E) ((fun ζ ↦ z + ζ) ⁻¹' M) := by
      rw [← lintegral_indicator_one (hM.preimage (measurable_const_add z))]
      rfl
    rw [this, measure_preimage_add, hM0]
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀⟩ := exists_norm_eq E zero_le_one
  let h : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun r ↦ unitaryAverage E g ((r : ℂ) • e₀)
  have hh : Measurable h :=
    (measurable_unitaryAverage hg).comp (by fun_prop)
  have havg : ∫⁻ ζ : E, h ‖ζ‖ = 0 := by
    have := lintegral_mul_radial_eq_unitaryAverage hg (k := fun _ ↦ 1) measurable_const
    simp only [mul_one] at this
    rw [← hg0, this]
    congr 1
    funext ζ
    exact (unitaryAverage_eq_norm_smul g he₀ ζ).symm
  have hplane := lintegral_norm_complex_eq_zero hh havg
  have hcont : Continuous fun p : UnitaryGroup E × ℂ ↦
      ((p.1⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) (p.2 • e₀) := by
    fun_prop
  have hswap : ∫⁻ U : UnitaryGroup E, ∫⁻ t : ℂ,
      g (((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) (t • e₀)) ∂volume ∂unitaryHaar E = 0 := by
    rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap]
    · rw [← hplane]
      congr 1
      funext t
      change unitaryAverage E g (t • e₀) = h ‖t‖
      have ht : ‖t • e₀‖ = ‖t‖ := by rw [norm_smul, he₀, mul_one]
      simp only [h, ← ht]
      exact unitaryAverage_eq_norm_smul g he₀ _
    · exact (hg.comp hcont.measurable).aemeasurable
  have hmU := hg.comp hcont.measurable
  have hmeas := Measurable.lintegral_prod_right' (ν := (volume : Measure ℂ)) hmU
  have hae := (lintegral_eq_zero_iff hmeas).mp hswap
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := hae.exists
  refine ⟨((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) e₀, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Unitary.norm_map, he₀]
  · refine measure_mono_null (preimage_mono (subset_toMeasurable (volume : Measure E) N)) ?_
    have hpre : MeasurableSet ((fun t : ℂ ↦ z + t • ((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) e₀) ⁻¹' M) :=
      hM.preimage (by fun_prop)
    rw [← lintegral_indicator_one hpre]
    simp only [g, Function.comp_def, map_smul, Pi.zero_apply] at hU
    exact hU

name: PshLines.PSHD.chartParameter_finrank
statement:
theorem chartParameter_finrank {e : E} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (ℝ × (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ) =
      2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have he0 : e ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by rw [he]; exact one_ne_zero)
  have h := (ℂ ∙ e).finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal
  rw [finrank_span_singleton he0] at h
  rw [Module.finrank_prod, Module.finrank_self,
    ← Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℝ ℂ (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ, Complex.finrank_real_complex]
  omega

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_uniform_highValue_star
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_highValue_star
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (hn : 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℂ E) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ C : ℝ≥0∞, C < ⊤ ∧ ∀ (u : E → ℝ), Measurable u →
      ∀ (D : Set E) (x : E), closedBall x R ⊆ D →
      (∀ v : E, v ≠ 0 → DiscPshOn (fun z => (u (x + z • v) : EReal))
        ((fun z : ℂ => x + z • v) ⁻¹' D)) →
      ∃ μ : Measure E, IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧
        μ {y | ‖y - x‖ ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ u x ≤ u y} = 1 ∧
        rieszEnergy (2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) : ℕ) μ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial E := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := ℂ) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_ne (0 : E)
  have he := NormedSpace.norm_normalize hv
  refine exists_uniform_highValue_star_of_unit he ?_ ?_ hR
  · exact_mod_cast (show 0 < 2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) by omega)
  · rw [chartParameter_finrank he]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self (2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1))

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_uniform_highValue_star_of_components
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_highValue_star_of_components
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (hn : 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℂ E) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ C : ℝ≥0∞, C < ⊤ ∧ ∀ (u : E → ℝ), Measurable u →
      ∀ (D : Set E), IsOpen D → ∀ (x : E), closedBall x R ⊆ D →
      (∀ v : E, v ≠ 0 → ∀ z ∈ ((fun t : ℂ => x + t • v) ⁻¹' D),
        DiscPshOn (fun t => (u (x + t • v) : EReal))
          (connectedComponentIn ((fun t : ℂ => x + t • v) ⁻¹' D) z)) →
      ∃ μ : Measure E, IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧
        μ {y | ‖y - x‖ ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ u x ≤ u y} = 1 ∧
        rieszEnergy (2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) : ℕ) μ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hCt, hC⟩ := exists_uniform_highValue_star (E := E) hn hR
  refine ⟨C, hCt, ?_⟩
  intro u hum D hD x hball hu
  apply hC u hum D x hball
  intro v hv
  exact discPshOn_of_connectedComponentIn (hD.preimage (by fun_prop)) (hu v hv)

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.coe_le_of_ae_le
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.coe_le_of_ae_le {u : E → ℝ} {v : E → EReal} {D : Set E}
    (hD : IsOpen D) (hl : LineSubharmonicOn u D) (hu : Measurable u)
    (hbdd : ∀ p ∈ D, ∃ r > 0, BddAbove (u '' ball p r))
    (hv : UpperSemicontinuousOn v D) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hae : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.restrict D, (u y : EReal) ≤ v y) :
    ∀ x ∈ D, (u x : EReal) ≤ v x
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  by_contra hle
  have hlt : v x < u x := lt_of_not_ge hle
  obtain ⟨q, hvq, hqu⟩ := EReal.exists_rat_btwn_of_lt hlt
  have hqu' : (q : ℝ) < u x := EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp hqu
  have hvc : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, v y < ((q : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    have h := hv x hx _ hvq
    rwa [nhdsWithin_eq_nhds.mpr (hD.mem_nhds hx)] at h
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, C, hC⟩ := hbdd x hx
  have hnbhd : {y | y ∈ D ∧ v y < ((q : ℝ) : EReal) ∧ y ∈ ball x r₁} ∈ 𝓝 x := by
    filter_upwards [hD.mem_nhds hx, hvc, ball_mem_nhds x hr₁] with y hyD hyv hyB
    exact ⟨hyD, hyv, hyB⟩
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnbhd
  have hBD : ball x ε ⊆ D := fun y hy => (hεsub hy).1
  have hCb : ∀ y ∈ ball x ε, u y ≤ C := fun y hy => hC ⟨y, (hεsub hy).2.2, rfl⟩
  have huq : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.restrict (ball x ε), u y ≤ q := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset hBD hae,
      ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball] with y hy hyB
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp (hy.trans (hεsub hyB).2.1.le)
  have hlower : ENNReal.ofReal (C - q) * μ (ball 0 ε) ≤
      ∫⁻ y in ball x ε, ENNReal.ofReal (C - u y) ∂μ := by
    calc
      _ = ∫⁻ _y in ball x ε, ENNReal.ofReal (C - q) ∂μ := by
        simp [lintegral_const, μ.addHaar_ball_center x ε]
      _ ≤ _ := lintegral_mono_ae (huq.mono fun y hy => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by linarith))
  have hupper := hl.ball_deficit_le hu μ x ε C hBD hCb
  rw [mul_comm (μ (ball 0 ε))] at hupper
  have hdeficit : ENNReal.ofReal (C - q) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C - u x) :=
    (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_left (ne_of_gt (Metric.measure_ball_pos μ (0 : E) hε))
      measure_ball_ne_top).mp (hlower.trans hupper)
  have hxC : u x ≤ C := hCb x (mem_ball_self hε)
  have hreal := (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (sub_nonneg.mpr hxC)).mp hdeficit
  linarith

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.le_coe_of_plurisubharmonicOn_of_ae_le
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.le_coe_of_plurisubharmonicOn_of_ae_le {u : E → ℝ} {v : E → EReal}
    {D : Set E} (hD : IsOpen D) (hl : LineSubharmonicOn u D) (hu : Measurable u)
    (hbdd : ∀ p ∈ D, ∃ r > 0, BddAbove (u '' ball p r))
    (hv : PlurisubharmonicOn v D) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hae : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.restrict D, v y ≤ (u y : EReal)) :
    ∀ x ∈ D, v x ≤ (u x : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  by_contra hle
  have hlt : (u x : EReal) < v x := lt_of_not_ge hle
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, hdisc⟩ := hv x hx
  have hw : ((v x).toReal : EReal) = v x :=
    EReal.coe_toReal (hdisc.ne_top x hxU) (ne_bot_of_gt hlt)
  have huw : u x < (v x).toReal := EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp (hw.symm ▸ hlt)
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (hU.inter hD) x ⟨hxU, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, C₁, hC₁⟩ := hbdd x hx
  set ρ' := min (ρ / 2) r₁ with hρ'
  have hρ'pos : 0 < ρ' := lt_min (half_pos hρ) hr₁
  have hclosed : closedBall x ρ' ⊆ U ∩ D :=
    (closedBall_subset_ball ((min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (half_lt_self hρ))).trans hρsub
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := hdisc.exists_compact_upper_bound (isCompact_closedBall x ρ')
    ⟨x, mem_closedBall_self hρ'pos.le⟩ (fun y hy => (hclosed hy).1)
  set C := max (max C₁ C₂) (v x).toReal with hCdef
  have hwC : (v x).toReal ≤ C := le_max_right _ _
  have ht : ENNReal.ofReal (C - (v x).toReal) < ENNReal.ofReal (C - u x) :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by linarith)).mpr (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨r, ⟨hr, hrρ⟩, hgt⟩ := hl.exists_ball_deficit_gt hD hu μ hx C ht hρ'pos
  have hBsub : ball x r ⊆ closedBall x ρ' :=
    ball_subset_ball hrρ |>.trans ball_subset_closedBall
  have hmono : ∫⁻ y in ball x r, ENNReal.ofReal (C - u y) ∂μ ≤
      ∫⁻ y in ball x r, ((C : EReal) - v y).toENNReal ∂μ := by
    refine lintegral_mono_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset
      (fun y hy => (hclosed (hBsub hy)).2) hae] with y hy
    rw [← EReal.real_coe_toENNReal, EReal.coe_sub]
    exact EReal.toENNReal_le_toENNReal (EReal.sub_le_sub le_rfl hy)
  have hupper := hdisc.ball_deficit_le μ x r C (fun y hy => (hclosed (hBsub hy)).1)
    (fun y hy => (hC₂ y (hBsub hy)).trans
      (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _))))
  have hcenter : ((C : EReal) - v x).toENNReal = ENNReal.ofReal (C - (v x).toReal) := by
    rw [← hw, ← EReal.coe_sub, EReal.real_coe_toENNReal, EReal.toReal_coe]
  rw [hcenter] at hupper
  exact lt_irrefl _ (hgt.trans_le (hmono.trans hupper))

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.eqOn_of_ae_eq
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.eqOn_of_ae_eq {u : E → ℝ} {v : E → EReal} {D : Set E}
    (hD : IsOpen D) (hl : LineSubharmonicOn u D) (hu : Measurable u)
    (hbdd : ∀ p ∈ D, ∃ r > 0, BddAbove (u '' ball p r))
    (hv : PlurisubharmonicOn v D) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hae : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.restrict D, (u y : EReal) = v y) :
    ∀ x ∈ D, (u x : EReal) = v x
proof:
:= fun x hx =>
  le_antisymm
    (hl.coe_le_of_ae_le hD hu hbdd (PlurisubharmonicOn.upperSemicontinuousOn hv) μ
      (hae.mono fun _ h => h.le) x hx)
    (hl.le_coe_of_plurisubharmonicOn_of_ae_le hD hu hbdd hv μ (hae.mono fun _ h => h.ge) x hx)

name: PshLines.PSHD.real_ball_submean
statement:
theorem real_ball_submean {u : E → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn (fun x => (u x : EReal)) U)
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (a : E) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hB : closedBall a R ⊆ U) :
    (μ (ball a R)).toReal * u a ≤ ∫ x in ball a R, u x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hmassfin : μ (ball a R) < ⊤ := measure_ball_lt_top
  let : IsFiniteMeasure (μ.restrict (ball a R)) := ⟨by simpa using hmassfin⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hu.exists_compact_upper_bound (isCompact_closedBall a R)
    ⟨a, mem_closedBall_self hR.le⟩ hB
  have hCa : u a ≤ C := by
    exact_mod_cast hC a (mem_closedBall_self hR.le)
  have hCy (x : E) (hx : x ∈ ball a R) : u x ≤ C := by
    exact_mod_cast hC x (ball_subset_closedBall hx)
  have hU : ball a R ⊆ U := ball_subset_closedBall.trans hB
  have hint : IntegrableOn u (ball a R) μ := by
    simpa using (hu.ae_finite_and_integrableOn_ball μ a hR hB
      (EReal.coe_ne_bot (u a))).2.1
  let d : E → ℝ≥0∞ := fun x => ((C : EReal) - (u x : EReal)).toENNReal
  have hd : AEMeasurable d (μ.restrict (ball a R)) :=
    hu.aemeasurable_deficit_restrict measurableSet_ball hU C μ
  have hdfin : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict (ball a R), d x < ⊤ := by
    filter_upwards [] with x
    simp only [d, ← EReal.coe_sub, EReal.real_coe_toENNReal]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hdeq : ∫ x in ball a R, (d x).toReal ∂μ =
      (μ (ball a R)).toReal * C - ∫ x in ball a R, u x ∂μ := by
    have heq : (fun x => (d x).toReal) =ᶠ[ae (μ.restrict (ball a R))]
        (fun x => C - u x) := by
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball] with x hx
      simp [d, ← EReal.coe_sub,
        ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sub_nonneg.mpr (hCy x hx))]
    rw [integral_congr_ae heq, integral_sub (integrable_const C) hint]
    simp [integral_const, Measure.real, smul_eq_mul]
  have hmass : μ (ball (0 : E) R) = μ (ball a R) := by
    simpa using lintegral_ball_add μ (fun _ => (1 : ℝ≥0∞)) a R
  have hineq := hu.ball_deficit_le μ a R C hU
    (fun x hx => hC x (ball_subset_closedBall hx))
  have hfin : μ (ball (0 : E) R) * d a ≠ ⊤ := by
    apply ENNReal.mul_ne_top measure_ball_lt_top.ne
    simp [d, ← EReal.coe_sub]
  have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono hfin hineq
  change (∫⁻ x in ball a R, d x ∂μ).toReal ≤ _ at hreal
  rw [← integral_toReal hd hdfin, hdeq] at hreal
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_mul, hmass, d, ← EReal.coe_sub,
    EReal.real_coe_toENNReal, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sub_nonneg.mpr hCa)] at hreal
  nlinarith

name: PshLines.PSHD.le_real_ball_average
statement:
theorem le_real_ball_average {u : E → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn (fun x => (u x : EReal)) U)
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (a : E) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hB : closedBall a R ⊆ U) :
    u a ≤ (∫ x in ball a R, u x ∂μ) / (μ (ball a R)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have hm : 0 < (μ (ball a R)).toReal :=
    ENNReal.toReal_pos (ne_of_gt (measure_ball_pos μ a hR)) measure_ball_lt_top.ne
  exact (le_div_iff₀ hm).mpr (by
    simpa only [mul_comm] using real_ball_submean hu μ a hR hB)

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_real_ball_average_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_real_ball_average_bounds {u : E → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn (fun x => (u x : EReal)) U)
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (a : E) (hUa : U ∈ 𝓝 a) {b : ℝ} (hb : u a < b) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ,
      u a ≤ (∫ x in ball a r, u x ∂μ) / (μ (ball a r)).toReal ∧
      (∫ x in ball a r, u x ∂μ) / (μ (ball a r)).toReal ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  have hupper : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, u x < b := by
    have h := hu.upperSemicontinuousOn a (mem_of_mem_nhds hUa)
      (b : EReal) (EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr hb)
    rw [nhdsWithin_eq_nhds.mpr hUa] at h
    filter_upwards [h] with x hx
    exact_mod_cast hx
  have hUevent : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, x ∈ U := hUa
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hlocal⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hUevent.and hupper)
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  have hB : closedBall a r ⊆ U := by
    intro x hx
    exact (hlocal ((mem_closedBall.mp hx).trans_lt hr.2)).1
  refine ⟨le_real_ball_average hu μ a hr.1 hB, ?_⟩
  have hmassfin : μ (ball a r) < ⊤ := measure_ball_lt_top
  let : IsFiniteMeasure (μ.restrict (ball a r)) := ⟨by simpa using hmassfin⟩
  have hint : IntegrableOn u (ball a r) μ := by
    simpa using (hu.ae_finite_and_integrableOn_ball μ a hr.1 hB
      (EReal.coe_ne_bot (u a))).2.1
  have hle : (∫ x in ball a r, u x ∂μ) ≤ ∫ _x in ball a r, b ∂μ := by
    apply integral_mono_ae hint (integrable_const b)
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball] with x hx
    exact (hlocal ((mem_ball.mp hx).trans hr.2)).2.le
  have hm : 0 < (μ (ball a r)).toReal :=
    ENNReal.toReal_pos (ne_of_gt (measure_ball_pos μ a hr.1)) hmassfin.ne
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hm).mpr
  simpa [integral_const, Measure.real, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using hle

name: PshLines.PSHD.tendsto_real_ball_average
statement:
theorem tendsto_real_ball_average {u : E → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn (fun x => (u x : EReal)) U)
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (a : E) (hUa : U ∈ 𝓝 a) :
    Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (∫ x in ball a r, u x ∂μ) / (μ (ball a r)).toReal)
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (u a))
proof:
:= by
  have hsmall {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), r ∈ Ioo 0 δ := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,
      nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds hδ)] with r hr hδr
    exact ⟨hr, hδr⟩
  apply tendsto_order.mpr
  constructor
  · intro b hb
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hbds⟩ := exists_real_ball_average_bounds hu μ a hUa
      (b := u a + 1) (by linarith)
    filter_upwards [hsmall hδ] with r hr
    exact hb.trans_le (hbds r hr).1
  · intro b hb
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcb⟩ := exists_between hb
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hbds⟩ := exists_real_ball_average_bounds hu μ a hUa hc
    filter_upwards [hsmall hδ] with r hr
    exact (hbds r hr).2.trans_lt hcb

name: PshLines.PSHD.isCompact_highValue_angles
proof:
:= by
  have hsc : UpperSemicontinuous (fun t : ℝ => (u (circleMap 0 r t) : EReal)) := by
    apply upperSemicontinuousOn_univ_iff.mp
    exact hu.upperSemicontinuousOn.comp (continuous_circleMap 0 r).continuousOn
      (fun t _ => hD (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall (circleMap_mem_sphere 0 hr t)))
  have hc : IsClosed {t : ℝ | A ≤ u (circleMap 0 r t)} := by
    simpa only [preimage, mem_Ici, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff] using
      hsc.isClosed_preimage (A : EReal)
  exact isCompact_Icc.inter_right hc

name: PshLines.PSHD.measurableSet_highValue_angles
statement:
theorem measurableSet_highValue_angles
    {S E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {u : E → ℝ} (hu : Measurable u)
    {x v : S → E} {r A : S → ℝ}
    (hx : Measurable x) (hv : Measurable v)
    (hr : Measurable r) (hA : Measurable A) :
    MeasurableSet {p : S × ℝ | p.2 ∈ Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      A p.1 ≤ u (x p.1 + circleMap 0 (r p.1) p.2 • v p.1)}
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Measurable (fun p : S × ℝ => circleMap 0 (r p.1) p.2) := by
    have hcont : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => circleMap 0 q.1 q.2) := by
      unfold circleMap
      fun_prop
    exact hcont.measurable.comp ((hr.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
  exact (measurableSet_Icc.preimage measurable_snd).inter
    (measurableSet_le (hA.comp measurable_fst)
      (hu.comp ((hx.comp measurable_fst).add (hc.smul (hv.comp measurable_fst)))))

name: PshLines.PSHD.measurable_lintegral_ball_min_restrict
statement:
theorem measurable_lintegral_ball_min_restrict
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [SequentialSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X]
    [MetricSpace Y] [SecondCountableTopology Y]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure Y} {s : Set Y} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    [IsFiniteMeasure (μ.restrict s)] {f : X → Y → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hmeas : ∀ x, Measurable (fun y : s => f x y))
    (husc : ∀ y ∈ s, UpperSemicontinuous (fun x => f x y))
    {N : ℝ≥0∞} (hN : N ≠ ⊤) {r : ℝ}
    (hμ : ∀ y, μ (sphere y r) = 0) :
    Measurable (fun p : X × Y =>
      ∫⁻ y in ball p.2 r, min (f p.1 y) N ∂(μ.restrict s))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let g : X → Y → ℝ≥0∞ := fun x => s.indicator (f x)
  have hgm : ∀ x, Measurable (g x) := by
    intro x
    apply measurable_of_restrict_of_restrict_compl hs
    · convert hmeas x using 1
      funext y
      simp [g, Set.domRestrict, y.property]
    · have heq : sᶜ.domRestrict (g x) = fun _ : (sᶜ : Set Y) => (0 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
        funext y
        exact indicator_of_notMem y.property _
      rw [heq]
      exact measurable_const
  have hgu : ∀ y, UpperSemicontinuous (fun x => g x y) := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ s
    · simpa only [g, indicator_of_mem hy] using husc y hy
    · simpa only [g, indicator_of_notMem hy] using
        (upperSemicontinuous_const : UpperSemicontinuous (fun _ : X => (0 : ℝ≥0∞)))
  have hnull : ∀ y, (μ.restrict s) (sphere y r) = 0 := by
    intro y
    exact le_antisymm ((Measure.restrict_apply_le s (sphere y r)).trans_eq (hμ y)) bot_le
  have hm := measurable_lintegral_ball_min (μ := μ.restrict s) hgm hgu hN hnull
  convert hm using 1
  funext p
  apply lintegral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_restrict_mem hs)] with y hy
  simp [g, hy]

name: PshLines.PSHD.affineChart_gram_lower_bound
statement:
theorem affineChart_gram_lower_bound
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] (v w : E) :
    ‖v - w‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (1 + ‖v‖ ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖ ^ 2) - ‖(1 : ℂ) + inner ℂ v w‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hi := norm_inner_le_norm v w (𝕜 := ℂ)
  have hisq : ‖inner ℂ v w‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖v‖ ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (inner ℂ v w), norm_nonneg v, norm_nonneg w]
  rw [norm_sub_sq (𝕜 := ℂ), norm_add_sq (𝕜 := ℂ)]
  simp only [norm_one, RCLike.inner_apply, map_one, mul_one]
  change ‖v‖ ^ 2 - 2 * (inner ℂ v w).re + ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤
    (1 + ‖v‖ ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖ ^ 2) -
      (1 ^ 2 + 2 * (inner ℂ v w).re + ‖inner ℂ v w‖ ^ 2)
  nlinarith

name: PshLines.PSHD.affineChart_correlation_lower_bound
statement:
theorem affineChart_correlation_lower_bound
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    {v w : E} (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 1) (hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖v - w‖ ^ 2 / 4 ≤ 2 - 2 *
      (‖(1 : ℂ) + inner ℂ v w‖ /
        Real.sqrt ((1 + ‖v‖ ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖ ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  let D := (1 + ‖v‖ ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖ ^ 2)
  let B := ‖(1 : ℂ) + inner ℂ v w‖
  let q := B / Real.sqrt D
  have hD : 0 < D := by dsimp [D]; positivity
  have hD4 : D ≤ 4 := by
    have hv2 : ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg v]
    have hw2 : ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg w]
    calc
      D ≤ 2 * 2 := mul_le_mul (by linarith : 1 + ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2)
        (by linarith : 1 + ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2) (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = 4 := by norm_num
  have hd : 0 < Real.sqrt D := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hD
  have hd2 : Real.sqrt D ^ 2 = D := Real.sq_sqrt hD.le
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hd.le
  have hmul : q * Real.sqrt D = B := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hd.ne'
  have hg : ‖v - w‖ ^ 2 ≤ D - B ^ 2 := affineChart_gram_lower_bound v w
  have hB : B ≤ Real.sqrt D := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖v - w‖]
  have hq1 : q ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hd).mpr hB
  have hidentity : D * (1 - q ^ 2) = D - B ^ 2 := by
    calc
      D * (1 - q ^ 2) = D - (q * Real.sqrt D) ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_pow, hd2]
        ring
      _ = D - B ^ 2 := by rw [hmul]
  have hpos : 0 ≤ 1 - q ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hD4 hpos
  change ‖v - w‖ ^ 2 / 4 ≤ 2 - 2 * q
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - q)]

name: PshLines.PSHD.lintegral_fun_norm_addHaar
statement:
theorem lintegral_fun_norm_addHaar (μ : Measure V) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    ∫⁻ x, f ‖x‖ ∂μ = Module.finrank ℝ V * μ (ball 0 1) *
      ∫⁻ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (Module.finrank ℝ V - 1)) * f r
proof:
:= by
  calc ∫⁻ x, f ‖x‖ ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in ({0}ᶜ : Set V), f ‖x‖ ∂μ := by
        rw [restrict_compl_singleton]
    _ = ∫⁻ x : ({0}ᶜ : Set V), f ‖x.1‖ ∂(μ.comap (↑)) :=
        (lintegral_subtype_comap (measurableSet_singleton _).compl (fun x ↦ f ‖x‖)).symm
    _ = ∫⁻ p, f p.2.1 ∂(μ.toSphere.prod (Measure.volumeIoiPow (Module.finrank ℝ V - 1))) := by
        simpa using (μ.measurePreserving_homeomorphUnitSphereProd.lintegral_comp_emb
          (Homeomorph.measurableEmbedding _) (fun p ↦ f p.2.1))
    _ = μ.toSphere univ *
          ∫⁻ r, f r.1 ∂(Measure.volumeIoiPow (Module.finrank ℝ V - 1)) := by
        rw [lintegral_prod _ (by fun_prop)]
        exact (lintegral_const (∫⁻ r, f r.1 ∂(Measure.volumeIoiPow
          (Module.finrank ℝ V - 1)))).trans (mul_comm _ _)
    _ = _ := by
        rw [Measure.toSphere_apply_univ, Measure.volumeIoiPow,
          lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
          ← lintegral_subtype_comap measurableSet_Ioi
            (fun r : ℝ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (Module.finrank ℝ V - 1)) * f r)]
        rfl

name: PshLines.PSHD.reflection_sub_complex
statement:
theorem reflection_sub_complex {v w : E} [(ℂ ∙ (v - w))ᗮ.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (h : ‖v‖ = ‖w‖) (him : (⟪v, w⟫_ℂ).im = 0) :
    (ℂ ∙ (v - w))ᗮ.reflection v = w
proof:
:= by
  set R : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E := (ℂ ∙ (v - w))ᗮ.reflection
  suffices R v + R v = w + w by
    apply smul_right_injective E (by simp : (2 : ℂ) ≠ 0)
    simpa [two_smul] using this
  have h₁ : R (v - w) = -(v - w) :=
    Submodule.reflection_orthogonalComplement_singleton_eq_neg (v - w)
  have h₂ : R (v + w) = v + w := by
    apply Submodule.reflection_mem_subspace_eq_self
    rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_left]
    have hvw : ⟪w, v⟫_ℂ = ⟪v, w⟫_ℂ := by
      rw [← inner_conj_symm, Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr him]
    rw [inner_add_left, inner_sub_right, inner_sub_right, hvw, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K,
      inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, h]
    ring
  convert! congr_arg₂ (· + ·) h₂ h₁ using 1
  · simp
  · abel

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_linearIsometryEquiv_apply_eq
statement:
theorem exists_linearIsometryEquiv_apply_eq [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] {v w : E}
    (h : ‖v‖ = ‖w‖) : ∃ L : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E, L v = w
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : ⟪v, w⟫_ℂ = 0
  · refine ⟨(ℂ ∙ (v - w))ᗮ.reflection, reflection_sub_complex h (by simp [hz])⟩
  · set c : ℂ := ⟪v, w⟫_ℂ / ‖⟪v, w⟫_ℂ‖
    have hn : ‖⟪v, w⟫_ℂ‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz
    have hc : ‖c‖ = 1 := by
      simp [c, hn]
    have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      simp [h0] at hc
    let S : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E :=
      { LinearEquiv.smulOfNeZero ℂ E c hc0 with
        norm_map' := fun x ↦ by simp [norm_smul, hc] }
    have hS : S v = c • v := rfl
    have hnorm : ‖c • v‖ = ‖w‖ := by rw [norm_smul, hc, one_mul, h]
    have him : (⟪c • v, w⟫_ℂ).im = 0 := by
      rw [inner_smul_left]
      simp only [c, map_div₀, Complex.conj_ofReal]
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, Complex.conj_mul', ← Complex.ofReal_pow]
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_im]
    refine ⟨S.trans (ℂ ∙ (c • v - w))ᗮ.reflection, ?_⟩
    rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.trans_apply, hS]
    exact reflection_sub_complex hnorm him

name: PshLines.PSHD.unitaryAverage_apply_unitary
statement:
theorem unitaryAverage_apply_unitary (g : E → ℝ≥0∞) (V : UnitaryGroup E) (ζ : E) :
    unitaryAverage E g ((V : E →L[ℂ] E) ζ) = unitaryAverage E g ζ
proof:
:= by
  unfold unitaryAverage
  conv_rhs => rw [← lintegral_mul_left_eq_self _ V⁻¹]
  congr 1
  funext U
  simp only [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, Submonoid.coe_mul]
