name: PshLines.PSHD.unitaryAverage_eq_norm_smul
statement:
theorem unitaryAverage_eq_norm_smul (g : E → ℝ≥0∞) {e₀ : E} (he₀ : ‖e₀‖ = 1) (ζ : E) :
    unitaryAverage E g ζ = unitaryAverage E g ((‖ζ‖ : ℂ) • e₀)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_linearIsometryEquiv_apply_eq
    (v := (‖ζ‖ : ℂ) • e₀) (w := ζ) (by simp [norm_smul, he₀])
  conv_lhs => rw [← hL]
  exact unitaryAverage_apply_unitary g (Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv.symm L) _

name: PshLines.PSHD.lintegral_mul_radial_eq_unitaryAverage
statement:
theorem lintegral_mul_radial_eq_unitaryAverage {g : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable g)
    {k : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hk : Measurable k) :
    ∫⁻ ζ, g ζ * k ‖ζ‖ = ∫⁻ ζ, unitaryAverage E g ζ * k ‖ζ‖
proof:
:= by
  have hU : ∀ U : UnitaryGroup E,
      ∫⁻ ζ, g (((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) ζ) * k ‖ζ‖ = ∫⁻ ζ, g ζ * k ‖ζ‖ := by
    intro U
    set L : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E :=
      { (Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv U⁻¹).toLinearEquiv.restrictScalars ℝ with
        norm_map' := (Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv U⁻¹).norm_map }
    have hL : ∀ ζ, L ζ = ((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) ζ := fun _ ↦ rfl
    have h := (L.measurePreserving).lintegral_comp (f := fun ζ ↦ g ζ * k ‖ζ‖) (by fun_prop)
    simp only [hL, Unitary.norm_map] at h
    exact h
  calc ∫⁻ ζ, g ζ * k ‖ζ‖ = ∫⁻ U : UnitaryGroup E, ∫⁻ ζ, g ζ * k ‖ζ‖ ∂volume ∂unitaryHaar E := by
        rw [lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one]
    _ = ∫⁻ U : UnitaryGroup E, ∫⁻ ζ,
          g (((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) ζ) * k ‖ζ‖ ∂volume ∂unitaryHaar E := by
        simp_rw [hU]
    _ = _ := by
        rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap]
        · congr 1
          funext ζ
          have hm : Measurable fun U : UnitaryGroup E ↦
              g (((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) ζ) :=
            hg.comp ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_inv).clm_apply
              continuous_const).measurable
          rw [lintegral_mul_const _ hm]
          rfl
        · exact ((hg.comp measurable_unitary_inv_apply).mul
            (hk.comp (measurable_norm.comp measurable_snd))).aemeasurable

name: PshLines.PSHD.finrank_real_orthogonal_span_singleton
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, Module.finrank ℂ E = m + 1 := ⟨Module.finrank ℂ E - 1, by omega⟩
  have : Fact (Module.finrank ℂ E = m + 1) := ⟨hm⟩
  rw [finrank_real_of_complex, finrank_real_of_complex,
    Submodule.finrank_orthogonal_span_singleton (n := m) he₀, hm]
  ring

name: PshLines.PSHD.lintegral_unitaryHaar_hyperplane_eq
statement:
theorem lintegral_unitaryHaar_hyperplane_eq (hn : 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℂ E) {e₀ : E}
    (he₀ : ‖e₀‖ = 1) {g : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable g) :
    ∫⁻ U, ∫⁻ h : (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ, g (((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) h) ∂volume
        ∂unitaryHaar E =
      croftonConstant e₀ * ∫⁻ ζ, g ζ * (ENNReal.ofReal ‖ζ‖ ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have he₀' : e₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    simp [h] at he₀
  have hdim := finrank_real_orthogonal_span_singleton hn he₀'
  have h4 : 4 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E := by rw [finrank_real_of_complex]; omega
  set H := (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ
  have hH : Nontrivial H := by
    apply Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := ℝ)
    omega
  have hE : Nontrivial E := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := ℂ) (by omega)
  set φ : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun r ↦ unitaryAverage E g ((r : ℂ) • e₀) with hφ
  have hφm : Measurable φ :=
    (measurable_unitaryAverage hg).comp (by fun_prop)
  set m := Module.finrank ℝ H
  
  have hL : ∫⁻ U, ∫⁻ h : H, g (((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) h) ∂volume
        ∂unitaryHaar E =
      m * (volume : Measure H) (ball 0 1) *
        ∫⁻ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (m - 1)) * φ r := by
    rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap]
    · have : ∀ h : H, unitaryAverage E g h = φ ‖h‖ := fun h ↦ by
        rw [unitaryAverage_eq_norm_smul g he₀]
        rfl
      show ∫⁻ h : H, unitaryAverage E g h = _
      simp_rw [this]
      exact lintegral_fun_norm_addHaar _ hφm
    · exact (hg.comp ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst.inv).clm_apply
        (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)).measurable).aemeasurable
  
  have hk : Measurable fun r : ℝ ↦ (ENNReal.ofReal r ^ 2)⁻¹ := by fun_prop
  have hR : ∫⁻ ζ, g ζ * (ENNReal.ofReal ‖ζ‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ =
      Module.finrank ℝ E * (volume : Measure E) (ball 0 1) *
        ∫⁻ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (m - 1)) * φ r := by
    rw [lintegral_mul_radial_eq_unitaryAverage hg hk]
    have : ∀ ζ : E, unitaryAverage E g ζ = φ ‖ζ‖ := fun ζ ↦ by
      rw [unitaryAverage_eq_norm_smul g he₀]
    simp_rw [this]
    rw [lintegral_fun_norm_addHaar (f := fun r ↦ φ r * (ENNReal.ofReal r ^ 2)⁻¹) _
      (hφm.mul hk)]
    congr 1
    refine setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun r hr ↦ ?_
    have hr : 0 < r := hr
    have hpow : ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1)) * (ENNReal.ofReal r ^ 2)⁻¹ =
        ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (m - 1)) := by
      rw [← hdim, show m + 2 - 1 = (m - 1) + 2 by omega, pow_add,
        ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity), ENNReal.ofReal_pow hr.le, ENNReal.ofReal_pow hr.le,
        mul_assoc, ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel (pow_ne_zero _ (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hr).ne')
        (ENNReal.pow_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top), mul_one]
    rw [mul_left_comm, hpow, mul_comm]
  rw [hL, hR, croftonConstant, ← mul_assoc, ENNReal.div_mul_cancel]
  · simp only [ne_eq, mul_eq_zero, Nat.cast_eq_zero, not_or]
    exact ⟨Module.finrank_pos.ne', (isOpen_ball.measure_pos _ (nonempty_ball.mpr one_pos)).ne'⟩
  · exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by simp) measure_ball_lt_top.ne

name: PshLines.PSHD.croftonConstant_pos_ne_top
statement:
theorem croftonConstant_pos_ne_top (hn : 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℂ E) {e₀ : E} (he₀ : ‖e₀‖ = 1) :
    0 < croftonConstant e₀ ∧ croftonConstant e₀ ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have he₀' : e₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    simp [h] at he₀
  have hdim := finrank_real_orthogonal_span_singleton hn he₀'
  have h4 : 4 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E := by rw [finrank_real_of_complex]; omega
  have hH : Nontrivial (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := ℝ) (by omega)
  have hE : Nontrivial E := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := ℝ) (by omega)
  have hballH := (isOpen_ball (x := (0 : (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ)) (ε := 1)).measure_pos volume
    (nonempty_ball.mpr one_pos)
  have hballE := (isOpen_ball (x := (0 : E)) (ε := 1)).measure_pos volume
    (nonempty_ball.mpr one_pos)
  unfold croftonConstant
  constructor
  · refine ENNReal.div_pos (mul_ne_zero (by simp; omega) hballH.ne') ?_
    exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by simp) measure_ball_lt_top.ne
  · refine ENNReal.div_ne_top (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by simp) measure_ball_lt_top.ne) ?_
    exact mul_ne_zero (by simp; omega) hballE.ne'

name: PshLines.PSHD.measurable_of_open_neighborhoods
statement:
theorem measurable_of_open_neighborhoods
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {f : X → Y}
    (h : ∀ x, ∃ V : Set X, IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ Measurable (V.domRestrict f)) :
    Measurable f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose V hVo hxV hVm using h
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hEq⟩ := TopologicalSpace.isOpen_iUnion_countable V hVo
  have hcover (x : X) : ∃ i ∈ T, x ∈ V i := by
    have hx : x ∈ ⋃ i ∈ T, V i := by
      rw [hEq]
      exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x, hxV x⟩
    simpa only [mem_iUnion, exists_prop] using hx
  intro s hs
  have heq : f ⁻¹' s = ⋃ i ∈ T, Subtype.val '' ((V i).domRestrict f ⁻¹' s) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := hcover x
      exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hi, ⟨⟨x, hxi⟩, hx, rfl⟩⟩⟩
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi, y, hy, rfl⟩ := by
        simpa only [mem_iUnion, mem_image, exists_prop] using hx
      exact hy
  rw [heq]
  exact MeasurableSet.biUnion hT (fun i _ =>
    (hVo i).measurableSet.subtype_image (hVm i hs))

name: PshLines.PSHD.hopf_saturation
statement:
theorem hopf_saturation (U : Set (sphere (0 : E) 1)) :
    hopf ⁻¹' (hopf '' U) =
      ⋃ a : sphere (0 : ℂ) 1, (fun e => phaseOrbit e a) ⁻¹' U
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_image, mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hfe⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, heq⟩ := (hopf_eq_iff f e).mp hfe
    refine ⟨⟨a, by simpa using ha⟩, ?_⟩
    have h : phaseOrbit e ⟨a, by simpa using ha⟩ = f := Subtype.ext heq
    simpa only [h] using hf
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    exact ⟨phaseOrbit e a, ha, (hopf_eq_iff _ _).mpr ⟨a, by simp, rfl⟩⟩

  rw [hopf_saturation]
  apply isOpen_iUnion
  intro a
  have hc : Continuous (fun e : sphere (0 : E) 1 => phaseOrbit e a) :=
    (continuous_const.smul continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _
  exact hU.preimage hc

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_upper_bound_of_isCompact
proof:
:= by
  refine hK.induction_on (p := fun s => ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ s, u x ≤ C) ⟨0, by simp⟩
    (fun s t hst ⟨C, hC⟩ => ⟨C, fun x hx => hC x (hst hx)⟩)
    (fun s t ⟨C, hC⟩ ⟨C', hC'⟩ => ⟨max C C', fun x hx => hx.elim
      (fun hx => (hC x hx).trans (le_max_left _ _))
      (fun hx => (hC' x hx).trans (le_max_right _ _))⟩) ?_
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨r, hr, C, hC⟩ := hbdd p (hKD hp)
  exact ⟨ball p r, mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds (ball_mem_nhds p hr),
    C, fun x hx => hC ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩

name: PshLines.PSHD.locallyIntegrableOn_of_bddAbove
statement:
theorem locallyIntegrableOn_of_bddAbove {u : E → ℝ} {D : Set E} (hD : IsOpen D)
    (hu : Measurable u) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ D, 0 ≤ u x)
    (hbdd : ∀ p ∈ D, ∃ r > 0, BddAbove (u '' ball p r))
    (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] :
    LocallyIntegrableOn u D μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [locallyIntegrableOn_iff hD.isLocallyClosed]
  intro K hKD hK
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_upper_bound_of_isCompact hbdd hK hKD
  refine Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded hK.measure_lt_top.ne
    hu.aestronglyMeasurable (M := C) ?_
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hK.measurableSet] with x hx
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hpos x (hKD hx))]
  exact hC x hx

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi {Ω : Opens E} {u : E → ℝ}
    (hl : LineSubharmonicOn u Ω) (hu : Measurable u)
    (hbdd : ∀ p ∈ Ω, ∃ r > 0, BddAbove (u '' ball p r))
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] (huL : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ) :
    HasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi (regularDistribution μ u huL)
proof:
:= by
  intro v φ hφn
  obtain ⟨R, hR, K, hK, hKΩ, hφK, hdiscs⟩ :=
    exists_compact_affineClosedDisc_family φ.hasCompactSupport Ω.isOpen φ.tsupport_subset v
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_upper_bound_of_isCompact hbdd hK hKΩ
  let f : E → ℝ := K.indicator (fun x => C - u x)
  have hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ := by
    simpa only [EReal.toReal_coe] using
      locallyIntegrable_indicator_realDeficit_of_isCompact (u := fun x => (u x : EReal))
        hK hKΩ (by simpa only [EReal.toReal_coe] using huL) C
  have hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x := fun x => by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ K
    · simpa [f, hx] using hC x hx
    · simp [f, hx]
  have hD : K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - (u y : EReal)).toENNReal) =
      fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (f y) := by
    funext y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ K
    · simp only [f, indicator_of_mem hy, ← EReal.coe_sub, EReal.real_coe_toENNReal]
    · simp [f, hy]
  have hDm : Measurable (K.indicator (fun y => ((C : EReal) - (u y : EReal)).toENNReal)) := by
    rw [hD]
    exact ((measurable_const.sub hu).indicator hK.measurableSet).ennreal_ofReal
  have hφ2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 (φ : E → ℝ) :=
    φ.contDiff.of_le (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)
  have hpair := (hl.hasDiscSubmeanOn.mono hKΩ).integral_deficit_mul_leviForm_nonpos
    subset_rfl C (fun y hy => EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (hC y hy)) hDm
    (Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq hD) hf hfn φ.hasCompactSupport hφ2 hφn v hR (by
      intro r hr x hx
      exact hdiscs x (subset_closure hx) r hr.2.le)
  change (∫ x, K.indicator (fun y => C - u y) x * leviForm φ x v ∂μ) ≤ 0 at hpair
  rw [integral_indicator_deficit_mul_leviForm_testFunction huL φ hφK C v] at hpair
  exact neg_nonpos.mp hpair

name: PshLines.PSHD.measureFourier_eq_vectorFourier
statement:
theorem measureFourier_eq_vectorFourier (μ : Measure E) (ξ : E) :
    measureFourier μ ξ =
      VectorFourier.fourierIntegral Real.fourierChar μ (innerₗ E) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℂ)) ξ
proof:
:= by
  rw [measureFourier_eq_integral, Real.vector_fourierIntegral_eq_integral_exp_smul]
  simp

name: PshLines.PSHD.integral_measureFourier_mul_gaussian
statement:
theorem integral_measureFourier_mul_gaussian (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {b : ℂ} (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    (∫ ξ : E, measureFourier μ ξ * Complex.exp (-b * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2)) =
      ∫ x, (Real.pi / b) ^ (Module.finrank ℝ E / 2 : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (-Real.pi ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 / b) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hg : Integrable (fun ξ : E ↦ Complex.exp (-b * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2)) := by
    simpa using GaussianFourier.integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add hb 0 (0 : E)
  have h := VectorFourier.integral_fourierIntegral_smul_eq_flip
    (μ := μ) (ν := volume) (L := innerₗ E) (f := fun _ ↦ (1 : ℂ))
    (g := fun ξ : E ↦ Complex.exp (-b * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2))
    Real.continuous_fourierChar (by simpa using continuous_inner) (integrable_const 1) hg
  simp only [← measureFourier_eq_vectorFourier, smul_eq_mul, flip_innerₗ, one_mul] at h
  rw [h]
  congr 1
  funext x
  exact fourier_gaussian_innerProductSpace hb x

name: PshLines.PSHD.norm_smul_sub_sq_of_unit
statement:
theorem norm_smul_sub_sq_of_unit
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {e f : E} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hf : ‖f‖ = 1) (r s : ℝ) :
    ‖r • e - s • f‖ ^ 2 = (r - s) ^ 2 + r * s * ‖e - f‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_sub_sq_real, norm_sub_sq_real]
  simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs, he, hf,
    real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
  ring

name: PshLines.PSHD.annulus_chord_lower_bound
statement:
theorem annulus_chord_lower_bound
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {e f : E} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hf : ‖f‖ = 1)
    {R r s : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hr : R / 2 ≤ r) (hs : R / 2 ≤ s) :
    (r - s) ^ 2 + (R ^ 2 / 4) * ‖e - f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖r • e - s • f‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_smul_sub_sq_of_unit he hf]
  have hprod : R ^ 2 / 4 ≤ r * s := by
    calc
      R ^ 2 / 4 = (R / 2) * (R / 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ r * s := mul_le_mul hr hs (by positivity) (by linarith)
  exact add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hprod (sq_nonneg _))

name: PshLines.PSHD.chord_sq_lower_bound_inner_norm
statement:
theorem chord_sq_lower_bound_inner_norm
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    {e f : E} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hf : ‖f‖ = 1) :
    2 - 2 * ‖inner ℂ e f‖ ≤ ‖e - f‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_sub_sq (𝕜 := ℂ), he, hf]
  have h := Complex.re_le_norm (inner ℂ e f)
  change 2 - 2 * ‖inner ℂ e f‖ ≤ 1 ^ 2 - 2 * (inner ℂ e f).re + 1 ^ 2
  linarith

name: PshLines.PSHD.annulus_inner_norm_lower_bound
statement:
theorem annulus_inner_norm_lower_bound
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    {e f : E} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hf : ‖f‖ = 1)
    {R r s : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hr : R / 2 ≤ r) (hs : R / 2 ≤ s) :
    (r - s) ^ 2 + (R ^ 2 / 4) * (2 - 2 * ‖inner ℂ e f‖) ≤
      ‖(r : ℂ) • e - (s : ℂ) • f‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hchord := chord_sq_lower_bound_inner_norm he hf
  let := InnerProductSpace.rclikeToReal ℂ E
  calc
    _ ≤ (r - s) ^ 2 + (R ^ 2 / 4) * ‖e - f‖ ^ 2 :=
      add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hchord (by positivity))
    _ ≤ _ := annulus_chord_lower_bound he hf hR hr hs

name: PshLines.PSHD.annulus_complex_smul_lower_bound
statement:
theorem annulus_complex_smul_lower_bound
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    {e f : E} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hf : ‖f‖ = 1)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {z w : ℂ}
    (hz : R / 2 ≤ ‖z‖) (hw : R / 2 ≤ ‖w‖) :
    (‖z‖ - ‖w‖) ^ 2 + (R ^ 2 / 4) * (2 - 2 * ‖inner ℂ e f‖) ≤
      ‖z • e - w • f‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hip : ‖inner ℂ e f‖ ≤ 1 := by
    simpa [he, hf] using norm_inner_le_norm e f
  have hprod : R ^ 2 / 4 ≤ ‖z‖ * ‖w‖ := by
    calc
      R ^ 2 / 4 = (R / 2) * (R / 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ ‖z‖ * ‖w‖ := mul_le_mul hz hw (by positivity) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hre := Complex.re_le_norm (inner ℂ (z • e) (w • f))
  have hnorm : ‖inner ℂ (z • e) (w • f)‖ =
      ‖z‖ * ‖w‖ * ‖inner ℂ e f‖ := by
    simp [inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
  rw [hnorm] at hre
  rw [norm_sub_sq (𝕜 := ℂ), norm_smul, norm_smul, he, hf]
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hprod (show 0 ≤ 2 - 2 * ‖inner ℂ e f‖ by
    linarith)
  change _ ≤ (‖z‖ * 1) ^ 2 - 2 * (inner ℂ (z • e) (w • f)).re + (‖w‖ * 1) ^ 2
  nlinarith

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.exists_plurisubharmonicOn_ae_eq
statement:
theorem LineSubharmonicOn.exists_plurisubharmonicOn_ae_eq {u : E → ℝ} {D : Set E}
    (hD : IsOpen D) (hl : LineSubharmonicOn u D) (hu : Measurable u)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ D, 0 ≤ u x) (hbdd : ∀ p ∈ D, ∃ r > 0, BddAbove (u '' ball p r))
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] :
    ∃ v : E → EReal, PlurisubharmonicOn v D ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict D, (u x : EReal) = v x
proof:
:= by
  let Ω : Opens E := ⟨D, hD⟩
  have huL : LocallyIntegrableOn u Ω μ := locallyIntegrableOn_of_bddAbove hD hu hpos hbdd μ
  have hT := LineSubharmonicOn.hasNonnegativeDistributionalLevi_of_slices (Ω := Ω) hl hu hpos
    hbdd μ huL
  obtain ⟨v, hvPsh, hvfin, hvL, hTv⟩ := Regularization.exists_pshRepresentative μ hT
  refine ⟨v, hvPsh, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [ae_eq_of_regularDistribution_eq μ huL hvL hTv, hvfin] with x hx hfx
  rw [hx]
  exact EReal.coe_toReal hfx.1 hfx.2

name: PshLines.PSHD.volume_highValue_angles_pos
statement:
theorem volume_highValue_angles_pos
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    {u : E → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hu : DiscPshOn (fun y => (u y : EReal)) U)
    (x v : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hD : affineClosedDisc x v r ⊆ U) :
    0 < volume {t ∈ Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi) | u x ≤ u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hu.exists_disc_upper_bound x v hr.le hD
  have hCx : u x ≤ C := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp
    (hC x (center_mem_affineClosedDisc x v hr.le))
  have hp : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have hm : volume (Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) := by
    simp
  by_contra hpos
  have hzero : volume {t ∈ Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi) |
      u x ≤ u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v)} = 0 := by simpa using hpos
  have hlt : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume, t ∈ Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi) →
      u (x + circleMap 0 r t • v) < u x := by
    simpa only [ae_iff, not_forall, not_lt, exists_prop] using hzero
  have hconst : (∫⁻ _t in Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi), ENNReal.ofReal (C - u x)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * ENNReal.ofReal (C - u x) := by
    simp [mul_comm]
  have hstrict := setLIntegral_strict_mono measurableSet_Ioc
    (by rw [hm]; exact (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hp).ne')
    (hu.measurable_circle_deficit x v hr.le hD C)
    (f := fun _t : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (C - u x))
    (by rw [hconst]; exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)
    (hlt.mono fun t ht hmem => by
      simp only [← EReal.coe_sub, EReal.real_coe_toENNReal]
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff
        (sub_pos.mpr ((ht hmem).trans_le hCx))).mpr
        (sub_lt_sub_left (ht hmem) C))
  have hmean := hu.submean x v r hr hD C hC
  simp only [← EReal.coe_sub, EReal.real_coe_toENNReal] at hmean
  rw [hconst] at hstrict
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hmean) hstrict

name: PshLines.PSHD.lintegral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi
statement:
theorem lintegral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi {a c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (a - 1) * exp (-(c * t))) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / c) ^ a * Gamma a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi ha hc, ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal]
  · have := integrableOn_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow (p := 1) (s := a - 1) (b := c)
      (by linarith) one_pos hc
    simpa [neg_mul, IntegrableOn] using this
  · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    have : 0 < t := ht
    positivity

name: PshLines.PSHD.lintegral_rpow_Ioi_eq_top
statement:
theorem lintegral_rpow_Ioi_eq_top {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (a - 1)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  set L := ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (a - 1))
  have hΓ : 0 < Gamma a := Gamma_pos_of_pos ha
  set M : ℝ := L.toReal / Gamma a + 1
  have hM : 0 < M := by positivity
  set c : ℝ := (M ^ a⁻¹)⁻¹
  have hc : 0 < c := by positivity
  have hle : ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / c) ^ a * Gamma a) ≤ L := by
    rw [← lintegral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi ha hc]
    refine setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_Ioi fun t ht ↦ ?_
    have ht : 0 < t := ht
    refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
    have h1 : exp (-(c * t)) ≤ 1 := exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ t ^ (a - 1) := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have hpow : (1 / c) ^ a = M := by
    simp only [c, one_div, inv_inv]
    exact rpow_inv_rpow hM.le ha.ne'
  rw [hpow] at hle
  have := (ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal hne).mp hle
  have hlt : L.toReal < M * Gamma a := by
    simp only [M, add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hΓ.ne']
    linarith
  linarith

name: PshLines.PSHD.lintegral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_div_Ioi
statement:
theorem lintegral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_div_Ioi {a c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (-a - 1) * exp (-(c / t))) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / c) ^ a * Gamma a)
proof:
:= by
  have himage : (fun x : ℝ ↦ x⁻¹) '' Ioi 0 = Ioi 0 := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact inv_pos.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < x from hx)
    · intro hy
      exact ⟨y⁻¹, show (0 : ℝ) < y⁻¹ from inv_pos.mpr hy, inv_inv y⟩
  have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun x : ℝ ↦ x⁻¹) (-(x ^ 2)⁻¹) (Ioi 0) x :=
    fun x hx ↦ (hasDerivAt_inv (ne_of_gt hx)).hasDerivWithinAt
  have hinj : InjOn (fun x : ℝ ↦ x⁻¹) (Ioi 0) := fun x _ y _ h ↦ inv_injective h
  have h := lintegral_image_eq_lintegral_abs_deriv_mul measurableSet_Ioi hderiv hinj
    (fun t ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (a - 1) * exp (-(c * t))))
  rw [himage, lintegral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi ha hc] at h
  rw [h]
  refine setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun x hx ↦ ?_
  have hx : 0 < x := hx
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (abs_nonneg _)]
  congr 1
  rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by positivity), inv_rpow hx.le, ← rpow_neg hx.le, div_eq_mul_inv,
    ← mul_assoc, ← rpow_natCast, ← rpow_neg hx.le, ← rpow_add hx]
  congr 2
  push_cast
  ring

name: PshLines.PSHD.inv_ofReal_rpow_eq_lintegral
statement:
theorem inv_ofReal_rpow_eq_lintegral {s r : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (ENNReal.ofReal r ^ s)⁻¹ =
      ENNReal.ofReal (π ^ (s / 2) / Gamma (s / 2)) *
        ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (s / 2 - 1) * exp (-(π * r ^ 2 * t)))
proof:
:= by
  have hs2 : 0 < s / 2 := by positivity
  have hΓ : 0 < Gamma (s / 2) := Gamma_pos_of_pos hs2
  rcases hr.eq_or_lt with rfl | hr
  · simp only [ENNReal.ofReal_zero, ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos hs, ENNReal.inv_zero]
    simp only [ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, mul_zero, zero_mul,
      neg_zero, exp_zero, mul_one]
    rw [lintegral_rpow_Ioi_eq_top hs2, ENNReal.mul_top]
    simp only [ne_eq, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero, not_le]
    positivity
  · have hc : 0 < π * r ^ 2 := by positivity
    rw [lintegral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi hs2 hc, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity),
      ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_pos hr, ← ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos (by positivity)]
    congr 1
    rw [one_div, inv_rpow hc.le, mul_rpow pi_pos.le (by positivity), ← rpow_natCast,
      ← rpow_mul hr.le]
    field_simp
    ring_nf

name: PshLines.PSHD.integrable_exp_neg_mul_sq_norm
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_neg_mul_sq_norm {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    Integrable (fun ξ : E ↦ exp (-(b * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := GaussianFourier.integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add (V := E)
    (b := (b : ℂ)) (by simpa using hb) 0 (0 : E)
  refine h.norm.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ ↦ ?_)
  simp only [zero_mul, add_zero]
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_neg, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal]
  ring_nf

name: PshLines.PSHD.lintegral_prod_exp_neg_eq
statement:
theorem lintegral_prod_exp_neg_eq (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∫⁻ p : E × E, ENNReal.ofReal (exp (-(π * ‖p.1 - p.2‖ ^ 2 * t))) ∂μ.prod μ =
      ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (-(Module.finrank ℝ E / 2 : ℝ))) *
        ∫⁻ ζ, ENNReal.ofReal (‖measureFourier μ ζ‖ ^ 2 * exp (-(π / t * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  set ν := (μ.prod μ).map (fun p : E × E ↦ p.1 - p.2) with hν
  have hbt : 0 < π / t := by positivity
  have hG := integral_measureFourier_mul_gaussian ν (b := ((π / t : ℝ) : ℂ))
    (by simpa using hbt)
  simp only [hν, measureFourier_map_sub] at hG
  rw [← hν] at hG
  have hreal : ∫ ξ, ‖measureFourier μ ξ‖ ^ 2 * exp (-(π / t * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2)) =
      t ^ (Module.finrank ℝ E / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ x, exp (-(π * ‖x‖ ^ 2 * t)) ∂ν := by
    apply Complex.ofReal_injective
    rw [Complex.ofReal_mul, ← integral_complex_ofReal, ← integral_complex_ofReal]
    convert hG using 1
    · congr 1
      funext ξ
      push_cast [Complex.ofReal_exp]
      ring_nf
    · rw [← integral_const_mul]
      congr 1
      funext x
      rw [Complex.ofReal_cpow ht.le]
      have hpi : (π : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast pi_pos.ne'
      have htc : (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ht.ne'
      push_cast [Complex.ofReal_exp]
      congr 1
      · congr 1
        field_simp
      · congr 1
        field_simp
  have hint₁ : Integrable (fun x : E ↦ exp (-(π * ‖x‖ ^ 2 * t))) ν := by
    refine (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono' (by fun_prop) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (exp_pos _)]
    exact exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by
      have := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg pi_pos.le (sq_nonneg ‖x‖)) ht.le
      linarith)
  have hint₂ : Integrable (fun ξ : E ↦ ‖measureFourier μ ξ‖ ^ 2 * exp (-(π / t * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2))) := by
    refine ((integrable_exp_neg_mul_sq_norm hbt).const_mul ((μ.real univ) ^ 2)).mono'
      (by
        have := measurable_measureFourier μ
        fun_prop) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ ↦ ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    gcongr
    exact norm_measureFourier_le μ ξ
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun p : E × E ↦ p.1 - p.2) := by fun_prop
  rw [← lintegral_map (f := fun x : E ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (exp (-(π * ‖x‖ ^ 2 * t))))
      (by fun_prop) hmeas, ← hν,
    ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hint₁ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ (exp_pos _).le),
    ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hint₂
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ by positivity),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity), hreal, ← mul_assoc, ← rpow_add ht]
  simp

name: PshLines.PSHD.rieszFourierConstant_pos
statement:
theorem rieszFourierConstant_pos {d s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hsd : s < d) :
    0 < rieszFourierConstant d s
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Gamma_pos_of_pos (show 0 < s / 2 by positivity)
  have h2 := Gamma_pos_of_pos (show 0 < (d - s) / 2 by linarith)
  unfold rieszFourierConstant
  have := pi_pos
  positivity

name: PshLines.PSHD.rieszEnergy_eq_lintegral_measureFourier
statement:
theorem rieszEnergy_eq_lintegral_measureFourier (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hsd : s < Module.finrank ℝ E) :
    rieszEnergy s μ =
      ENNReal.ofReal (rieszFourierConstant (Module.finrank ℝ E) s) *
        ∫⁻ ζ, ENNReal.ofReal (‖measureFourier μ ζ‖ ^ 2 * ‖ζ‖ ^ (s - Module.finrank ℝ E))
proof:
:= by
  set d : ℝ := (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) with hd
  have hdpos : 0 < Module.finrank ℝ E := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < Module.finrank ℝ E := hs.trans hsd
    exact_mod_cast this
  have : Nontrivial E := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos hdpos
  set K : ℝ := π ^ (s / 2) / Gamma (s / 2)
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := by
    have := Gamma_pos_of_pos (show 0 < s / 2 by positivity)
    have := pi_pos
    positivity
  set a : ℝ := (d - s) / 2
  have ha : 0 < a := by simp only [a]; linarith
  have hfour := measurable_measureFourier μ
  
  have step1 : rieszEnergy s μ = ENNReal.ofReal K *
      ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ p : E × E,
        ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (s / 2 - 1) * exp (-(π * ‖p.1 - p.2‖ ^ 2 * t))) ∂μ.prod μ := by
    unfold rieszEnergy
    simp_rw [edist_dist, dist_eq_norm]
    simp_rw [inv_ofReal_rpow_eq_lintegral hs (norm_nonneg _)]
    rw [lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top]
    congr 1
    rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap]
    exact (by fun_prop : Measurable fun q : (E × E) × ℝ ↦
      ENNReal.ofReal (q.2 ^ (s / 2 - 1) * exp (-(π * ‖q.1.1 - q.1.2‖ ^ 2 * q.2)))).aemeasurable
  
  have step2 : ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ p : E × E,
        ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (s / 2 - 1) * exp (-(π * ‖p.1 - p.2‖ ^ 2 * t))) ∂μ.prod μ =
      ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ ζ,
        ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (-a - 1) * exp (-(π * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 / t)) *
          ‖measureFourier μ ζ‖ ^ 2) := by
    refine setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun t ht ↦ ?_
    have ht : 0 < t := ht
    simp_rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (rpow_nonneg ht.le _)]
    rw [lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top, lintegral_prod_exp_neg_eq μ ht,
      ← mul_assoc, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (rpow_nonneg ht.le _), ← rpow_add ht,
      ← lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top]
    congr 1
    funext ζ
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (rpow_nonneg ht.le _)]
    congr 1
    have hexp : -(π / t * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) = -(π * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 / t) := by ring
    rw [hexp]
    have hpow : s / 2 - 1 + -(d / 2) = -a - 1 := by simp only [a]; ring
    rw [hpow]
    ring
  
  have step3 : ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ ζ,
        ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (-a - 1) * exp (-(π * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 / t)) *
          ‖measureFourier μ ζ‖ ^ 2) =
      ∫⁻ ζ, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / π) ^ a * Gamma a) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (‖measureFourier μ ζ‖ ^ 2 * ‖ζ‖ ^ (s - d)) := by
    rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap (by
      exact (by fun_prop : Measurable fun q : ℝ × E ↦
        ENNReal.ofReal (q.1 ^ (-a - 1) * exp (-(π * ‖q.2‖ ^ 2 / q.1)) *
          ‖measureFourier μ q.2‖ ^ 2)).aemeasurable)]
    have hne : ∀ᵐ ζ : E ∂volume, ζ ≠ 0 := by
      simp [ae_iff, measure_singleton]
    refine lintegral_congr_ae (hne.mono fun ζ hζ ↦ ?_)
    have hζ : 0 < ‖ζ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hζ
    have hc : 0 < π * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
    simp_rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul' (sq_nonneg ‖measureFourier μ ζ‖)]
    rw [lintegral_mul_const' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top, lintegral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_div_Ioi ha hc,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity), ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
    congr 1
    have hpow : (1 / (π * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2)) ^ a = (1 / π) ^ a * ‖ζ‖ ^ (s - d) := by
      rw [one_div, mul_inv, mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity), ← one_div,
        inv_rpow (by positivity), ← rpow_natCast, ← rpow_mul hζ.le, ← rpow_neg hζ.le]
      congr 2
      simp only [a]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hpow]
    ring
  rw [step1, step2, step3, lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top, ← mul_assoc,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hK]
  rfl

name: PshLines.PSHD.measureFourier_eq_integral
statement:
theorem measureFourier_eq_integral (μ : Measure E) (ξ : E) :
    measureFourier μ ξ =
      ∫ x, Complex.exp ((-2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ x ξ : ℝ) * Complex.I) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp [measureFourier, charFun_apply, inner_smul_right, mul_comm]

name: PshLines.PSHD.measureFourier_map_orthogonalProjection
statement:
theorem measureFourier_map_orthogonalProjection (μ : Measure E)
    (H : Submodule ℝ E) [H.HasOrthogonalProjection] (ξ : H) :
    measureFourier (μ.map H.orthogonalProjectionOnto) ξ = measureFourier μ (ξ : E)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [measureFourier, charFun_apply]
  rw [integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  congr 1
  funext x
  congr 2
  simp

name: PshLines.PSHD.norm_measureFourier_le
statement:
theorem norm_measureFourier_le (μ : Measure E) (ξ : E) :
    ‖measureFourier μ ξ‖ ≤ μ.real Set.univ
proof: := norm_charFun_le _

name: PshLines.PSHD.measurable_measureFourier
statement:
theorem measurable_measureFourier (μ : Measure E) [SFinite μ]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] : Measurable (measureFourier μ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold measureFourier
  exact measurable_charFun.comp (by fun_prop)

name: PshLines.PSHD.measureFourier_eq_integral_complex
statement:
theorem measureFourier_eq_integral_complex (μ : Measure V) (ξ : V) :
    measureFourier μ ξ =
      ∫ x, Complex.exp ((-2 * Real.pi * (inner ℂ x ξ).re : ℝ) * Complex.I) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  exact measureFourier_eq_integral μ ξ

name: PshLines.PSHD.measureFourier_map_complexProjection
statement:
theorem measureFourier_map_complexProjection (μ : Measure V)
    (H : Submodule ℂ V) [H.HasOrthogonalProjection] (ξ : H) :
    measureFourier (μ.map H.orthogonalProjectionOnto) ξ = measureFourier μ (ξ : V)
proof:
:= by
  rw [measureFourier_eq_integral_complex, measureFourier_eq_integral_complex,
    integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  congr 1
  funext x
  simp

name: PshLines.PSHD.continuous_unitaryProjection
statement:
theorem continuous_unitaryProjection (e₀ : E) (U : UnitaryGroup E) :
    Continuous (unitaryProjection e₀ U)
proof:
:=
  (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto.continuous.comp (U : E →L[ℂ] E).continuous

name: PshLines.PSHD.continuous_unitaryProjection_uncurry
statement:
theorem continuous_unitaryProjection_uncurry (e₀ : E) :
    Continuous fun p : UnitaryGroup E × E ↦ unitaryProjection e₀ p.1 p.2
proof:
:=
  (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto.continuous.comp
    ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).clm_apply continuous_snd)

name: PshLines.PSHD.measurable_lintegral_measureFourier_sq
statement:
theorem measurable_lintegral_measureFourier_sq (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (e₀ : E) :
    Measurable fun U : UnitaryGroup E ↦ ∫⁻ ξ : (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ,
      ‖measureFourier μ (((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) ξ)‖ₑ ^ 2
proof:
:=
  Measurable.lintegral_prod_right' (((measurable_measureFourier μ).enorm.pow_const 2).comp
    ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst.inv).clm_apply
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)).measurable)

name: PshLines.PSHD.measureFourier_map_unitaryProjection
statement:
theorem measureFourier_map_unitaryProjection (μ : Measure E) (e₀ : E) (U : UnitaryGroup E)
    (ξ : (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ) :
    measureFourier (μ.map (unitaryProjection e₀ U)) ξ =
      measureFourier μ (((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) ξ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : μ.map (unitaryProjection e₀ U) =
      (μ.map (U : E →L[ℂ] E)).map (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto :=
    (Measure.map_map (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto.continuous.measurable
      (U : E →L[ℂ] E).continuous.measurable).symm
  rw [hmap, measureFourier_map_complexProjection, measureFourier_eq_integral_complex,
    measureFourier_eq_integral_complex, integral_map (U : E →L[ℂ] E).continuous.aemeasurable
      (by fun_prop)]
  congr 1
  funext y
  have h : inner ℂ ((U : E →L[ℂ] E) y) (ξ : E) =
      inner ℂ y (((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) ξ) := by
    rw [← Unitary.star_eq_inv, Unitary.coe_star, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,
      ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
  rw [h]

name: PshLines.PSHD.finrank_real_eq_two_mul
statement: theorem finrank_real_eq_two_mul : Module.finrank ℝ E = 2 * Module.finrank ℂ E
proof:
:=
  finrank_real_of_complex E

name: PshLines.PSHD.rieszExponent_pos_lt
statement:
theorem rieszExponent_pos_lt (hn : 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℂ E) :
    0 < ((2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧
      ((2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) < Module.finrank ℝ E
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_real_eq_two_mul]
  constructor
  · exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < 2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1))
  · exact_mod_cast (by omega : 2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) < 2 * Module.finrank ℂ E)

name: PshLines.PSHD.projectionConstant_pos_ne_top
statement:
theorem projectionConstant_pos_ne_top (hn : 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℂ E) {e₀ : E}
    (he₀ : ‖e₀‖ = 1) : 0 < projectionConstant e₀ ∧ projectionConstant e₀ ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha, hat⟩ := croftonConstant_pos_ne_top hn he₀
  obtain ⟨hs, hsd⟩ := rieszExponent_pos_lt (E := E) hn
  have hb := rieszFourierConstant_pos hs hsd
  exact ⟨ENNReal.div_pos ha.ne' ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top,
    ENNReal.div_ne_top hat (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hb).ne'⟩

name: PshLines.PSHD.lintegral_unitaryHaar_measureFourier_sq
statement:
theorem lintegral_unitaryHaar_measureFourier_sq (hn : 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℂ E) {e₀ : E}
    (he₀ : ‖e₀‖ = 1) (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    ∫⁻ U, ∫⁻ ξ : (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ, ‖measureFourier μ (((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) ξ)‖ₑ ^ 2
        ∂volume ∂unitaryHaar E =
      projectionConstant e₀ * rieszEnergy ((2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hs, hsd⟩ := rieszExponent_pos_lt (E := E) hn
  have hE : Nontrivial E := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := ℂ) (by omega)
  have hG : Measurable fun ζ : E ↦ ‖measureFourier μ ζ‖ₑ ^ 2 :=
    (measurable_measureFourier μ).enorm.pow_const 2
  rw [lintegral_unitaryHaar_hyperplane_eq hn he₀ hG,
    rieszEnergy_eq_lintegral_measureFourier μ hs hsd, projectionConstant]
  have hb := rieszFourierConstant_pos hs hsd
  have hk : ∫⁻ ζ, ‖measureFourier μ ζ‖ₑ ^ 2 * (ENNReal.ofReal ‖ζ‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ =
      ∫⁻ ζ, ENNReal.ofReal (‖measureFourier μ ζ‖ ^ 2 *
        ‖ζ‖ ^ (((2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) - Module.finrank ℝ E)) := by
    have hne : ∀ᵐ ζ : E ∂volume, ζ ≠ 0 := by
      simp [ae_iff, measure_singleton]
    refine lintegral_congr_ae (hne.mono fun ζ hζ ↦ ?_)
    have hr : 0 < ‖ζ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hζ
    have hexp : (((2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) - Module.finrank ℝ E) = -2 := by
      rw [finrank_real_eq_two_mul]
      push_cast [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℂ E)]
      ring
    dsimp only
    rw [hexp, Real.rpow_neg hr.le, Real.rpow_two, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity),
      ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos (by positivity), ENNReal.ofReal_pow hr.le,
      ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _), ofReal_norm, ofReal_norm]
  rw [hk, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc _ (ENNReal.ofReal _),
    ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hb).ne' ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top, one_mul]

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_projection_densities
statement:
theorem exists_projection_densities (hn : 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℂ E) {e₀ : E}
    (he₀ : ‖e₀‖ = 1) (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hI : rieszEnergy ((2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) μ < ⊤) :
    ∃ g : UnitaryGroup E → (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ → ℝ,
      (∀ᵐ U ∂unitaryHaar E, Measurable (g U) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ g U x) ∧ MemLp (g U) 2 ∧
        μ.map (unitaryProjection e₀ U) =
          volume.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (g U x)) ∧
        ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (g U x) ^ 2 = ∫⁻ ξ : (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ,
          ‖measureFourier μ (((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) ξ)‖ₑ ^ 2) ∧
      ∫⁻ U, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (g U x) ^ 2 ∂volume ∂unitaryHaar E =
        projectionConstant e₀ * rieszEnergy ((2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) μ
proof:
:= by
  set η : UnitaryGroup E → Measure (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ := fun U ↦ μ.map (unitaryProjection e₀ U)
  have hη : ∀ U, IsFiniteMeasure (η U) := fun U ↦ Measure.isFiniteMeasure_map _ _
  have hsq : ∀ U, ∫⁻ ξ, ‖measureFourier (η U) ξ‖ₑ ^ 2 =
      ∫⁻ ξ : (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ, ‖measureFourier μ (((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) ξ)‖ₑ ^ 2 :=
    fun U ↦ by simp_rw [η, measureFourier_map_unitaryProjection]
  have htot := lintegral_unitaryHaar_measureFourier_sq hn he₀ μ
  obtain ⟨_, hct⟩ := projectionConstant_pos_ne_top hn he₀
  have hfin : ∀ᵐ U ∂unitaryHaar E,
      ∫⁻ ξ : (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ, ‖measureFourier μ (((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) ξ)‖ₑ ^ 2 < ⊤ := by
    refine ae_lt_top ?_ (htot ▸ ENNReal.mul_ne_top hct hI.ne)
    exact Measurable.lintegral_prod_right' (((measurable_measureFourier μ).enorm.pow_const 2).comp
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst.inv).clm_apply
        (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)).measurable)
  have hmem : ∀ᵐ U ∂unitaryHaar E, MemLp (measureFourier (η U)) 2 := by
    filter_upwards [hfin] with U hU
    refine ⟨(measurable_measureFourier (η U)).aestronglyMeasurable, ?_⟩
    have h2 := lintegral_enorm_sq_eq_eLpNorm_sq (volume : Measure (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ)
      (measureFourier (η U))
    rw [hsq] at h2
    rw [h2] at hU
    refine lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr fun htop ↦ ?_
    simp [htop] at hU
  classical
  let g : UnitaryGroup E → (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ → ℝ := fun U ↦
    if h : MemLp (measureFourier (η U)) 2 then
      (exists_density_of_memLp_measureFourier (η U) h).choose else 0
  have hg : ∀ U (h : MemLp (measureFourier (η U)) 2), g U =
      (exists_density_of_memLp_measureFourier (η U) h).choose := fun U h ↦ by
    simp only [g, dif_pos h]
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [hmem] with U hU
    have := (exists_density_of_memLp_measureFourier (η U) hU).choose_spec
    rw [hg U hU]
    exact ⟨this.1, this.2.1, this.2.2.1, this.2.2.2.1, this.2.2.2.2.trans (hsq U)⟩
  · rw [← htot]
    refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [hmem] with U hU
    have := (exists_density_of_memLp_measureFourier (η U) hU).choose_spec
    rw [hg U hU, this.2.2.2.2, hsq]

name: PshLines.PSHD.isCompact_line_preimage_closedBall
statement:
theorem isCompact_line_preimage_closedBall (c : E) {v : E} (hv : v ≠ 0) (p : E) (r : ℝ) :
    IsCompact ((fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' closedBall p r)
proof:
:= by
  refine Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
    (isClosed_closedBall.preimage (by fun_prop)) ?_
  refine (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x := (0 : ℂ)) (r := (r + ‖p - c‖) / ‖v‖)).subset ?_
  intro t ht
  have hvpos : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at ht
  rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, le_div_iff₀ hvpos]
  calc ‖t‖ * ‖v‖ = ‖t • v‖ := (norm_smul t v).symm
    _ = ‖(c + t • v - p) + (p - c)‖ := by congr 1; abel
    _ ≤ ‖c + t • v - p‖ + ‖p - c‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ r + ‖p - c‖ := by linarith

name: PshLines.PSHD.convex_line_preimage_ball
statement:
theorem convex_line_preimage_ball (c v p : E) (r : ℝ) :
    Convex ℝ ((fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' ball p r)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' ball p r =
      ((LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ E v).restrictScalars ℝ) ⁻¹' ball (p - c) r := by
    ext t
    simp only [mem_preimage, mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply,
      LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]
    congr! 1
    abel_nf
  rw [h]
  exact (convex_ball _ _).linear_preimage _

name: PshLines.PSHD.LineSubharmonicOn.exists_bddAbove
proof:
:= by
  have : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  obtain ⟨R₃, hR₃, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hD p hp
  set R := R₃ / 4 with hRdef
  have hR : 0 < R := by positivity
  have hball3 : closedBall p (3 * R) ⊆ D :=
    (closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
  refine ⟨R / 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  by_contra hunb
  rw [not_bddAbove_iff] at hunb
  have hx : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ x ∈ ball p (R / 2), (j : ℝ) < u x := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hjx⟩ := hunb j
    exact ⟨x, hx, hjx⟩
  choose x hxball hxj using hx
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hstar⟩ := exists_uniform_highValue_star_of_components (E := E) hn hR
  have hμ : ∀ j, ∃ μ : Measure E, IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧
      μ {y | ‖y - x j‖ ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ u (x j) ≤ u y} = 1 ∧
      rieszEnergy (2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) : ℕ) μ ≤ C := by
    intro j
    refine hstar u hu D hD (x j) ?_ (fun v hv z hz ↦ hl (x j) v hv z hz)
    intro y hy
    apply hball3
    rw [mem_closedBall] at hy ⊢
    have := mem_ball.mp (hxball j)
    calc dist y p ≤ dist y (x j) + dist (x j) p := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ ≤ 3 * R := by linarith
  choose μ hμprob hμS hμI using hμ
  set S : ℕ → Set E := fun j ↦ {y | ‖y - x j‖ ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ u (x j) ≤ u y}
  have hSm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (S j) := fun j ↦
    (measurableSet_preimage (by fun_prop) measurableSet_Icc).inter
      (measurableSet_le measurable_const hu)
  have hSK : ∀ j, S j ⊆ closedBall p (2 * R) := by
    intro j y hy
    rw [mem_closedBall]
    have h1 := mem_ball.mp (hxball j)
    have h2 := hy.1.2
    calc dist y p ≤ dist y (x j) + dist (x j) p := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ ≤ 2 * R := by rw [dist_eq_norm]; linarith
  obtain ⟨c, v, hv, hrec⟩ := exists_affineLine_frequently_meets hn (isCompact_closedBall p (2 * R))
    hSm hSK μ hμS hC hμI
  
  set T := (fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' closedBall p (2 * R)
  set O := (fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' ball p (3 * R)
  obtain ⟨j₀, -, t₀, ht₀⟩ := hrec 0
  have ht₀T : t₀ ∈ T := hSK j₀ ht₀
  have hTO : T ⊆ O := fun t ht ↦ closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) ht
  have hOD : O ⊆ (fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' D := fun t ht ↦ hball3 (ball_subset_closedBall ht)
  have hOcomp : O ⊆ connectedComponentIn ((fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' D) t₀ :=
    (convex_line_preimage_ball c v p (3 * R)).isPreconnected.subset_connectedComponentIn
      (hTO ht₀T) hOD
  have hpsh := (hl c v hv t₀ (hOD (hTO ht₀T))).mono (hTO.trans hOcomp)
  obtain ⟨s, hsT, hmax⟩ := hpsh.upperSemicontinuousOn.exists_isMaxOn ⟨t₀, ht₀T⟩
    (isCompact_line_preimage_closedBall c hv p (2 * R))
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_gt (u (c + s • v))
  obtain ⟨j, hmj, t, ht⟩ := hrec m
  have htT : t ∈ T := hSK j ht
  have h1 : u (c + t • v) ≤ u (c + s • v) := by
    have := hmax htT
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  have h2 : u (x j) ≤ u (c + t • v) := ht.2
  have h3 : (m : ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hmj
  linarith [hxj j]

name: PshLines.PSHD.projectivePolishSpace
statement: theorem projectivePolishSpace : PolishSpace (Projectivization ℂ E)

:= by

    TopologicalSpace.metrizableSpaceMetric _
