name: PshLines.PSHD.projectiveStandardBorelSpace
statement: theorem projectiveStandardBorelSpace : StandardBorelSpace (Projectivization ℂ E)
proof:
:= by
  infer_instance

name: PshLines.PSHD.coe_truncShift
statement:
theorem coe_truncShift {φ : E → EReal} {x : E} (hx : φ x ≠ ⊤) (m : ℕ) :
    ((truncShift φ m x : ℝ) : EReal) = max (φ x) ((-(m : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) + (m : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : max (φ x) ((-(m : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_of_lt (max_lt (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hx) (EReal.coe_lt_top _))
  have h2 : max (φ x) ((-(m : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) ≠ ⊥ :=
    ne_bot_of_le_ne_bot (EReal.coe_ne_bot _) (le_max_right _ _)
  rw [truncShift, EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_toReal h1 h2]

name: PshLines.PSHD.truncShift_nonneg
statement:
theorem truncShift_nonneg {φ : E → EReal} {x : E} (hx : φ x ≠ ⊤) (m : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ truncShift φ m x
proof:
:= by
  have h := coe_truncShift hx m
  have hle : ((0 : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ max (φ x) ((-(m : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) + (m : ℝ) := by
    calc ((0 : ℝ) : EReal) = ((-(m : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) + (m : ℝ) := by
          rw [← EReal.coe_add]; simp
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add_left (le_max_right _ _) _
  rw [← h] at hle
  exact_mod_cast hle

name: PshLines.PSHD.lineSubharmonicOn_truncShift
statement:
theorem lineSubharmonicOn_truncShift {φ : E → EReal} {Ω : Set E} (htop : ∀ x ∈ Ω, φ x ≠ ⊤)
    (hl : ∀ c v : E, v ≠ 0 → ∀ z ∈ (fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' Ω,
      DiscPshOn (fun t ↦ φ (c + t • v)) (connectedComponentIn ((fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' Ω) z))
    (m : ℕ) : LineSubharmonicOn (truncShift φ m) Ω
proof:
:= by
  intro c v hv z hz
  refine (((hl c v hv z hz).max
    (discPshOn_const ((-(m : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) (EReal.coe_ne_top _) _)).add
    (discPshOn_const ((m : ℝ) : EReal) (EReal.coe_ne_top _) _)).congr ?_
  intro t ht
  have htΩ : t ∈ (fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' Ω := connectedComponentIn_subset _ _ ht
  exact (coe_truncShift (htop _ htΩ) m).symm

name: PshLines.PSHD.discPshOn_of_line_sections_of_truncShift
statement:
theorem discPshOn_of_line_sections_of_truncShift {φ : E → EReal} {Ω : Set E}
    (htop : ∀ x ∈ Ω, φ x ≠ ⊤)
    (hl : ∀ c v : E, v ≠ 0 → ∀ z ∈ (fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' Ω,
      DiscPshOn (fun t ↦ φ (c + t • v)) (connectedComponentIn ((fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' Ω) z))
    (hu : ∀ m : ℕ, DiscPshOn (fun x => ((truncShift φ m x : ℝ) : EReal)) Ω) :
    DiscPshOn φ Ω
proof:
:= by
  have hψ : ∀ m : ℕ, DiscPshOn (fun x => max (φ x) ((-(m : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal)) Ω := by
    intro m
    refine ((hu m).add (discPshOn_const ((-(m : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) (EReal.coe_ne_top _) _)).congr ?_
    intro x hx
    simp only
    rw [coe_truncShift (htop x hx), add_assoc, ← EReal.coe_add, add_neg_cancel, EReal.coe_zero,
      add_zero]
  refine ⟨htop, ?_, hasDiscSubmeanOn_of_line_sections hl⟩
  intro z hz b hb
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, (r : EReal) < b := by
    induction b using EReal.rec with
    | bot => exact absurd hb not_lt_bot
    | coe b => exact ⟨b - 1, EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr (by linarith)⟩
    | top => exact ⟨0, EReal.coe_lt_top 0⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_ge (-r)
  have hmb : ((-(m : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) < b :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (by linarith)) hr
  have hz' : max (φ z) ((-(m : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) < b := max_lt hb hmb
  filter_upwards [(hψ m).upperSemicontinuousOn z hz b hz'] with y hy
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hy

name: PshLines.PSHD.discPshOn_of_line_sections
statement:
theorem discPshOn_of_line_sections [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] {φ : E → EReal} {Ω : Set E}
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (htop : ∀ x ∈ Ω, φ x ≠ ⊤)
    (hl : ∀ c v : E, v ≠ 0 → ∀ z ∈ (fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' Ω,
      DiscPshOn (fun t ↦ φ (c + t • v)) (connectedComponentIn ((fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' Ω) z)) :
    DiscPshOn φ Ω
proof:
:=
  discPshOn_of_line_sections_of_truncShift htop hl fun m =>
    LineSubharmonicOn.discPshOn_of_nonneg hΩ (fun x hx => truncShift_nonneg (htop x hx) m)
      (lineSubharmonicOn_truncShift htop hl m)

name: PshLines.PSHD.plurisubharmonicOn_of_line_sections
statement:
theorem plurisubharmonicOn_of_line_sections [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] {φ : E → EReal}
    {Ω : Set E} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (htop : ∀ x ∈ Ω, φ x ≠ ⊤)
    (hl : ∀ c v : E, v ≠ 0 → ∀ z ∈ (fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' Ω,
      DiscPshOn (fun t ↦ φ (c + t • v)) (connectedComponentIn ((fun t : ℂ ↦ c + t • v) ⁻¹' Ω) z)) :
    UpperSemicontinuousOn φ Ω ∧ PlurisubharmonicOn φ Ω
proof:
:=
  have h := discPshOn_of_line_sections hΩ htop hl
  ⟨h.upperSemicontinuousOn, h.plurisubharmonicOn hΩ⟩

name: PshLines.PSHD.rieszEnergy_star_le
statement:
theorem rieszEnergy_star_le
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (x : E) (k : ℕ)
    (m : Measure (Icc (R / 2) R × sphere (0 : E) 1)) [SFinite m]
    {Ψ : (Icc (R / 2) R × sphere (0 : E) 1) → E} (hΨ : Measurable Ψ)
    (hcircle : ∀ s, ∃ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = (s.1 : ℝ) ∧ Ψ s = x + z • (s.2 : E)) :
    rieszEnergy (2 * k : ℕ) (m.map Ψ) ≤
      ∫⁻ p, (ENNReal.ofReal
        (((p.1.1 : ℝ) - (p.2.1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 + (R ^ 2 / 4) *
          (2 - 2 * ‖inner ℂ (p.1.2 : E) (p.2.2 : E)‖)) ^ k)⁻¹ ∂m.prod m
proof:
:= by
  rw [rieszEnergy_map_even k m hΨ]
  apply lintegral_mono
  intro p
  apply ENNReal.inv_le_inv'
  apply pow_le_pow_left'
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  obtain ⟨z, hz, heq⟩ := hcircle p.1
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hfeq⟩ := hcircle p.2
  have h := annulus_complex_smul_lower_bound
    (E := E) (e := (p.1.2 : E)) (f := (p.2.2 : E))
    (by simp) (by simp) hR
    (z := z) (w := w) (by rw [hz]; exact p.1.1.property.1)
    (by rw [hw]; exact p.2.1.property.1)
  simpa [heq, hfeq, hz, hw] using h

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_highValue_annulus_energy_bound
statement:
theorem exists_highValue_annulus_energy_bound
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {u : E → ℝ} (hum : Measurable u) {D : Set E} (x : E)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hball : closedBall x R ⊆ D)
    (hu : ∀ v : E, v ≠ 0 → DiscPshOn (fun z => (u (x + z • v) : EReal))
      ((fun z : ℂ => x + z • v) ⁻¹' D))
    (k : ℕ) (m : Measure (Icc (R / 2) R × sphere (0 : E) 1))
    [IsProbabilityMeasure m] :
    ∃ μ : Measure E, IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧
      μ {y | ‖y - x‖ ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ u x ≤ u y} = 1 ∧
      rieszEnergy (2 * k : ℕ) μ ≤
        ∫⁻ p, (ENNReal.ofReal
          (((p.1.1 : ℝ) - (p.2.1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 + (R ^ 2 / 4) *
            (2 - 2 * ‖inner ℂ (p.1.2 : E) (p.2.2 : E)‖)) ^ k)⁻¹ ∂m.prod m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ, hval, hmass⟩ := exists_highValue_annulus_map hum x hR hball hu m
  refine ⟨m.map Ψ, ?_, hmass, ?_⟩
  · exact Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hΨ.aemeasurable
  · exact rieszEnergy_star_le hR.le x k m hΨ (fun s => (hval s).2)

name: PshLines.PSHD.le_measure_recurrent
proof:
:= by
  let t : ℕ → Set X := fun m ↦ ⋃ j ≥ m, s j
  have ht : Antitone t := by
    intro m n hmn x hx
    rcases mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨j, hj⟩
    rcases mem_iUnion.mp hj with ⟨hnj, hxj⟩
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hmn.trans hnj, hxj⟩⟩
  have htm : ∀ m, MeasurableSet (t m) := fun m ↦
    MeasurableSet.iUnion fun j ↦ MeasurableSet.iUnion fun _ ↦ hs j
  have heq : {x | ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ j, m ≤ j ∧ x ∈ s j} = ⋂ m, t m := by
    ext x
    simp [t]
  rw [heq, ht.measure_iInter (fun m ↦ (htm m).nullMeasurableSet)
    ⟨0, measure_ne_top μ _⟩]
  refine le_iInf fun m ↦ (hδ m).trans (measure_mono ?_)
  intro x hx
  exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨m, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨le_rfl, hx⟩⟩

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_recurrent_of_measure_lower_bound
statement:
theorem exists_recurrent_of_measure_lower_bound {s : ℕ → Set X}
    (hs : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (s j)) {δ : ℝ≥0∞} (hδpos : 0 < δ)
    (hδ : ∀ j, δ ≤ μ (s j)) :
    ∃ x, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ j, m ≤ j ∧ x ∈ s j
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := hδpos.trans_le (le_measure_recurrent μ hs hδ)
  exact MeasureTheory.nonempty_of_measure_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hpos)

name: PshLines.PSHD.rieszEnergy_smul
statement:
theorem rieszEnergy_smul {E : Type*} [PseudoEMetricSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] (s : ℝ) (μ : Measure E) [SFinite μ] (c : ℝ≥0∞) :
    rieszEnergy s (c • μ) = c ^ 2 * rieszEnergy s μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rieszEnergy, Measure.prod_smul_left, Measure.prod_smul_right,
    lintegral_smul_measure, smul_eq_mul, pow_two, mul_assoc]

name: PshLines.PSHD.rieszEnergy_map
statement:
theorem rieszEnergy_map {S E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S]
    [PseudoEMetricSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] (s : ℝ) (m : Measure S) [SFinite m]
    {Ψ : S → E} (hΨ : Measurable Ψ) :
    rieszEnergy s (m.map Ψ) =
      ∫⁻ p : S × S, (edist (Ψ p.1) (Ψ p.2) ^ s)⁻¹ ∂m.prod m
proof:
:= by
  unfold rieszEnergy
  rw [Measure.map_prod_map m m hΨ hΨ]
  exact lintegral_map (by fun_prop) (hΨ.prodMap hΨ)

name: PshLines.PSHD.rieszEnergy_map_le_of_ae_edist_le
statement:
theorem rieszEnergy_map_le_of_ae_edist_le
    {S E : Type*} [PseudoEMetricSpace S] [MeasurableSpace S] [BorelSpace S]
    [SecondCountableTopology S] [PseudoEMetricSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E]
    [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (m : Measure S) [SFinite m]
    {Ψ : S → E} (hΨ : Measurable Ψ) {c : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hc₀ : c ≠ 0) (hctop : c ≠ ⊤)
    (hsep : ∀ᵐ p : S × S ∂m.prod m,
      c * edist p.1 p.2 ≤ edist (Ψ p.1) (Ψ p.2)) :
    rieszEnergy s (m.map Ψ) ≤ (c ^ s)⁻¹ * rieszEnergy s m
proof:
:= by
  rw [rieszEnergy_map s m hΨ]
  have hc : c ^ s ≠ 0 := by simp [ENNReal.rpow_eq_zero_iff, hc₀, hctop]
  have hct : c ^ s ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.rpow_ne_top_of_nonneg hs hctop
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ p : S × S, (c ^ s)⁻¹ * (edist p.1 p.2 ^ s)⁻¹ ∂m.prod m := by
      apply lintegral_mono_ae
      filter_upwards [hsep] with p hp
      calc
        _ ≤ ((c * edist p.1 p.2) ^ s)⁻¹ :=
          ENNReal.inv_le_inv' (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow hp hs)
        _ = _ := by rw [ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ hs,
          ENNReal.mul_inv (Or.inl hc) (Or.inl hct)]
    _ = _ := lintegral_const_mul _ (by fun_prop)

name: PshLines.PSHD.rieszEnergy_map_le_of_edist_le
statement:
theorem rieszEnergy_map_le_of_edist_le
    {S E : Type*} [PseudoEMetricSpace S] [MeasurableSpace S] [BorelSpace S]
    [SecondCountableTopology S] [PseudoEMetricSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E]
    [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (m : Measure S) [SFinite m]
    {Ψ : S → E} (hΨ : Measurable Ψ) {c : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hc₀ : c ≠ 0) (hctop : c ≠ ⊤)
    (hsep : ∀ x y, c * edist x y ≤ edist (Ψ x) (Ψ y)) :
    rieszEnergy s (m.map Ψ) ≤ (c ^ s)⁻¹ * rieszEnergy s m
proof:
:= by
  rw [rieszEnergy_map s m hΨ]
  have hc : c ^ s ≠ 0 := by simp [ENNReal.rpow_eq_zero_iff, hc₀, hctop]
  have hct : c ^ s ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.rpow_ne_top_of_nonneg hs hctop
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ p : S × S, (c ^ s)⁻¹ * (edist p.1 p.2 ^ s)⁻¹ ∂m.prod m := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro p
      calc
        _ ≤ ((c * edist p.1 p.2) ^ s)⁻¹ :=
          ENNReal.inv_le_inv' (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (hsep p.1 p.2) hs)
        _ = _ := by rw [ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ hs,
          ENNReal.mul_inv (Or.inl hc) (Or.inl hct)]
    _ = _ := lintegral_const_mul _ (by fun_prop)

name: PshLines.PSHD.rieszEnergy_map_even
statement:
theorem rieszEnergy_map_even {S E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] (k : ℕ) (m : Measure S) [SFinite m]
    {Ψ : S → E} (hΨ : Measurable Ψ) :
    rieszEnergy (2 * k : ℕ) (m.map Ψ) =
      ∫⁻ p : S × S, (ENNReal.ofReal (‖Ψ p.1 - Ψ p.2‖ ^ 2) ^ k)⁻¹ ∂m.prod m
proof:
:= by
  rw [rieszEnergy_map _ m hΨ]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro p
  rw [ENNReal.rpow_natCast, edist_dist, dist_eq_norm,
    ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _) 2, pow_mul]

name: PshLines.PSHD.lintegral_rieszKernel_ball_lt_top
proof:
:= by
  have hdim : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < Module.finrank ℝ E := hs.trans hd
    exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt this)
  have : Nontrivial E := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := ℝ) hdim
  have hi : IntegrableOn (fun x : E ↦ ‖x‖ ^ (-s)) (ball 0 R) μ :=
    integrableOn_ball_of_norm_le_rpow hdim hd (C := 1)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (by intro x; simp [Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg x) _)]))
      ((measurable_norm.pow_const (-s)).aestronglyMeasurable)
  have heq : (fun x : E ↦ (edist x 0 ^ s)⁻¹) =ᵐ[μ.restrict (ball 0 R)]
      (fun x : E ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (‖x‖ ^ (-s))) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae (μ.ae_ne (0 : E))] with x hx
    rw [edist_dist, dist_zero_right, ← ENNReal.rpow_neg,
      ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx)]
  rw [lintegral_congr_ae heq]
  exact hi.lintegral_lt_top

name: PshLines.PSHD.lintegral_rieszKernel_ball_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_rieszKernel_ball_le (s : ℝ) {c x : E} {R : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ ball c R) :
    (∫⁻ y in ball c R, (edist x y ^ s)⁻¹ ∂μ) ≤
      ∫⁻ z in ball (0 : E) (2 * R), (edist z 0 ^ s)⁻¹ ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lintegral_indicator measurableSet_ball]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ y, (ball (0 : E) (2 * R)).indicator
        (fun z ↦ (edist z 0 ^ s)⁻¹) (y - x) ∂μ := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ ball c R
      · have hxy : y - x ∈ ball (0 : E) (2 * R) := by
          rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right, ← dist_eq_norm]
          calc
            dist y x ≤ dist y c + dist x c := dist_triangle_right y x c
            _ < 2 * R := by linarith [mem_ball.mp hx, mem_ball.mp hy]
        simp only [indicator_of_mem hy, indicator_of_mem hxy]
        simp [edist_dist, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev]
      · simp only [indicator_of_notMem hy]
        exact bot_le
    _ = _ := by rw [lintegral_sub_right_eq_self, lintegral_indicator measurableSet_ball]

name: PshLines.PSHD.rieszEnergy_restrict_ball_lt_top
proof:
:= by
  unfold rieszEnergy
  rw [lintegral_prod _ (by fun_prop)]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ _x in ball c R,
        (∫⁻ z in ball (0 : E) (2 * R), (edist z 0 ^ s)⁻¹ ∂μ) ∂μ := by
      apply lintegral_mono_ae
      filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_ball] with x hx
      exact lintegral_rieszKernel_ball_le s hx
    _ < ⊤ := by
      rw [lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply_univ]
      exact ENNReal.mul_lt_top (lintegral_rieszKernel_ball_lt_top hs hd _) measure_ball_lt_top

name: PshLines.PSHD.normalized_restrict_ball_properties
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : μ (ball c R) ≠ 0 := (measure_ball_pos μ c hR).ne'
  have hfin : μ (ball c R) ≠ ⊤ := measure_ball_lt_top.ne
  have hmass : (μ (ball c R))⁻¹ * μ (ball c R) = 1 :=
    ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hpos hfin
  refine ⟨⟨?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Measure.smul_apply, Measure.restrict_apply_univ, smul_eq_mul] using hmass
  · simpa only [Measure.smul_apply, Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_ball,
      inter_self, smul_eq_mul] using hmass
  · rw [rieszEnergy_smul]
    exact ENNReal.mul_lt_top
      (ENNReal.pow_lt_top (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr (ENNReal.inv_ne_top.mpr hpos)))
      (rieszEnergy_restrict_ball_lt_top hs hd c R)

name: PshLines.PSHD.withDensity_apply_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem withDensity_apply_le_sqrt (ν : Measure α) {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : AEMeasurable f ν)
    {A : Set α} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    ν.withDensity f A ≤ (∫⁻ x, f x ^ 2 ∂ν) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ν A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hind : AEMeasurable (A.indicator fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞)) ν :=
    (measurable_const.indicator hA).aemeasurable
  have h := ENNReal.lintegral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq ν Real.HolderConjugate.two_two hf hind
  rw [withDensity_apply _ hA, ← lintegral_indicator hA]
  have h1 : ∫⁻ x, A.indicator f x ∂ν = ∫⁻ x, (f * A.indicator fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞)) x ∂ν := by
    congr 1
    funext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ A <;> simp [hx]
  have h2 : ∫⁻ x, (A.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞)) x) ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂ν = ν A := by
    rw [← lintegral_indicator_one hA]
    congr 1
    funext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ A <;> simp [hx]
  have h3 : ∫⁻ x, f x ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂ν = ∫⁻ x, f x ^ 2 ∂ν := by
    simp_rw [ENNReal.rpow_two]
  rw [h1]
  refine h.trans_eq ?_
  rw [h2, h3]

name: PshLines.PSHD.sq_le_lintegral_mul_lintegral
statement:
theorem sq_le_lintegral_mul_lintegral [MeasurableSpace α] (m : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure m]
    {N V : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hN : AEMeasurable N m) (hV : AEMeasurable V m) {a : ℝ≥0∞}
    (h : ∀ᵐ U ∂m, a ≤ N U ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * V U ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    a ^ 2 ≤ (∫⁻ U, N U ∂m) * ∫⁻ U, V U ∂m
proof:
:= by
  have hf : AEMeasurable (fun U ↦ N U ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) m := hN.pow_const _
  have hg : AEMeasurable (fun U ↦ V U ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) m := hV.pow_const _
  have hH := ENNReal.lintegral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq m Real.HolderConjugate.two_two hf hg
  have hsq : ∀ x : ℝ≥0∞, (x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (2 : ℝ) = x := fun x ↦ by
    rw [← ENNReal.rpow_mul]
    norm_num
  simp_rw [hsq] at hH
  have ha : a ≤ ∫⁻ U, (fun U ↦ N U ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) U * (fun U ↦ V U ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) U ∂m := by
    calc a = ∫⁻ _, a ∂m := by rw [lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one]
      _ ≤ _ := lintegral_mono_ae h
  have := ha.trans hH
  calc a ^ 2 ≤ ((∫⁻ U, N U ∂m) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∫⁻ U, V U ∂m) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ zero_le this 2
    _ = _ := by
        rw [mul_pow, ← ENNReal.rpow_natCast, ← ENNReal.rpow_natCast, ← ENNReal.rpow_mul,
          ← ENNReal.rpow_mul]
        norm_num

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_eq_add_smul_of_unitaryProjection_eq
statement:
theorem exists_eq_add_smul_of_unitaryProjection_eq (e₀ : E) (U : UnitaryGroup E)
    {c : (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ} {y : E} (h : unitaryProjection e₀ U y = c) :
    ∃ t : ℂ, y = ((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) c +
      t • ((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) e₀
proof:
:= by
  set z := (U : E →L[ℂ] E) y
  have hz : z - ((ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto z : E) ∈ (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮᗮ :=
    Submodule.sub_starProjection_mem_orthogonal z
  rw [Submodule.orthogonal_orthogonal, Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hz
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hz
  have hc : ((ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto z : E) = c := congrArg Subtype.val h
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  have hzy : ((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) z = y := by
    change ((U⁻¹ * U : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) y = y
    simp
  rw [← hzy, ← map_smul, ← map_add, ht, hc]
  congr 1
  abel

name: PshLines.PSHD.exists_affineLine_frequently_meets
statement:
theorem exists_affineLine_frequently_meets (hn : 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℂ E) {K : Set E}
    (hK : IsCompact K) {S : ℕ → Set E} (hS : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (S j)) (hSK : ∀ j, S j ⊆ K)
    (μ : ℕ → Measure E) [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ j)] (hμS : ∀ j, μ j (S j) = 1)
    {C : ℝ≥0∞} (hC : C < ⊤)
    (hI : ∀ j, rieszEnergy ((2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) (μ j) ≤ C) :
    ∃ c v : E, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ j, m ≤ j ∧ ∃ t : ℂ, c + t • v ∈ S j
proof:
:= by
  have hE : Nontrivial E := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := ℂ) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_ne (0 : E)
  set e₀ : E := ((‖w‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • w
  have he₀ : ‖e₀‖ = 1 := by
    simp only [e₀, norm_smul, Complex.norm_real, norm_inv, norm_norm]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hw)
  set H := (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ
  
  have hF : ∀ j, ∃ F ⊆ S j, IsCompact F ∧ (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) < μ j F := fun j ↦
    (hS j).exists_lt_isCompact_of_ne_top (by simp [hμS j]) (by rw [hμS j]; norm_num)
  choose F hFS hFc hFμ using hF
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hK.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : E)
  set B : Set H := closedBall 0 M
  set lam : Measure (UnitaryGroup E × H) := (unitaryHaar E).prod (volume.restrict B)
  have hBfin : volume B < ⊤ := (isCompact_closedBall (0 : H) M).measure_lt_top
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict B) := isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr hBfin.ne
  have hlam : IsFiniteMeasure lam := inferInstance
  set Φ : UnitaryGroup E × E → UnitaryGroup E × H := fun p ↦ (p.1, unitaryProjection e₀ p.1 p.2)
  have hΦ : Continuous Φ := continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_unitaryProjection_uncurry e₀)
  set I : ℕ → Set (UnitaryGroup E × H) := fun j ↦ Φ '' (univ ×ˢ F j)
  have hIc : ∀ j, IsCompact (I j) := fun j ↦ (isCompact_univ.prod (hFc j)).image hΦ
  have hIm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (I j) := fun j ↦ (hIc j).isClosed.measurableSet
  have hslice : ∀ j U, Prod.mk U ⁻¹' I j = unitaryProjection e₀ U '' F j := by
    intro j U
    ext c
    simp only [I, Φ, mem_preimage, mem_image, mem_prod, mem_univ, true_and, Prod.mk.injEq,
      Prod.exists]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨U', y, hy, rfl, hc⟩
      exact ⟨y, hy, hc⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hc⟩
      exact ⟨U, y, hy, rfl, hc⟩
  have hsliceB : ∀ j U, unitaryProjection e₀ U '' F j ⊆ B := by
    rintro j U _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have hyK := hM (hSK j (hFS j hy))
    rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hyK ⊢
    calc ‖unitaryProjection e₀ U y‖ ≤ ‖(U : E →L[ℂ] E) y‖ :=
          (ℂ ∙ e₀)ᗮ.norm_orthogonalProjectionOnto_apply_le _
      _ = ‖y‖ := Unitary.norm_map U y
      _ ≤ M := hyK
  set c₀ := projectionConstant e₀
  obtain ⟨hc₀pos, hc₀top⟩ := projectionConstant_pos_ne_top hn he₀
  set δ : ℝ≥0∞ := (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2 / (c₀ * C)
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := ENNReal.div_pos (by norm_num) (ENNReal.mul_ne_top hc₀top hC.ne)
  have hδ : ∀ j, δ ≤ lam (I j) := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨g, hgae, _⟩ := exists_projection_densities hn he₀ (μ j) ((hI j).trans_lt hC)
    set N : UnitaryGroup E → ℝ≥0∞ := fun U ↦ ∫⁻ ξ : H,
      ‖measureFourier (μ j) (((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) ξ)‖ₑ ^ 2
    set V : UnitaryGroup E → ℝ≥0∞ := fun U ↦ volume.restrict B (Prod.mk U ⁻¹' I j)
    have hNm : Measurable N := measurable_lintegral_measureFourier_sq (μ j) e₀
    have hVm : Measurable V := measurable_measure_prodMk_left (hIm j)
    have hlamI : lam (I j) = ∫⁻ U, V U ∂unitaryHaar E := Measure.prod_apply (hIm j)
    have hNint : ∫⁻ U, N U ∂unitaryHaar E ≤ c₀ * C := by
      rw [lintegral_unitaryHaar_measureFourier_sq hn he₀ (μ j)]
      gcongr
      exact hI j
    have hpt : ∀ᵐ U ∂unitaryHaar E, (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ N U ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * V U ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hgae] with U hU
      obtain ⟨hgm, -, -, hmap, hnorm⟩ := hU
      set A := unitaryProjection e₀ U '' F j
      have hA : MeasurableSet A := ((hFc j).image (continuous_unitaryProjection e₀ U)).isClosed.measurableSet
      have hVU : V U = volume A := by
        simp only [V, hslice]
        rw [Measure.restrict_apply hA, inter_eq_left.mpr (hsliceB j U)]
      calc (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ μ j (F j) := (hFμ j).le
        _ ≤ μ j (unitaryProjection e₀ U ⁻¹' A) := measure_mono (subset_preimage_image _ _)
        _ = (μ j).map (unitaryProjection e₀ U) A :=
            (Measure.map_apply (continuous_unitaryProjection e₀ U).measurable hA).symm
        _ = volume.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (g U x)) A := by rw [hmap]
        _ ≤ (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (g U x) ^ 2) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * volume A ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
            withDensity_apply_le_sqrt _ (ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp hgm).aemeasurable hA
        _ = N U ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * V U ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by rw [hnorm, hVU]
    have hsq := sq_le_lintegral_mul_lintegral (unitaryHaar E) hNm.aemeasurable hVm.aemeasurable hpt
    rw [hlamI]
    have hle : (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2 ≤ (∫⁻ U, V U ∂unitaryHaar E) * (c₀ * C) := by
      calc (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2 ≤ (∫⁻ U, N U ∂unitaryHaar E) * ∫⁻ U, V U ∂unitaryHaar E := hsq
        _ ≤ (c₀ * C) * ∫⁻ U, V U ∂unitaryHaar E := by gcongr
        _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
    exact ENNReal.div_le_of_le_mul hle
  obtain ⟨⟨U, c⟩, hrec⟩ := exists_recurrent_of_measure_lower_bound lam hIm hδpos hδ
  refine ⟨((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) c, ((U⁻¹ : UnitaryGroup E) : E →L[ℂ] E) e₀,
    ?_, fun m ↦ ?_⟩
  · intro h0
    have := Unitary.norm_map U⁻¹ e₀
    rw [h0, norm_zero, he₀] at this
    exact zero_ne_one this
  · obtain ⟨j, hmj, hj⟩ := hrec m
    have hj' : c ∈ Prod.mk U ⁻¹' I j := hj
    rw [hslice] at hj'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyc⟩ := hj'
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_eq_add_smul_of_unitaryProjection_eq e₀ U hyc
    exact ⟨j, hmj, t, ht ▸ hFS j hy⟩

name: PshLines.PSHD.affineLift_norm_sq
statement:
theorem affineLift_norm_sq {e v : E} (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    (hv : inner ℂ e v = 0) : ‖e + v‖ ^ 2 = 1 + ‖v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_add_sq (𝕜 := ℂ), he, hv]
  simp

name: PshLines.PSHD.affineLift_ne_zero
statement:
theorem affineLift_ne_zero {e v : E} (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    (hv : inner ℂ e v = 0) : e + v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := affineLift_norm_sq he hv
  rw [h, norm_zero] at this
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖v‖]

name: PshLines.PSHD.normalized_affineLift_inner_norm
statement:
theorem normalized_affineLift_inner_norm {e v w : E} (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    (hv : inner ℂ e v = 0) (hw : inner ℂ e w = 0) :
    ‖inner ℂ (NormedSpace.normalize (e + v)) (NormedSpace.normalize (e + w))‖ =
      ‖(1 : ℂ) + inner ℂ v w‖ /
        Real.sqrt ((1 + ‖v‖ ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖ ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hve : inner ℂ v e = 0 := (inner_eq_zero_symm).mpr hv
  have hi : inner ℂ (e + v) (e + w) = 1 + inner ℂ v w := by
    simp [inner_add_left, inner_add_right, hw, hve,
      inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, he]
  have hd : Real.sqrt ((1 + ‖v‖ ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖ ^ 2)) =
      ‖e + v‖ * ‖e + w‖ := by
    rw [← affineLift_norm_sq he hv, ← affineLift_norm_sq he hw,
      ← mul_pow, Real.sqrt_sq (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))]
  simp only [NormedSpace.normalize, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := ℂ),
    inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, norm_mul, hi, hd]
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]

name: PshLines.PSHD.normalized_affineLift_correlation_lower_bound
statement:
theorem normalized_affineLift_correlation_lower_bound {e v w : E}
    (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hv : inner ℂ e v = 0) (hw : inner ℂ e w = 0)
    (hv1 : ‖v‖ ≤ 1) (hw1 : ‖w‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖v - w‖ ^ 2 / 4 ≤ 2 - 2 *
      ‖inner ℂ (NormedSpace.normalize (e + v)) (NormedSpace.normalize (e + w))‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalized_affineLift_inner_norm he hv hw]
  exact affineChart_correlation_lower_bound hv1 hw1

name: PshLines.PSHD.normalized_affineLift_annulus_lower_bound
statement:
theorem normalized_affineLift_annulus_lower_bound {e v w : E}
    (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hv : inner ℂ e v = 0) (hw : inner ℂ e w = 0)
    (hv1 : ‖v‖ ≤ 1) (hw1 : ‖w‖ ≤ 1)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {z t : ℂ}
    (hz : R / 2 ≤ ‖z‖) (ht : R / 2 ≤ ‖t‖) :
    (‖z‖ - ‖t‖) ^ 2 + (R ^ 2 / 16) * ‖v - w‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖z • NormedSpace.normalize (e + v) -
        t • NormedSpace.normalize (e + w)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsep := annulus_complex_smul_lower_bound
    (NormedSpace.norm_normalize (affineLift_ne_zero he hv))
    (NormedSpace.norm_normalize (affineLift_ne_zero he hw)) hR hz ht
  have hc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (normalized_affineLift_correlation_lower_bound he hv hw hv1 hw1)
    (show 0 ≤ R ^ 2 / 4 by positivity)
  nlinarith

name: PshLines.PSHD.normalized_affineLift_max_lower_bound
statement:
theorem normalized_affineLift_max_lower_bound {e v w : E}
    (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hv : inner ℂ e v = 0) (hw : inner ℂ e w = 0)
    (hv1 : ‖v‖ ≤ 1) (hw1 : ‖w‖ ≤ 1)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {z t : ℂ}
    (hz : R / 2 ≤ ‖z‖) (ht : R / 2 ≤ ‖t‖) :
    min 1 (R / 4) * max |‖z‖ - ‖t‖| ‖v - w‖ ≤
      ‖z • NormedSpace.normalize (e + v) -
        t • NormedSpace.normalize (e + w)‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := normalized_affineLift_annulus_lower_bound he hv hw hv1 hw1 hR hz ht
  let d := ‖z • NormedSpace.normalize (e + v) -
    t • NormedSpace.normalize (e + w)‖
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := norm_nonneg _
  have hrad : |‖z‖ - ‖t‖| ≤ d := by
    have hnon : 0 ≤ (R ^ 2 / 16) * ‖v - w‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
    nlinarith [sq_abs (‖z‖ - ‖t‖), abs_nonneg (‖z‖ - ‖t‖)]
  have hang : R / 4 * ‖v - w‖ ≤ d := by
    have hnon : 0 ≤ R / 4 * ‖v - w‖ := by positivity
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖z‖ - ‖t‖)]
  rw [mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ (le_min (by norm_num) (by positivity))]
  apply max_le
  · calc
      _ ≤ 1 * |‖z‖ - ‖t‖| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left _ _) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ d := by simpa using hrad
  · exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) (norm_nonneg _)).trans hang

name: PshLines.Kahler.complexStructure_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem complexStructure_apply (u : E) : complexStructure u = Complex.I • u
proof: := rfl

name: PshLines.Kahler.complexStructure_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem complexStructure_involutive (u : E) :
    complexStructure (complexStructure u) = -u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [complexStructure, smul_smul, Complex.I_mul_I, neg_smul, one_smul]

name: PshLines.Kahler.fundamentalForm_self
statement: @[simp] theorem fundamentalForm_self (u : E) : fundamentalForm u u = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fundamentalForm, ← RCLike.im_to_complex, inner_self_im]

name: PshLines.Kahler.fundamentalForm_antisymm
statement:
theorem fundamentalForm_antisymm (u v : E) :
    fundamentalForm u v = - fundamentalForm v u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fundamentalForm, ← RCLike.im_to_complex]
  exact inner_im_symm u v

name: PshLines.Kahler.fundamentalForm_add_left
statement:
theorem fundamentalForm_add_left (u u' v : E) :
    fundamentalForm (u + u') v = fundamentalForm u v + fundamentalForm u' v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fundamentalForm, inner_add_left, Complex.add_im]

name: PshLines.Kahler.fundamentalForm_real_smul_left
statement:
theorem fundamentalForm_real_smul_left (r : ℝ) (u v : E) :
    fundamentalForm ((r : ℂ) • u) v = r * fundamentalForm u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fundamentalForm, inner_smul_left, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.mul_im,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero]

name: PshLines.Kahler.fundamentalForm_eq_metric_complexStructure
statement:
theorem fundamentalForm_eq_metric_complexStructure (u v : E) :
    fundamentalForm u v = metric (complexStructure u) v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fundamentalForm, metric, complexStructure, inner_smul_left, Complex.conj_I,
    neg_mul, Complex.neg_re, Complex.I_mul_re, neg_neg]

name: PshLines.Kahler.metric_eq_fundamentalForm_complexStructure
statement:
theorem metric_eq_fundamentalForm_complexStructure (u v : E) :
    metric u v = fundamentalForm u (complexStructure v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [metric, fundamentalForm, complexStructure, inner_smul_right, Complex.I_mul_im]

name: PshLines.Kahler.inner_complexStructure
statement:
theorem inner_complexStructure (u v : E) :
    inner ℂ (complexStructure u) (complexStructure v) = inner ℂ u v
proof:
:= by
  show inner ℂ (Complex.I • u) (Complex.I • v) = inner ℂ u v
  rw [inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, Complex.conj_I, ← mul_assoc, neg_mul,
    Complex.I_mul_I, neg_neg, one_mul]

name: PshLines.Kahler.metric_complexStructure
statement:
theorem metric_complexStructure (u v : E) :
    metric (complexStructure u) (complexStructure v) = metric u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [metric, inner_complexStructure]

name: PshLines.Kahler.fundamentalForm_complexStructure
statement:
theorem fundamentalForm_complexStructure (u v : E) :
    fundamentalForm (complexStructure u) (complexStructure v) = fundamentalForm u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fundamentalForm, inner_complexStructure]

name: PshLines.Kahler.metric_self
statement: @[simp] theorem metric_self (u : E) : metric u u = ‖u‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [metric, ← RCLike.re_to_complex]
  exact inner_self_eq_norm_sq u

name: PshLines.Kahler.metric_comm
statement: theorem metric_comm (u v : E) : metric u v = metric v u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [metric, ← RCLike.re_to_complex]
  exact inner_re_symm u v

name: PshLines.Kahler.fundamentalForm_complexStructure_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem fundamentalForm_complexStructure_self (u : E) :
    fundamentalForm u (complexStructure u) = ‖u‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fundamentalForm, complexStructure, inner_smul_right, Complex.I_mul_im,
    ← RCLike.re_to_complex]
  exact inner_self_eq_norm_sq u

name: PshLines.Kahler.fundamentalForm_complexStructure_self_pos
statement:
theorem fundamentalForm_complexStructure_self_pos {u : E} (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    0 < fundamentalForm u (complexStructure u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fundamentalForm_complexStructure_self]
  exact pow_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hu) 2

name: PshLines.Kahler.fubiniStudy_pointwise_kahler_compatibility
statement:
theorem fubiniStudy_pointwise_kahler_compatibility (u v : E) :
    complexStructure (complexStructure u) = -u
    ∧ fundamentalForm u v = metric (complexStructure u) v
    ∧ metric u v = fundamentalForm u (complexStructure v)
    ∧ fundamentalForm (complexStructure u) (complexStructure v) = fundamentalForm u v
    ∧ fundamentalForm u (complexStructure u) = ‖u‖ ^ 2
proof:
:=
  ⟨complexStructure_involutive u, fundamentalForm_eq_metric_complexStructure u v,
    metric_eq_fundamentalForm_complexStructure u v,
    fundamentalForm_complexStructure u v, fundamentalForm_complexStructure_self u⟩

name: PshLines.Kahler.complexStructure_mem_orthogonal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal] at hv ⊢
  intro u hu
  simp only [complexStructure, inner_smul_right, hv u hu, mul_zero]

name: PshLines.Kahler.tangent_complexStructure_invariant
statement:
theorem tangent_complexStructure_invariant (ψ : E) :
    ∀ v ∈ (Submodule.span ℂ {ψ})ᗮ, complexStructure v ∈ (Submodule.span ℂ {ψ})ᗮ
proof:
:=
  fun _ hv => complexStructure_mem_orthogonal hv

name: PshLines.Kahler.metric_linearIsometryEquiv
statement:
theorem metric_linearIsometryEquiv (f : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E) (u v : E) :
    metric (f u) (f v) = metric u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [metric, f.inner_map_map]

name: PshLines.Kahler.fundamentalForm_linearIsometryEquiv
statement:
theorem fundamentalForm_linearIsometryEquiv (f : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E) (u v : E) :
    fundamentalForm (f u) (f v) = fundamentalForm u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fundamentalForm, f.inner_map_map]

name: PshLines.Kahler.kahler_structure_isometry_invariant
statement:
theorem kahler_structure_isometry_invariant (f : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] E) (u v : E) :
    metric (f u) (f v) = metric u v ∧ fundamentalForm (f u) (f v) = fundamentalForm u v
proof:
:=
  ⟨metric_linearIsometryEquiv f u v, fundamentalForm_linearIsometryEquiv f u v⟩

name: PshLines.extDeriv_const_apply
statement:
theorem extDeriv_const_apply (c : E [⋀^Fin n]→L[𝕜] F) (x : E) :
    extDeriv (fun _ : E => c) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [extDeriv, fderiv_fun_const, ← alternatizeUncurryFinCLM_apply]
  exact map_zero _

name: PshLines.extDeriv_const
statement:
theorem extDeriv_const (c : E [⋀^Fin n]→L[𝕜] F) :
    extDeriv (fun _ : E => c) = 0
proof:
:=
  funext (extDeriv_const_apply c)

name: PshLines.Kahler.fundamentalForm_add_right
statement:
theorem fundamentalForm_add_right (u v v' : E) :
    fundamentalForm u (v + v') = fundamentalForm u v + fundamentalForm u v'
proof:
:= by
  simp [fundamentalForm, inner_add_right]

name: PshLines.Kahler.fundamentalForm_real_smul_right
statement:
theorem fundamentalForm_real_smul_right (r : ℝ) (u v : E) :
    fundamentalForm u (r • v) = r * fundamentalForm u v
proof:
:= by
  have hcast : (r • v : E) = ((r : ℂ)) • v := by
    rw [← smul_one_smul ℂ r v, Complex.real_smul, mul_one]
  rw [hcast]
  simp only [fundamentalForm, inner_smul_right, Complex.mul_im,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero]

name: PshLines.Kahler.abs_fundamentalForm_le
statement: theorem abs_fundamentalForm_le (u v : E) : |fundamentalForm u v| ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖v‖
proof:
:=
  calc |fundamentalForm u v| = |(inner ℂ u v).im| := rfl
    _ ≤ ‖(inner ℂ u v : ℂ)‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
    _ ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖v‖ := norm_inner_le_norm u v

name: PshLines.Kahler.fundamentalFormCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma fundamentalFormCLM_apply (u v : E) :
    fundamentalFormCLM u v = fundamentalForm u v

name: PshLines.Kahler.fundamentalFormMulti_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma fundamentalFormMulti_apply (v : Fin 2 → E) :
    fundamentalFormMulti v = fundamentalForm (v 0) (v 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [fundamentalFormMulti, Fin.tail]

name: PshLines.Kahler.fundamentalFormAlt_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma fundamentalFormAlt_apply (v : Fin 2 → E) :
    fundamentalFormAlt v = fundamentalForm (v 0) (v 1)
proof:
:=
  fundamentalFormMulti_apply v

name: PshLines.Kahler.extDeriv_fundamentalFormAlt
statement:
theorem extDeriv_fundamentalFormAlt (x : E) :

proof:
:=
  extDeriv_const_apply _ x
